title: Geometric Similarity in VLM Low-Level Vision Representations
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as powerful candidates for universal vision backbones, with representative architectures including autoregressive (AR) models and diffusion transformers (DiTs). Yet, adapting them efficiently for all-in-one low-level image restoration remains a challenge. Crucially, the field lacks an understanding of how VLMs organize hidden-layer representations and whether these structurally distinct paradigms share a common geometric organization for pixel-level perception. Such shared organization is a prerequisite for building highly transferable, unified restoration VLMs and adapters. In this paper, we systematically investigate representational similarity across 24 low-level tasks spanning 5 categories. We propose GeoSim, a unified four-level framework that analyzes task-conditioned representations from global similarity, local geometry, sparse feature decomposition, and topological verification perspectives. Our formulation applies to the analysis of hidden states in AR models and feature maps in DiTs across same- and cross-task/model settings. Our results reveal the organizing principles of low-level visual representations while exposing their limits in cross-task and cross-model agreement. Ultimately, GeoSim provides an interpretability lens for probing latent transferability in low-level vision and diagnosing model limitations in task- or model-specific scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoSim框架，系统分析AR与DiT两类视觉语言模型在24个低层图像复原任务中的隐层表征，从全局相似度、局部几何、稀疏特征分解和拓扑验证四个层级刻画其组织规律与跨任务/跨模型一致性。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（含自回归模型与扩散Transformer）有望成为通用视觉骨干，但高效适配到"一体化"低层图像复原仍具挑战。关键在于领域内尚不清楚VLM隐层表征如何组织，也不明确这两种结构迥异的范式是否共享统一的像素级感知几何组织；而这种共享组织是构建高可迁移、统一复原模型与适配器的前提。
AI.method: 提出GeoSim——一个统一的四层级分析框架，从全局相似度、局部几何、稀疏特征分解、拓扑验证四个视角分析任务条件化表征。该框架可应用于同任务与跨任务/跨模型设定下AR模型隐状态与DiT特征图的分析，覆盖5大类共24个低层任务。
AI.result: 揭示了低层视觉表征的组织原则，同时暴露了其在跨任务与跨模型一致性方面的局限。
AI.conclusion: GeoSim为探究低层视觉中的潜在可迁移性提供了可解释性视角，并可用于诊断任务特定或模型特定场景下的模型局限。

title: AuraForge: Scaling Security Supervision for Training Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents are now proficient enough to generate complex software applications from a single prompt. As their capabilities have grown, human oversight has increasingly shifted from line-by-line code review toward hands-off evaluation of outcomes. However, recent studies have shown that such a transition exposes a critical risk: functional correctness alone does not guarantee a secure implementation. Despite growing attention to code security, training safer coding agents remains challenging because reliable security supervision is difficult to obtain at scale from real-world repositories. We introduce AuraForge to synthesize and validate executable security tests for training secure coding agents. Our approach combines attack-oriented test synthesis, language-extensible task construction, and safeguards against reward hacking. Using AuraForge, we construct AuraGym, a multi-language and multi-CWE executable training gym: 679 executable feature-implementation tasks from 344 real-world repositories across Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript, covering 177 CWE categories. On the subset with human-written security tests, AuraForge produces about 3 times as many test cases on average and reduces the false-positive rate by 83.23%, allowing alternative secure implementations to receive correct supervision. Training Qwen3.5-4B with synthesized security tests gains larger improvements than human-written security tests (average 19.7 FuncPass and 6.2 SecPass vs. 14.9 FuncPass and 4.4 SecPass) on three languages. These results demonstrate that AuraForge provides more diverse and reliable security supervision to train secure coding agents.

AI.tldr: AuraForge 通过合成并验证可执行的安全测试，为编码智能体提供可扩展的安全监督，并在多语言、多 CWE 训练环境 AuraGym 上显著提升安全编码能力。
AI.motivation: 随着编码智能体能力增强，人类监督从逐行代码审查转向结果评估，但功能正确性并不等于实现安全；而从真实代码仓库大规模获取可靠的安全监督信号十分困难，导致训练更安全的编码智能体仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出 AuraForge，结合面向攻击的测试合成、语言可扩展的任务构造以及针对奖励黑客（reward hacking）的防护机制；基于该方法构建 AuraGym——一个多语言、多 CWE 的可执行训练 gym，包含来自 344 个真实仓库的 679 个功能实现任务。训练 Qwen3.5-4B，并比较合成安全测试与人工编写安全测试的训练效果。
AI.result: 在含人工安全测试的子集上，AuraForge 平均生成约 3 倍测试用例，并将假阳性率降低 83.23%，使其他安全实现也能获得正确监督。使用合成安全测试训练 Qwen3.5-4B 的提升优于人工测试：平均 19.7 FuncPass 与 6.2 SecPass，对比 14.9 FuncPass 与 4.4 SecPass（跨三种语言）。
AI.conclusion: AuraForge 能够提供更丰富、更可靠的安全监督信号，从而有效训练更安全的编码智能体。

title: SmoothOperator: Enhancing Representations for Fine-grained Open-set Recognition via Modulated Label Smoothing
summary: Open Set Recognition (OSR) aims to enable models to accurately classify known classes while rejecting samples from unseen classes. A key challenge in OSR lies in the inability to model the unbounded distribution of unknown classes during training, often leading to the misclassification of samples from these classes. Rather than modeling unknowns, recent work shapes the feature space so that known classes are compact and well separated, and spherical representation learning methods have achieved strong results this way. Label smoothing has been identified as one of the key drivers of this success, yet it applies the same coefficient to every training sample, regardless of how well each sample is already embedded. We show that the spherical representation learning objectives used in OSR share a single alignment--uniformity structure in which labels enter only through the alignment term. Label smoothing therefore acts as an alignment dial, and a fixed coefficient sets this dial to the same value for every sample. We propose a plug-in, SmoothOperator (SmoothOP), which sets the smoothing coefficient of each sample from its \textbf{prominence}, an embedding-space signal measuring how clearly the sample's own class stands out against its strongest competing class. Our method integrates into four existing spherical representation learning methods at minimal training overhead. SmoothOP assigns strong smoothing to samples with high prominence, which reduces their alignment and relaxes their pull. On the Semantic Shift Benchmark, SmoothOP-augmented variants generally outperform their base objectives across datasets, degrees of semantic shift, and OSR post-processors, with gains of up to 4.7\% in AUROC, OSCR, and closed-set accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对开集识别（OSR）中标签平滑对所有样本使用固定系数的问题，提出即插即用的 SmoothOperator（SmoothOP），根据样本在嵌入空间中的 prominence 自适应设置平滑系数，并在多个球形表示学习方法上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: OSR 的关键挑战是训练时无法建模无界的未知类分布，容易导致未知类样本被误分类。近期工作转向塑造特征空间，使已知类紧凑且分离，其中球形表示学习效果显著；标签平滑被认为是其成功的关键因素之一，但现有方法对所有训练样本使用相同系数，忽略了各样本当前的嵌入质量差异。
AI.method: 作者指出 OSR 中的球形表示学习目标共享单一的 alignment–uniformity 结构，标签仅通过 alignment 项进入，因此标签平滑相当于一个 alignment 调节旋钮，固定系数意味着所有样本使用同一调节值。为此提出 SmoothOP，依据样本的 prominence（衡量其自身类别相对最强竞争类在嵌入空间中的显著程度）为每个样本设置平滑系数：对高 prominence 样本施加强平滑，降低其 alignment 并放松拉近力度。该方法可集成到四种现有球形表示学习方法中，训练开销极小。
AI.result: 在 Semantic Shift Benchmark 上，SmoothOP 增强的变体在多数情况下优于其基础目标，跨数据集、不同语义偏移程度以及多种 OSR 后处理方式均表现稳健，AUROC、OSCR 和闭集准确率最高提升 4.7%。
AI.conclusion: 标签平滑在球形表示学习中可理解为按样本调节 alignment 的机制，固定系数并非最优；基于 prominence 的自适应平滑是一种通用、低开销的改进策略，能有效提升现有 OSR 方法的性能。

title: Child-Adapted Structured Phonological Representations for Interpretable Speech Sound Analysis
summary: Structured phonological representations provide an interpretable alternative to generic speech embeddings, but existing models are largely trained on adult speech. We adapt PhonoQ-2.0 to child speech using CHILDES-Aligned data and compare three alignment-supervision conditions (Adult, Adult+Child, and Child-only) across two initialization strategies (Adult PhonoQ and scratch). Generalization is evaluated against manual child-speech annotations. On 1,352 consonant targets from 58 typically developing children, child-speech adaptation improves voicing recognition across all supervision conditions, from 0.922 macro-F1 for Adult PhonoQ to 0.972--0.987 after adaptation. Manner is more sensitive to alignment supervision: Adult+Child MFA reaches 0.804 and 0.796, compared to approximately 0.70 under Adult MFA supervision. Place remains comparatively strong across systems (0.871--0.902), although per-class performance varies substantially. The velar-fronting contrast is preserved across all seven model variants. Longitudinal UltraPhonix analysis further reveals speaker-specific velar and post-alveolar changes that are largely preserved across models and broadly consistent with reported clinical progress.

AI.tldr: 将成人语音训练的 PhonoQ-2.0 迁移至儿童语音，比较三种对齐监督条件与两种初始化策略，显示儿童语音适配可提升发音特征识别（尤其浊音），方法表现受监督条件影响，并保持舌根前移对比。
AI.motivation: 结构化音系表征较通用语音嵌入更具可解释性，但现有模型多基于成人语音训练，缺乏对儿童语音的适配与泛化验证。
AI.method: 使用 CHILDES-Aligned 数据将 PhonoQ-2.0 适配至儿童语音；比较 Adult、Adult+Child、Child-only 三种对齐监督条件，以及成人 PhonoQ 初始化与从零初始化两种策略；以人工儿童语音标注评估泛化。
AI.result: 在 58 名典型发育儿童的 1,352 个辅音目标上，儿童语音适配在全部监督条件下提升浊音识别，宏平均 F1 从成人 PhonoQ 的 0.922 提升至适配后的 0.972–0.987。方式特征对监督更敏感：Adult+Child MFA 达 0.804 与 0.796，Adult MFA 约 0.70。部位特征较稳定（0.871–0.902），但各类别差异较大。舌根前移对比在七种模型变体中均保持。
AI.conclusion: 儿童语音适配可显著提升结构化音系表征的发音特征识别，尤其浊音与方式特征；UltraPhonix 纵向分析进一步显示说话人特异的舌根与齿龈后变化在模型中大体保持，并与临床进展报告基本一致。

title: Lang3DSeg: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation with Point Transformers
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Accurate 3D semantic perception is critical for safe autonomous navigation. However, supervised LiDAR segmentation remains tied to closed taxonomies and to the cost of point-wise manual annotation. Open-vocabulary methods avoid that cost by projecting the output of 2D vision-language models onto LiDAR and distilling it into a 3D network. These methods rely almost exclusively on voxel-based sparse convolutions, and point transformers have so far been limited to indoor environments, where 3D data is dense and bounded. We present Lang3DSeg, which establishes a point transformer as the backbone for annotation-free open-vocabulary segmentation of outdoor 3D LiDAR, and is trained from scratch without geometric pre-training. This training paradigm necessitates addressing the inherent noise in 2D-to-3D label projections; specifically, naive projection often suffers from depth ambiguity, where points behind an object are erroneously assigned its semantic label. We therefore composite masks using an explicit class-priority rule and truncate each projected instance at the first gap in its depth distribution, correcting the projection error directly rather than averaging it over registered sequences. Lang3DSeg achieves 52.8% mIoU on nuScenes validation and 41.4% on SemanticKITTI, the highest among published annotation-free methods on both benchmarks. Every 3D semantic segmentation is on a single LiDAR sweep, and inference operates in real-time without running vision-language models.

AI.tldr: Lang3DSeg 提出以点变换器为骨干、无需人工标注的户外 LiDAR 开放词汇 3D 语义分割方法，并针对 2D 到 3D 标签投影中的深度歧义问题设计类别优先合成与深度截断策略，在 nuScenes 与 SemanticKITTI 上取得无标注方法中的最优结果。
AI.motivation: 精确的 3D 语义感知对自主导航安全至关重要，但监督式 LiDAR 分割受限于封闭类别体系和逐点人工标注的高成本。现有开放词汇方法虽通过将 2D 视觉语言模型输出投影到 LiDAR 并蒸馏到 3D 网络来规避标注成本，却几乎完全依赖体素稀疏卷积，点变换器则仅局限于数据稠密且有界的室内场景。
AI.method: 以点变换器作为户外 3D LiDAR 无标注开放词汇分割的骨干网络，且不进行几何预训练、从零训练。针对 2D 到 3D 标签投影的固有噪声（如物体后方点因深度歧义被错误赋予其语义标签），采用显式类别优先规则合成掩码，并在每个投影实例深度分布的首个间隙处截断，直接修正投影误差而非在配准序列上平均。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 验证集上达到 52.8% mIoU，在 SemanticKITTI 上达到 41.4%，均为已发表无标注方法在两个基准上的最优结果。
AI.conclusion: Lang3DSeg 验证了点变换器可用于户外 LiDAR 的开放词汇分割；每次 3D 语义分割基于单帧 LiDAR 扫描，推理可实时进行且无需运行视觉语言模型，为低成本、开放类别的 3D 语义感知提供了有效方案。

title: CtrlWAM: Controllable World Action Models with Aligned Intent and Foresight
summary: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict actions (intent) and visual future (foresight). Standard training adds noise to recorded actions and video simultaneously, but such training paradigms introduce a mismatch: perturbed actions imply counterfactual future visual, while the noised video remains tied to the GT recording. In low-noise regime, the scene geometry and even the dynamic behavior remain clearly visible from the noisy future frames despite the added noise. We present CtrlWAM, which executes perturbed actions in a simulator and pairs them with their noised visual consequences for joint WAM learning. To accommodate the different denoising requirements of video and actions, we introduce warped video--action noise schedules that aim to keep visual layout responsive as action predictions evolve. We further extend the action interface from ego-only control to a variable number of agent streams, allowing a unified model to represent predicted or commanded futures for multiple agents. Driving experiments show more accurate action forecasts, closer agreement between generated video and actions, and better following of supplied commands; robotics experiments show stronger motion fidelity and controllability. Matched controls support the benefit of off-path renders for command following and manipulation fidelity. Together, these findings contribute to a more controllable world action model. Project page: https://ctrl-wam.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出CtrlWAM，通过在人机仿真器中执行扰动动作并配对其噪声化视觉结果，解决世界动作模型中动作扰动与视频噪声不匹配的问题，并引入warped噪声调度与多智能体动作接口，提升动作预测精度、视频-动作一致性与指令跟随能力。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）联合预测动作（意图）与视觉未来（预见），但标准训练对录制动作与视频同步加噪，导致输入不一致：被扰动的动作对应反事实的未来视觉，而加噪视频仍绑定于真实录制的未来。尤其在低噪声区间，噪声化未来帧仍清晰保留场景几何与动态行为，使动作与视觉之间的监督信号错配，限制模型的可控性与一致性。
AI.method: CtrlWAM在仿真器中执行被扰动的动作，并将其与对应的噪声化视觉后果配对，用于联合WAM学习，从而保证动作扰动与视觉未来在语义上一致。针对视频与动作不同的去噪需求，提出warped video-action噪声调度，使视觉布局随动作预测演进保持响应性。同时将动作接口从仅自我（ego-only）控制扩展为可变数量的智能体流，使统一模型能够表示多个智能体的预测或指令未来。通过仿真驾驶与机器人实验及匹配对照验证各设计的作用。
AI.result: 驾驶实验中，CtrlWAM实现了更准确的动作预测、生成视频与动作之间更高的一致性，以及更好地跟随给定指令；机器人实验显示更强的运动保真度与可控性。匹配对照实验支持了离轨渲染（off-path renders）对指令跟随与操作保真度的增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过将扰动动作与其仿真视觉后果配对、引入warped噪声调度并扩展至多智能体动作流，CtrlWAM缓解了动作-视觉监督错配问题，推动了更可控的世界动作模型发展。

title: MorphoBranch: A Fine-Structure-Preserving Workbench for Morphometric Analysis of Branched Cellular Structures
summary: Background and Objectives: Fluorescence-labeled cellular arbors provide readouts of neuronal and microglial morphology, but fine and weakly labeled processes are prone to fragmentation and false connections that bias skeleton-based measurements. We present MorphoBranch, a fine-structure-preserving, human-reviewable workbench for morphometry of branched cellular structures. Methods: MorphoBranch combines a deterministic Morphometry Engine with an LLM-assisted Refinement Engine. The Mor- phometry Engine implements an image-to-graph workflow integrating multiscale structural evidence extraction, hysteresis segmen- tation, evidence-constrained skeleton refinement, and graph-based morphometry. The Refinement Engine maps natural-language requests to registered actions for parameter adjustment, preview execution, metric reporting, and unsupported-request handling, while image processing and quantitative computation remain deterministic and reviewable. Results: MorphoBranch was evaluated on two public neuronal axon datasets, AxonMIP and AxonStack, and the in-house Cell- Morph dataset of microglial fluorescence images. It achieved the highest Skeleton F1 and clDice and the lowest length-estimation error among the evaluated methods on all three datasets, while also achieving the highest Dice and IoU on AxonMIP and Axon- Stack. Across 150 natural-language tasks, the Refinement Engine achieved a 94.0% end-to-end success rate. Conclusions: These results demonstrate that MorphoBranch provides a reproducible, human-reviewable workflow for mor- phometric analysis of branched cellular structures. It supports fine-structure-preserving quantification across neuronal axon and microglial fluorescence images while maintaining inspectable and reproducible analysis workflows.

AI.tldr: MorphoBranch 是一个保持精细结构、可人工复核的分支细胞结构形态计量工作台，由确定性形态计量引擎与LLM辅助精化引擎组成，在神经元轴突与微胶质数据集上均领先对比方法。
AI.motivation: 荧光标记的细胞分支结构可用于读取神经元与微胶质的形态，但细微、弱标记的突起容易断裂并产生虚假连接，从而使基于骨架的测量产生偏差，因此需要一个既保持精细结构又可人工复核的形态计量方案。
AI.method: MorphoBranch 将确定性形态计量引擎与LLM辅助精化引擎结合。形态计量引擎实现图像到图的工作流，集成多尺度结构证据提取、滞后阈值分割、证据约束的骨架精化以及基于图的形态计量；精化引擎将自然语言请求映射为已注册动作，用于参数调整、预览执行、指标报告与不支持请求处理，而图像处理与定量计算保持确定性和可复核性。
AI.result: 在两个公开神经元轴突数据集 AxonMIP、AxonStack 以及自建微胶质荧光图像数据集 CellMorph 上评估：MorphoBranch 在三个数据集上均取得最高 Skeleton F1 与 clDice 以及最低的长度估计误差，并在 AxonMIP 和 AxonStack 上取得最高 Dice 与 IoU；在 150 项自然语言任务中，精化引擎端到端成功率为 94.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 MorphoBranch 为分支细胞结构的形态计量分析提供了可复现、可人工复核的工作流，支持在神经元轴突与微胶质荧光图像中进行保持精细结构的定量分析，同时保持分析流程的可检查性与可复现性。

title: Don't Waste the Noise: Importance-Guided Perturbation Allocation under Joint Global and Local Constraints
summary: Adversarial optimization under a shared $\ell_1$ budget requires deciding not only how much perturbation to use, but also where that limited budget should be spent. This allocation problem becomes particularly important when individual input coordinates are subject to local magnitude constraints, which restrict the extent to which perturbation can be concentrated on a small number of locations. We introduce an importance-guided allocation mechanism that uses a fixed clean-gradient prior to steer perturbation toward model-sensitive regions while leaving the feasible perturbation set unchanged. A centered allocation objective encourages perturbation at above-average importance locations and discourages unnecessary expenditure elsewhere, thereby redistributing rather than enlarging the available budget. Across ten robust model--dataset configurations under a common capacity-limited threat setting, the proposed method improves attack success over matched APGD- and PMA-based baselines by $2.52$ to $17.70$ percentage points. Allocation analysis shows that these gains are accompanied by substantially greater perturbation mass in high-importance regions without increased global $\ell_1$ consumption. Mechanism ablations further show that centered non-uniform redistribution provides part of the benefit, while model-derived importance yields an additional improvement. These results identify perturbation allocation as a distinct and practically relevant dimension of adversarial optimization under shared-budget, locally constrained threat models.

AI.tldr: 提出重要性引导的扰动分配机制，在共享ℓ1预算与局部幅度约束下重新分配扰动，而非扩大预算，从而提升攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 共享ℓ1预算下的对抗优化不仅需决定扰动总量，还需决定预算的分配位置；当输入坐标受局部幅度约束时，扰动难以集中于少数位置，分配问题尤为关键。
AI.method: 利用固定干净梯度先验构建重要性引导的分配机制，将扰动导向模型敏感区域，同时保持可行扰动集不变；采用中心化分配目标，鼓励在高重要性位置施加扰动、抑制其他位置的多余开销。
AI.result: 在十个鲁棒模型—数据集配置、统一容量受限威胁设定下，相较匹配的APGD与PMA基线，攻击成功率提升2.52至17.70个百分点；分配分析显示高重要性区域扰动质量显著增加而全局ℓ1消耗未上升；消融表明中心化非均匀重分配贡献部分收益，模型导出的重要性带来额外提升。
AI.conclusion: 扰动分配是共享预算、局部约束威胁模型下对抗优化中一个独立且具有实际意义的维度。

title: Kinematic MeanFlow: One-Step Action Generation Policy for Robotic Foundation Models
summary: In this paper, we study how to achieve one-step action generation in Robotic Foundation Models (RFMs), aiming to overcome the high inference latency of multi-step flow matching. MeanFlow provides a promising framework for this goal, yet its direct application leads to performance collapse. We discover that this stems from two distinctive dynamics exhibited in the RFM velocity field: (1) the ``local acceleration" exhibits stability early on, but surges sharply towards the end of the denoising process, and (2) the spread of its magnitudes across samples widens as denoising progresses. To address these issues, we introduce Kinematic MeanFlow (K-MF), a novel one-step action policy tailored for RFMs. Specifically, grounded in a kinematic identity, K-MF decouples the time derivative term in the MeanFlow formulation into two sub-interval terms separated by an intermediate point. This decoupled formulation enables the two terms to capture early-stage and late-stage denoising dynamics, respectively, while mitigating the error amplification across the process. As a result, our K-MF empowers RFMs to achieve one-step action generation in both training from scratch and fine-tuning paradigms across diverse tasks, while outperforming multi-step flow matching in most settings. In terms of inference efficiency, K-MF reduces action-head latency of GR00T-N1.6 by 67.5%~74.4% across L40 and Jetson Orin in eager and compiled modes, yielding end-to-end latency reductions of 30.3%~54.9%. Code will be available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/K-MF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出K-MF（Kinematic MeanFlow），通过运动学恒等式解耦MeanFlow中的时间导数项，实现机器人基础模型的单步动作生成，缓解性能崩溃并显著降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型（RFMs）中多步flow matching推理延迟高，而直接应用MeanFlow实现单步生成会导致性能崩溃。作者发现根源在于RFM速度场的两种特性：(1)"局部加速度"在早期稳定但接近去噪末端急剧上升；(2)其幅度在样本间的离散度随去噪推进而增大。
AI.method: 提出Kinematic MeanFlow（K-MF），一种面向RFM的单步动作策略。基于运动学恒等式，将MeanFlow公式中的时间导数项解耦为以中间点为界的两段子区间项，分别捕捉早期和晚期的去噪动态，同时缓解全过程的误差放大。该方法支持从零训练和微调两种范式。
AI.result: K-MF在多种任务上实现单步动作生成，并在多数设置下优于多步flow matching。在推理效率上，K-MF将GR00T-N1.6的动作头延迟在L40与Jetson Orin上、eager与compiled模式下降低67.5%~74.4%，端到端延迟降低30.3%~54.9%。
AI.conclusion: K-MF为RFM提供了一种有效的单步动作生成方案，兼顾性能与推理效率，适用于从零训练和微调范式，代码将开源。

title: UniTrackPLA: Unified Panorama-Language-Action Model for Instruction-Guided Navigation and Dynamic Person Tracking
comment: The project page is at https://tw5775.github.io/UniTrackPLA
summary: General-purpose embodied robots should support both navigation toward language-specified destinations and dynamic person tracking under arbitrary initial target azimuths. However, existing methods typically rely on forward-facing observations and address these tasks with separate policies, limiting omnidirectional perception and unified closed-loop control. We present UniTrackPLA, a unified panorama-language-action model for instruction-guided navigation and dynamic person tracking. Its Panoramic-Aware Encoding (PAE) preserves the temporal and azimuthal structure of perspective views projected from each panorama, enabling perspective-pretrained visual encoders to process omnidirectional observations. A shared vision-language backbone grounds instructions in the panoramic context and predicts continuous robot-centric waypoint chunks for both tasks. World-Action Consistency (WAC) further predicts action-conditioned future visual states and verifies waypoint prefixes online, allowing reliable actions to be reused while triggering replanning upon inconsistency. We also introduce OmniTrackNav-Bench, comprising 5,000 simulated tracking trajectories, 10,000 simulated VLN routes, and 96 verified real-world routes, providing 919,978 waypoint-supervision instances. UniTrackPLA improves overall tracking SR from 23.50% to 35.00% and Omni-VLN SR/SPL from 13.00%/12.77% to 19.75%/19.29%. Incorporating 76 real-world routes further improves held-out EP@0.2m from 42.92% to 92.08%. Closed-loop experiments on a Go2-W robot demonstrate unified panoramic tracking and navigation across indoor and outdoor environments. The project page is at https://tw5775.github.io/UniTrackPLA.

AI.tldr: UniTrackPLA 是一个统一的全景-语言-动作模型，融合指令导航与动态人员跟踪两类任务，通过全景感知编码、共享视觉-语言骨干与世界-动作一致性机制，实现全向闭环控制，并配套提出 OmniTrackNav-Bench 基准。
AI.motivation: 通用具身机器人需同时支持语言指定目的地导航与任意初始方位下的动态人员跟踪，但现有方法多依赖前向观测、以分离策略处理两类任务，制约了全向感知与统一闭环控制能力。
AI.method: 核心方法包括：(1) Panoramic-Aware Encoding (PAE)，保留全景投影透视视图的时间与方位结构，使透视预训练视觉编码器可处理全向观测；(2) 共享视觉-语言骨干，在全景上下文中对齐指令并预测连续的机器人中心航点块；(3) World-Action Consistency (WAC)，预测动作条件未来视觉状态并在线校验航点前缀，一致则复用可靠动作、不一致则触发重规划。同时构建 OmniTrackNav-Bench 数据集。
AI.result: 跟踪整体 SR 由 23.50% 提升至 35.00%；Omni-VLN 的 SR/SPL 由 13.00%/12.77% 提升至 19.75%/19.29%；加入 76 条真实路线后，留出集 EP@0.2m 由 42.92% 提升至 92.08%。在 Go2-W 机器人上完成室内外闭环实验，验证了统一的全景跟踪与导航。
AI.conclusion: UniTrackPLA 以统一模型实现全向感知下的导航与人员跟踪闭环控制，并在仿真与真实环境中显著优于基线，验证了全景统一策略的可行性与有效性。

title: Machine Translation for Sign Languages
comment: Accepted for publication in the Annual Review of Linguistics, Volume 13
summary: Sign language machine translation has progressed substantially over the past decade, evolving from isolated sign recognition to end-to-end translation systems. Advances in pose estimation, transformer architectures, and large-scale dataset collection have driven progress, yet challenges remain. Datasets are limited compared to spoken-language resources; evaluation metrics inadequately capture the linguistic quality of output; and models must capture the simultaneous, multi-layered, and three-dimensional structure of sign languages. This manuscript provides a comprehensive review that seeks to balance technical challenges with stakeholder considerations. We examine the linguistic properties that make sign languages computationally unique, trace the evolution of recognition, translation, and production systems, and analyze ongoing technical challenges. Crucially, we address ethical considerations around data governance, community involvement, and appropriate use. Drawing on interdisciplinary perspectives spanning computer vision, sign language linguistics, and deaf studies, our analysis emphasizes that continued progress requires sustained collaboration across these fields and with deaf communities.

AI.tldr: 手语机器翻译领域综述：梳理从孤立手语识别到端到端翻译的技术演进，兼顾技术挑战与利益相关者伦理考量。
AI.motivation: 手语机器翻译近十年快速发展，但数据集规模不足、评价指标难以捕捉语言质量、模型难以刻画手语同时性、多层次与三维结构等问题依然突出，且数据治理与社群参与等伦理议题亟待重视。
AI.method: 采用跨学科综述方法，结合计算机视觉、手语语言学和聋人研究视角，分析手语的计算语言学特性，梳理识别、翻译与生成系统的演进脉络，并讨论技术挑战与伦理问题。
AI.result: 系统总结了姿态估计、Transformer架构和大规模数据采集等推动因素，指出数据资源匮乏、评价指标局限以及三维同时性建模困难等核心瓶颈，并强调数据治理、社群参与和恰当使用的伦理维度。
AI.conclusion: 手语机器翻译的持续进步需要计算机视觉、手语语言学与聋人研究等领域的长期协作，并与聋人社区共同推进。

title: DeBERTa-ConPara: Attack-Aware and Deployment-Realistic Detection of AI-Generated Text
comment: Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (main conference). 9 pages plus appendix. Code and checkpoint: https://github.com/MohamedMady19/deberta-conpara, https://huggingface.co/mohamedmady/deberta-conpara
summary: Robust detection of AI-generated text under deployment conditions is challenging: distribution shifts across domains and generators, adversarial perturbations of the input surface, and the absence of target-domain labels for threshold calibration all degrade detectors that perform well in-domain. We present DeBERTa-ConPara, a deployment-oriented detector combining attack-aware Unicode preprocessing with a contextual transformer encoder trained over HC3 Plus, M4, MAGE and RAID. Our central finding is that preprocessing acts in opposite directions depending on where it is applied: normalising the training corpus deduplicates it, collapsing 35.4% of RAID rows into copies of their clean siblings and deleting the adversarial supervision, whereas normalising at inference is an effective defence. A factorial varying the two placements independently identifies raw training with normalised inference as the best configuration, reaching 99.61% AUROC, 99.01% TPR@5% FPR and 96.57% TPR@1% FPR on the official RAID hidden test, alongside 93.14% average balanced accuracy across HC3 Plus and MAGE under a fixed threshold. The gain is confined to two of twelve attack classes: homoglyph and zero-width-space insertion rise from 11.05% and 1.12% to 96.98%. The same signature reproduces in a zero-shot detector of different architecture, showing the effect belongs to the attacks rather than to our model. We additionally report two negative results: semantic-invariance augmentation through paraphrasing and supervised contrastive learning (ConPara) does not improve the best configuration, and the handcrafted feature-fusion branch is inert in distribution and harmful outside it.

AI.tldr: 提出面向部署的AI生成文本检测器DeBERTa-ConPara，核心发现是Unicode归一化在训练与推理两端的相反效应：训练端归一化破坏对抗监督，推理端归一化是有效防御。
AI.motivation: 真实部署场景下AI生成文本检测面临域与生成器分布偏移、输入层对抗扰动、缺乏目标域标签用于阈值校准等挑战，域内表现良好的检测器性能显著退化，需要面向部署条件的鲁棒检测方案。
AI.method: 结合攻击感知的Unicode预处理与上下文Transformer编码器，在HC3 Plus、M4、MAGE和RAID上训练；设计因子实验，独立改变训练端与推理端的归一化位置进行对比；并附加语义不变性增强（改写）与监督对比学习（ConPara）分支及手工特征融合分支的消融验证。
AI.result: 训练语料归一化会去重、将35.4%的RAID样本坍缩为干净样本副本并删除对抗监督，而推理端归一化则是有效防御；“原始训练+归一化推理”为最优配置，在RAID官方隐藏测试集上达99.61% AUROC、99.01% TPR@5% FPR、96.57% TPR@1% FPR，在HC3 Plus与MAGE固定阈值下平均平衡准确率93.14%；增益集中于12类攻击中的两类，同形字与零宽空格插入分别从11.05%、1.12%提升至96.98%；该特征在不同架构的零样本检测器上同样复现，表明效应来源于攻击本身而非模型。
AI.conclusion: 推理端Unicode归一化是应对输入层对抗扰动的关键且架构无关的防御手段，而训练端归一化因破坏对抗监督反而有害；语义不变性增强与监督对比学习未带来提升，手工特征融合分支在分布内无效、分布外有害，均为阴性结果。

title: Towards Fast and Disentangled Counterfactuals for Visual Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models remain vulnerable to spurious correlations and ``Clever Hans'' strategies. Explainable machine learning can find and remove such strategies for classifiers without metadata. For foundation models, no such option exists yet. We propose Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders (DiDAE). DiDAE wraps a frozen foundation model in a conditional diffusion decoder. A counterfactual is one closed-form edit along a direction of a disentangled dictionary, followed by decoding. The dictionary can be supervised (Procrustes) or unsupervised (Singular Value Decomposition, Sparse Autoencoders). No gradients are needed, so DiDAE is up to 2000 times faster than the state of the art. We evaluate on six datasets, two synthetic and four real-world. In a desiderata-driven benchmark on three of them, its counterfactuals are on par with or better than the state of the art, and they repair downstream classifiers through Counterfactual Knowledge Distillation (CFKD), where they beat metadata-based correction. The same machinery can rank a pretrained dictionary against a trained classifier. It returns the few directions the classifier actually reads, each causally verified by a counterfactual that flips the decision, and repairs the classifier along those a teacher marks spurious. The workflow is plug-and-play in our open-source Peal library we publish alongside the paper. With a public dictionary and a pretrained decoder, all that remains is a cheap linear distillation of the classifier and its own fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出解耦扩散自编码器（DiDAE），将冻结的基础模型包裹在条件扩散解码器中，通过对解耦字典方向进行闭式编辑生成反事实；无需梯度，速度比SOTA快至多2000倍，并在六数据集上验证其反事实质量、下游分类器修复及字典排序能力。
AI.motivation: 基础模型依然易受虚假相关与"Clever Hans"策略影响；可解释机器学习虽能在无元数据条件下为分类器发现并移除此类策略，但面向基础模型尚无同类方案，因此需要一种无需梯度、可迁移至基础模型的反事实与策略诊断方法。
AI.method: DiDAE：在冻结基础模型外包裹条件扩散解码器；反事实通过沿解耦字典方向的闭式编辑再解码生成。字典可监督构建（Procrustes）或无监督构建（SVD、稀疏自编码器）；过程无需梯度。同一机制可对预训练字典与已训练分类器排序，定位分类器实际依赖的少数方向，并用反事实因果验证其翻转决策，再沿这些方向修复分类器。方法集成于开源Peal库。
AI.result: 在六个数据集（两个合成、四个真实）上评测；其中三个数据集的需求驱动基准显示，反事实质量与SOTA持平或更优；通过反事实知识蒸馏（CFKD）修复下游分类器，效果优于基于元数据的纠正方法；速度较SOTA快至多2000倍。字典排序可返回分类器真正依赖的少数方向，并经因果验证与修复。
AI.conclusion: DiDAE为无元数据场景下的基础模型提供了可解释、无需梯度的反事实生成与虚假策略诊断/修复方案；配合公开字典与预训练解码器，仅需对分类器进行廉价线性蒸馏及其自身微调，流程即插即用。

title: ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization
comment: 37 pages, 16 figures. Project website and code: https://autosaddler-projectpage.github.io/activesaddler/
summary: Automated harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents by iteratively updating their prompts, tool interfaces, and control logic from execution feedback. However, existing methods primarily optimize how the harness is updated while largely fixing which training scenarios generate the feedback that drives those updates. As the harness evolves, the scenarios most useful for further optimization can change, suggesting that the training curriculum itself should adapt alongside the harness. We formulate this missing dimension of harness optimization as an automated curriculum learning problem and introduce ActiveSaddler. ActiveSaddler models the evolving curriculum as a non-stationary bandit with dynamically instantiated optimization targets. It abstracts recurring failures into reusable failure-pattern arms, estimates the potential learning progress from further targeting each pattern, and adaptively balances revisiting known weaknesses with exploring unseen scenarios for new ones. Optimization outcomes continually update both the set of discovered failure patterns and their priorities, allowing the curriculum to co-evolve with the harness. Experiments on GAIA2 and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that ActiveSaddler consistently discovers stronger harnesses, improving test Pass@1 by 4.4 and 7.5 percentage points over the same harness optimizer using a scenario order fixed before optimization, respectively. Ablations further show that these gains depend on dynamically constructing optimization targets, estimating their evolving utility, and balancing continued optimization with new failure discovery. Together, these results establish automated curriculum learning as a new crucial optimization dimension for harness optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ActiveSaddler，将自动化harness优化的训练场景选择建模为自动化课程学习问题，用非平稳老虎机动态调整训练课程，使课程与harness共同演化。
AI.motivation: 现有harness优化方法主要关注如何用执行反馈更新prompt、工具接口和控制逻辑，却基本固定了产生反馈的训练场景。随着harness演化，最有用的训练场景会发生变化，因此训练课程本身也应随之自适应。
AI.method: 将这一缺失维度形式化为自动化课程学习问题。ActiveSaddler把演化的课程建模为非平稳老虎机，并动态实例化优化目标：将反复出现的失败抽象为可复用的失败模式臂，估计继续针对每种模式的学习进展潜力，并自适应平衡"重访已知弱点"与"探索新场景以发现新弱点"。优化结果持续更新失败模式集合及其优先级，使课程与harness协同演化。
AI.result: 在GAIA2和Terminal-Bench 2.0上，相比使用优化前固定场景顺序的同一harness优化器，ActiveSaddler稳定发现更强的harness，测试Pass@1分别提升4.4和7.5个百分点。消融实验表明，收益依赖于动态构建优化目标、估计其演化效用，以及平衡持续优化与新失败发现。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了自动化课程学习是harness优化的一个新的关键维度。

title: The Geometry of Contextual Relations: Language Models Address Facts by Order of Mention
summary: Human reasoning depends on how objects are related within propositions. \textit{How do relations organize the language representations of contextual contents?} We give an LLM a list of facts in its context (e.g., \emph{Alice eats an apple. Bob eats a pear.}) and measure how its hidden state changes when the question switches from what Alice eats to what Bob eats. Averaged over many lists, this change is a steering vector, which we call the \emph{ordinal vector}. It points to a fact by its \emph{order of mention}, the order in which the facts were stated in the context. We find that LLMs represent the fact a question asks about by its order of mention, not by the name the question contains. We state this as the \textit{ordinal addressing hypothesis}: each order of mention has a \emph{fact address} in the model's state, shared by all contexts, and a question moves the state to the fact address of the fact it asks about, while the context supplies what that fact says. Across Qwen, Gemma, and Llama, fact addresses are (1) \emph{ordered by mention}: query states are organized by the order of facts, not of names, even when one fact has multiple subjects; (2) \emph{steerable}: added to a question about the first fact of a new list, the ordinal vector makes the model answer with the second fact of that list; (3) \emph{low-rank}: they span a low-rank subspace in which the first-mentioned fact is the easiest to reach, surprisingly similar to human recall; and (4) \emph{emergent}: they are shared in late-middle layers, hold from 1.5B to 32B parameters, and form early in pretraining. Language models reach a stated fact by where it was mentioned, deepening our understanding of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"序数寻址假设"：大语言模型通过事实在上下文中被提及的顺序（而非名称）来定位问题所指的事实，每个提及顺序在模型状态中对应一个共享的"事实地址"。
AI.motivation: 人类推理依赖命题中对象之间的关系，但大语言模型如何组织上下文内容的关系表征尚不清晰。作者希望探究模型是否以及如何按关系来组织事实表征，特别是问题所指的事实如何被定位。
AI.method: 向LLM上下文中输入一系列事实（如"Alice吃苹果。Bob吃梨。"），测量当问题从"Alice吃什么"切换到"Bob吃什么"时隐状态的变化；对大量列表取平均得到引导向量（序数向量）；在Qwen、Gemma、Llama上检验事实地址的排序性、可引导性、低秩性和涌现性。
AI.result: 事实地址具有四个特性：(1)按提及顺序排序，查询状态按事实顺序而非名称组织，即使某事实有多个主语也成立；(2)可引导，将序数向量加到关于新列表第一个事实的问题上，模型会回答该列表的第二个事实；(3)低秩，事实地址张成低秩子空间，其中首个提及的事实最易到达，类似人类回忆；(4)涌现性，在中间偏后层共享，从1.5B到32B参数均成立，并在预训练早期形成。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型通过事实被提及的位置来访问该事实，即按提及顺序寻址，这深化了对LLM推理机制的理解。

title: EyeTAG: Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation
summary: Gaze estimation under natural head-eye motion underpins applications from driver monitoring to human-computer interaction. Single-frame methods predict each frame independently, so consecutive outputs fluctuate as jitter. Multi-frame methods reduce this, but they learn motion implicitly inside appearance features, so the gaze trajectory is never an explicit variable. We propose EyeTAG (Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation), a causal multi-frame framework built around an explicit first-order gaze prior: at each step it differentiates its own recent predictions and feeds the resulting trajectory back as a compact kinematic token. Because differencing is translation-invariant in gaze space, this token carries subject-invariant motion rather than personal gaze offsets. Face and eye streams supply visual evidence, fused by cross-attention and a causal Transformer decoder. EyeTAG reduces the mean angular error by about 1.0$^\circ$ on Gaze360 and performs on par with the strongest baseline on EVE (2.56$^\circ$ vs. 2.58$^\circ$). Within-model ablations, which keep the encoder and the rest of the architecture fixed and vary only the gaze history, show that the differential formulation, rather than temporal context alone, removes the systematic saccade bias that persists even with an absolute gaze-history prior. Our code is available at https://github.com/peter8366/EyeTAG.

AI.tldr: 提出EyeTAG，一种因果多帧视线估计框架，以显式一阶视线先验（对自身近期预测做差分得到轨迹token）为核心，减少抖动与扫视偏差。
AI.motivation: 自然头眼运动下的视线估计对驾驶监控、人机交互等应用至关重要。单帧方法逐帧独立预测，输出存在抖动；多帧方法虽能缓解，但仅在表观特征中隐式学习运动，视线轨迹从未成为显式变量。
AI.method: EyeTAG为因果多帧框架：每步对自身近期预测进行差分，将所得轨迹作为紧凑的运动学token反馈；由于差分在视线空间中具有平移不变性，该token携带的是主体无关的运动而非个人视线偏移。人脸与眼部双流提供视觉证据，经交叉注意力融合并由因果Transformer解码器处理。
AI.result: 在Gaze360上平均角度误差降低约1.0°；在EVE上与最强基线持平（2.56° vs. 2.58°）。模型内消融（固定编码器及架构其余部分，仅变化视线历史）表明，是差分形式而非单纯时序上下文消除了即使使用绝对视线历史先验仍存在的系统性扫视偏差。
AI.conclusion: 显式的一阶差分轨迹先验优于隐式运动建模与绝对视线历史先验，能有效抑制抖动与扫视偏差；代码已开源。

title: A Survey on End-to-End Autonomous Driving Training from the Perspectives of Data, Strategy, and Platform
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, accepted by IEEE transactions on intelligent transportation systems
summary: Autonomous driving is a cornerstone technology for the future of intelligent transportation, where end-to-end learning has emerged as a transformative paradigm that directly maps multimodal sensory inputs to driving actions through unified differentiable models. While offering advantages, the effectiveness of end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) is ultimately determined by the quality of its training ecosystem. This paper provides a comprehensive review of training methods and ecosystem for E2E-AD. We introduce a Data-Strategy-Platform taxonomy that conceptualizes training as an interdependent system. The data layer defines what can be learned, the strategy layer governs how learning aligns with driving objectives, and the platform layer supports scalability and continuous evolution. Within this framework, we survey recent advances across data-centric pipelines, learning paradigms, and training infrastructures, and analyze their interplay in shaping model performance, robustness, and deployability. Finally, we reflect on current limitations and articulate a forward-looking vision that emphasizes a shift from data quantity to data value, from isolated optimization to foundation-driven generalization, and from static training to integrated training-testing loops, aiming toward robust, scalable, and trustworthy autonomous driving systems. We maintain a continuously updated repository tracking cutting-edge literature and works at \href{https://github.com/Jiaaqiliu/Awesome-Training-Ecosystem-for-E2E-AD}{Our Project Page}.

AI.tldr: 本文对端到端自动驾驶（E2E-AD）的训练方法与训练生态进行综述，提出“数据—策略—平台”三层分类体系，并展望从数据数量转向数据价值、从孤立优化转向基础驱动泛化、从静态训练转向训练—测试闭环的未来方向。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶虽具变革性，但其效果最终取决于训练生态的质量；现有研究缺乏对训练方法、数据流程与基础设施之间系统性关联的梳理与整合视角。
AI.method: 采用综述方法，构建“数据—策略—平台”（Data-Strategy-Platform）分类法，将训练视为相互依赖的系统：数据层定义可学习内容，策略层决定学习如何对齐驾驶目标，平台层支撑可扩展性与持续演化；并据此梳理数据中心流程、学习范式与训练基础设施的最新进展及其相互作用。
AI.result: 系统归纳了E2E-AD训练生态的关键进展，并分析了三层要素在塑造模型性能、鲁棒性与可部署性方面的协同影响，同时总结了当前研究的局限。
AI.conclusion: E2E-AD训练需从数据数量转向数据价值、从孤立优化转向基础驱动的泛化、从静态训练转向集成式训练—测试闭环，以实现鲁棒、可扩展且可信的自动驾驶系统；作者维护了持续更新的文献仓库。

title: Efficient Task Adaptation in Large Language Models: A Survey of Weight-Based, Prompt-Based, and Embedding-Based Adaptations
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed across diverse downstream tasks, efficient task adaptation has emerged as a central challenge. In response, a wide range of task adaptation methods have been proposed, spanning parameter-efficient fine-tuning, in-context learning, and embedding-injection approaches. However, these lines of work have largely evolved within individual paradigms, leaving their cross-paradigm relationships and trade-offs underexplored, especially for recently emerging embedding-based adaptations. This survey presents a unified framework that categorizes task adaptation methods by where and how task information is encoded: model weights, input prompts, or injected task embeddings. We provide a comprehensive taxonomy that integrates these paradigms, analyze their key strengths and limitations to explain how different adaptation paradigms have evolved, clarify relationships across paradigms, and highlight open problems for future research.

AI.tldr: 该综述针对大语言模型任务适配方法分散于不同范式、缺乏跨范式关系与权衡分析的问题，提出以"任务信息编码位置"为核心的统一框架，将适配方法归纳为模型权重、输入提示、注入任务嵌入三类，并系统整合分类、分析优劣与演化、厘清范式间关系及指出未来开放问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在下游任务中广泛部署，高效任务适配成为核心挑战；已有方法（参数高效微调、上下文学习、嵌入注入）多在各自范式内独立发展，跨范式关系与权衡尤其对新兴的基于嵌入的适配缺乏探索。
AI.method: 提出统一框架，按照任务信息"在哪里、如何"被编码进行划分：模型权重、输入提示、注入任务嵌入；据此构建涵盖各范式的综合分类体系，并分析各范式的核心优势与局限以解释其演化，厘清范式间关系。
AI.result: 形成整合参数高效微调、上下文学习与嵌入注入的跨范式分类体系，阐明不同适配范式的演化逻辑与相互关系，并识别出若干开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为任务适配研究提供了统一视角与分类框架，弥合了不同范式间的割裂，为未来研究指明方向。

title: Platonic Task Arithmetic
summary: Distinct pre-trained models specialized for the same task converge to closely similar behavior, yet the parameter updates that produce it share no common coordinate system. Weight-space task arithmetic is therefore confined to a single model, and transporting an update between models requires a structural correspondence. Drawing on Plato's allegory of the cave, we hypothesize that these model-specific updates are shadows cast by one shared, model-agnostic object, the platonic task vector. To make it operational across models of different architectures, we introduce Universal Task Descriptors, matrices whose shape is independent of architecture and embedding dimension, which record a task's functional effect and admit addition and negation as ordinary matrix operations, and we transfer a descriptor into a target in two ways. A single least-squares solve returns a linear operator folded into the target's last layer, and a bank of such operators, one per source and task, realizes any composition as a signed sum of its entries. Alternatively, a low-rank adapter of the target's encoder is trained on the same objective at the price of one optimization per edit. Despite a model-specific residual comparable in norm to the shared component, transfer from another model retains 74 to 80 percent of the gain the target's own descriptors attain. Experiments across six model families, eight tasks and audio-text models confirm both realizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"通用任务描述子"（Universal Task Descriptors），一种与架构和嵌入维度无关的矩阵表示，将模型特定的权重更新视为柏拉图式任务向量的"影子"，从而实现跨模型的任务算术迁移。
AI.motivation: 同一任务的多个预训练模型虽行为相似，但参数更新不共享坐标系统，导致权重空间任务算术被限制在单一模型内。跨模型迁移更新需要结构性对应关系，本文旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: 借鉴柏拉图洞穴寓言，假设模型特定更新是共享的、模型无关的"柏拉图任务向量"投射的影子。引入通用任务描述子——形状独立于架构和嵌入维度的矩阵，记录任务的功能效应，支持普通矩阵加法和取负运算。迁移方式有两种：一是单次最小二乘求解得到线性算子并折叠进目标模型最后一层，并用算子库以符号和实现任意组合；二是训练目标编码器的低秩适配器，代价是每次编辑需一次优化。
AI.result: 尽管存在与共享分量范数相当的模型特定残差，跨模型迁移仍能保留目标自身描述子所获增益的74%至80%。在六个模型族、八个任务以及音频-文本模型上的实验均验证了两种实现方式。
AI.conclusion: 通用任务描述子为跨模型任务算术提供了可行方案，验证了模型特定更新源于共享柏拉图任务向量的假设，两种迁移实现均有效。

title: Joint Branch-Space Transform Coding for Diffusion Activation Quantization with Classifier-Free Guidance
summary: Post-training quantization for diffusion models increasingly exploits timestep, feature, and layer structure. While recent work has begun incorporating CFG structure into diffusion quantization, activation quantization still operates independently across conditional and unconditional coordinates, leaving cross-activation structure unexploited. We show that matched CFG activations form a strongly correlated two-dimensional source and that, under a fixed bit budget, the choice of branch coding basis materially affects quantization fidelity. Motivated by this observation, we introduce branch-space transform coding, which rotates matched CFG branches via an offline derived 2x2 orthogonal matrix, requiring minimal modifications to model parameters or the quantization pipeline. We further derive the Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT), which jointly incorporates the CFG guidance direction and cross-branch second moments. Under an equal-rate quantization-noise surrogate, GCBT admits a closed-form per-layer solution without gradient optimization or angle search. Applied on top of existing diffusion PTQ methods, GCBT yields statistically significant fidelity gains in most evaluated comparisons with no statistically significant degradation, while leaving the underlying host quantization pipeline unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文将CFG引导的匹配激活视为强相关的二维信源，提出分支空间变换编码GCBT，通过对匹配CFG分支施加离线推导的2x2正交旋转，在比特预算不变的前提下显著提升扩散模型后训练量化的保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型后训练量化虽已利用时间步、特征与层结构，并开始引入CFG结构，但激活量化仍在条件与无条件坐标上独立进行，忽略了跨激活结构。作者发现匹配的CFG激活构成强相关的二维信源，且在固定比特预算下，分支编码基的选择会实质影响量化保真度，因此需要一种能显式利用该跨分支相关性的方法。
AI.method: 提出分支空间变换编码：用离线推导的2x2正交矩阵旋转匹配的CFG分支，对模型参数与量化流程改动极小。进一步推导引导-相关分支变换（GCBT），联合纳入CFG引导方向与跨分支二阶矩，在等速率量化噪声代理下得到逐层闭式解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索。
AI.result: 在既有扩散PTQ方法之上应用GCBT，在多数评测对比中取得统计显著的保真度提升，且无统计显著退化，同时不改变底层宿主量化流程。
AI.conclusion: 跨CFG分支的激活相关性是可利用的量化先验，分支空间的主轴旋转能以零额外比特代价改善量化保真度，且GCBT以闭式、低侵入的方式兼容现有扩散PTQ框架。

title: ReHoPER: Receding-Horizon Planning for Enhanced Reasoning
summary: We propose ReHoPER, an inference-only, zero-shot method that improves large language models' reasoning by generating and answering intermediate questions along multiple paths before the final answer. It iteratively plans a horizon of candidate intermediate questions, selects one to answer, and replans from the updated history. ReHoPER is task-agnostic, using the same generic instructions across datasets and models without labeled data or task-specific prompt design. Across multiple datasets, including iLLC, a new controlled benchmark for compositional reasoning, ReHoPER outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains in the most compositional settings. Our implementation and the iLLC generator are publicly available to support future work.

AI.tldr: 提出ReHoPER：一种仅推理、零样本的方法，通过沿多条路径生成并回答中间问题来提升大语言模型的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 提升大语言模型的推理能力，且无需标注数据和任务特定提示设计。
AI.method: 迭代规划一个候选中间问题的horizon，选择一个进行回答，并基于更新后的历史重新规划；任务无关，跨数据集和模型使用相同的通用指令。
AI.result: 在多个数据集（包括新的组合推理受控基准iLLC）上优于强基线，在最具组合性的设置中增益最大。
AI.conclusion: ReHoPER是一种有效的零样本、任务无关推理增强方法，且实现与iLLC生成器已公开以支持后续研究。

title: A Matched-Budget Audit Framework for Recaptioned Image-Text Supervision Distributions
summary: Recaptioned image-text corpora are now standard for text-to-image (T2I) training, with vision--language model (VLM) captioners replacing sparse alt-text by dense descriptions. A recaptioned corpus is a supervision distribution induced by a documented captioning policy ($π$), captioner ($V_c$), and source corpus ($C$). Length-correlated proxies miss caption-register artifacts and downstream T2I benchmarks entangle the corpus with training choices, so this distribution is hard to audit at corpus scale. We introduce a reusable matched-budget audit framework for recaptioned supervision distributions $D_{π,V_c,C}$: at a fixed text budget of $B = 64$ it reports a five-axis profile spanning prompt-side coverage, image-conditioned faithfulness, and caption-surface health, with claimed controllable basic units (CBU) as the common claim unit. We instantiate the framework on seven paired comparisons over five public source corpora. Across the four cross-corpus pairs, the released surface raises supported CBU per caption by $+3.39$ to $+6.36$ under both Qwen and Gemma Judges, and on CC12M the same framework exposes a long-vs-dense frontier that is consistent across both judges and four budgets. We release the audited multi-source recap corpus ($\approx$ 490M) together with the audit-artifact bundle.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个可复用的"匹配预算"审计框架，用于在固定文本预算下对重标注图文语料（recaptioned image-text corpora）的监督分布进行五维画像，并在五个公开源语料的七组配对比较上实例化该框架。
AI.motivation: 重标注重述已成文生图（T2I）训练标准，VLM 标注器用密集描述替代稀疏 alt-text。此类语料是由标注策略 π、标注器 Vc 与源语料 C 共同诱导的监督分布。现有审计手段存在两大缺陷：基于长度相关的代理指标会遗漏标注语域的伪影；而下游 T2I 基准又将语料与训练选择纠缠在一起，导致该分布在语料尺度上难以审计。
AI.method: 引入面向重标注监督分布 D_{π,Vc,C} 的可复用匹配预算审计框架。在固定文本预算 B=64 下，输出覆盖提示侧覆盖度（prompt-side coverage）、图像条件忠实度（image-conditioned faithfulness）以及标注表层健康度（caption-surface health）的五轴画像，并统一以"可主张可控基本单元（CBU）"作为共同的主张单位。在五个公开源语料上实例化七组配对比较。
AI.result: 在四组跨语料配对中，所发布的表层在 Qwen 与 Gemma 两种 Judge 下均将每标注的支持 CBU 提升 +3.39 至 +6.36；在 CC12M 上，同一框架揭示出长文本与密集文本之间的前沿（long-vs-dense frontier），且该结果在两种 Judge 与四个预算下保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 该匹配预算审计框架可对齐地刻画重标注监督分布的多个维度，并具有跨 Judge、跨预算的稳健性。作者发布经审计的多源重标注语料（约 4.9 亿）及审计产物包。

title: Two Clocks in Diffusion MLLMs: When Answers Stabilize Before Rationales Unfold
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on BeNTo (Beyond Next-Token Prediction - Diffusion & Flow Models for Next-Generation Decoding)
summary: An answer candidate in a masked diffusion MLLM can stabilize while its rationale is still unfolding. We distinguish retrospective stabilization of the logged candidate from token commitment, and examine these two clocks relative to rationale generation. Analyzing our results across three visual question-answering benchmarks, we find that 89.4-98.1% of the rationale-side canvas remains unwritten at stabilization in single-block, EOS-suppressed LaViDa runs. On V*Bench, reducing block length from 128 to 8 changes this fraction from 89.4% to 1.7%, together with answer coverage and the eligible observation window. Under EOS-enabled prompting, direct instructions improve Nemotron's overall accuracy by 15.0 and 19.5 percentage points on M3CoT and ScienceQA, but reduce LaViDa/V*Bench accuracy by 11.0 points. A symmetric decomposition associates the larger absolute component of each change with coverage rather than conditional accuracy. Matched-canvas image ablations measure visual sensitivity alongside answer stabilization, separating the two temporal readouts. Together, these measurements distinguish answer stabilization, rationale unfolding, and visual sensitivity, and identify coverage as the larger component of the prompting differences.

AI.tldr: 该文研究掩码扩散多模态大模型（MLLM）中答案候选"稳定"与"承诺"两个时间尺度的区别，通过三个VQA基准测试表明：89.4-98.1%的推理画布在答案稳定时仍未写出，答案稳定与推理展开、视觉敏感性是可分离的独立过程，覆盖率而非条件准确率是提示差异的主要成分。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散MLLM中，答案候选可能在推理（rationale）尚未展开时就趋于稳定，这使"稳定"与"承诺"（token commitment）容易混淆。作者希望厘清这两个时间点相对于推理生成的关系，从而正确理解模型的推理与决策过程。
AI.method: 区分对已记录候选的回顾性稳定与token承诺两个"时钟"，并分析它们相对推理生成的位置。在三个视觉问答基准上运行单块、抑制EOS的LaViDa；在V*Bench上将块长度从128降至8；在启用EOS的提示下测试直接指令对Nemotron和LaViDa的影响；并采用对称分解与匹配画布的图像消融实验。
AI.result: 单块、抑制EOS的LaViDa运行中，答案稳定时89.4-98.1%的推理画布尚未写出。V*Bench上块长度由128降至8时，该比例从89.4%变为1.7%，同时改变答案覆盖率与可用观测窗口。启用EOS提示时，直接指令使Nemotron在M3CoT和ScienceQA上总准确率提升15.0和19.5个百分点，但使LaViDa/V*Bench准确率下降11.0个百分点。对称分解显示每次变化中绝对值较大的分量归因于覆盖率而非条件准确率。
AI.conclusion: 这些测量将答案稳定、推理展开和视觉敏感性区分开来，并确认覆盖率是提示差异中较大的成分。

title: Beyond Leaderboards: Tokenomics of Agentic Small Language Model Ensembles
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, Presented at ACM CAIS 2026 Workshop RLEval: Methods and Reinforcement Learning Environments for Evaluating AI Agents. Resubmission of permitted appeal, Ticket #MOD-104177
summary: As large language models (LLMs) move from standalone assistants into agentic workflows, evaluation must extend beyond scalar leaderboard accuracy to account for operational reliability, cost, latency, and token efficiency. We use an agentic ensemble of small language models (SLMs) with an SLM-judge-mediated feedback loop as a case study for such beyond-leaderboard evaluation. On the 541-prompt IFEval benchmark, the best ensemble achieves 97.34% strict prompt accuracy, exceeding the strongest standalone LLM baseline, gpt-5.4, by 5.81 percentage points while operating in a lower-cost regime. We then analyze the tokenomics and operational behavior behind this gain, including cost per sample, token composition, useful-output goodput, feedback-loop recovery, latency decomposition, and performance across instruction categories and constraint counts. Our results show that agentic SLM ensembles can trade additional test-time tokens and orchestration overhead for improved instruction-following fidelity, motivating multi-dimensional evaluation protocols for future agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文以小模型智能体集成（含SLM评判反馈回路）为案例，提出超越排行榜精度的多维评测，在IFEval上达97.34%严格准确率，超最强基线5.81个百分点且成本更低。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型从独立助手演变为智能体工作流，仅用标量排行榜精度评估已不足，需要纳入运行可靠性、成本、延迟与Token效率等维度。
AI.method: 采用小语言模型（SLM）构成的智能体集成，并引入由SLM评判者中介的反馈回路（feedback loop）作为案例，在541条提示的IFEval基准上进行评测与分析。
AI.result: 最优集成实现97.34%严格提示准确率，较最强独立LLM基线gpt-5.4高出5.81个百分点，且运行于更低成本区间；随后分析了每样本成本、Token构成、有效输出goodput、反馈回路恢复、延迟分解及各指令类别与约束数量下的表现。
AI.conclusion: 智能体SLM集成可以以额外的测试时Token与编排开销换取更高的指令遵循保真度，从而推动未来智能体AI系统采用多维评测协议。

title: Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention for Conversational LLMs
comment: This submission was made in error as an independent article instead of a new version for arXiv:2512.06869
summary: Large language models often lose track of persistent instructions and relevant information as multi-turn conversations grow. We study this cumulative contextual decay through three related failure modes: attention pollution, dilution, and drift. We propose REA (Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention), a context-management framework that assigns different persistence and representation policies to instructions and episodic interactions. Instructional Memory retains identified global constraints in a dedicated prefix. Episodic Memory preserves user inputs and compresses model replies, while heuristic retrieval selects raw text, compressed representations, or omission for each historical turn. On Long-MT-Bench+, REA improves the judge score from 6.32 to 7.36 on a 10-point scale, a 16.5% relative gain over the Vanilla baseline, and reduces average latency by 2.91$\times$. Additional evaluations show aggregate gains on three backbones spanning 1.7B-7B parameters and on Chinese and English role-playing tasks. These results support role-aware context management as a practical approach to maintaining conversational continuity and instruction adherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REA（角色感知启发式情景注意力）上下文管理框架，通过区分指令与情景交互的持久化策略，缓解多轮对话中的累积上下文衰减问题，在Long-MT-Bench+上将评分从6.32提升至7.36，并降低延迟2.91倍。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多轮对话增长过程中常会丢失持续指令与相关信息。作者将这一累积上下文衰减归纳为三种失败模式：注意力污染、稀释与漂移，并希望从上下文管理角度加以缓解。
AI.method: REA框架对指令与情景交互采用不同的持久化与表示策略：Instructional Memory将识别出的全局约束保留在专用前缀中；Episodic Memory保留用户输入、压缩模型回复，并通过启发式检索为每个历史轮次选择原始文本、压缩表示或省略。
AI.result: 在Long-MT-Bench+上，REA将评测评分从6.32提升至7.36（满分10分），相对Vanilla基线提升16.5%，平均延迟降低2.91倍。在1.7B–7B参数范围的三个骨干模型以及中英文角色扮演任务上均取得整体增益。
AI.conclusion: 角色感知的上下文管理是维持对话连续性与指令遵循性的实用方法。

title: Video-Index: A Curated Meta-Benchmark for Video Understanding
summary: A video benchmark should reward the capability it claims to measure, yet models can exploit answer options, question text, or partial visual evidence. We introduce the attack pyramid, five levels of shortcut attacks with increasing access to each item, and audit 115 video benchmarks with it. On 35 benchmarks, attackers that never see a frame approach full-video accuracy. On 51 benchmarks with temporal probes, shuffled frames keep a median 96% of full-video accuracy. Near-duplicate questions make up at least half the items in 63 benchmarks. We screen 505,518 question-answer pairs from 112 of them into an audited pool. Agents turn evaluation requests into specifications, and a deterministic selector with a red-team gate composes reproducible benchmarks. We release Video-Index, the 210 hardest verified items under these attacks in each of four capability groups, 840 items from 76 sources. With the same fixed input, Claude Opus 5 outscores every open-source model by over 37 percentage points, and agent tools add about 20 more, yet all systems leave room to improve efficiency and accuracy. Blog: https://www.enxinsong.com/blog/video-index/ GitHub: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/Video-Index Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Video-Index/Video-Index

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"攻击金字塔"框架来审计视频基准测试的可靠性，揭示了大量基准可被捷径攻击（如无视觉输入、打乱帧序、近似重复题目）欺骗，并据此构建了更严格的Video-Index基准。
AI.motivation: 视频基准应能衡量其声称评估的能力，但模型可利用答案选项、问题文本或部分视觉证据进行"捷径"作弊。因此需要系统性地审计现有视频基准的可靠性，并构建能抵御此类攻击的评测体系。
AI.method: 提出"攻击金字塔"（attack pyramid），即五个逐级增强对题目访问权限的捷径攻击层级，并用其审计115个视频基准。通过智能体将评测请求转化为规格，配合确定性选择器和红队门控，从112个基准的505,518个问答对中筛选出经审计的题池，构建可复现基准Video-Index。
AI.result: 在35个基准上，完全不看视频帧的攻击者即可接近完整视频精度；在51个带时序探针的基准上，打乱帧序仍保留中位数96%的完整视频精度；63个基准中至少有半数题目为近似重复。最终发布Video-Index，含4个能力组各210道最难验证题目，共840道来自76个来源。相同输入下，Claude Opus 5比所有开源模型高出逾37个百分点，智能体工具再增约20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频基准普遍存在严重的捷径漏洞，无法真实衡量视频理解能力。Video-Index通过抗攻击筛选提供了更可靠的评测集，但所有系统在效率与准确率上仍有提升空间。

title: RPTune: Learned Context Curation for LLM Catalog Search
summary: For small merchant businesses (SMBs) whose catalogs fit within a long-context LLM, full-catalog prompting offers a compelling alternative to multi-stage retrieval designed primarily for large marketplaces with millions of items. However, fitting the full catalog into the context window does not ensure that the model can use it effectively, since LLMs do not exploit long contexts uniformly. We therefore study in-context catalog search through two complementary questions: (1) how to curate and present catalogs to the LLM, and (2) how to adapt the LLM for product selection on curated contexts. We propose RPTune, an end-to-end framework that couples learned catalog curation with LLM post-training using automatically generated, catalog-grounded supervision. An encoder-reorganizer curator orders and prunes products guided by downstream LLM feedback, while the resulting curated catalogs in turn improve the effectiveness of LLM post-training with a context-relative reward. We evaluate RPTune on 7 real merchants spanning distinct retail verticals, using 100 complex conversational queries per merchant. RPTune consistently improves search accuracy across both proprietary and open-weight LLMs, with context curation yielding gains of up to 31.4 percentage points and post-training adding a further 10.3 points on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RPTune端到端框架，通过"上下文目录编排+LLM后训练"协同优化，提升中小商户全目录上下文搜索的产品召回准确率。
AI.motivation: 中小商户（SMB）目录可整体放入长上下文LLM窗口，从而无需面向百万级商品的大市场多阶段检索架构。但"能装下"不等于"用得好"——LLM对长上下文的利用并不均匀，全目录提示的效果因此受限，需要研究如何编排目录以及如何让模型适配该上下文进行产品选择。
AI.method: 提出RPTune，一个将可学习目录编排与LLM后训练耦合的端到端框架：1）由encoder-reorganizer组成的编排器（curator）对商品进行排序与剪枝，其优化信号来自下游LLM反馈；2）利用自动生成的、基于目录的监督数据进行LLM后训练，并使用上下文相对奖励（context-relative reward）；3）两个环节互为促进——编排后的目录提升后训练效果，后训练后的模型又反哺编排质量。
AI.result: 在7家真实商户（覆盖不同零售垂直领域）、每家100条复杂多轮对话查询上评测：RPTune在闭源与开源权重LLM上均稳定提升搜索准确率，其中上下文编排带来最高31.4个百分点的提升，后训练平均再提升10.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 对于目录规模适配长上下文的中小商户场景，全目录上下文搜索是可行的替代方案；而要让LLM有效利用长上下文，需要把目录编排与面向该上下文的后训练联合优化，二者协同可显著提升产品选择准确率。

title: ZAGNet: Zone-Aware Graph Aggregation Network for Patient-Level Lung Ultrasound Diagnosis
summary: Patient-level lung ultrasound (LUS) diagnosis requires integrating findings acquired across multiple anatomical zones, yet clinical examinations frequently involve variable and incomplete scanning protocols with missing zones. Existing diagnostic AI methods primarily analyze individual frames or video loops, relying on heuristic aggregation strategies such as max or mean pooling that ignore inter-zone relationships for patient-level inference. This paper presents ZAGNet, a Zone- Aware Graph Neural Network that represents temporally tracked pathology findings as graph nodes connected by anatomical zone adjacency. A graph transformer network propagates contextual information across neighboring lung regions, while a virtual global node aggregates graph-level features to predict patientlevel consolidation and pleural effusion using only patient-level supervision. ZAGNet accommodates missing zones by computing on a graph structure without fixed input format or size. We evaluate ZAGNet on a multicenter dataset of 714 subjects (20,256 LUS video loops) with exams varying from 4 to 16 zones across anterior, posterior, and lateral thoracic regions. For consolidation diagnosis, ZAGNet achieved an AUC of 0.803 compared to 0.677 (max pooling) and 0.674 (mean pooling). For pleural effusion, AUC increased to 0.893 from 0.804 (max pooling) and 0.815 (mean pooling). These represent improvements of up to 19% and 11% for consolidation and pleural effusion respectively. The results demonstrate that graph-based inter-zone reasoning provides an effective and clinically consistent framework for automated patient-level LUS assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出ZAGNet，一种区域感知图神经网络，将跨解剖区域的时序病理发现建模为图节点，通过图Transformer传播区域间上下文，实现患者级肺部超声诊断，并能自然处理缺失区域。
AI.motivation: 患者级肺部超声（LUS）诊断需要整合跨多个解剖区域的发现，但临床检查常采用可变且不完整的扫描方案，存在区域缺失。现有诊断AI方法多分析单帧或视频片段，采用max或mean池化等启发式聚合策略进行患者级推断，忽略了区域间关系。
AI.method: ZAGNet将时序跟踪的病理发现表示为图节点，以解剖区域相邻性作为边连接。采用图Transformer网络在相邻肺区域间传播上下文信息，并引入虚拟全局节点聚合图级特征，仅用患者级监督预测患者级肺实变与胸腔积液。由于基于图结构计算、不依赖固定输入格式或尺寸，ZAGNet可适应缺失区域。
AI.result: 在多中心数据集（714名受试者、20,256个LUS视频片段，检查涵盖前、后、侧胸部的4至16个区域）上评估。肺实变诊断AUC达0.803，优于max pooling（0.677）与mean pooling（0.674）；胸腔积液AUC提升至0.893，优于max pooling（0.804）与mean pooling（0.815）。实变与胸腔积液分别最高提升19%与11%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于图的区域间推理为自动化患者级LUS评估提供了有效且符合临床实际的框架。

title: A Citation-Grounded Benchmark for Trustworthy Earnings Call Transcript Analysis with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly used for financial document analysis, including earnings call transcripts (ECTs). Beyond generating standalone claims, users increasingly prefer grounded analyses that pair claims with verifiable citations from source documents to enable independent validation. However, evaluating such analytical claims typically requires extensive expert annotation, which is costly and difficult to scale, and real-world financial analysis commonly involves long context-question-answer triplets, further increasing task complexity. To address these challenges and benchmark the current landscape of grounded analysis by LLMs, we propose a numeric evidence evaluation method that enables groundedness assessment without reliance on expert annotation. We also introduce an automated dataset construction pipeline and construct ECTs-100 from the top 100 constituents of the S&P 500 to support benchmark of both groundedness and correctness. In addition, we examine conscious incompetence, a practical failure mode in financial analysis in which LLMs must detect when available evidence is insufficient and refrain from producing unsupported hallucinations. Empirical results show that LLMs perform well in groundedness but face notable limitations in correctness, with informational insufficiency presenting an additional challenge.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对LLM财报电话会议记录（ECT）分析中的"有据分析"评测难题，提出基于数值证据的评估方法（免专家标注）、自动化数据集构建流程，并构建ECTs-100基准，同时考察"自觉无能"（证据不足时拒绝幻觉）的失败模式。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多用于金融文档分析（如财报电话会议记录），用户偏好带有可验证引用的"有据分析"以便独立验证。但此类分析claims的评估通常依赖昂贵、难以规模化的专家标注；且真实金融分析常涉及长上下文-问题-答案三元组，进一步增加复杂度。因此需要一个无需专家标注、可规模化的评测方案来刻画当前LLM有据分析能力。
AI.method: 1）提出基于数值证据的评估方法，实现不依赖专家标注的有据性（groundedness）评估；2）设计自动化数据集构建pipeline，从S&P 500前100大成分股构建ECTs-100，以同时支持有据性与正确性（correctness）基准测试；3）引入并考察"自觉无能"（conscious incompetence）这一实际失败模式，即LLM需识别证据不足并避免输出无支撑的幻觉。
AI.result: 实证结果显示：LLM在有据性方面表现良好，但在正确性方面存在明显局限；此外，信息不足（informational insufficiency）构成额外挑战，即模型在证据不足时难以正确克制幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为LLM金融有据分析提供了可扩展、免专家标注的评估框架与基准（ECTs-100），并揭示当前模型"有据但未必正确"、且难以应对信息不足的核心短板，为后续改进指明方向。

title: RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation
comment: 10 pages. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Project page: https://relationvggt.github.io/
summary: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction have progressed from per-scene optimization to feed-forward inference, and semantic scene understanding has followed suit -- yet existing methods remain confined to object-centric perception, neglecting spatial relations between objects. We formulate 3D spatial relation segmentation in a feed-forward, pose-free multi-view setting: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query, the model segments the target across views without receiving its category name. To this end, we propose RelationVGGT, a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model and leverages a relation transformer for subject-conditioned, cross-view relation prediction -- requiring neither per-scene optimization nor known camera poses. We additionally provide a fully automated annotation pipeline built on ScanNet++ with VLMs and LLMs, enabling scalable training data generation for this new task.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出无位姿前馈的多视图3D空间关系分割任务，并设计RelationVGGT框架，融合视觉与几何基础模型特征，通过关系Transformer实现主体条件下的跨视图关系预测，同时基于ScanNet++构建自动化标注流程。
AI.motivation: 现有3D重建已从逐场景优化迈向可前馈推理，语义场景理解也随之发展，但当前方法局限于以物体为中心的感知，忽视了物体之间的空间关系。作者希望将关系理解引入前馈、免位姿的多视图场景中。
AI.method: 提出RelationVGGT框架：整合视觉基础模型的语义特征与3D几何基础模型的几何感知表示，并利用关系Transformer进行以主体为条件、跨视图的关系预测；无需逐场景优化，也无需已知相机位姿。此外，基于ScanNet++构建了结合VLM与LLM的全自动标注流程，用于可扩展训练数据生成。
AI.result: 原文未提供具体实验数据，仅说明该框架可在无位姿、前馈设定下跨视图分割由关系文本查询指定的目标，并支持可扩展训练数据生成。
AI.conclusion: 论文定义并研究了前馈、免位姿多视图下的3D空间关系分割，并提出RelationVGGT与配套数据标注流程，为空间关系理解提供了新任务设定与解决思路。

title: Concept Driven Domain Adaptation: Finding an Abstract Needle in a Haystack
summary: Science teachers frequently search for documentary excerpts not by describing what appears on screen, but by querying the abstract concepts they intend to teach. This use case exposes a limitation of existing language-based video moment retrieval methods, which typically assume that queries describe observable events, whereas instructional search requires retrieving concrete visual phenomena that instantiate an underlying scientific principle. We study this setting as concept-to-example video retrieval, an abstract-needle-in-a-haystack problem where compact curriculum concepts must be grounded in temporally sparse documentary evidence. To bridge this abstraction gap, we propose Concept-Driven Domain Adaptation (CDDA), a three-stage framework for adapting two-tower vision-language models to concept-level retrieval. CDDA treats concepts as intermediate semantic anchors: it first structures the textual embedding space with textbook and teacher-handbook example-concept pairs, then transfers this concept-aware geometry to documentary visuals under a frozen visual encoder, and finally jointly adapts both encoders with sparse visual concept supervision. From a geometric perspective, this staged alignment reduces text-concept and vision-concept angular gaps, thereby encouraging concept-level adaptation while preserving the pretrained model's concrete image description alignment. On a curated middle-school physics retrieval benchmark, CDDA achieves stronger pedagogically oriented concept retrieval than several competitive multimodal baselines, including Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, while maintaining concrete image-text matching after adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“概念到示例视频检索”新设定，并用三阶段框架CDDA将双塔视觉语言模型适配到概念级检索，在中学物理基准上优于多个多模态基线。
AI.motivation: 科学教师通常按想教的抽象概念而非屏幕可见事件检索纪录片片段，现有基于语言的视频时刻检索假设查询描述可观察事件，无法满足需要将抽象概念落地为具体视觉现象的教学检索需求。
AI.method: 提出概念驱动域适配（CDDA）三阶段框架：1）用教科书与教师手册的示例-概念对结构化文本嵌入空间；2）在冻结视觉编码器下将概念感知几何迁移到纪录片视觉；3）用稀疏视觉概念监督联合适配双编码器。几何上通过分阶段对齐缩小文本-概念与视觉-概念的角距离。
AI.result: 在自建中学物理检索基准上，CDDA的教学导向概念检索强于包括Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B在内的多个竞争性多模态基线，并在适配后保持具体图文匹配能力。
AI.conclusion: 概念可作为中间语义锚点，分阶段对齐能在不破坏预训练具体图文对齐的前提下实现概念级检索适配，为教学场景的视频片段检索提供有效方案。

title: NarrativeFlow: Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Model Using Robot Velocity Fields
summary: We focus on language-conditioned flow-based manipulation, where robot flows (robot velocity fields) serve as embodiment-agnostic, motion-centric representations for leveraging data collected from multiple robot platforms. This task is crucial because language-conditioned manipulation is essential for practical robotic systems, yet scaling robot foundation models remains limited by the labor-intensive collection of embodiment-specific data. Existing methods either coarsely approximate robot flows with sparse keypoint displacements, or cannot handle language-conditioned manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose NarrativeFlow, which models robot flows as continuous velocity fields using a flow-matching formulation conditioned on language. Accordingly, NarrativeFlow generates robot flows that are physically consistent with real-world manipulation. To validate NarrativeFlow, we have conducted experiments on standard datasets for language-conditioned manipulation. The experimental results show that NarrativeFlow outperforms representative baseline methods on standard evaluation metrics. Furthermore, through real-world experiments, we show that NarrativeFlow achieves higher success rates than baseline methods across multiple manipulation tasks. The project page is available at https://shota0520.github.io/NarrativeFlow-project-page/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NarrativeFlow，将机器人流建模为以语言为条件的连续速度场，通过 flow-matching 生成物理一致的机器人流，从而利用多平台数据实现语言条件下的操作，并在标准数据集与真实机器人任务上超越基线方法。
AI.motivation: 语言条件下的操作对实际机器人系统至关重要，但机器人基础模型的扩展受限于特定实体的数据采集成本高昂。机器人流（速度场）作为与实体无关、以运动为中心的表示，可复用多机器人平台的数据。然而现有方法要么用稀疏关键点位移粗略近似机器人流，要么无法处理语言条件下的操作。
AI.method: 提出 NarrativeFlow，将机器人流建模为连续速度场，采用以语言为条件的 flow-matching 形式化框架来生成机器人流，使其与真实世界操作在物理上保持一致。
AI.result: 在语言条件操作的标准数据集上，NarrativeFlow 在标准评价指标上优于代表性基线方法；在真实世界实验中，NarrativeFlow 在多种操作任务上取得了高于基线方法的成功率。
AI.conclusion: NarrativeFlow 通过连续速度场与语言条件 flow-matching 的建模方式，有效解决了现有方法在语言条件操作上的不足，并在标准数据集与真实机器人实验中验证了其优越性，为跨实体机器人数据利用提供了可行路径。

title: The Devil Is in the Reconstruction Loss Scale: Rethinking Optimization in LLM Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods typically use sequential quantization that partitions a pre-trained LLM into a series of units (e.g., transformer blocks), with one unit quantized at each stage. State-of-the-art PTQ methods are predominantly learning-based, optimizing auxiliary quantization parameters (e.g., scaling factors, rotation matrices, clipping thresholds, and adapters) via gradient descent to minimize a reconstruction loss. A common practice is to use mean squared error (MSE) as the reconstruction loss function, yet its induced optimization behavior remains largely unexplored. In this work, we take a holistic view of sequential quantization and systematically investigate how optimization evolves from the first quantization stage to the last, aiming for a deep understanding of optimization in learning-based PTQ schemes. Through extensive empirical studies spanning representative learning-based PTQ methods, LLM families, model scales, architectures, quantization settings and various tasks, we consistently uncover Optimization Imbalance: reconstruction loss magnitudes vary dramatically across stages, accompanied by highly uneven gradient magnitudes and parameter updates under MSE. We term the cross-stage range of loss magnitudes the reconstruction loss scale, and reveal that MSE translates the unexpectedly large reconstruction loss scale into highly uneven gradient magnitudes, which in turn lead to uneven optimization strength across quantization stages. This finding suggests a general principle for improving learning-based PTQ: optimization strength across stages should be decoupled from the reconstruction loss scale. Theoretically, we show that root mean squared error (RMSE) variants defined at the sample, channel, token, and element levels naturally realize this principle through implicit gradient normalization, outperforming MSE significantly as a drop-in replacement.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了基于学习的训练后量化（PTQ）中的优化过程，发现并揭示了"MSE导致的优化失衡"现象，并提出用RMSE变体作为即插即用替代方案来解耦优化强度与重建损失尺度。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的PTQ方法多为基于学习的方法，普遍使用MSE作为重建损失，但其诱导的优化行为尚未被深入探究。作者希望通过对顺序量化从第一阶段到最后一阶段的优化演化进行整体性研究，深入理解基于学习的PTQ方案中的优化机制。
AI.method: 作者对顺序量化采取整体视角，跨多种代表性学习型PTQ方法、LLM家族、模型规模、架构、量化设置及任务进行了大量实证研究，观察重建损失幅度、梯度幅度和参数更新的跨阶段变化；并进行了理论分析，说明样本、通道、token和元素级别的RMSE变体可通过隐式梯度归一化实现优化强度与损失尺度的解耦。
AI.result: 研究一致发现"优化失衡"（Optimization Imbalance）：各阶段重建损失幅度差异巨大，并伴随MSE下高度不均的梯度幅度和参数更新。作者将跨阶段的损失幅度范围定义为"重建损失尺度"，揭示MSE将此异常的损失尺度转化为高度不均的梯度幅度，进而导致各量化阶段优化强度不均。理论上证明RMSE变体作为即插即用替代可显著优于MSE。
AI.conclusion: 改进基于学习的PTQ的通用原则是：各阶段的优化强度应与重建损失尺度解耦。基于样本、通道、token和元素级别定义的RMSE变体通过隐式梯度归一化自然地实现了这一原则，作为MSE的直接替代可显著提升性能。

title: VIEScore2: Unified Image Evaluation with Spatially Grounded Explanations
summary: Existing synthetic image evaluators typically provide only a scalar quality score and do not identify the image regions that support it. We introduce VIEScore2, a unified evaluator for image generation and editing tasks with optional conditioning images. VIEScore2 represents an image as an N x N grid and jointly predicts quality scores and defect locations in a single model pass. Its text-native grid representation provides a common interface for heterogeneous spatial supervision and enables directly verifiable post-training objectives. We train on 38K examples spanning score-only, localization-only, and joint supervision across generation and editing tasks. Starting from supervised fine-tuning, we further apply GRPO to improve defect localization using rewards that combine cell-level Dice overlap, score accuracy, and output-format validity. A parameter-free parser converts the structured predictions into readable explanations. On the primary suite, VIEScore2 achieves an overall-score SRCC of 0.601, compared with 0.491 for Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest zero-shot general-purpose VLM baseline under matched inputs. For defect localization, VIEScore2 outperforms both general-purpose VLMs and specialized spatial evaluators on three of six benchmarks in per-image grid IoU and ranks among the top three on five, including datasets beyond its training sources.

AI.tldr: VIEScore2：将图像表示为N×N网格，在一次前向中同时预测质量分数与缺陷位置，统一生成与编辑任务的评估，显著优于零样本通用VLM基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多数合成图像评估器仅输出标量质量分数，无法指出支撑该分数的图像区域，缺乏空间可解释性；同时生成与编辑任务、有无条件图像等异构设定缺少统一接口与可验证的训练目标。
AI.method: 提出文本原生的N×N网格表示，为异构空间监督提供统一接口并支持直接可验证的后训练目标；在38K样本上进行分数监督、定位监督与联合监督训练；先做有监督微调，再用GRPO以单元级Dice重叠、分数准确率和输出格式有效性组成的奖励提升缺陷定位；参数无关解析器将结构化预测转为可读解释。
AI.result: 主评测集上总体分数SRCC达0.601，超过最强零样本通用VLM基线Gemini-3-Flash的0.491；缺陷定位在6个基准中3个的单图网格IoU优于通用VLM与专用空间评估器，5个进入前三，且包含训练来源之外的数据集。
AI.conclusion: 统一网格化表示与联合预测可在单次推理中同时给出分数与缺陷定位，兼顾评估精度与空间可解释性，并可推广到未见数据集，为图像生成与编辑评估提供统一方案。

title: Distilling Directional Verification
summary: Knowledge distillation aims to transfer the factual knowledge of large language models to smaller models for efficient deployment. Yet a teacher may recall a relation in one direction while failing to generate the answer in the reverse direction. Distillation from its generated answers can therefore propagate this directional limitation to the student. The same teacher can nevertheless recognize such an answer by scoring the relation in the direction it knows. We introduce directional label distillation, in which frozen teachers score candidate answers in that known direction and the best-scoring candidate becomes the student's training target. On facts about parents and their children, known-direction scoring yields more accurate labels than scoring the requested direction, even after tuned corrections for name priors. With prior-corrected scores, the better direction depends on the facts rather than the template, and reverses on mined facts whose notable entity is the parent rather than the child. With the evaluated children's forward facts withheld, students trained on known-direction labels improve open-ended accuracy on their trained queries by 13 to 15 points over students trained on prior-corrected reverse labels. After generated answers are matched to a fixed name list by lexical similarity, students reproduce nearly all selected labels. Their accuracy largely follows label quality. The label advantage holds on unscreened queries and when candidates are retrieved without inserting correct answers. Our findings show that directional verification mitigates the transfer of errors from teacher-generated answers to students by providing more accurate training targets. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/directional-verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出方向性标签蒸馏（directional label distillation）：让冻结教师模型在其"已知方向"上对候选答案打分，以最优候选作为学生模型的训练目标，从而缓解教师生成答案中方向性错误向学生的传播。在父母-子女关系事实上，已知方向打分比请求方向打分标签更准确，学生开放式准确率提升13–15个点。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏旨在将大语言模型的事实知识迁移给小模型以便高效部署。但教师模型可能存在方向性局限：能回忆某一方向的关系，却在反向生成时失败。若直接蒸馏其生成的答案，该方向性缺陷会传播给学生。然而，同一个教师在其"已知方向"上对同一答案进行打分时却能够识别正确与否，这为获得更可靠标签提供了机会。
AI.method: 提出方向性标签蒸馏：冻结教师模型在已知方向上对候选答案打分，取最高分候选作为学生的训练目标。使用经过先验修正（prior-corrected）的打分，并对生成答案通过词汇相似度匹配到固定姓名列表。在父母-子女关系事实上对比已知方向打分与请求方向打分的标签质量，并考察更好方向是否取决于事实本身而非模板（在"知名实体为父母"的挖掘事实上方向反转）；同时设置屏蔽儿童前向事实等条件进行对照实验。
AI.result: 已知方向打分比请求方向打分产生更准确的标签，即使在做姓名先验的调优修正后依然如此。经先验修正后，更优方向取决于事实而非模板，并且在知名实体为父母而非子女的挖掘事实上发生反转。在屏蔽所评估儿童的前向事实时，使用已知方向标签训练的学生在其训练查询上的开放式准确率，比使用先验修正的反向标签训练的学生高13–15个点。生成答案经词汇相似度匹配到固定姓名列表后，学生几乎能复现全部所选的标签；其准确率大体跟随标签质量。这种标签优势在未筛选查询以及不插入正确答案的候选检索条件下依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，方向性验证通过提供更准确的训练目标，缓解了错误从教师生成答案向学生的迁移。即教师模型在其已知方向上做验证性打分，可有效提升蒸馏所得学生模型的事实准确率。代码已开源。

title: Watch Your Speech: Text-aware Video-to-Speech Synthesis with Textual Conditioning
summary: Video-to-speech synthesis aims to generate natural-sounding speech from silent talking-face videos while ensuring phonetic accuracy. A fundamental challenge in this task is the inherent one-to-many mapping problem, where visual dynamics often lack sufficient information to uniquely determine the corresponding utterance. To address this, we propose Watch Your Speech (WYS), a video-to-speech synthesis framework that incorporates textual conditioning as an explicit linguistic cue to mitigate visual ambiguity. Our framework features an attention-based embedding fusion module that synergistically integrates textual context with video sequences, coupled with a conditional flow matching objective for high-fidelity speech generation. Extensive experiments on the LRS2 and LRS3 datasets demonstrate that WYS achieves superior performance, establishing new state-of-the-art results in audio-visual synchronization (LSE-C/D) while maintaining highly competitive textual accuracy (WER). Subjective evaluations further confirm that our model generates speech with near-human naturalness, validating the effectiveness of textual conditioning in content-controlled video-to-speech synthesis. Project page: https://github.com/gunwoo5034/Watch-your-Speech

AI.tldr: 提出WYS框架，引入文本条件作为显式语言线索，缓解视频到语音合成中的一对多映射问题，在LRS2/LRS3上取得SOTA同步性能并保持有竞争力的文本准确率。
AI.motivation: 视频到语音合成需从无声说话人脸视频生成自然语音并保证音素准确。其核心挑战是一对多映射：视觉动态信息不足以唯一确定对应话语，导致合成结果存在歧义。
AI.method: WYS框架以文本条件作为显式语言线索缓解视觉歧义；设计基于注意力的嵌入融合模块，将文本上下文与视频序列协同融合；采用条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）目标实现高保真语音生成。
AI.result: 在LRS2和LRS3数据集上，WYS在音视频同步指标（LSE-C/D）上刷新SOTA，同时保持具有竞争力的文本准确率（WER）；主观评测表明生成语音接近人类自然度。
AI.conclusion: 文本条件在内容可控的视频到语音合成中有效，可在保证语音自然度的同时提升同步质量与文本准确性。

title: VASC: Value-Aware Sparse Attention with Cross-Layer Memory for Efficient 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D vision models such as VGGT have achieved remarkable progress, unifying camera estimation and dense scene reconstruction in a single pass. However, their quadratic global attention makes long image sequences expensive, while existing sparse methods may favor highly attended yet value-redundant regions. To address these limitations, we introduce VASC, a training-free sparse attention method combining value-aware block selection and execution-aware cross-layer memory. Our value-aware block selection integrates pooled query--key relevance with neighboring value contrast, reducing redundancy while preserving query-relevant and distinctive content. Cross-layer memory tracks unserved demand across layers and updates this state according to actual execution, enabling previously underserved blocks to compete under a fixed computation budget. Experiments on 7Scenes and NeuralRGB-D with VGGT and $π^3$ demonstrate improved pose estimation and reconstruction quality compared with FasterVGGT, together with up to $2.29\times$ faster inference than dense VGGT. Code is available at https://github.com/kosakayamahoo-design/VASC.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练稀疏注意力方法 VASC，通过值感知块选择与执行感知跨层记忆，降低前馈3D视觉模型（VGGT、π³）的冗余与开销，在7Scenes和NeuralRGB-D上提升位姿与重建质量，推理最高提速2.29倍。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D视觉模型（如VGGT）将相机估计与稠密场景重建统一到单次前向中，但二次复杂度的全局注意力使长图像序列代价高昂；现有稀疏方法倾向于选择注意力高但值冗余的区域，导致计算浪费与信息损失。
AI.method: VASC 为免训练稀疏注意力：1）值感知块选择，将池化后的 query–key 相关性与邻域值对比度结合，在保留 query 相关且具区分度内容的同时降低冗余；2）执行感知跨层记忆，跟踪跨层未被服务的需求，并依据实际执行结果更新该状态，使此前被欠服务的块能在固定计算预算下参与竞争。
AI.result: 在7Scenes与NeuralRGB-D数据集上，基于VGGT和π³验证，相比FasterVGGT在位姿估计与重建质量上均有提升，相较稠密VGGT推理最高提速2.29倍。
AI.conclusion: VASC 以即插即用、免训练的方式缓解了前馈3D视觉模型的注意力冗余与长序列开销问题，在保持甚至提升精度的情况下显著加速推理，为高效3D视觉提供可行方案。
