title: Scaling and Distilling Text Embeddings for Better Diffusibility
comment: 28 pages, 12 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/la0ka1/diffusing-scaled-text-embeddings
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) language generation. Recent advances in continuous DLMs, which apply latent diffusion to continuous text embeddings, raise a practical question: which embedding makes the best latent space, i.e., the most diffusible? To answer this, we search through different embeddings and find that scaling the embedding model to stronger ones within the same family (T5 to T5Gemma-1 to T5Gemma-2) greatly improves generative performance. But the raw T5Gemma-2 embeddings are still not optimal. They are so discriminative that even the embeddings of plausible alternative words are separated, which makes the generation vulnerable to imperfect sampling. Consequently, continuous diffusion often fails to reach any of them and ends up at an invalid embedding instead. To address this, we distill T5Gemma-2 into a student encoder that learns the teacher's decoded probabilities as soft labels. Learning from such soft labels makes the student pull the alternative embeddings closer while maintaining the encoding-decoding mechanism. The distilled embeddings form a more connected and diffusible latent space, improving over the vanilla T5Gemma-2 embeddings. As a result, our medium-sized DLM achieves Gen. PPL 17.8 (against real-text PPL 15.4) at real-text entropy on OpenWebText, outperforming GPT-2-M on Gen. PPL.

AI.tldr: 将T5Gemma-2编码器蒸馏为学生编码器，学习教师解码概率作为软标签，构建更连通、更可扩散的连续文本嵌入潜空间，中等规模扩散语言模型在OpenWebText上达到Gen. PPL 17.8，优于GPT-2-M。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型（DLM）将潜在扩散用于连续文本嵌入，但"哪种嵌入构成最优（最可扩散）的潜空间"这一问题尚不明确。原始强判别性嵌入（如T5Gemma-2）把合理的替代词嵌入也相互分离，导致生成对不完美采样十分脆弱：扩散过程往往无法命中任一有效嵌入，最终落到无效嵌入上。
AI.method: 在不同嵌入族间进行搜索，发现同族内将嵌入模型放大到更强版本（T5→T5Gemma-1→T5Gemma-2）可显著提升生成性能。但原始T5Gemma-2仍非最优，故通过蒸馏将T5Gemma-2迁移到一个学生编码器：令学生以教师解码概率作为软标签进行学习，使学生把替代词嵌入拉近，同时保持编码-解码机制。
AI.result: 蒸馏得到的嵌入形成更连通、更可扩散的潜空间，优于原始T5Gemma-2嵌入。在OpenWebText上，中等规模DLM在真实文本熵下取得Gen. PPL 17.8（真实文本PPL为15.4），并在Gen. PPL上超过GPT-2-M。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间的"可扩散性"是连续扩散语言生成的关键，嵌入的强判别性会损害生成；通过软标签蒸馏可构造更连通的嵌入空间并显著提升生成质量，表明嵌入选择与重塑应成为连续DLM设计的重要环节。

title: Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

AI.tldr: 提出 InFlowOp，用无标签成本统一刻画多智能体工作流的构建与运行决策，并发布多智能体协调基准 Braid。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体工作流构建困难：任务分解粒度、子任务与智能体的匹配、何时新增专家等关键决策必须预先确定，成功与否只能等运行后才知道；而改进工作流代价高昂，故障定位通常需要参考答案、打分结果或训练好的评估器，修复往往需整体重执行、重新搜索或重新训练。
AI.method: 提出 InFlowOp，将每一个决策统一折算为一种无标签成本，该成本同时衡量智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配程度以及运行代价。执行前，成本驱动双向确定任务分解粒度与智能体分配，摆脱固定模板；执行中，依据同一成本以最小代价动作纠正故障，使同一成本既服务于工作流构建又服务于运行。同时构建 Braid 基准，其任务需要超出单智能体能力的多智能体协作。
AI.result: 在多种领域与多种骨干模型上，InFlowOp 相较单智能体基线最高提升 +11.97%，采用流内优化时提升 +9.64%。
AI.conclusion: InFlowOp 用统一的成本机制联动工作流的构建与运行阶段，在无需标签与外部评估器的前提下实现高效的多智能体工作流自适应优化，并获得一致的经验性增益。

title: FutureWorlds: Learning Robotic World Models from Alternative Futures
comment: 32 pages, including references and appendix. Code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds
summary: Robotic world models predict action-conditioned future scenes, providing a foundation for understanding action outcomes. However, turning alternative predictions into useful learning signals remains challenging: similar candidates limit informative quality comparisons, while diverging trajectories require persistent maintenance of their individual histories. We introduce FutureWorlds, a framework that unifies candidate construction, history maintenance, and learning from relative quality. Built on a multimodal discrete autoregressive model, FutureWorlds uses diverse beam search during reinforcement learning to construct candidate futures that balance confidence and diversity. Candidate-specific bounded memory preserves scene states and ensures that generation and policy scoring use matching histories. We further propose MemSPO (Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization), which converts video trajectory rewards into group-relative advantages to optimize the world model. On RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa, FutureWorlds reduces LPIPS for 32-frame predictions by 14.78%, 20.84%, and 9.12%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. Under fixed evaluation configurations, only 200 MemSPO updates further improve generation quality and support continued prediction beyond the training horizon. Memory ablations, decoding sensitivity analysis, and optical-flow evaluation show that these gains extend beyond visual quality to more accurate motion prediction and more consistent object states. Project page and code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FutureWorlds框架，统一候选构建、历史维护与相对质量学习，结合记忆条件化搜索引导策略优化MemSPO，显著提升机器人世界模型的未来场景预测质量。
AI.motivation: 机器人世界模型可预测动作条件下的未来场景，但将多个备选预测转化为有效学习信号存在困难：候选过于相似则难以进行有信息量的质量比较，候选差异过大则需持续维护各自的历史状态。因此需要一种能同时兼顾候选多样性构建、历史一致维护与相对质量学习的统一框架。
AI.method: FutureWorlds基于多模态离散自回归模型构建：在强化学习中使用多样性束搜索生成兼顾置信度与多样性的候选未来；采用候选专属的有界记忆保存场景状态，确保生成与策略评分使用匹配的历史；提出MemSPO（记忆条件化搜索引导策略优化），将视频轨迹奖励转化为组相对优势以优化世界模型。
AI.result: 在RT-1、BridgeV2和RoboCasa数据集上，相对各自最强基线，FutureWorlds将32帧预测的LPIPS分别降低14.78%、20.84%和9.12%。在固定评估配置下，仅200次MemSPO更新即进一步改善生成质量，并支持超出训练时长的持续预测。记忆消融、解码敏感性分析与光流评估表明，增益不仅限于视觉质量，还体现在更准确的运动预测和更一致的对象状态上。
AI.conclusion: FutureWorlds通过统一候选构建、有界记忆维护与基于相对质量的学习，有效提升了机器人世界模型的预测质量、运动准确性与对象状态一致性，并具备超出训练horizon的持续预测能力和良好的消融验证支撑。

title: Towards Automatic Video Annotation with ASH: Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking and Segmentation
summary: Memory-attention-based Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) methods have demonstrated strong zero-shot tracking capability, yet their substantial memory requirements confine them to short video clips and their single-prompt inference design makes multi-category open-vocabulary tracking computationally prohibitive. This work introduces two contributions toward fully automated tracking annotation of arbitrary video. The Generalized Presence Token (GPT) reformulates SAM3's inference pipeline to process N text prompts simultaneously via virtual prompt batching, reducing image encoding cost from O(N) to O(1) with no modifications to any learned component. The Annotation and Segmentation Handler (ASH) extends any memory-attention VIS tracker to sequences of arbitrary length through overlapping temporal chunks with IoU-based inter-chunk identity matching, requiring no dataset-specific training. Instantiated on SAM3, the resulting pipeline -- SAM3-ASH -- achieves state-of-the-art HOTA on MOTS20 under fully zero-shot conditions and remains competitive with trained specialists across seven additional benchmarks, while peak GPU memory consumption stays below 25 GB, establishing a practical baseline for scalable, training-free automated video annotation.

AI.tldr: 提出GPT与ASH两个模块，使SAM3在无需训练的情况下实现任意长视频的多类别开放词表实例分割与跟踪，峰值显存低于25GB，零样本HOTA达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于记忆-注意力的视频实例分割方法零样本跟踪能力强，但显存开销大，仅适用于短片段；且单提示推理设计使多类别开放词表跟踪的计算成本过高，难以实现全自动的视频标注。
AI.method: 1) Generalized Presence Token（GPT）：将SAM3的推理流程重构为虚拟提示批处理，使N个文本提示可同时处理，将图像编码成本从O(N)降至O(1)，且不修改任何学习组件；2) Annotation and Segmentation Handler（ASH）：通过带IoU帧间身份匹配的重叠时间分块，将任意记忆-注意力VIS跟踪器扩展至任意长度序列，无需数据集特定训练。二者实例化于SAM3得到SAM3-ASH。
AI.result: 在完全零样本条件下，SAM3-ASH在MOTS20上取得当前最优HOTA，并在另外七个基准上与经过训练的专用方法保持竞争力，同时峰值GPU显存占用低于25GB。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可扩展、免训练的全自动视频标注建立了实用基线，表明通过推理流程重构与时间分块匹配即可突破显存与提示数量的限制。

title: Groundability, Not Scale Alone: When Weak Reviewers Can Audit Strong Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents can return plausible patches that omit required behavior. These failures are hard to review because long traces and confident summaries often hide what was missed. We ask when a nominally weaker reviewer can reliably decide whether a patch solves its issue. We study 411 execution-labeled traces from three agents and 101 controlled cases. On 154 GPT-5.4 traces, structured but unchecked evidence raises both defect catch and over-rejection. We then provide official execution evidence as an upper-bound diagnostic. After choosing and freezing one of two formats per reviewer, five of six reviewers improve both rates on 122 held-out traces; two classify every trace correctly. Reviewer size is not a consistent predictor of quality. Because official tests are unavailable in deployment, we also evaluate a frozen cascade with patch-caused static errors and generated tests that first fail on the unpatched repository. On 121 scored held-out GPT-5.4 traces and 59 Gemini traces, its coverage is 0.89 and 0.86, risk is 0.33 and 0.26, catch is 0.76 and 0.80, and over-rejection is 0.66 and 0.67. Most false rejections occur when unresolved cases reach the reviewer. Official execution evidence shows the potential of weak review when decisive checks are available. Producing equally reliable checks without official tests remains the main bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 研究编码代理补丁审查：弱审查者在"权威执行证据"下能可靠判定补丁是否解决问题，但无官方测试时，自行生成检查的可靠性仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 编码代理会返回貌似合理但遗漏必要行为的补丁，而长执行轨迹和自信的摘要往往掩盖了这些遗漏，导致此类失败难以人工审查。作者因此追问：一个名义上更弱的审查者，能否可靠地判断某补丁是否真正解决了其对应的问题。
AI.method: 基于来自三个代理的411条带执行标签的轨迹与101个受控案例展开研究。在154条GPT-5.4轨迹上，考察"结构化但未经校验的证据"对审查的影响；随后引入官方执行证据作为上界诊断。让每位审查者在两种格式中择一并冻结，在122条留出轨迹上评估。进一步在无官方测试的部署条件下，评估一个冻结级联方案：由补丁引入的静态错误（patch-caused static errors）加上"在未打补丁仓库上首次失败"的生成测试构成。在121条GPT-5.4与59条Gemini计分留出轨迹上测量覆盖率、风险、缺陷捕获率与过度拒绝率。
AI.result: 结构化但未经校验的证据同时抬高缺陷捕获率与过度拒绝率。提供官方执行证据作为上界后，六位审查者中有五位在122条留出轨迹上两项指标均改善，其中两位能完全正确分类所有轨迹；审查者规模并非质量的稳定预测因子。冻结级联方案在GPT-5.4上覆盖率为0.89、风险0.33、捕获0.76、过度拒绝0.66，在Gemini上分别为0.86、0.26、0.80、0.67。多数误拒发生在未解决案例被送抵审查者时。
AI.conclusion: 官方执行证据表明：当存在决定性检查时，弱审查具备可观潜力。真正的瓶颈在于，在缺乏官方测试的情况下如何生成同等可靠的检查。

title: It Takes Workflows to Evolve Better Workflows
summary: Tackling complex real-world tasks can exceed the capabilities of a single large language model (LLM), motivating the use of multi-agent workflows that coordinate specialized agents to work together on these tasks. Recent methods train LLMs to construct better workflows from execution outcomes, but they optimize only the workflow generator, while the other agents that build or execute each workflow remain fixed even though every outcome depends on all of them. However, extending training beyond the generator is challenging: the agents are coupled, and a workflow's outcome is a single sparse score that cannot tell which agent causes a failure. We propose FloWright, which leverages the workflow as a harness to optimize workflows. By introducing a hierarchical, structure-aware reward paradigm, FloWright enables one role to self-evolve and two or more roles to co-evolve, with no additional models, labels, or executions. Considering the limitation that workflows are commonly trained and evaluated on data that a single agent can already handle, we further propose DataWright, an adaptive data hardening approach that converts existing datasets into workflow-level tasks with increased difficulty. Across document, slide, chart, code, math, and finance tasks, small open models trained with FloWright achieve improved performance by up to $+7.41\%$, with co-evolving ($+5.03\%$) more roles gaining more than optimizing one of them alone ($+2.83\%$). Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/FloWright/.

AI.tldr: 提出 FloWright 与 DataWright，用结构感知的分层奖励实现多智能体工作流中多角色的自进化与协同进化，并在多类任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 真实复杂任务常超出单个大语言模型（LLM）的能力，需要由多个专精智能体协同构建并执行工作流。现有方法仅训练工作流生成器，而构建/执行工作流的其他智能体保持固定；但工作流结果依赖所有智能体。直接扩展训练范围很困难：智能体之间相互耦合，且整条工作流只有一个稀疏的结果分数，无法定位是何角色导致失败。此外，现有工作流的数据通常单智能体即可解决，训练与评估难度不足。
AI.method: FloWright：将工作流本身作为"缰绳/载体"（harness）来优化工作流，引入分层、结构感知（structure-aware）的奖励范式，使单个角色可自我进化（self-evolve），两个及以上角色可协同进化（co-evolve），且无需额外模型、标注或执行。DataWright：自适应数据加固（adaptive data hardening），将现有数据集转换为难度更高的"工作流级"任务。
AI.result: 在文档、幻灯片、图表、代码、数学与金融任务上，使用 FloWright 训练的小型开源模型性能提升最高达 +7.41%；协同进化（+5.03%）优于仅优化单一角色（+2.83%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构感知的分层奖励，可把优化范围从生成器扩展到多角色，实现多智能体的协同进化；协同优化多角色比优化单角色收益更大，配合数据加固可进一步提升工作流级任务的难度与训练效果。

title: LawCompass: Navigating from Legal QA to Multi-Agent Deep Research with Grounded Evidence
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have significantly democratized access to legal information. Nevertheless, most existing legal assistants remain confined to multi-turn conversational QA, failing to support complex legal tasks that require systematic evidence retrieval, multi-step reasoning, and report-level synthesis. In this paper, we present LawCompass, an evidence-grounded legal assistant that navigates the transition from standard Legal QA to multi-agent deep research. LawCompass provides three task-oriented functions: Legal QA, which delivers precise, evidence-backed answers to legal questions; Professional Retrieval, which enables structured exploration of statutes and judicial cases via query rewriting; and Deep Research, which employs a multi-agent workflow to decompose complex legal tasks and synthesize comprehensive research reports. Crucially, LawCompass maintains explicit citation links across all modules, empowering users to directly verify system outputs against original legal sources. Evaluation results demonstrate that LawCompass provides a practical and scalable paradigm for transforming conversational AI into trustworthy and evidence-grounded legal research assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LawCompass，一个立足于证据溯源的法律助手，实现从传统法律问答到多智能体深度研究的转变，包含法律问答、专业检索与深度研究三大功能，并全程保持显式引文链接以支持用户核验。
AI.motivation: LLM 与 RAG 虽降低了法律信息获取门槛，但现有法律助手多局限于多轮对话式问答，难以支撑需要系统性证据检索、多步推理与报告级综合的复杂法律任务。
AI.method: LawCompass 设计三个面向任务的功能模块：1) 法律问答，提供精确且证据支撑的回答；2) 专业检索，通过查询重写实现法规与判例的结构化探索；3) 深度研究，采用多智能体工作流分解复杂法律任务并综合生成研究报告。所有模块间保持显式引文链接。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，LawCompass 为将会话式 AI 转变为可信、证据落地的法律研究辅助工具提供了实用且可扩展的范式。
AI.conclusion: LawCompass 通过多智能体深度研究与全链路引文溯源，突破了传统法律问答的局限，为构建可信法律研究助手提供了可扩展路径。

title: WAMJET: A Harness for World Action Model Acceleration
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video foundation models for robot manipulation, but their large backbones and video-action co-prediction are expensive. Although existing acceleration techniques offer many ways to reduce this cost, selecting and composing them requires substantial engineering for each model and hardware platform. To tackle this bottleneck, we present WAMJET, an agentic harness that accelerates WAM inference by equipping coding agents with reusable optimization guidance and measurement and validation tools. WAMJET follows a bottleneck-driven workflow where the agent profiles inference, modifies targeted code, validates effects, and iteratively refines the acceleration stack as bottlenecks shift, while preserving action quality. Experiments span six WAMs, three coding agents, and two GPU architectures. WAMJET achieves up to 9.95x lossless speedup over upstream implementations. Approximation and hardware-aware optimization yield additional latency reductions, with comparable success rates. The results show that WAMJET can produce effective acceleration stacks for WAM deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出WAMJET——一个agentic加速框架，通过为编码智能体提供可复用的优化指引、测量与验证工具，自动为世界动作模型(WAM)构建推理加速栈，最高实现9.95倍无损加速。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型(WAM)借助预训练视频基础模型做机器人操作，但其大骨干网络与视频-动作联合预测导致推理开销高昂。现有加速技术虽多，却需针对每个模型和硬件平台做大量工程化选型与组合，形成部署瓶颈。
AI.method: WAMJET是一个agentic harness，为编码智能体配备可复用的优化指导以及测量、验证工具。其采用瓶颈驱动的工作流：智能体对推理进行性能剖析(profiling)，定位并修改目标代码，验证优化效果，并在瓶颈迁移时迭代精炼加速栈，同时保持动作质量。
AI.result: 实验覆盖6个WAM、3种编码智能体、2种GPU架构。WAMJET相较上游实现取得最高9.95倍无损加速；近似优化与硬件感知优化进一步降低时延，且成功率相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，WAMJET能够为WAM部署生成有效的加速栈，验证了以智能体驱动、瓶颈导向的自动化优化流程的可行性与通用性。

title: Bootstrapping Video Interaction Generation with Synthetic State Transitions
summary: While recent video generative models can synthesize high-fidelity videos, they struggle to portray plausible physical interactions and the resulting state transitions, a critical bottleneck for applications in robotics and VR/AR. To address this, we introduce a framework to generate a scalable synthetic dataset of controllable interactions. Our pipeline leverages a structured taxonomy and state-of-the-art image editing models to create explicit `start' and `end' state images, which serve as visual anchors for the interaction. To generate a seamless video utilizing these anchors, we propose State-Guided Sampling (SGS), a novel sampling technique that mitigates artifacts common in naive conditional generation. Furthermore, we develop and validate a new automated evaluation system that aligns with human judgments to ensure data quality. Experiments show that fine-tuning a base model on our dataset significantly enhances its ability to generate plausible interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可扩展的合成数据集生成框架，用于可控物理交互视频生成。框架结合结构化分类法与图像编辑模型生成显式起止状态图像作为视觉锚点，并提出状态引导采样（SGS）技术生成无缝视频，同时建立自动化评估系统。实验表明在合成数据集上微调基座模型可显著提升交互生成能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能合成高保真视频，但难以描绘合理的物理交互及其状态转移，这是机器人与VR/AR应用的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 1）构建可扩展的可控交互合成数据集框架，利用结构化分类法与先进图像编辑模型生成显式"起始"和"结束"状态图像作为视觉锚点；2）提出状态引导采样（State-Guided Sampling, SGS），一种新颖采样技术，缓解朴素条件生成中常见伪影；3）开发并验证与人类判断对齐的自动化评估系统以保障数据质量。
AI.result: 实验表明，在提出的合成数据集上微调基座模型，能显著增强其生成合理交互的能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过状态锚点与SGS采样可有效生成可控交互视频数据，并提升模型物理交互生成表现。

title: Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent communication aims to help agents benefit from one another's information. Yet improvements in system performance leave a fundamental ambiguity: do they reflect effective communication, a favorable agent architecture, or simply additional reasoning? Because communication methods are commonly evaluated within the systems they were designed for, these factors are difficult to disentangle. Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions. We introduce Independent--Communicate--Revise (ICR), a controlled framework that evaluates communication as answer revision following independent reasoning. ICR fixes initial reasoning trajectories, measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness, and uses a no-message revision control to quantify gains beyond additional reasoning. Across four reasoning benchmarks, our audit of textual and latent communication reveals that similar aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behaviors. Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike. Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks. These findings challenge treating communication quality as an intrinsic property of a channel. ICR therefore recenters evaluation on selective revision, providing a unified framework for examining how message content and receiver policies jointly produce benefits and harms.

AI.tldr: 该文提出受控框架ICR，将多智能体通信评估从最终准确率重构为"独立推理—通信—修正"三阶段的答案修正行为分析，揭示聚合准确率掩盖了差异化的修正与保持行为，并强调通信质量并非信道固有属性。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体通信研究存在两重模糊性：一是系统性能提升难以区分是源于有效通信、智能体架构，还是单纯增加了推理量；二是最终准确率将"纠错"与"被污染的错误答案"合并为单一结果，无法揭示通信如何改变决策过程。且通信方法通常仅在为其设计的系统内评估，因素难以解耦。
AI.method: 提出Independent–Communicate–Revise (ICR)受控框架：固定初始推理轨迹，以"独立推理后的答案修正"为评估对象；在双方初始正确性条件下分别度量修正率(correction)与保持率(preservation)；引入无消息的修正对照(no-message revision control)以剥离单纯额外推理带来的增益。在四个推理基准上审计文本通信与潜在(latent)通信，并在MedQA与GPQA-D上比较接收方策略。
AI.result: 四个基准上，相近的聚合准确率可对应显著不同的修正行为。相比仅传递答案，传递完整推理在所有四个基准上均提高修正率同时降低保持率，说明更丰富的信息同时放大了有益与有害影响。MedQA与GPQA-D的接收方策略比较显示，结构化验证策略使各信道向"更高保持、更低修正"移动，而其对选择性的影响随信道与任务而异。
AI.conclusion: 研究挑战了"通信质量是信道内在属性"的传统观点，指出收益与损害由消息内容与接收方策略共同决定。ICR将评估重心重新定位于选择性修正(selective revision)，为统一分析消息内容与接收方策略如何共同产生收益与损害提供了框架。

title: Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What They Cannot Deliver
summary: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness is decided by the agent's configuration at the moment of speaking, so it can be detected from a single turn, before deployment or at run time. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and an outcome taxonomy that separates these failures from honest deferrals and from over-refusal. We build a checker (a setup-blind detector, deterministic feasibility rules, and a response judge) validated against 400 human labels. On a controlled benchmark of 293 follow-up requests across five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, four open-weight models of 8-14B parameters fail on 45.9% of responses when no tool exists and nothing is stated. A frontier model fails on 4.4%, but it gets there by deferring and asking, not by using the tools it has: promises made without the enabling call remain in every model. Telling the model its runtime, the cheapest fix, cuts open-weight failures nearly in half where nothing is doable and changes nothing where a scheduler exists; a directive capability card removes most failures at the largest cost in over-refusal; running the checker in the loop and rewriting flagged replies removes more at a smaller cost. Code, prompts, model outputs, and human labels are released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"空承诺"（empty commitment）概念：智能体承诺在当前轮次之后执行某项动作，但其工具或运行时无法实现该承诺。区别于失信承诺，空承诺可由单轮对话在部署前或运行时检出。作者基于承诺语义定义了三种失败类型、锚定条件与结果分类法，构建了包含检测器、确定性可行性规则和回复评判器的检查器，并用400条人工标注验证。
AI.motivation: 聊天机器人常作出"我明天提醒你"这类承诺，但用户不再发言时智能体不会再运行，承诺无从兑现。此类空承诺由智能体当时配置决定，可在单轮内检出，需在部署前或运行时加以识别与消除。
AI.method: 在承诺语义之上定义空承诺，给出三类失败、工具可实现承诺的锚定条件，以及区分空承诺失败与诚实延迟、过度拒绝的结果分类法。构建检查器：setup-blind 检测器＋确定性可行性规则＋回复评判器，用400条人工标注验证。在293条后续请求、五个逐步增加持久化能力的设定构成的受控基准上评测四个8–14B开源模型与一个前沿模型。
AI.result: 无工具且未加说明时空开源模型失败率达45.9%；前沿模型失败率4.4%，但靠延迟与询问而非使用已有工具，且所有模型都存在"未调用使能工具即作承诺"的现象。告知运行时（最廉价修复）在无可行操作时将近乎减半开源模型失败率，在有调度器时不产生影响；能力卡指令消除大部分失败但过度拒绝代价最大；检查器入环并改写被标记回复可在更小代价下消除更多失败。
AI.conclusion: 空承诺是可单轮检测的配置性缺陷，跨模型普遍存在；低成本干预（告知运行时）与检查器入环改写是有效缓解手段，而能力卡在降低失败的同时带来最高过度拒绝代价。代码、提示、模型输出与人工标注已公开。

title: Sentence Specificity Scores for Collaborative Technical Documentation: A Domain-Transfer Study
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE 12th International Conference on Collaboration and Internet Computing (CIC)
summary: Collaboration depends on shared context, and technical documentation is one way that context persists across people and AI teammates. Specificity, the amount and exactness of detail expressed in language, shapes what information documentation captures and how precisely that information is communicated. This work audits sentence-specificity scoring artifacts on technical documentation and tests whether scores applied only after generation help choose among fixed LLM-generated revisions. Across Wikipedia and three technical-documentation corpora, the fixed general-domain predictor SpeciTeller and the pinned post-publication author-repository implementation of Ko et al.'s target-adapted predictor produce different corpus orders and same-sentence rank agreement from -0.066 to 0.510. Strict filtering and token-length adjustment change these patterns without reconciling them. In the Gemma set, SpeciTeller ranking raises direction-valid selection from 71.7% to 83.3% (+11.7 points; 95% source-case bootstrap interval +1.7 to +21.7); in the GPT-OSS-120B set, SpeciTeller ranking raises direction-valid selection from 51.7% to 56.7% (+5.0 points; 95% source-case bootstrap interval -6.7 to +16.7), and every primary single-score GPT-OSS-120B interval includes zero. These findings tie score interpretation and decision value to the predictor and candidate set.

AI.tldr: 该工作审计技术文档上句子特异性评分工具（SpeciTeller与Ko等的目标适配预测器），并测试仅在生成后使用该分数能否在固定LLM修订候选中做出选择。两工具在语料排序与同句秩一致性上存在差异（-0.066至0.510），过滤与长度调整无法调和；在Gemma集上SpeciTeller排序将方向有效选择从71.7%提升至83.3%，在GPT-OSS-120B集上从51.7%提升至56.7%且各主要区间含零。结论：分数解释与决策价值取决于预测器与候选集。
AI.motivation: 协作依赖共享上下文，技术文档是上下文在人-AI团队间持久化的重要载体；特异性（细节的数量与精确度）决定文档所捕获与传达的信息。既有句子特异性评分工具多为通用域预测器或特定实现，其得分是否可跨语料解释、能否实际用于生成后选择修订尚不清楚，因此需要审计评分伪影并检验其决策价值。
AI.method: 在Wikipedia及三个技术文档语料上，对比固定通用域预测器SpeciTeller与Ko等目标适配预测器的固定发布后作者仓库实现；计算语料级排序与同句秩一致性（Spearman类秩一致），并施加严格过滤与token长度调整。在Gemma与GPT-OSS-120B生成的固定修订候选集上，仅用生成后评分对候选排序，以"方向有效选择"率作为决策指标，并用源案例bootstrap给出95%区间。
AI.result: 两个预测器产生不同的语料排序，同句秩一致性介于-0.066至0.510；严格过滤与token长度调整改变模式但无法调和差异。Gemma集：SpeciTeller排序使方向有效选择由71.7%升至83.3%（+11.7个百分点，95%源案例bootstrap区间+1.7至+21.7）。GPT-OSS-120B集：由51.7%升至56.7%（+5.0个百分点，95%区间-6.7至+16.7），且所有主要单分数区间均含零。
AI.conclusion: 句子特异性分数的解释与决策价值并非工具无关，而取决于所用预测器与候选集；通用域预测器在部分设置下可提升方向有效选择，但增益在另一模型集上不显著。使用此类评分进行生成后选择时需报告预测器、实现版本与候选集，并对区间含零的结果保持谨慎。

title: Towards Subject Consistency over Dynamic Subject Sets in Video Generation
summary: We argue that as video generation extends to longer durations, subject consistency should be evaluated over \textit{dynamic subject sets}. We therefore introduce \textbf{DynSC-Eval}, an evaluation framework that dynamically tracks eligible subjects throughout their visible lifespans and measures local continuity and global identity preservation using six complementary object-level metrics, with explicit detection of inconsistency events. To validate its effectiveness, we design synthetic experiments that actively inject inconsistency events, demonstrating both the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and the limitations of existing metrics. Evaluations of diverse models on 5s, 15s, and 60s video generation further reveal substantial subject consistency differences that are obscured by conventional metrics. Beyond evaluation, we construct rewards from DynSC-Eval and apply DiffusionNFT post-training in an autonomous-driving testbed. On 5s generation, our approach reduces the six inconsistency metrics by an average of 13.82\% for Wan-2.1-1.3B and 5.66\% for SANA-2B, with improvements also observed on the I2V model ReSim. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. We then extend generation to 10s and 30s through curriculum learning and show that consistency optimization remains effective while largely preserving other capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出DynSC-Eval动态主体一致性评测框架，并基于其构建奖励进行后训练优化视频生成一致性。
AI.motivation: 随视频生成时长延长，主体一致性需在动态主体集合上评估，而现有指标无法有效度量长视频中的主体一致性差异。
AI.method: DynSC-Eval动态跟踪主体可见生命周期，用六个对象级指标度量局部连续性与全局身份保持并检测不一致事件；通过注入不一致事件的合成实验验证；并基于该指标构建奖励，在自动驾驶场景下用DiffusionNFT对Wan-2.1-1.3B、SANA-2B、ReSim做后训练，进一步用课程学习扩展至10s/30s。
AI.result: 5s生成中六个不一致指标平均降低13.82%（Wan-2.1-1.3B）与5.66%（SANA-2B），I2V模型ReSim亦有提升；揭示5s/15s/60s生成中被传统指标掩盖的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: DynSC-Eval更敏感、更能反映长视频主体一致性，且可作为有效奖励优化一致性并基本保持其他能力。

title: Capturing In-Context Learning Dynamics with Task Operators
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to perform new tasks from demonstrations without weight updates. However, every ICL inference requires processing the full set of examples, resulting in inefficient deployments, and how ICL works mechanistically is not fully understood. Prior work compresses ICL into fixed activation vectors extracted from specific layers or positions, but these input-independent interventions fail on complex tasks where the output depends on fine-grained interactions with the input. By analyzing the ICL forward pass, we show that each attention head's output is an affine transformation of its context-masked counterpart, and that the parameters of this transformation are empirically stable across samples for a given task. Building on this, we introduce Task Operator (TO), which replays this transformation as an analytically derived update to the attention output projection. Across lexical, algorithmic, and reasoning tasks, TO achieves the best overall performance among prior methods and substantially narrows the gap between zero-shot inference and ICL. We further show that the extracted knowledge concentrates in a task-specific sparse circuit across layers and positions, and that averaging operators from disjoint demonstration batches enables effective many-shot scaling without expanding the context window. Our code is available at https://github.com/gzxiong/task_operator.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分析ICL前向传播，发现每个注意力头的输出是其上下文掩码对应输出的仿射变换，且该变换参数在给定任务下跨样本稳定，据此提出Task Operator，将ICL重放为对注意力输出投影的解析更新。
AI.motivation: ICL每次推理需处理全部示例，部署效率低；且其工作机制尚不完全清楚。此前将ICL压缩为固定激活向量的方法依赖特定层或位置、与输入无关，在输出依赖细粒度输入交互的复杂任务上失效。
AI.method: 分析ICL前向传播，证明每个注意力头输出是上下文掩码对应输出的仿射变换，且变换参数对给定任务跨样本经验稳定；提出Task Operator (TO)，将该变换重放为对注意力输出投影的解析推导更新。进一步显示提取的知识集中于跨层与位置的稀疏任务特定回路，并发现对来自不相交示例批次的算子求平均可实现有效的many-shot扩展而无需扩大上下文窗口。
AI.result: 在词汇、算法与推理任务上，TO取得优于既有方法的整体性能，并显著缩小零样本推理与ICL之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: ICL可被解析地压缩为任务级注意力输出投影更新，避免了样本级全过程推理；知识以稀疏任务特定回路形式存在，且算子平均支持免扩展上下文的many-shot扩展。

title: HierGF: Hierarchical Gaussian Fields via Geometry-perception Message Passing for Sparse-view 3D Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM), 2026
summary: Sparse view 3D reconstruction is an important and common scenario in multimedia applications, such as augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) content creation, cultural heritage digitization, and certain robotic applications, where only a limited number of randomly captured views may be available. However, sparse views contain only limited 3D information, posing two major challenges:1) too few images are available for matching, making it difficult to build multi-view consistency; 2) insufficient view coverage leads to a lack of information in under-sampled regions, resulting in missing parts of object structure. Existing methods mostly still rely on limited reprojection errors and regularization terms, which are prone to overfitting to a single view and inconsistent appearances across views. In geometrically under-sampled regions, they often rely on heuristic density control, lacking reliable guidance and often resulting in blurring and structural holes.To address these issues, this paper proposes Hierarchical Gaussian Fields (HierGF), which revisits sparse-view reconstruction from a hierarchical geometry-perception perspective and converts limited observations into reliable self-generated supervision beyond fixed priors and heuristic density control. In particular, we transform coarse 3D geometric information and additional 2D generative priors into structured pseudo-supervision through a two-stage geometry-perception backbone network, thereby enhancing multi-view consistency with very few input views. In addition, we introduce a learnable confidence network to guide gradients toward cross-view consistent content, and a geometrically consistent densification module to improve the reconstruction of multi-view alignment and under-sampled regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层高斯场（HierGF），从分层几何感知视角重新审视稀疏视角三维重建，将有限观测转化为可靠的自生成监督信号，以提升多视角一致性与欠采样区域的几何质量。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角三维重建在AR/VR内容创建、文化遗产数字化、机器人等多媒体应用中十分常见，但仅有少量随机拍摄视角，存在两大挑战：1）可用于匹配的图像太少，难以建立多视角一致性；2）视角覆盖不足导致欠采样区域信息缺失，物体结构出现缺失。现有方法多依赖有限的重投影误差和正则项，易过拟合单视角、跨视角外观不一致；在几何欠采样区域依赖启发式密度控制，缺乏可靠引导，常导致模糊和结构空洞。
AI.method: 提出Hierarchical Gaussian Fields（HierGF）。核心采用两阶段几何感知骨干网络，将粗糙的三维几何信息与额外的二维生成先验转化为结构化的伪监督信号，从而在极少输入视角下增强多视角一致性；此外引入可学习置信度网络，将梯度引导至跨视角一致的内容，并设计几何一致的稠密化模块，提升多视角对齐与欠采样区域的还原效果。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体定量实验数据。
AI.conclusion: HierGF通过分层几何感知视角，将有限观测转化为可靠的自生成监督，超越了固定先验与启发式密度控制，在极少量输入视角下改善了多视角一致性与欠采样区域重建，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。

title: JoinGR: Learning to Traverse Join Graphs for Table Retrieval
summary: Retrieving the right tables is a prerequisite for Text-to-SQL over realistic databases. Dense table retrievers rank schema elements independently, but this ignores a key source of evidence: some required tables are not mentioned in the question and become identifiable only through their join relationships to already relevant tables. We introduce JOINGR, a join-aware table retrieval method that treats the database join graph as the retrieval space. Columns are represented as graph nodes, while intra-table and foreign-key relationships are represented as typed edges. Given a question, JOINGR selects semantically similar anchor tables, traverses join edges with a query-conditioned scorer, and aggregates the resulting edge deposits into table scores. The scorer is a lightweight MLP on top of frozen query, node, and edge embeddings, trained with a pairwise margin loss over gold tables. On BIRD and Spider datasets, JOINGR is competitive with the strongest retrieval baselines. On BEAVER, a challenging enterprise benchmark with multi-hop table requirements, JOINGR substantially improves recall over dense retrieval and re-ranking baselines. Cross-domain experiments show that the learned scorer transfers across benchmarks, indicating that the method captures reusable joingraph traversal behavior.

AI.tldr: JOINGR是一种面向Text-to-SQL的连接感知表格检索方法，将数据库连接图作为检索空间，显式建模表间外键关系，从而召回问题中未直接提及但通过连接关系关联的必需表。
AI.motivation: 密集表格检索器独立地对schema元素进行排序，忽略了关键证据来源：部分必需表并未在问题中被提及，只能通过其与已相关表的连接关系来识别。这一缺陷在多跳表格需求的真实数据库中尤为突出。
AI.method: 将列表示为图节点，表内关系与foreign-key关系表示为带类型边；给定问题，先选出语义相似的锚点表，再用query-conditioned scorer在连接边上遍历，将边上的deposit聚合为表分数。该scorer是叠加在冻结的query、node、edge嵌入之上的轻量MLP，使用基于gold表的pairwise margin loss进行训练。
AI.result: 在BIRD和Spider数据集上与最强检索基线相当；在具有多跳表格需求的企业级基准BEAVER上，召回率显著优于密集检索与重排序基线；跨域实验显示所学scorer可在不同基准间迁移。
AI.conclusion: 将连接图作为检索空间并学习遍历行为，可有效解决隐含必需表的召回问题，且所捕获的连接图遍历模式具有可复用性与跨基准迁移能力。

title: Probe with Participation Trophies: Random-Reward RL as a Probe of LLM Capability
summary: We connect the spurious-reward paradox to a model's reachability and propose random-reward reinforcement learning (RL) as a useful tool for the probing enterprise, addressing a decade-long debate over what probing performance actually reveals about a model. There are two prevailing explanations for the surprising finding that even random rewards can improve the performance of large language models (LLMs): one attributes the gains to particular mechanisms within RL training; the other to data contamination. Our results motivate a different view: spurious-reward RL can probe a model's reachability, or what further training can attain from its current state under specified constraints, beyond what is reflected in its current performance. Two OLMo checkpoints with the same accuracy on synthetic arithmetic (3.5%), for example, reach 8.5% and 55% in their best runs under the same correctness-rewarded RL. Examining OLMo checkpoints across pre-training and mid-training reveals three distinct regimes of training response: early on, RL produces little improvement even when correct answers are rewarded; later in pre-training, rewarding correct answers becomes effective while random rewards remain weak; and, upon entering mid-training, even random rewards can produce large gains. A similar ordering appears in a number-masked supervised fine-tuning (SFT) analysis of these checkpoints, suggesting that the pattern is not specific to a particular RL mechanism. Moreover, RL with random rewards offers a distinctive perspective on what training can make an LLM do, since its reward signal supplies no information about which answers are correct. By asking what training can attain without correctness feedback, it addresses the label-leakage side of a central problem in decodability-based probing: whether a successful probe reveals the model's capabilities or learns the task itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"虚假奖励悖论"与模型可达性（reachability）联系起来，提出随机奖励强化学习（RL）可作为探测工具，用来说明随机奖励之所以能提升LLM表现，是因为它探测的是模型在当前状态下进一步训练可达到的上限，而非其当前性能。
AI.motivation: 针对"即便使用随机奖励也能提升大语言模型性能"这一令人意外的发现，学界存在两种主流解释：一是将其归因于RL训练中的特定机制，二是归因于数据污染。作者希望解决这一持续十年的争论，即探测（probing）性能究竟揭示了模型的什么，并提出一种不同于上述两种解释的新视角。
AI.method: 作者提出将虚假奖励悖论与模型可达性（即在指定约束下，从当前状态出发进一步训练所能达到的程度）相连接，并将随机奖励RL作为探测手段。实验上，他们比较了：两个在合成算术任务上准确率相同（均为3.5%）的OLMo检查点在相同正确性奖励RL下的最佳表现；跨预训练与中期训练的多个OLMo检查点在RL下的训练响应；以及对这些检查点进行数字掩码监督微调（SFT）分析，以检验该模式是否依赖特定RL机制。
AI.result: 两个在合成算术上准确率相同（3.5%）的OLMo检查点在相同正确性奖励RL下，最佳运行分别达到8.5%和55%。跨预训练与中期训练的OLMo检查点呈现三种不同的训练响应阶段：早期即使奖励正确答案，RL带来的提升也很小；预训练后期，奖励正确答案变得有效，而随机奖励仍然较弱；进入中期训练后，即便随机奖励也能带来大幅提升。数字掩码SFT分析中出现了类似的排序，说明该模式并非某种特定RL机制所独有。
AI.conclusion: 随机奖励RL提供了一种独特视角来观察训练能使LLM做到什么，因为其奖励信号不包含任何关于正确答案的信息。通过追问"在没有正确性反馈的情况下训练能达到什么"，它回应了基于可解码性探测中一个核心问题里与标签泄漏相关的一面：一个成功的探针究竟是揭示了模型的能力，还是自行学会了任务本身。

title: Overcoming Kernel Redundancy for Scaling Logic Gate Networks
summary: Differentiable logic gate networks, which operate using only logic gates, have recently attracted attention as an efficient alternative to conventional neural networks. However, despite their efficiency, the scaling behavior of logic gate networks remains underexplored. By contrast, scaling model capacity is a central design principle in deep neural networks and typically leads to improved performance. This discrepancy raises a key question: Can similar scaling benefits also be achieved in logic gate networks? In this work, we focus on width as a primary scaling axis and conduct a systematic analysis of its behavior in logic gate networks. We observe that naive width scaling often introduces redundancy among logic kernels, limiting the effective use of additional kernels and leading to performance saturation. To address this limitation, we propose a dynamic logic kernel framework that reorganizes kernel utilization by promoting specialization across kernel groups. This enables the network to better utilize increased width via input-dependent kernel routing, while ensuring that both routing and computation are implemented entirely with gate-level Boolean operations at inference time. We further find that kernel redundancy is most pronounced at the first gate level, motivating an early-stage dynamic logic kernel strategy that concentrates adaptation at this level. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves kernel utilization and increases kernel diversity, leading to higher accuracy with improved parameter efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可微逻辑门网络的宽度缩放行为，发现朴素宽度缩放会导致逻辑核冗余与性能饱和，提出动态逻辑核框架，通过输入依赖的路由促进核组专业化，显著提升核利用率与精度。
AI.motivation: 逻辑门网络作为高效替代方案受到关注，但其缩放行为研究不足。深层神经网络中扩大模型容量通常提升性能，因此关键问题是：逻辑门网络能否获得类似的缩放收益？作者聚焦宽度这一主要缩放轴，系统分析其行为。
AI.method: 提出动态逻辑核框架（dynamic logic kernel framework）：通过促进核组间的专业化来重组核利用率，实现输入依赖的核路由，且路由与计算在推理时完全由门级布尔运算实现。进一步发现核冗余在第一层门级最显著，据此提出早期阶段动态逻辑核策略，将自适应集中在该层。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法提升了核利用率与核多样性，在改善参数效率的同时获得更高精度。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑门网络的宽度缩放存在冗余瓶颈，动态逻辑核（尤其集中于第一门级的早期策略）可有效缓解该瓶颈，使宽度扩展带来实质性性能收益，为逻辑门网络的高效缩放提供了可行路径。

title: Event-guided Neural Video Compression
summary: Neural video codecs derive motion and temporal contexts mainly from RGB frames, leaving room for cross-modal guidance from complementary temporal observations. Event streams can provide such observations by recording brightness changes between frames. In this work, we propose an Event-guided Neural Video Codec (ENVC) that uses events shared by the encoder and decoder to improve RGB compression efficiency. For motion coding, ENVC forms an event-guided motion prior and codes the remaining motion residual. For frame coding, an event-conditioned predictor supplies multi-scale features for gated temporal context refinement. To support training and evaluation on standard video datasets, we synthesize paired RGB-event data and assess its predictive utility through comparisons with real events. Across six benchmarks, ENVC achieves average BD-rate savings of 39.13% using PSNR-RGB and 67.63% using LPIPS relative to DCMVC. Further analyses show that our gains persist on large-motion sequences and that ENVC effectively learns to integrate event information. These results demonstrate the potential of events as a complementary modality for reducing the RGB coding rate. Our model and code are available at https://github.com/kjungwoo03/ENVC.

AI.tldr: 论文提出事件引导的神经视频编解码器（ENVC），利用编码器与解码器共享的事件流作为互补模态，提升RGB视频压缩效率，在六个基准上相较DCMVC实现显著BD-rate节省。
AI.motivation: 现有神经视频编解码器主要从RGB帧中提取运动信息与时域上下文，未充分利用其他模态的补充时域观测；事件流能记录帧间亮度变化，可为此提供额外互补信息，从而降低RGB编码码率。
AI.method: 提出ENVC，编码器与解码器共享事件流：运动编码方面构建事件引导的运动先验，仅对剩余运动残差编码；帧编码方面设计事件条件预测器，提供多尺度特征用于门控时域上下文细化。为在标准视频数据集上训练与评测，合成配对的RGB-事件数据，并通过与真实事件的对比验证其预测效用。
AI.result: 在六个基准上，ENVC相对DCMVC平均BD-rate节省达39.13%（PSNR-RGB）与67.63%（LPIPS）；在大运动序列上增益依然保持，且模型能有效学会整合事件信息。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明事件作为互补模态在降低RGB编码码率方面具有潜力，验证了事件引导神经视频编码的有效性，模型与代码已开源。

title: Precision over Scale: A Polish-Silesian Benchmark and a Translation System Outperforming Open-Source and Commercial Models
summary: Dialectal machine translation remains challenging due to limited data and strong linguistic variation not captured by standard benchmarks, which often assume standardized and well-edited text. We study Polish-Silesian MT using neural and rule-based systems, evaluating on SiLTT - a new Pol-Szl testset, alongside established BOUQuET and FLORES benchmarks. Results show our rule-based system is consistently strongest on SiLTT and BOUQuET datasets and that TranslateGemma fine-tuned on a curated dataset improves over strong neural baselines but does not surpass the rule-based system in dialectal settings. We release SiLTT and our best neural model to support further research.

AI.tldr: 研究波兰语-西里西亚语方言机器翻译，构建新测试集SiLTT，对比神经与规则系统，发现规则系统在方言场景下持续最优，并开源资源。
AI.motivation: 方言机器翻译因数据稀缺和语言变体差异大而困难，且标准基准通常假设文本已标准化、经过良好编辑，无法充分反映方言的语言变异。
AI.method: 以波兰语-西里西亚语翻译为对象，采用神经方法与规则方法两类系统；在新建的Pol-Szl测试集SiLTT上进行评测，并与BOUQuET、FLORES等既有基准对比；同时对TranslateGemma在精选数据集上进行微调。
AI.result: 规则系统在SiLTT和BOUQuET上表现始终最强；微调后的TranslateGemma优于强神经基线，但在方言场景下仍未超过规则系统。
AI.conclusion: 方言机器翻译中规则方法仍具竞争力，神经方法在方言场景下存在局限；作者发布SiLTT与最佳神经模型以支持后续研究。

title: Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation
comment: Preprint. 51 pages, 19 figures, 23 tables. Code, dataset and project website linked in the paper
summary: Video generation models are increasingly being explored as world simulators for embodied planning and learning. To do so effectively, these models must not only generate visually appealing frames, but also predict how environments dynamically evolve when executing goal-directed actions. While evaluating these capabilities is crucial, existing benchmarks focus mainly on single short actions or step-by-step instructions. This leaves multi-step physical reasoning underexplored, especially in egocentric video generation that requires planning to simulate proper execution to accomplish high-level goals by carrying out multiple real-world manipulations. We introduce Ego2Act, a goal-directed benchmark featuring 2,640 videos from 110 real-world tasks across day-to-day settings, varying object clutter and multi-step complexity. Given an initial scene image and a high-level goal, Ego2Act evaluates whether video generation models can produce realistic egocentric videos of a hand manipulating objects to carry out the task. To support scalable evaluation, we also introduce Ego2ActJudge, a reference-free evaluation pipeline that achieves better task completion and physics plausibility evaluation alignment with human consensus compared to relevant baselines. Our findings reveal that models' generated simulations often skip or partially execute steps, leaving later steps missing dependent states, which leads to unfulfilled goal. Furthermore, models consistently fail at fine-grained physical dynamics, particularly during complex object manipulation and persistent world modeling. We hope Ego2Act provides a rigorous testbed for advancing video models toward physically plausible, goal-directed simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ego2Act 基准（2,640 个视频、110 项真实任务）及免参考评估流程 Ego2ActJudge，用于评测视频生成模型在自我中心视角下完成多步目标导向操作的能力，发现现有模型普遍存在跳步、缺依赖状态与细粒度物理动态失败。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型被越来越多地用作具身规划与学习的世界模拟器，但现有基准主要聚焦单一短动作或逐步指令，忽视了多步物理推理，尤其在需要规划多步真实操作以达成高层目标的自我中心视频生成场景中更缺乏评测。
AI.method: 提出 Ego2Act：目标导向基准，含 110 项真实日常任务、2,640 个视频，覆盖不同物体杂乱度与多步复杂度；输入为初始场景图像与高层目标，要求模型生成手部操作物体的自我中心视频。同时提出免参考评估流程 Ego2ActJudge，用于可扩展评测任务完成度与物理合理性。
AI.result: Ego2ActJudge 在任务完成度与物理合理性评估上与人类共识的对齐优于相关基线；评测显示模型生成的模拟常跳过或部分执行步骤，导致后续步骤缺少依赖状态、目标无法完成，并在细粒度物理动态（复杂物体操作、持续性世界建模）上持续失败。
AI.conclusion: Ego2Act 为推进视频模型走向物理合理、目标导向的模拟提供了严格测试平台。

title: Dataset Identity, Not Novelty: The Source of an Inflated OOD Detection Gain
summary: A post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detector reads the activations of a trained classifier and returns a score. It fits that score on in-distribution data, and the benchmarks that evaluate it supply a second piece of OOD data for the fitting itself. Some detectors tune a constant on it. Others fit a direction in feature space or train a flexible combiner and report the number that it reaches as the gain that is still available. Every such fit is validated on held-out samples of the same OOD dataset. That check rules out memorizing individual images. It says nothing about a fit that has instead learned which dataset it is looking at, and a direction that recognizes one OOD dataset rather than novelty passes it perfectly. The detector that a practitioner installs meets OOD data from a source that nobody fitted it on, so the difference decides what the reported number is worth. We measure it by holding out the whole OOD dataset rather than a sample of it, and we call that gap the inflation. We read it across a range of combiners on ImageNet and CIFAR-100 backbones. Most of the gain that the usual protocol reports turns out to be dataset identity rather than novelty. The size of the fit does not move what survives, so the effect is not ordinary overfitting. The share depends instead on whether the input exposes class identity, and two controls that vary that property alone separate the inflation on every backbone of both benchmarks. A closed form accounts for the effect and computes it from the fitting rows, so a practitioner can tell which fits will inflate without running the hold-out protocol. One of these fits survives, namely the single constant that the field already picks on a designated validation dataset. Anything above it reports a gain that the hold-out protocol does not return, and on one benchmark what survives falls while what is reported climbs.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了后处理式OOD检测基准中普遍存在的"膨胀"(inflation)现象：常规协议用同一OOD数据集的留出样本验证拟合，无法排除检测器学到"数据集身份"而非"新颖性"。作者通过留出整个OOD数据集来量化该差距，发现在ImageNet和CIFAR-100骨干上，多数报告增益实为数据集身份识别而非新颖性检测。
AI.motivation: 后处理OOD检测器会在OOD数据上拟合分数（调常数、拟合特征方向或训练组合器），而基准评测只用同一OOD数据集的留出样本验证，只能排除对单张图像的记忆，无法排除拟合学到的是"这是哪个OOD数据集"而非"这是新颖性"。实际部署时检测器面对的是从未拟合过的OOD来源，因此该协议报告的增益可能被高估，作者希望量化并解释这一差距。
AI.method: 作者提出以"留出整个OOD数据集"（而非留出样本）作为更严格的评测协议，将新协议与常规协议之间的差距定义为"膨胀"(inflation)。在ImageNet与CIFAR-100骨干上，对多种组合器（combiner）测量该膨胀。通过两个仅改变"输入是否暴露类别身份"这一属性的对照实验进行归因分析，并推导一个可从拟合行直接计算的闭式解来预测哪些拟合会膨胀。
AI.result: 多数常规协议报告的增益被证明是数据集身份而非新颖性。拟合规模不影响残留增益，说明该效应不是普通过拟合。膨胀比例取决于输入是否暴露类别身份，两个仅改变该性质的对照实验在两种基准的所有骨干上都成功区分出膨胀。闭式解能准确刻画该效应，使从业者无需运行留出协议即可判断哪些拟合会膨胀。
AI.conclusion: 唯一能经受留出整个OOD数据集协议检验的拟合，是领域已在指定验证集上选定的那个单一常数。任何高于它的做法所报告的增益，留出协议都无法复现；在某个基准上甚至出现"保留下来的部分下降、而报告的数值上升"的悖论。作者据此建议采用留出整个OOD数据集的评测协议，并可用闭式解提前识别会膨胀的拟合。

title: MVDG: Efficient Multi-view 3D Disambiguation on Unconstrained Real-World Images
summary: Illusory matches between distinct yet visually similar 3D surfaces--doppelgangers--remain a fundamental obstacle for large-scale, in-the-wild 3D reconstruction and visual localization. Prior work mitigates this issue with pairwise classifiers, but this design limits multi-view contextual reasoning and incurs O(n^2) inference complexity for downstream structure-from-motion (SfM). We present MVDG, a scalable multi-view disambiguation framework built on the 3D foundation model VGGT, which jointly reasons over an arbitrary number of multiview images. By incorporating 3D-aware multi-view features, our method reduces dependence on pairwise comparisons by encoding and decoding views in a single pass. We further observe that direct multi-view fine-tuning of VGGT can be unstable under noisy supervision; motivated by label ambiguity in Doppelgangers, we construct a pseudo-pairwise training set from AerialMegaDepth and show that fine-tuning on sampled subsets yields stable optimization and strong generalization to held-out scenes. Finally, because full SfM evaluation (even with faster pipelines such as GLOMAP) remains expensive, we process a pseudo-pairwise dataset for efficient validation; we derive a predictive relationship between regular SfM metrics and the classification accuracy on this pseudo-pairwise test. Experiments show that our method achieves comparable pairwise accuracy while improving both SfM accuracy and inference speed over baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MVDG，一个基于 3D 基础模型 VGGT 的多视图消歧框架，通过单次编解码实现多视图上下文联合推理，替代传统 O(n²) 成对分类器，在 Doppelgangers 问题上提升 SfM 精度与推理速度。
AI.motivation: 不同但视觉相似的 3D 表面（doppelgangers）之间的"错觉匹配"是大规模野外 3D 重建与视觉定位的根本障碍。现有方法采用成对分类器缓解，但该设计限制了多视图上下文推理能力，并在下游 SfM 中带来 O(n²) 的推理复杂度。
AI.method: 基于 3D 基础模型 VGGT 构建可扩展的多视图消歧框架 MVDG，通过引入 3D 感知的多视图特征，在单次前向编解码中对任意数量视图联合推理，减少对成对比较的依赖。针对 VGGT 直接多视图微调在噪声监督下不稳定的问题，受 Doppelgangers 标签歧义启发，从 AerialMegaDepth 构建伪成对训练集，并在采样子集上微调以获得稳定优化与对未见过场景的强泛化。为降低完整 SfM 评估成本，构建伪成对数据集用于高效验证，并推导常规 SfM 指标与该伪成对测试分类精度之间的预测关系。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在取得与基线相当的成对准确率的同时，提升了 SfM 精度与推理速度。
AI.conclusion: MVDG 通过多视图联合推理与稳定微调策略，有效缓解了 doppelgangers 导致的错觉匹配问题，在精度与效率上均优于现有成对分类器基线，为大规模 3D 重建与视觉定位提供了可扩展方案。

title: AgSpec: Pushing the Limits of Retrieval-Based Speculative Decoding in Coding Agent Pipelines
summary: Retrieval-based speculative decoding (SD) drafts tokens by copying continuations from existing text, which suits coding agents that repeatedly reproduce code, logs, and earlier attempts. Yet existing methods fall short in agent pipelines: much of the reusable text is missing from their corpora or stored in a form that differs from what the agent emits, and their draft lengths ignore that accept length varies across agents and drifts over turns. We present AgSpec, a framework that supplies the corpus and draft-length policies that existing retrieval engines lack in coding-agent pipelines. AgSpec retrieves from session, workspace, and global corpora, retaining the ongoing session trajectory and indexing opened files in the agent's emission format. It bounds each agent's draft length with an offline-profiled cap and adapts the length online from verification feedback. On two repository-level multi-agent coding benchmarks, AgSpec outperforms five retrieval-based drafters and EAGLE-3 in most evaluated settings, raising generation throughput over autoregressive decoding up to 4.37$\times$ at batch size 1 and 4.76$\times$ at batch size 16. AgSpec also remains effective on benchmarks without a repository or a multi-agent pipeline, showing that its gains generalize to coding agents broadly.

AI.tldr: AgSpec 是一个面向编码智能体流水线的检索式推测解码框架，通过补充语料库与草稿长度策略提升生成吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 检索式推测解码（SD）通过复制已有文本的后续内容来草拟 token，适合反复复现代码、日志和先前尝试的编码智能体。但现有方法在智能体流水线中不足：可复用文本大量缺失于其语料库，或存储形式与智能体实际输出不一致；且其草稿长度忽略了接受长度在不同智能体间的差异及随轮次的漂移。
AI.method: AgSpec 为现有检索引擎在编码智能体流水线中补齐语料库与草稿长度策略：从会话、工作区与全局三类语料库检索，保留当前会话轨迹，并以智能体的输出格式索引已打开文件；用离线分析的容量上限约束每个智能体的草稿长度，并依据验证反馈在线自适应调整长度。
AI.result: 在两个仓库级多智能体编码基准上，AgSpec 在多数评测设置中优于五种检索式草拟器和 EAGLE-3；batch size 为 1 时生成吞吐量相对自回归解码最高提升 4.37×，batch size 为 16 时最高提升 4.76×。在无仓库或无多智能体流水线的基准上同样有效。
AI.conclusion: AgSpec 通过完善语料库覆盖与自适应草稿长度策略，有效提升编码智能体的生成吞吐量，且增益可泛化到更广泛的编码智能体场景。

title: Affine-Aligned Atlas for Canonical Gaussian Construction in Video Representation
summary: Gaussian splatting has recently emerged as an efficient representation for images and videos due to its explicit structure and fast rendering capability. Existing Gaussian-based video representations often decompose a video into canonical Gaussians and temporal deformation. However, when a video contains large global motion such as camera movement, the canonical representation may become misaligned with individual frames, increasing the burden on the temporal deformation model. In this paper, we propose an affine-atlas canonical Gaussian representation, which constructs canonical Gaussians in a larger affine-aligned atlas space. Frame-wise affine transforms absorb global motion before canonical Gaussian construction, reducing the gap between the canonical representation and target frames. Since the proposed method only modifies the canonical construction stage, it can be integrated into existing canonical-Gaussian-based methods with negligible additional parameter cost. Experiments show that our method improves reconstruction quality especially for sequences with large camera motion.

AI.tldr: 提出仿射图集(canonical)高斯表示，将规范高斯构建于更大的仿射对齐图集空间，用逐帧仿射变换吸收全局运动，从而缓解大相机运动下规范表示与单帧失配问题，可低成本集成进现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯的视频表示将视频分解为规范高斯与时序形变。当视频存在大范围全局运动（如相机移动）时，规范表示会与各单帧失配，加重时序形变模型的负担，导致重建质量下降。
AI.method: 核心构建仿射图集规范高斯表示：在更大的仿射对齐图集空间中构建规范高斯；在规范高斯构建前，用逐帧仿射变换吸收全局运动，缩小规范表示与目标帧之间的差距。该方法仅修改规范构建阶段，可无缝集成到已有基于规范高斯的方法中，额外参数开销可忽略。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法提升了重建质量，尤其在包含大相机运动的序列上效果显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全局运动在规范构建前用逐帧仿射变换解耦到更大的图集空间，可在几乎不增加参数的情况下增强现有规范高斯视频表示对大全局运动的鲁棒性与重建质量。

title: StepCAD: Mesh-to-CAD Code Generation via LLM Policy and Geometry-Guided Search
summary: Recovering executable CAD programs from 3D meshes is challenging due to the compositional nature of CAD construction and the interaction between discrete modeling choices and continuous parameters. Many learning-based methods predict complete programs in a single pass and rely predominantly on sketch-extrude representations, limiting operation diversity and opportunities to correct geometric errors during reconstruction. We introduce StepCAD, a generative optimization approach that combines a state-conditioned CAD policy with geometry-guided search. Given an input mesh, the policy predicts construction actions conditioned on both target and intermediate geometry, and an IoU-guided tree search refines the resulting program through local edits. We also introduce ARCADE-1.5M, a large-scale dataset of 1.5M executable CAD programs spanning diverse operations, sequences with a maximum length of 150+ counted operations, and 12.5M intermediate state-action transitions. Experiments across multiple CAD reconstruction benchmarks show that StepCAD achieves state-of-the-art geometric reconstruction accuracy with consistently high validity, yielding up to 87.2% relative IoU improvement over the strongest evaluated baseline, with particularly large gains on complex shapes. Project page: https://ghadinehme.com/stepcad.github.io/

AI.tldr: StepCAD：状态条件CAD策略+几何引导搜索，从网格恢复可执行CAD程序。
AI.motivation: 从3D网格恢复可执行CAD程序具有挑战性，原因在于CAD构建的组合性，以及离散建模选择与连续参数之间的交互。现有许多基于学习的方法一次性预测完整程序，且主要依赖草图-拉伸（sketch-extrude）表示，限制了操作多样性与重建中纠正几何误差的机会。
AI.method: 提出StepCAD，一种生成式优化方法，将状态条件CAD策略与几何引导搜索相结合。给定输入网格，策略以目标几何与中间几何为条件预测构建动作，并通过IoU引导的树搜索以局部编辑方式精炼所得程序。同时构建ARCADE-1.5M大规模数据集，包含150万个可执行CAD程序，涵盖多样操作、操作数超过150的最长序列，以及1250万条中间状态-动作转移。
AI.result: 在多个CAD重建基准上，StepCAD取得最先进的几何重建精度，并保持稳定的高有效性，相较最强基线实现最高87.2%的相对IoU提升，在复杂形状上增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 结合状态条件生成策略与搜索精炼可有效提升CAD程序恢复的精度、有效性与复杂形状泛化能力，配套的大规模数据集为相关研究提供支撑。

title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
summary: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built from 18 public sources: 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants, with byte-identical inputs, paired tests, and cross-hardware and cross-day reproducibility checks. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 decision points (+10.8 to +46.0 pp). Neither model beats chance on zero-shot model routing, and they tie on RAG relevance gating. Laya changes 30% of its answers when the option order is reversed and degrades sharply with many or similar candidates (31% at 50 nearest-neighbour tools, vs. 98% for Jev on items with a unique correct tool). We also audit our own pipeline. Three analysis errors and one design confound distorted headline deployment claims: an omitted pre-screen cost (reported 23.9% saving, actual 4.3%), gate accuracy reported as end-to-end quality (58% vs. 98%), in-sample thresholds (5% target, up to 17% held-out misses), and a "channel effect" on injection false positives that vanishes with channel-native content. Two other suspected confounds did not change the conclusions. All cases, raw outputs and analysis code are available at https://github.com/David-DL-Space/sys1-eval.

AI.tldr: 本文对两个System-1决策模型（开源Laya与托管Jev）在11个Agent决策点上进行配对评测，使用7,283个基础案例与6,640个鲁棒性变体，发现Jev在9/11决策点上显著更优；同时对自身评测流程进行审计，发现三处分析错误与一处设计混淆曾导致部署收益被高估。
AI.motivation: Agent harness需频繁执行大量小型类型化决策（选模型、选工具、判断检索相关性、检测注入），用LLM调用成本与延迟高；System-1模型以单次前向传播输出类别概率，有望显著节省开销，但其实际可靠性尚缺乏严格的配对评测证据。
AI.method: 构建来自18个公开数据源的11个Agent决策点基准，包含7,283基础案例与6,640鲁棒性变体；采用字节级相同输入、配对检验，以及跨硬件与跨日期可复现性检查，对开源模型Laya与托管模型Jev进行受控对比，并额外对评测流程本身进行审计。
AI.result: Jev在9/11决策点上显著更准确（+10.8至+46.0个百分点）；两模型在零样本模型路由上均未超过随机水平，在RAG相关性门控上持平。Laya在选项顺序反转时改变30%答案，并在候选多且相似时性能急剧下降（50个最近邻工具时仅31%准确率，而Jev在唯一正确项上达98%）。审计发现：遗漏预筛选成本（声称节省23.9%，实际4.3%）、门控准确率被当作端到端质量报告（58% vs 98%）、使用样本内阈值（目标5%，留出集漏检高达17%），以及注入误报的"通道效应"在通道原生内容下消失。
AI.conclusion: System-1模型在多数Agent决策点上可行，但性能对模型选择、候选规模与顺序扰动高度敏感；评测部署收益时必须纳入完整成本、使用留出阈值并以端到端质量度量，否则容易得出误导性结论。所有案例、原始输出与分析代码已公开。

title: Madeleine: Learning Involuntary Recall for Conversational Memory from Simulated Lives
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. v2: adds three-seed results for the HyperMem plug-in and an evaluation with human-written triggers (Appendix D)
summary: A long-term conversational assistant must recall the right memory at the right moment, yet the memory that matters most is often not similar to what the user says now. Current systems recover such associations by letting an LLM reason at write or read time, at a cost of hundreds to over a thousand LLM calls per memory bank and up to several thousand context tokens per query. We argue that association is a learnable relevance: the pointwise mutual information of memories under how human lives unfold. We introduce Madeleine, which learns amortized association: offline, an LLM life simulator writes simulated lives, whose cue-trigger pairs teach a query encoder a residual association on top of frozen similarity; online, it calls no LLM and plugs into any vector memory by replacing only the query encoder. On LoCoMo-Plus under the official protocol, Madeleine (I) reaches 66.6 when plugged into HyperMem, the highest among all systems evaluated under this protocol; (II) used alone, reaches the score of HyperMem as released (52.4 vs. 52.9) with zero LLM calls and about 1/21 of its answer context; and (III) lifts T-Mem by 26.2 points, significantly outperforms the same untrained backbone inside both systems, and leaves ordinary QA intact on the 4B backbone.

AI.tldr: 提出Madeleine：将长期对话记忆中的"关联"视为可学习的相关性（记忆在人类生活展开方式下的逐点互信息），通过LLM生活模拟器离线生成线索-触发对训练查询编码器，在线无需LLM调用即可即插即用地增强任意向量记忆检索。
AI.motivation: 长期对话助手需要在恰当时机回忆恰当记忆，但最关键的记忆往往与用户当前话语并不相似。现有系统依赖LLM在写入或读取时进行推理来恢复此类关联，代价是每个记忆库数百至上千次LLM调用、每查询高达数千上下文token。
AI.method: Madeleine实现摊销式关联学习：离线阶段由LLM生活模拟器生成模拟人生，其中的线索-触发对教导查询编码器在冻结相似度之上学习残差关联；在线阶段不调用任何LLM，仅替换查询编码器即可接入任意向量记忆系统。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo-Plus官方协议下：(I) 接入HyperMem达66.6，为该协议所有评估系统最高；(II) 单独使用达52.4，与发布版HyperMem的52.9相当，且零LLM调用、答案上下文约为其1/21；(III) 使T-Mem提升26.2分，显著优于两系统内相同未训练主干，并在4B主干上不影响普通QA。
AI.conclusion: 关联可作为可学习的相关性被摊销：离线模拟数据训练出的查询编码器以零在线LLM成本显著提升记忆检索，且具备即插即用性与对普通QA的保持性。

title: Counting and Min-Cost Encoding for Tokenization in Large Language Models
summary: Mainstream large language models rely on a tokenizer to encode text into a token sequence. Different tokenizers may yield token sequences of substantially different lengths for the same text. With a fixed model architecture, shorter token sequences correspond to lower inference time. We propose a tokenizer training approach named Counting and Filtering (CNF) and a text encoding algorithm called Min-Cost Encoding (MCE). MCE defines a cost function over a text segment, and determines the best segmentation by globally minimizing the overall segmentation cost. CNF builds a raw vocabulary by directly counting valid substrings, and then constructs the final vocabulary through a filtering step based on actual token usage when segmenting the training corpus with MCE. The CNF-MCE conbination offers several advantages over BPE, including higher token efficiency, greater scalability, and lower dependency. Across six text categories and two vocabulary-size groups, CNF-MCE consistently achieves better compression than the evaluated BPE tokenizers. With a 250K vocabulary, CNF-MCE increases compression rate by 26% and 30% on English web text over the o200k_base and qwen250k tokenizers. Experiments scaling the vocabulary to 1M entries on English web text demonstrate sustained improvements over BPE, with a token efficiency improvement of over 60% and vocabulary utilization rising from 52.9% to 96.9%. The MCE algorithm does not depend on a merge list (as in BPE) or token probability (as in UnigramLM), making it applicable to a wide range of vocabularies, including those built from BPE, UnigramLM, CNF, and others. Language models trained from scratch at the 1.8B and 8B scales achieve comparable average performance to models using the BPE tokenizers across 11 benchmarks. These results demonstrate that CNF-MCE can improve token efficiency significantly while maintaining competitive downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CNF（计数与过滤）分词器训练方法与 MCE（最小代价编码）文本编码算法，通过全局最小化分词代价提升 token 效率，在多种文本类别上压缩率显著优于 BPE。
AI.motivation: 主流大模型依赖分词器将文本编码为 token 序列，不同分词器对同一文本产生的序列长度差异很大。在模型架构固定时，更短的 token 序列意味着更低的推理时延，因此需要提升 token 效率。
AI.method: 提出两条技术路线：MCE 定义文本片段上的代价函数，通过全局最小化整体分词代价确定最佳切分；CNF 先通过直接统计有效子串构建原始词表，再用 MCE 切分训练语料并依据实际 token 使用情况进行过滤，得到最终词表。MCE 不依赖 BPE 的 merge list 或 UnigramLM 的 token 概率。
AI.result: 在 6 类文本、2 组词表规模下，CNF-MCE 压缩率均优于所评估的 BPE 分词器。250K 词表下，英文网页文本压缩率较 o200k_base 和 qwen250k 分别提升 26% 和 30%；扩展至 1M 词表时 token 效率提升超 60%，词表利用率由 52.9% 升至 96.9%。1.8B 与 8B 规模从头训练的语言模型在 11 个基准上平均性能与使用 BPE 分词器的模型相当。
AI.conclusion: CNF-MCE 在显著提升 token 效率的同时保持有竞争力的下游性能，且 MCE 适用范围广，可兼容 BPE、UnigramLM、CNF 等多种词表构建方式。

title: Open Vocabulary Word Recognition From Transcribed Bangla Texts
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 26th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT). Code: https://github.com/FaiasPromit/Open-Vocabulary-Word-Recognition-From-Transcribed-Bangla-Texts.git
summary: An optical character recognition (OCR) can scan a paper and extract text using technology, making people's jobs easier. While various OCR systems are available in the software industry, finding a reliable equivalent solution for Bangla takes much work. When it comes to handwritten texts, the situation is much more unusual. Recognizing words from word images is the most critical stage in any OCR process. It is the second stage after segmenting words from text pictures. If this stage fails, the overall performance of the OCR will be poor, regardless of how well the other phases perform. This study aims to recognize words using deep learning in a handwritten Bangla word image. Three object detection models, SSD with MobileNetV2, Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2, and an ensemble model of these two, have been used to train and test handwritten word images. A modified Non-Maximum Suppression has been introduced to enhance the effectiveness of the models' results. A customized dataset of 9841 handwritten Bangla word images has been compiled, featuring diverse handwriting styles from various individuals. All three models' performances have been checked against the test dataset, and the ensemble model has been the most impressive, with an F1-score of 92.61%. Also, at the word level, the ensemble model correctly recognizes 96.12% of the words to some extent. The system can be further improved by introducing a post-processing phase to correct errors generated by the system.

AI.tldr: 该研究面向手写孟加拉语单词识别，构建9841张手写词图像数据集，采用SSD+MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN+InceptionResNetV2及二者集成模型，并引入改进的非极大值抑制，集成模型F1达92.61%。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语OCR系统稀缺，手写场景更具挑战；单词识别是OCR流程的关键阶段，其失败会导致整体性能下降，因此需针对性提升手写孟加拉语单词识别效果。
AI.method: 构建包含9841张、来自不同书写者、风格多样的手写孟加拉语单词图像数据集；使用三种目标检测模型（SSD+MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN+InceptionResNetV2及二者集成）进行训练与测试；引入改进的非极大值抑制（NMS）提升检测结果有效性；在测试集上比较各模型性能。
AI.result: 集成模型表现最佳，F1-score为92.61%；在单词层面，集成模型对96.12%的单词能在一定程度上正确识别。
AI.conclusion: 基于深度学习与集成目标检测的手写孟加拉语单词识别方案有效，集成模型优于单一模型；未来可通过引入后处理阶段纠正系统错误以进一步提升性能。

title: Confidence-Gated Cloud-Edge Cascade Triage via Variational Risk Minimization for Medical Imaging
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. Accepted manuscript of the article published in Smart Health 41 (2026) 100689. Presented as an oral at IEEE/ACM CHASE 2026. Code: https://github.com/Yangxinyee/vrm-edge-triage
summary: Emergency chest X-ray (CXR) triage has a structural modality gap: reports arrive after triage decisions, yet multimodal foundation models require image-text inputs. We present Variational Risk Minimization (VRM), a distillation framework that treats LVLM-generated report variants as Monte Carlo samples of latent clinical interpretations. Rather than distilling from a single teacher target, VRM learns from a variationally marginalized teacher distribution, enabling uncertainty-aware supervision under missing-modality constraints. Under matched encoder families, VRM outperforms direct fine-tuning baselines and improves calibration with strong recovery from hallucinated supervision. Marginalized supervision reduces report-selection instability. In our compact edge-student instantiation, a confidence-gated cascade reaches AUC 0.941 at 103ms average latency with 20.3% cloud escalation, yielding an explicit reliability-latency operating point for cloud-edge clinical workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出变分风险最小化（VRM）蒸馏框架，将LVLM生成的报告变体视为潜在临床解释的蒙特卡洛样本，从变分边缘化的教师分布中学习，用于急诊胸片分诊中"图像可用但报告缺失"场景下的不确定性感知监督。
AI.motivation: 急诊胸片分诊存在结构性模态鸿沟：报告在分诊决策之后才产生，但多模态基础模型需要图文双输入。此外单教师目标蒸馏难以刻画潜在临床解释的多义性与不确定性，且报告选择不稳定。
AI.method: VRM将LVLM生成的报告变体视作潜在临床解释的蒙特卡洛样本，不再从单一教师目标蒸馏，而是从变分边缘化的教师分布中学习，从而在缺失模态约束下实现不确定性感知监督；并实例化为紧凑边缘学生模型，采用置信度门控级联进行云边协同推断。
AI.result: 在匹配编码器家族下，VRM优于直接微调基线，校准性能提升，并能从幻觉监督中强恢复；边缘化监督降低了报告选择的不稳定性。紧凑边缘学生实例中，置信度门控级联达到AUC 0.941，平均延迟103ms，云端升级率20.3%，给出了显式的可靠性—延迟工作点。
AI.conclusion: VRM通过变分边缘化教师分布为缺失模态下的分诊提供不确定性感知监督，兼顾性能、校准与稳定性，并为云边临床工作流提供可调的可靠性—延迟操作点。

title: The RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset
summary: Intracranial aneurysm rupture is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, yet aneurysm detection remains challenging, particularly for small lesions and on routine non-angiographic imaging examinations. To support the development and evaluation of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms for intracranial aneurysm detection and localization, the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), in collaboration with the American Society of Neuroradiology (ASNR), the Society of Neurointerventional Surgery (SNIS), and the European Society of Neuroradiology (ESNR), curated the RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset. Developed for the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge, RSNA-ICA is a large, publicly available, expert-annotated dataset comprising 7202 CTA, MRA, and MRI series from 4278 adult patients collected across 21 institutions in 12 countries spanning five continents. The dataset includes 2566 CTA, 2166 MRA, and 2470 MRI series from patients with and without intracranial saccular aneurysms, providing substantial geographic and imaging diversity. Expert annotations indicate both aneurysm presence and location, and 178 series additionally include three-dimensional segmentations of challenge-defined vascular locations. RSNA-ICA was used to develop and evaluate algorithms in the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge. Of the 7202 image series, 5041 are publicly available through MIRA, while the remainder were used for challenge public and private test sets. The dataset is freely available to the research community for noncommercial use and provides a comprehensive resource for advancing AI-based aneurysm detection across both angiographic and routine neuroimaging examinations.

AI.tldr: RSNA-ICA数据集：来自21家机构、12个国家、4278名成人患者的7202个CTA/MRA/MRI序列，含动脉瘤存在与位置标注（178例附3D分割），用于2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛，5041例已通过MIRA公开。
AI.motivation: 颅内动脉瘤破裂致残致死率高，但动脉瘤检测仍具挑战，尤其对小病灶及常规非血管造影检查。为支持AI检测与定位算法的开发与评估，RSNA联合ASNR、SNIS、ESNR构建了该数据集。
AI.method: 多机构、跨国回顾性数据汇总，纳入7202个CTA、MRA与MRI序列（CTA 2566、MRA 2166、MRI 2470），来自4278名成人患者；由专家标注动脉瘤有无及位置，178个序列附加挑战赛定义血管位置的三维分割；作为2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛的开发与评测数据。
AI.result: 数据集规模大、成像模态与地域来源多样（5大洲12国21家机构）；5041个序列通过MIRA公开，其余用作挑战赛公开与私有测试集；对研究界免费开放（非商业用途）。
AI.conclusion: RSNA-ICA为跨血管造影与常规神经影像的AI动脉瘤检测提供全面资源，可推动算法发展与标准化评估。

title: Do Multilingual Encoders Produce Language-Consistent Semantic IDs?
comment: 7 pages, 8 tables. Accepted as a short paper at WiNLP 2026, co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Semantic IDs (SIDs) compress item embeddings into discrete code sequences used in generative retrieval. We ask whether a multilingual encoder is sufficient for different-language renderings of the same product to receive language-consistent SIDs. Using Amazon ESCI listings rendered in English, Spanish, and Japanese, we test whether translations remain close to their English source, whether residual quantization is unusually sensitive to translation-induced movement, and whether multilingual or language-balanced quantizer fitting improves SID agreement. Multilingual E5 places translations measurably apart: under an English-heavy fit, a Japanese translation preserves the first SID code of its English counterpart in only 7.7% of cases, compared with 89.0% for an English rewording. Distance-matched product-directed controls produce nearly the same full-SID mismatch as translation, providing no evidence that the quantizer selectively amplifies language directions. Balancing the fitting mixture makes codebook use more uniform but further reduces cross-lingual prefix agreement: Spanish first-code consistency falls from 28.3% to 6.6%, while an English-only fit preserves it for 67.6% of Spanish translations. These results show that multilingual exposure and balanced codebook use alone do not guarantee language-consistent SIDs.

AI.tldr: 本文检验多语言编码器是否能使同一商品的不同语言表述获得语言一致的语义ID（SID）。以Amazon ESCI的英/西/日三语listing为实验对象，发现翻译在嵌入空间中被显著拉开，且残差量化（RQ）对翻译位移并无选择性放大；平衡拟合混合虽使码本使用更均匀，却进一步降低跨语言前缀一致率。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索依赖语义ID（SID）将物品嵌入压缩为离散码序列，但同一商品的多语言版本能否获得语言一致的SID尚不明确。作者希望厘清该现象是否由多语言编码器能力不足、残差量化对翻译位移的敏感性，或量化器拟合数据语言分布失衡所导致。
AI.method: 使用Amazon ESCI商品listing的英文、西班牙文、日文三种呈现形式。核心检验三点：(1) 翻译是否在嵌入空间中保持与英文源项接近；(2) 残差量化（RQ）是否对翻译引起的嵌入位移异常敏感；(3) 多语言或语言均衡的量化器拟合能否提升SID一致率。指标为SID首码/前缀一致率与全SID不匹配率，并设置距离匹配的"产品导向控制"以区分语言方向效应。实验条件包括英文主导拟合、仅英文拟合和均衡拟合。
AI.result: 多语言E5使翻译在嵌入空间中可测地远离源项：在英文主导拟合下，日文翻译仅7.7%保留其英文对应项的首个SID码，而英文改写保留率高达89.0%。距离匹配的产品导向控制产生与翻译几乎相同的全SID不匹配率，说明量化器并未选择性地放大语言方向。均衡拟合混合使码本使用更均匀，却进一步降低跨语言前缀一致率：西班牙文首码一致率从28.3%降至6.6%；而仅英文拟合对67.6%的西班牙文翻译仍保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 多语言暴露与均衡码本使用本身并不足以保证语言一致的语义ID。翻译导致的嵌入位移是跨语言SID不一致的主要来源，且该效应与语言方向无关，而是与位移距离相关。仅英文拟合在目标语言一致率上反而优于均衡拟合，表明量化器拟合的语言配比需与跨语言一致目标协同设计，而非简单追求码本均衡。

title: Reliability Stress Tests and Decision-Time Routing for Chest X-ray Vision-Language Models
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted version of a workshop paper presented orally at the 2026 IEEE/ACM Conference on Connected Health: Applications, Systems and Engineering Technologies (CHASE). Code and per-case MIMIC-CXR results: https://github.com/Yangxinyee/cxr-vlm-routing
summary: Medical vision-language model (VLM) evaluation is sensitive to workflow design, prompting strategy, and benchmark construction, yet most studies treat these factors in isolation. We introduce a reliability stress test for chest X-ray interpretation built on two balanced datasets (a private report-backed set and a curated MIMIC subset). Three medical VLMs (CheXagent, MedGemma-4B, and MedGemma-27B) are evaluated across three prompt styles and two workflows (single-VLM and multi-agent), producing 36 configurations. We show that exact-match accuracy alone can overstate the effectiveness of conservative models that default to "Normal" predictions. Diagnostic reliability also depends heavily on model family and scale: multi-agent reasoning helps some configurations but hurts others. Building on these observations, we propose a decision-time routing framework that selectively escalates to multi-agent inference only when beneficial, improving the cost-quality trade-off over fixed workflows. Our results highlight the need for evaluation protocols that jointly consider prompt sensitivity, failure-mode diversity, and workflow choice before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出面向胸部X光解读的可靠性压力测试框架，在2个平衡数据集上对3个医学VLM、3种提示风格和2种工作流（单模型与多智能体）共36种配置进行评估，揭示精确匹配准确率会高估保守预测模型，并提出决策时路由框架以按需升级多智能体推理，改善成本-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型（VLM）的评估对工作流设计、提示策略和基准构建高度敏感，然而多数研究将这些因素孤立处理，缺乏联合考察其交互影响的评估方法，可能导致对模型诊断可靠性的误判。
AI.method: 构建基于两个平衡数据集（一个私有报告支撑集和一个精选MIMIC子集）的胸部X光解读可靠性压力测试；对CheXagent、MedGemma-4B、MedGemma-27B三个医学VLM，在3种提示风格与2种工作流（单VLM与多智能体）下组合出36种配置进行系统评估；并在此基础上提出决策时路由框架，仅在有益时选择性升级至多智能体推理。
AI.result: 仅使用精确匹配准确率会高估倾向于默认预测"Normal"的保守模型的有效性；诊断可靠性显著依赖模型家族与规模，多智能体推理对部分配置有益、对另一些则有害；所提出的决策时路由框架相比固定工作流改善了成本-质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 临床部署前需要采用能够联合考虑提示敏感性、失败模式多样性与工作流选择的评估协议，而非依赖单一准确率指标或固定工作流。

title: OptimusMesh: Compact Autoregressive Mesh Generation from Point Clouds via Sparse Latent Pivots
summary: Generating compact and geometrically faithful 3D meshes directly from point clouds remains a fundamental challenge. Point clouds are unordered and sparse, whereas meshes exhibit irregular structure and varying topology. As a result, many existing approaches rely on implicit representations followed by surface extraction or reconstruction. Although effective, these pipelines can produce dense or over-smoothed meshes, often requiring computationally expensive post-processing and simplification. We present OptimusMesh, a framework for direct compact triangle mesh generation from point clouds using sparse latent pivot conditioning. Our key idea is to compress $2{,}048$ oriented input points into only $16$ sparse latent pivots, reducing the geometric conditioning set by $128\times$. These pivots provide a compact structural representation shared across a two-stage autoregressive framework that first generates mesh vertices and then predicts triangular faces conditioned on the generated vertices and the same pivots. Compared with the evaluated recent point-cloud-conditioned autoregressive methods, which use $257$ decoder-conditioning tokens, OptimusMesh uses only $16$, yielding a $16.1\times$ shorter conditioning sequence. Experiments show that OptimusMesh produces the most compact outputs among the compared recent autoregressive methods, using $25.7\%$--$94.1\%$ fewer faces while maintaining competitive geometric fidelity and distributional quality.

AI.tldr: OptimusMesh 提出用稀疏潜在枢轴（16个）压缩2048个输入点，通过两阶段自回归框架直接从点云生成紧凑三角网格。
AI.motivation: 从点云直接生成紧凑且几何保真的3D网格仍是难题：点云无序稀疏，网格结构不规则、拓扑多变；现有方法多依赖隐式表示加表面提取或重建，易产生稠密或过度平滑的网格，且需昂贵的后处理与简化。
AI.method: 采用稀疏潜在枢轴条件：将2048个带朝向输入点压缩为仅16个稀疏潜在枢轴，几何条件集缩减128倍。枢轴作为紧凑结构表示，共享于两阶段自回归框架：第一阶段生成网格顶点，第二阶段以生成顶点和相同枢轴为条件预测三角面。相比对比方法使用的257个解码器条件token，本方法仅用16个，条件序列缩短16.1倍。
AI.result: 在对比的近期自回归方法中，OptimusMesh 输出最紧凑，面数减少25.7%–94.1%，同时保持有竞争力的几何保真度与分布质量。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏潜在枢轴条件可实现从点云直接生成紧凑三角网格，在显著压缩条件表示与输出规模的同时维持几何质量。

title: BanglaDial-Abuse: A Corpus-Grounded Dataset for Regional Dialect Identification in Abusive Bangla Text
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Dataset Version 1.0 available on Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.23074319
summary: Regional linguistic variation remains an important challenge for Bangla natural language processing, particularly in informal and non-standard text. This paper introduces BanglaDial-Abuse, a balanced Bengali-script dataset developed for regional dialect identification in abusive and hostile Bangla text. The dataset contains 1,000 sentences distributed equally across four linguistic varieties: Standard Bangla, Chattagram, Sylhet, and Barishal, with 250 samples per class. The resource was constructed using a corpus-grounded synthetic procedure incorporating regional variation in pronouns, possessive forms, verb morphology, negation, interrogative structures, postpositions, vocabulary, and Bengali-script spelling conventions while preserving the underlying hostile or abusive meaning. Descriptive analysis shows broadly comparable sentence-length distributions but partially distinct lexical spaces across the four classes. Pairwise Jaccard vocabulary similarity ranges from 0.37 to 0.56. The primary task is four-class regional dialect identification rather than binary abusive-text detection. The dataset is publicly available through Zenodo under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license. The current version is intended as a research and prototyping corpus rather than a native-speaker-validated gold-standard linguistic resource. Keywords: Bangla, Bengali, dialect identification, regional dialect, abusive language, low-resource NLP, Chattagram, Sylhet, Barishal, dataset

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BanglaDial-Abuse数据集，用于孟加拉语辱骂文本中的四类地区方言识别任务。数据集包含1000句，分属标准孟加拉语、Chattagram、Sylhet和Barishal四种变体，每类250句，采用基于语料库的合成方法构建，公开于Zenodo。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语自然语言处理中，地区语言变异仍是重要挑战，尤其在非正式、非标准文本中。现有研究缺乏针对辱骂性孟加拉语文本的地区方言识别资源，因此需要构建相应数据集。
AI.method: 采用基于语料库的合成构建方法，在代词、所有格形式、动词形态、否定、疑问结构、后置词、词汇及孟加拉文拼写规范等方面引入地区变异，同时保留底层辱骂或敌意含义。数据集共1000句，四类均衡分布各250句。
AI.result: 描述性分析显示四类句子长度分布大致相当，但词汇空间部分存在差异。两两Jaccard词汇相似度范围为0.37至0.56。主要任务为四类地区方言识别，而非二元辱骂文本检测。数据集通过Zenodo以CC BY 4.0许可公开。
AI.conclusion: 当前版本定位为研究与原型开发语料，而非经母语者验证的黄金标准语言资源。未来需进一步进行母语者验证以提升资源质量。

title: My FAULT: Self-Diagnosis as Credit Assignment in Self-Evolving Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful approach for training large language model agents on multi-step tasks, yet reliance on terminal outcome rewards creates two credit-assignment problems, particularly in long-horizon tasks. First, same-outcome rollout groups provide no learning signal from terminal rewards. Second, terminal rewards provide only trajectory-wide feedback, making it difficult to identify which decisions caused a failure. Recent work supplements terminal rewards with finer-grained information from trajectory analysis, such as natural-language reflections on intermediate decisions and errors. However, natural-language diagnoses are difficult to use directly for credit assignment: their error claims may be unreliable, and they do not quantify how much each error should affect learning. We propose Self-Diagnosis-guided Terminal Credit Redistribution (FAULT), which turns diagnosed errors into explicit step-level credit anchored by terminal outcomes. FAULT checks diagnostic evidence and learns relative error costs from task outcomes.
