During training, the policy and self-diagnoser co-evolve, while error costs are updated online from recent outcomes. On ALFWorld, FAULT recovers learning signals from same-outcome groups, reaching 95% signal coverage versus 41% for GRPO and 72% for GiGPO, while better localizing credit to specific error steps. Across two model scales, FAULT delivers strong. improvements on the long-horizon ALFWorld and WebShop tasks while remaining competitive on short-horizon Search-based QA.

AI.tldr: 提出FAULT方法，将自我诊断的语言错误归因转化为显式的步级信用分配，并以终端结果为锚定，通过策略与自诊断器协同演化、错误代价在线更新，缓解长程多步任务中的信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 智能体强化学习依赖终端结果奖励存在两类信用分配问题：一是同结果（同成败）的 rollout 组无法从终端奖励中获得学习信号；二是终端奖励仅为轨迹级反馈，难以定位导致失败的具体决策。现有利用自然语言反思/诊断补充细粒度信息的方法存在诊断结论不可靠、无法量化每个错误对学习影响程度的问题，难以直接用于信用分配。
AI.method: FAULT（Self-Diagnosis-guided Terminal Credit Redistribution）：将诊断出的错误转化为显式的步级信用，并以终端结果作为锚定。方法包含两点关键设计：一是对诊断证据进行校验；二是从任务结果中学习相对的"错误代价"（error costs）。训练过程中策略与自我诊断器共同演化（co-evolve），错误代价依据近期任务结果在线更新。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 上，FAULT 可从同结果组中恢复学习信号，信号覆盖率达95%，显著高于 GRPO 的41%和 GiGPO 的72%，并能更准确地定位到具体错误步骤。在两个模型规模上，FAULT 在长程任务 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上取得显著提升，同时在短程 Search-based QA 任务上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将自然语言自我诊断与终端结果锚定的步级信用重分配相结合，FAULT 有效缓解了智能体 RL 中的信用分配瓶颈，在长程任务上性能提升明显，并具备跨模型规模与跨任务的泛化性和竞争力。

title: PhysicsLENS: Diagnosing Physical Property Blindness in Video Generation Models
summary: Reliable video world models could provide scalable predictive environments for robot learning, planning, and evaluation. However, generated robot videos can violate physical principles and complete tasks through physically implausible behavior, limiting their reliability for robot learning and planning. Current video-generation benchmarks exclude physics that are inherently hidden by visuals (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction). Due to this, video models are evaluated on the fidelity of physics, not the underlying accuracy of physics. We introduce PhysicsLENS, a dataset and benchmark for evaluating plausibility of physical properties grounded in robotics. PhysicsLENS uses matched scenario pairs that hold the same conditioning frame and task, while varying underlying physics in the scene description. Scenarios are curated from public robot video sources and annotated across seven physical domains: collision, gravity, momentum, friction, deformation, fluid, and causality. We evaluate across four video generation models, producing over 400 human-annotated labels. Results show that plausible-looking videos often ignore the stated property (34 of 47), and that stating the property lowers plausibility only slightly and not significantly.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhysicsLENS，一个基于机器人场景、用于评估视频世界模型物理合理性的数据集与基准，通过匹配场景对改变隐藏物理属性进行评测，发现视觉逼真的生成视频常忽略物理设定。
AI.motivation: 可靠视频世界模型可为机器人学习、规划与评估提供可扩展的预测环境，但生成视频可能违背物理规律、以不合理行为完成任务。现有视频生成基准仅关注视觉可见的物理保真度，忽略了重量、黏度、摩擦等被视觉掩盖的物理属性，因此无法评估物理底层准确性。
AI.method: 构建 PhysicsLENS 数据集与基准，采用匹配场景对：同一条件帧与任务，仅在场景描述中改变底层物理属性；场景取自公开机器人视频，覆盖七个物理域（碰撞、重力、动量、摩擦、形变、流体、因果）；对四个视频生成模型进行评测，收集超过 400 个人工标注标签。
AI.result: 在 47 个可评估案例中，有 34 个看似合理的视频忽略了所声明的物理属性；且在提示中声明物理属性仅略微降低合理性，且未达到统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频生成模型缺乏对底层物理属性的真实建模，视觉合理性不能代表物理正确性；PhysicsLENS 为机器人场景下的物理合理性评测提供了基准，揭示现有模型的局限。

title: Persistent Depth Ordering amid Shifting Block-Bypass Responses in Language Model Pretraining
summary: Layer interventions are widely used to probe the internal organization of language models, yet most analyses examine a single training checkpoint even though model representations and computations evolve throughout pretraining. This leaves open which depth-dependent intervention responses reflect persistent organization and which are transient consequences of training. We study this question using single-block identity bypass on fixed teacher-forced contexts across five released trajectories and 11 model-domain combinations. We find that block-bypass responses retain recognizable depth ordering while their magnitudes redistribute: nearby checkpoints preserve stronger rank correspondence than distant ones, and large changes concentrate at positions that recur across text samples and transfer across evaluation domains. Controlled experiments further show that changes in the natural bypass effect cannot be reduced to a single downstream sensitivity: in replicated Pythia runs, local missing-update magnitude grows while the pooled matched downstream response decreases, whereas OLMo-2 7B exhibits a different balance. These matched responses also depend on perturbation strength and direction, without identifying targeted compensation. Together, our results show that longitudinal layer sensitivity is structured but not static, and that single-checkpoint intervention responses should be interpreted in the context of how the underlying perturbation pathway evolves during training.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对五个已发布训练轨迹、11个模型-领域组合做单块恒等旁路（identity bypass）干预,研究层干预响应在预训练过程中的动态演化,发现深度排序保持可识别但幅度重新分布,且变化不能归因于单一的下游敏感性。
AI.motivation: 层干预被广泛用于探测语言模型的内部组织,但多数分析只考察单一训练检查点。由于模型表征与计算在预训练全程持续演化,尚不清楚哪些深度相关的干预响应反映的是持久性组织,哪些只是训练的暂态产物。
AI.method: 采用单块恒等旁路（single-block identity bypass）干预,在固定teacher-forced上下文上,跨五个公开发布的预训练轨迹和11个模型-领域组合进行纵向分析;通过检查点之间的距离比较排序对应性,并设计受控实验考察扰动强度与方向的影响,以及下游敏感性的作用。
AI.result: 块旁路响应保留了可辨识的深度排序,但幅度会重新分布:邻近检查点的秩对应性强于远离的检查点,且大幅变化集中在跨文本样本重复出现、并可跨评估领域迁移的位置。在复制的Pythia运行中,局部缺失更新幅度增大而汇总的匹配下游响应减小,OLMo-2 7B则呈现不同平衡;匹配响应还依赖扰动强度与方向,未发现针对性的补偿。
AI.conclusion: 纵向层敏感性是有结构但非静态的;单检查点的干预响应必须在底层扰动通路如何随训练演化的背景下解读。

title: CineMR: Tool-Integrated Vision-Language Reasoning for Quantitative Cardiac MRI Assessment
comment: Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR
summary: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), including cine imaging, is a reference standard for the noninvasive assessment of cardiac morphology and ventricular function. Cine CMR interpretation integrates qualitative visual assessment with quantitative measurements of ventricular volumes, ejection fraction, myocardial mass, wall thickness, and regional wall motion. Current medical vision-language models (VLMs) cannot reliably derive quantitative measurements from multidimensional cine images without analysis tools. We present CineMR, a tool-augmented VLM that invokes cardiac image-analysis tools and integrates their outputs into interleaved reasoning for quantitative CMR assessment. We also construct a multi-cohort visual question answering benchmark covering quantitative metric extraction, multiclass diagnosis, and differential diagnosis, together with tools for segmentation, phase selection, volumetry, morphometry, and regional wall motion analysis. CineMR is trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-interaction traces followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with conditional tool-use rewards. On the multi-cohort cine CMR benchmark, CineMR achieves 35.9% pass@1 and 58.9% pass@4, compared with 1.5% pass@1 for the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone and 0.0% and 7.0% pass@1 for LLaVA-Med v1.5 and MedGemma-4B, respectively. Correct tool invocation reaches 99.8% after GRPO, up from 78.9% after SFT. Live tool outputs improve ventricular measurement accuracy by 20.4--23.7% over direct model predictions, and removing all tools reduces pass@1 from 35.9% to 27.9%. These results highlight the importance of reliable tool use for quantitative cine CMR reasoning and support CineMR as a promising approach for assistive cardiac image assessment. Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR.

AI.tldr: CineMR 是一种工具增强的视觉语言模型，通过调用心脏影像分析工具并将其输出整合到交错推理中，实现定量心脏 cine CMR 评估，在自建多队列基准上显著优于现有医学 VLM。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型无法在无分析工具辅助下从多维 cine 图像中可靠地得出定量测量结果（如心室容积、射血分数、心肌质量、室壁厚度及区域室壁运动），而临床 cine CMR 判读需将定性视觉评估与定量测量相结合，因此需要可靠的工具使用能力。
AI.method: 提出 CineMR——工具增强 VLM，调用心脏图像分析工具并将工具输出整合到交错推理中；构建覆盖定量指标提取、多类诊断与鉴别诊断的多队列视觉问答基准，并提供分割、时相选择、容积测定、形态测量与区域室壁运动分析工具；训练采用工具交互轨迹的监督微调（SFT），随后以带条件工具使用奖励的 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）进行优化。
AI.result: 在多队列 cine CMR 基准上，CineMR 达到 35.9% pass@1 与 58.9% pass@4；Qwen3-VL-8B 主干仅 1.5% pass@1，LLaVA-Med v1.5 与 MedGemma-4B 分别为 0.0% 与 7.0%。正确工具调用率经 GRPO 后从 SFT 的 78.9% 提升至 99.8%；实时工具输出使心室测量准确率较直接模型预测提升 20.4--23.7%；移除全部工具后 pass@1 由 35.9% 降至 27.9%。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了可靠工具使用对定量 cine CMR 推理的重要性，支持 CineMR 作为辅助心脏影像评估的有前景方法；代码、基准资源与模型权重已公开。

title: HeadEdit: Calibrating Language Model Behavior Through the Frozen Unembedding Matrix
summary: Alignment does not eliminate behavioral errors in language models. Models may still refuse benign requests, call unnecessary tools, or yield to false user claims. Current methods mitigate such errors as a computation problem, and rarely explore if the desired behavior is already encoded in the model's representation. Motivated by the observation that behavior-relevant information remains linearly decodable from the final hidden state even when the resulting logits produce the undesired behavior, we introduce HeadEdit, a gradient-free method that calibrates model behavior through the unembedding matrix. HeadEdit extracts a low-rank behavioral subspace from paired completions and uses each prompt's coordinates within it to generate a vocabulary-wide correction, thereby implementing implicitly adaptive steering without manually specified target tokens or parameter updates. HeadEdit improves all nine experimental settings across three tasks and three model families, with negligible inference overhead and no systematic loss of general capabilities. It also reveals a connection to gradient-based alignment. HeadEdit's low-dimensional representation partly predicts how preference tuning changes output logits on unseen prompts. The subspace learned from the model can also be reused after tuning, improving performance without re-extracting or retuning. These results show that HeadEdit provides a practical, lightweight, and interpretable way to calibrate model behavior through the unembedding matrix.

AI.tldr: 提出HeadEdit：一种免梯度方法，通过unembedding矩阵从成对补全中提取低秩"行为子空间"，利用提示坐标生成全词表修正，实现隐式自适应引导，无需目标token或参数更新，在3个任务×3个模型家族的9个设置上均提升，推理开销可忽略且不损失通用能力。
AI.motivation: 对齐后的语言模型仍存在行为错误（拒绝良性请求、调用不必要工具、屈从虚假用户声明）。现有方法多将此类错误视为计算问题加以缓解，很少探究所需行为是否已编码在模型表示中。观察到即便最终logits产生不良行为，行为相关信息仍可从最后隐状态中线性解码，说明行为信号已存在表示中，只需校准而非重训练。
AI.method: HeadEdit为免梯度校准方法，作用于unembedding矩阵：从成对补全中提取低秩行为子空间，用每个提示在该子空间内的坐标生成词表级修正，从而在无需人工指定目标token、无需参数更新的情况下实现隐式自适应引导（implicitly adaptive steering）。
AI.result: 在3个任务、3个模型家族共9个实验设置中全部取得改进；推理开销可忽略，通用能力无系统性损失；揭示与基于梯度的对齐方法的联系；其低维表示可部分预测偏好调优在未见提示上对输出logits的改变；该子空间在调优后仍可复用，无需重新提取或重新调优即可提升性能。
AI.conclusion: HeadEdit提供了一种实用、轻量且可解释的方式，通过unembedding矩阵校准模型行为，并表明期望行为已编码于模型表示中，可被低成本读取与复用。

title: Temporally-Resolved Token Attribution Reveals the Generation Dynamics of Diffusion Language Models
summary: This work presents Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients (DLIG), a token attribution method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that extends Integrated Gradients (IG~\cite{sundararajan2017axiomatic}) to arbitrary layers and denoising steps. DLIG attributes a DLM's progressive commitment to a self-generated or fixed completion for an input prompt. We establish direct correspondences between DLIG and the IG axioms of completeness, implementation invariance, linearity, and symmetry preservation. As a lightweight complement to interventional analysis, DLIG provides an inexpensive first check of mechanistic hypotheses across the denoising trajectory. We demonstrate this on word-sense disambiguation, multi-hop graph reasoning, and sentence infilling, revealing how DLMs draw on inputs across positions, layers, and denoising steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DLIG，将积分梯度扩展到扩散语言模型的任意层与去噪步，用于 token 归因，并在词义消歧、多跳图推理和句子填空上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）逐步承诺生成结果的机制尚不清晰，且缺乏轻量、可解释的归因方法来检验其去噪轨迹中的机制假设。
AI.method: DLIG 将积分梯度（IG）推广到扩散语言模型的任意层和任意去噪步，针对输入提示对自生成或固定补全的渐进承诺进行 token 归因；并与 IG 的公理（完备性、实现不变性、线性、对称保持）建立直接对应。
AI.result: 作为干预分析的轻量补充，DLIG 能低成本地初步检验跨去噪轨迹的机制假设；在词义消歧、多跳图推理和句子填空任务上，揭示了 DLM 如何跨位置、层与去噪步利用输入信息。
AI.conclusion: DLIG 为扩散语言模型提供了一种可扩展、符合公理的 token 归因方法，可用于高效的机制假设检验与去噪过程解释。

title: Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting: Training-Free Negation Understanding for Vision-Language Models
summary: Despite the strong performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a wide range of visual question answering (VQA) tasks, these models consistently struggle to understand negation and produce incorrect answers when questions involve negated clauses. To address this limitation, we propose Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting (\textbf{SSP}), a training-free, in-context learning method that improves VLM negation understanding capabilities without any parameter updates. Given a negation question, our method first abstracts the underlying question structure into a skeleton, retrieves a small set of same-skeleton questions from a lightweight question pool, then prompts the VLM to analyze their shared negation pattern and synthesize a single-sentence answering strategy. The skeleton and strategy are prepended to the test sample to guide the model correctly tackle the negation problems. Experiments on multiple negation VQA benchmarks show that SSP achieves state-of-the-art performance on negation-focused VQA tasks while remaining computationally efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting (SSP)，一种免训练、基于上下文学习的方法，通过抽象问题骨架、检索同骨架样例并合成否定应答策略，提升VLM的否定理解能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型（VLM）在大量VQA任务上表现优异，但在涉及否定从句的问题上持续失败，常给出错误答案。作者希望在不更新任何参数的前提下改善这一缺陷。
AI.method: SSP为免训练、上下文学习方法。给定否定问题，先将问题结构抽象为骨架（skeleton），从轻量问题池中检索少量同骨架问题，再提示VLM分析其共同否定模式并合成一句应答策略（strategy）。将骨架与策略前置到测试样本中以引导模型处理否定问题。
AI.result: 在多个否定VQA基准上，SSP在面向否定的VQA任务中达到最先进性能，同时保持较低的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过骨架抽象与策略合成的上下文提示，可在无参数更新情况下有效增强VLM的否定理解，兼顾性能与效率。

title: ReCast: Contract-Preserving Protection for Fixed-Interface Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Remote multimodal models offer strong numerical reasoning capabilities over charts and speech, but sending private inputs risks exposing sensitive content. Text-only sanitization cannot directly satisfy fixed media interfaces, while identity anonymization leaves the underlying task content exposed. We introduce ReCast, an agentic plug-in framework that replaces source-specific content while preserving task-relevant relations and the required input modality. ReCast locally converts inputs into a shared textual evidence-query record, jointly rewrites entities and topics with a distilled 4B model, and substitutes values through a locally invertible, role-aware numerical map. A reconstruction agent generates and validates the required media from the protected record. The remote solver returns a program whose protected operands are restored locally before execution. On 4,000 held-out ChartQA and NMSQA examples, ReCast achieves 75.10% accuracy, retaining 92.43% of unprotected remote accuracy, while a model-based audit flags source-content leakage in 7.95% of solver-bound requests. It outperforms all evaluated local baselines, preserving the benefit of remote reasoning while reducing source-content exposure under existing media interfaces.

AI.tldr: ReCast：面向远程多模态数值推理的智能体插件式隐私保护框架，通过内容替换在固定媒体接口下保留任务关系与模态，实现兼顾效用与隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 远程多模态模型在图表和语音上的数值推理能力强，但上传私有输入会暴露敏感内容。纯文本脱敏无法满足固定媒体接口要求，而身份匿名化仍会暴露任务内容本身。因此需要在保持输入模态与任务相关关系的前提下保护源内容。
AI.method: ReCast为智能体插件框架：本地将输入转换为共享的文本证据-查询记录；用蒸馏4B模型联合改写实体与主题；通过本地可逆的角色感知数值映射替换数值；重建智能体基于受保护记录生成并校验所需媒体；远程求解器返回程序，其受保护操作数在本地恢复后执行。
AI.result: 在4000个留存的ChartQA与NMSQA样本上，ReCast达到75.10%准确率，保留未保护远程准确率的92.43%；基于模型的审计显示，发往求解器的请求中源内容泄漏率为7.95%；性能优于所有评估的本地基线。
AI.conclusion: ReCast在现有媒体接口下既保留了远程推理的收益，又降低了源内容暴露风险，是一种兼顾隐私与效用的多模态远程推理保护方案。

title: Color Independent Word Segmentation From Transcribed Bangla Passages
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 6th International Conference on Electrical Information and Communication Technology (EICT). Code: https://github.com/FaiasPromit/Color-Independent-Word-Segmentation-From-Transcribed-Bangla-Passages.git
summary: An optical character recognition(OCR) system can scan paper and extract text, making people's jobs easier. While numerous OCR systems are accessible in the software sector, finding a dependable equivalent solution for Bangla is tough. When it comes to handwritten texts, the case is even more rare. The first fundamental step to any OCR is to segment words from text images. If this stage fails, the total OCR's performance will be poor no matter how promising the later stages perform. This research aims to segment words in a handwritten Bangla text image. This research can be implemented on any smartphone-captured image, irrespective of the color and type of paper and ink. Furthermore, as smartphone-captured images can create shadow interferences, the custom dataset built for this research is created in such a way that every possible obstacle that can be faced is included. For 7374 words, a total of 7278 bounding boxes are generated, which have recall of 90.60%, precision of 91.80%, and F1-score of 91.20%. The system can be further improved with nested operations on bounding boxes containing several words or by adjusting the adaptive thresholding and dilation filter sizes to a more precise level.

AI.tldr: 本文针对手写孟加拉语文本图像中的单词分割问题，提出了一套可在任意智能手机拍摄图像上运行的分割方法，并在包含阴影干扰的自建数据集上取得了90.60%召回率、91.80%精确率和91.20% F1分数。
AI.motivation: OCR系统能够扫描纸张并提取文本，但孟加拉语的可靠OCR方案稀缺，手写场景更为罕见。单词分割是OCR的基础步骤，若该阶段失败，后续环节再优秀整体性能也会很差。因此本研究旨在解决手写孟加拉语文本图像的单词分割问题。
AI.method: 构建了包含各种可能障碍（如智能手机拍摄产生的阴影干扰）的自定义数据集，并采用自适应阈值化与膨胀滤波等方法在文本图像上生成单词候选边界框；方法不依赖于纸张与墨水的颜色和类型，可适用于任意智能手机拍摄图像。
AI.result: 针对7374个单词共生成7278个边界框，召回率为90.60%，精确率为91.80%，F1分数为91.20%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统可通过以下方式进一步改进：对包含多个单词的边界框进行嵌套操作，或将自适应阈值化和膨胀滤波器的尺寸调整到更精细的水平。

title: FlashBack: Knowing When to Remember in Streaming Vision-Language Models
summary: Streaming vision-language models must process continuously growing video streams under a bounded compute budget, creating a persistent tension between real-time perception and long-term memory. Retrieving historical information provides a natural remedy, yet historical recall is not uniformly beneficial: unnecessary history may introduce irrelevant context into current reasoning and interfere with native real-time perception. Effective streaming memory should therefore address not only what to remember, but also when and how to access it. To this end, we introduce FlashBack, a training-free framework for selective, multi-level memory in streaming vision-language models. Before retrieving history, FlashBack draws on the semantic understanding of the frozen streaming VLM to infer whether a query calls for historical evidence. This assessment determines whether inference remains on the Native trajectory or invokes an isolated Recall trajectory. The Recall trajectory combines recent context with retrieved long-term memory through a query-local Side-KV pathway, preserving local temporal continuity without modifying the persistent Native state. We instantiate FlashBack on StreamingVLM and Mage-VL-4B and evaluate it on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench. The results show improvements on several long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks while largely preserving real-time perception, with performance competitive with strong training-based streaming methods despite requiring no additional training. Our code will be announced later.

AI.tldr: FlashBack：免训练的选择性多级流式记忆框架，先判断是否需要历史再决定走原生或召回轨迹。
AI.motivation: 流式视觉语言模型需在有限算力下处理持续增长的视频流，实时感知与长期记忆之间存在固有矛盾。检索历史虽可缓解，但并非总是有益，无关历史会污染当前推理并干扰实时感知，因此记忆机制需同时解决“记什么”和“何时、如何访问”。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架FlashBack，实现选择性多级记忆。检索前利用冻结流式VLM的语义理解判断查询是否需要历史证据，据此选择保持Native轨迹或切换到隔离的Recall轨迹；Recall轨迹通过查询局部的Side-KV通路融合近期上下文与检索到的长期记忆，在不修改持久Native状态的前提下保持局部时序连续性。在StreamingVLM与Mage-VL-4B上实例化。
AI.result: 在OVO-Bench与StreamingBench上评估，多项长时程与记忆依赖任务性能提升，同时基本保持实时感知能力，效果可与强训练型流式方法竞争，且无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: 选择性的“何时访问”机制是流式记忆有效性的关键，免训练的多级记忆设计可在不牺牲实时性的前提下增强长期记忆能力。

title: iSEE: Object Permanence Through Self-Supervision
summary: Object permanence, keeping track of an object's identity and position while it is occluded, is central to video representations that track, predict and plan. Trackers that achieve it learn from boxes, track identities and visibility labels. On the other hand, self-supervised object-centric methods discover objects without labels: through slot attention, it represents a video as slots that bind to objects and follow them across frames. However, these slots are lost under occlusion, making the desired permanence impossible. Reasoning permanence is a hard problem because it requires to detect when an object becomes occluded, re-identify when object reappears, and keep the object's hidden position continuous, using reapperance as the only learning cue. To address this, we propose iSEE, a novel framework that offers all three aforementioned requirements, without any labels whatsoever. We built iSEE using the following three proposed components: (i) Object evidence modelling: a slot's attention, compared with its own past, reveals when its object is hidden. (ii) Appearance-position separation: two slot streams let the appearance be held for re-identification while the position keeps changing. (iii) Permanence from reappearance: a walker follows the hidden object's position, trained only on where the object reappears. On LA-CATER static, iSEE returns a reappearing object to its own slot after 86% of occlusions, against 32% for SlotContrast, and localises it while hidden within 4.1 mAP of the label-trained SoTA RAM. The two streams also allow downstream planning, with the position stream as the action of a world model. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/iSEE/

AI.tldr: 提出无标签自监督框架 iSEE，通过目标证据建模、外观-位置分离与"重现驱动"学习，实现视频中被遮挡物体的身份与位置持续性保持。
AI.motivation: 物体永久性（遮挡下保持物体身份与位置）对追踪、预测与规划至关重要。有监督追踪器依赖框、身份与可见性标签；而基于 slot attention 的自监督方法虽无需标签，但其 slot 在遮挡下会丢失，无法实现永久性。核心难点在于：需检测遮挡开始、重现时重识别、并保持隐藏位置连续，且仅有"重现"作为监督线索。
AI.method: iSEE 框架，含三个组件：(i) 目标证据建模：将 slot 当前注意力与其自身历史对比，判断物体何时被隐藏；(ii) 外观-位置分离：设置两个 slot 流，外观流保持用于重识别，位置流持续更新；(iii) 重现驱动永久性：一个 walker 跟踪隐藏物体位置，仅以物体重现位置为训练信号。
AI.result: 在 LA-CATER static 上，iSEE 在 86% 的遮挡后将重现物体归回其原 slot，SlotContrast 仅 32%；隐藏期间定位误差在 4.1 mAP 以内，接近需标签训练的 SoTA RAM。双流结构还支持下游规划，位置流可作为世界模型的动作。
AI.conclusion: 无需任何标签即可满足遮挡下物体永久性的三项要求（检测遮挡、重识别、隐藏位置连续），在重识别与隐藏定位上显著优于自监督基线并逼近有监督方法，且位置流可服务于世界模型的下游规划。

title: Semantic RGB--Depth Based Surgical Skill Assessment in Microscopic Stereo Videos
summary: Objective assessment of microsurgical technical skill is essential for competency-based training and quality assurance, yet existing video-based approaches predominantly rely on RGB images and therefore overlook the 3D spatial relationships that characterize instrument-anatomy interactions. Although stereo operating microscopes provide complementary depth information, conventional stereo matching algorithms can produce sparse and unreliable depth estimates under high-magnification imaging conditions, limiting their use for automated skill assessment. This work presents a semantic RGB-Depth framework for surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. A regression-based depth fusion method combines sparse metric stereo depth with dense monocular depth estimates to generate a dense geometric representation of the surgical scene. This representation is integrated with semantically decomposed RGB streams corresponding to individual surgical instruments and surrounding anatomy. A hierarchical attention architecture jointly encodes these streams to capture discriminative patterns of instrument use and instrument-anatomy interaction across surgeons at different training levels. The framework was evaluated on 33 ex vivo transoral microlaryngeal procedures performed by six surgeons, comprising attending surgeons and surgical residents, using leave-one-surgeon-out cross-validation. The proposed semantic RGB-Depth model achieved an F1 score of 0.938 for skill-level classification, compared with 0.696 for semantic RGB and 0.929 for semantic depth. These results suggest that geometric information can improve automated surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. The learned spatial, temporal, and semantic attention patterns also support qualitative examination of the scene regions, video segments, and semantic streams emphasized by the model.

AI.tldr: 提出语义RGB-D框架，融合稀疏立体深度与稠密单目深度，结合语义分解RGB流与层次化注意力，实现显微外科技能自动评估，F1达0.938。
AI.motivation: 基于RGB视频的显微外科技能评估忽略器械-解剖交互的3D空间关系；立体显微镜虽提供深度，但高放大率下传统立体匹配深度稀疏且不可靠，制约自动化评估应用。
AI.method: 采用回归式深度融合，将稀疏度量立体深度与稠密单目深度估计结合生成稠密几何表征；与语义分解的RGB流（分属各手术器械与周围解剖）集成；用层次化注意力架构联合编码这些流以捕获不同训练水平外科医生的器械使用与器械-解剖交互判别模式。
AI.result: 在33例离体经口喉显微手术、6名外科医生（主治与住院医师）上以留一外科医生交叉验证评估；语义RGB-D模型技能分类F1=0.938，语义RGB为0.696，语义深度为0.929。
AI.conclusion: 几何信息可提升基于显微立体视频的自动化外科技能评估；所学空间、时间与语义注意力模式支持对模型关注区域、视频片段与语义流进行定性分析。

title: Resolving Mixed Single-Photon LiDAR Returns for Foreground-View and Hidden Scene Reconstruction
summary: Partially transmissive screens and protective covers are common in robotic inspection, but they create mixed LiDAR returns from both the foreground material and the scene behind it. Conventional peak-based LiDAR usually discards weak hidden returns, while single-photon LiDAR records time-resolved histograms that preserve attenuated and overlapping echoes. However, existing transient reconstruction methods typically fit a single scene representation to the measured waveform. Under occlusion, weak or nearby foreground--hidden echoes can form a broad peak or subtle shoulder. Because such waveforms can also be explained by a displaced single surface or a thick density distribution, accurate transient fitting does not necessarily imply correct geometry. We propose a state-aware framework for foreground-view and hidden scene reconstruction from occluded single-photon histograms. For each ray, we estimate local echo evidence, identifying no reliable surface evidence, single-return evidence, or two returns. The inferred echo state routes supervision for a two-head neural field: all rays constrain waveform reconstruction, while reliable anchors provide geometry localization. We also introduce a real paired single-photon LiDAR occlusion dataset with occluded and clean captures at fixed poses. Experiments on a real dataset show improved hidden scene depth and point-cloud accuracy over baselines. Our results demonstrate single-photon layered reconstruction as a practical route for 3D perception through partially transmissive occluders.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种状态感知框架，用于从被部分透射遮挡物遮挡的单光子LiDAR直方图中重建前景视角与隐藏场景，并发布了真实配对遮挡数据集，实验显示隐藏场景深度与点云精度优于基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人巡检中常见部分透射屏幕与防护罩，会造成前景材料与后方场景的混合LiDAR回波。传统峰值LiDAR丢弃弱隐藏回波，单光子LiDAR虽保留衰减与重叠回波的时间分辨直方图，但现有瞬态重建方法只对波形拟合单一场景表示。遮挡下弱或相近的前景-隐藏回波会形成宽峰或肩部，而这类波形也可由单一偏移表面或厚密度分布解释，因此瞬态拟合准确并不代表几何正确。
AI.method: 提出状态感知框架：对每条光线估计局部回波证据，判别无可靠表面证据、单回波证据或双回波三种状态；据推断的回波状态为双头神经场分配监督信号——所有光线约束波形重建，可靠锚点提供几何定位。同时构建真实配对单光子LiDAR遮挡数据集，包含固定位姿下的遮挡与干净采集。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上，隐藏场景深度与点云精度均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明单光子分层重建是穿透部分透射遮挡物实现3D感知的可行路径。

title: EgoFound3R: End-to-End Egocentric Hand Reconstruction in World Space with Point-Wise Interaction Attributes
summary: Egocentric video has become a primary source of supervision for embodied models, and its value rests on recovering hand motion in world coordinates, which camera motion and hand occlusion make difficult. Existing reconstruction pipelines typically separate hand and scene estimation, leave interaction attributes to separate task-specific models, and invoke several models per video, so no prior reconstruction model estimates these attributes and throughput becomes a practical constraint on large-scale annotation. We therefore introduce EgoFound3R, a unified end-to-end model that estimates world-space hand geometry in a metric scale shared with the scene, and predicts point-wise interaction attributes, including visibility, contact, and distance. The model integrates three designs: (i) structured hand prompts that transfer pretrained geometric priors to world-space hand reconstruction; (ii) an explicit hand representation that decodes hand geometry and interaction attributes; and (iii) a shared-parameter multi-rate design that lowers inference cost. Together, these designs predict hand geometry and point-wise attributes in one pass. On OakInk-v2, TACO, and HOI4D, EgoFound3R reduces the mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 43.2%, 22.4%, and 11.6% over previous methods and predicts point-wise contact and distance alongside the geometry in the same pass, while attaining approximately 6x higher throughput.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoFound3R，一个统一端到端模型，在共享场景度量尺度下估计世界坐标系手部几何并预测逐点交互属性（可见性、接触、距离），兼具高精度与约6倍吞吐。
AI.motivation: 第一视角视频已成为具身模型监督的主要来源，其价值依赖在世界坐标系中恢复手部运动，但相机运动与手部遮挡使该任务困难。现有重建流程将手与场景估计分离、把交互属性交给单独的任务专用模型、且每个视频需调用多个模型，导致缺乏能同时估计这些属性的重建模型，吞吐量成为大规模标注的实际瓶颈。
AI.method: EgoFound3R集成了三项设计：(i) 结构化手部提示（structured hand prompts），将预训练几何先验迁移到世界空间手部重建；(ii) 显式手部表示，用于解码手部几何与交互属性；(iii) 共享参数的多速率设计，以降低推理成本。三者共同实现一次前向即预测手部几何与逐点属性。
AI.result: 在OakInk-v2、TACO与HOI4D上，EgoFound3R相较此前方法将MPJPE分别降低43.2%、22.4%和11.6%，在同一次前向中同时预测逐点接触与距离，并实现约6倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: EgoFound3R以统一的端到端框架替代分离式多模型流程，在提升世界坐标手部重建精度的同时输出交互属性并显著提高效率，适用于大规模第一视角数据标注。

title: AutoGUIWorld: Image Generators as Visual World Models for GUI Agent
summary: GUI agents require high-quality interaction trajectories to learn how software environments respond to actions, maintain state, and support multi-step workflows. However, the diversity of available trajectories is constrained by the applications, interface states, and workflows accessible in the underlying environments. Expanding this coverage requires deploying increasingly diverse and complex software, with specialized applications imposing additional installation, configuration, and runtime costs. We introduce AutoGUIWorld, a data generation framework that combines the visual priors of image generators with the task knowledge of a planner to synthesize GUI interaction trajectories without deploying or running the corresponding software environments. AutoGUIWorld samples initial GUI scenes from structured specifications of operating-system context, visual appearance, and interface state, and generates tasks conditioned on those scenes. A planner then specifies atomic actions and their intended visual consequences, while an image generator iteratively edits the current screenshot to produce subsequent observations. Action grounding and transition-level quality filtering yield 79,266 spatially annotated step-level training samples across Ubuntu, Windows, macOS, and Chrome. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoGUIWorld trajectories improves the mean task score on OSWorld from 33.0% to 40.8% and the task success rate on ScienceBoard from 14.0% to 32.2%. These results show that generated trajectories improve GUI-agent performance on real desktop and scientific tasks.

AI.tldr: AutoGUIWorld是一个数据生成框架，结合图像生成器的视觉先验与规划器的任务知识，在不部署真实软件环境的情况下合成GUI交互轨迹，共生成79,266个带空间标注的步骤级训练样本，微调后显著提升GUI智能体在OSWorld与ScienceBoard上的表现。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体依赖高质量交互轨迹来学习环境响应、状态维护与多步工作流，但现有轨迹的多样性受限于底层环境中可获取的应用、界面状态和工作流。若想扩大覆盖范围，需部署日益多样、复杂的软件，而专用应用会带来额外的安装、配置与运行成本。
AI.method: AutoGUIWorld将图像生成器的视觉先验与规划器的任务知识相结合来合成GUI交互轨迹，无需部署或运行对应软件环境。它从操作系统上下文、视觉外观和界面状态的结构化规格中采样初始GUI场景，并基于场景生成任务；随后由规划器指定原子动作及其预期的视觉后果，图像生成器则通过迭代编辑当前截图来生成后续观测。最后通过动作定位（action grounding）与转换级质量过滤获得训练数据。
AI.result: 最终产出79,266个带空间标注的步骤级训练样本，覆盖Ubuntu、Windows、macOS和Chrome四个平台。在AutoGUIWorld轨迹上微调Qwen3.5-35B-A3B后，OSWorld平均任务得分从33.0%提升至40.8%，ScienceBoard任务成功率从14.0%提升至32.2%。
AI.conclusion: 生成式轨迹能够有效提升GUI智能体在真实桌面任务与科学任务上的性能，表明该无需真实环境部署的数据生成路径具有实用价值与可扩展性。

title: AGO AI Quality Gate: Evidence-First Release Decisions for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Submitted version (pre-review). Accepted at NFMCP 2026, ECML PKDD 2026 Workshops
summary: Enterprises adopting retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) face a recurring operational decision: promote, revise, or block a system version. The evidence is incomplete and the metrics come from fallible LLM judges. We report on AGO AI Quality Gate (AGO), an evidence-first quality-gate framework deployed in industrial RAG assessment engagements. AGO integrates four key components: a four-state decision model that treats missing data and judge errors as explicit outcomes; layered scoring combining deterministic checks, local guardrails, and structured LLM evaluation; a stratified beta-binomial gate that quantifies regression risk probabilistically; and a mandatory meta-evaluation protocol to validate the LLM judge before it influences decisions. Since engagement data is proprietary, we evaluate the judge layer on RAGBench, a public benchmark of 100k annotated RAG traces across 12 datasets. On identical stratified test samples (N=1200 per judge), a low-cost judge (gpt-4.1-nano) detects non-adherent answers barely above chance (AUROC 0.603 [0.570, 0.634]), despite producing flawless protocol output, while gpt-4o reaches 0.783 [0.756, 0.807] -- yet its per-domain performance still ranges from 0.62 to 0.88. A fixed-seed gate study spanning regression, no change, and improvement quantifies unsafe promotion, false-alarm cost, and improvement throughput. Under regression, the decision-grade profile reduces unsafe promotion to 22.2%-35.1%, against 29.3%-41.8% for a naive gate. These results support the design choices that judge quality must be measured per engagement and that point estimates alone are not a release decision.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AGO AI Quality Gate（AGO），一个面向工业RAG评估的"证据优先"质量门框架，通过四态决策模型、分层评分、分层beta-binomial门控和强制元评估协议，将缺失数据与评审错误显式建模，并在RAGBench上验证评审层质量与门控决策效果。
AI.motivation: 企业部署检索增强生成（RAG）系统时需反复决定是"上线、修订还是阻断"某个版本，但所依据的证据不完整，且指标来自可能出错的LLM评审。点估计式指标难以支撑可靠的发布决策，因此需要一个能显式处理缺失数据与评审误差、并以概率方式量化回归风险的质量门框架。
AI.method: AGO包含四个核心组件：（1）四态决策模型，将数据缺失与评审错误作为显式结果；（2）分层评分，融合确定性检查、本地护栏与结构化LLM评估；（3）分层beta-binomial门控，以概率方式量化回归风险；（4）强制元评估协议，在LLM评审影响决策前对其有效性进行验证。由于企业数据为专有数据，评审层在RAGBench（12个数据集、10万条标注RAG轨迹的公开基准）上评估；门控研究采用固定种子，覆盖回归、无变化与改进三类场景。
AI.result: 在相同分层测试样本（每个评审N=1200）上，低成本评审gpt-4.1-nano检测不合规答案的能力仅略高于随机水平（AUROC 0.603 [0.570, 0.634]），尽管其协议输出完美；gpt-4o达到0.783 [0.756, 0.807]，但其各领域性能仍在0.62至0.88间波动。固定种子门控研究表明，在回归场景下，决策级配置将不安全上线率降至22.2%–35.1%，而朴素门控为29.3%–41.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持两项设计选择：评审质量必须按每次评估场景单独度量，且仅有指标点估计不足以支撑发布决策，需结合概率化门控与元评估协议。

title: A Compact Explicit 4D Representation for Dynamic Scenes
summary: A compact dynamic-scene representation must retain both the surfaces seen over time and the appearance needed to render them from new viewpoints. We present Sparc4D, a feed-forward autoencoder that encodes a monocular video with known cameras into a sparse 4D scene state. Static features are shared across the clip, while spatially anchored temporal slots store time-varying features with a median $5.0\times$ fewer values than per-frame storage and negligible change in the complete model's novel-view quality. A sparse decoder produces 2D Gaussian surfels, while stored source pixels preserve fine texture through geometric re-projection. The state includes one full source frame and dynamic-region pixels sampled every fourth frame, alongside learned features and sparse occupancy. For a 32-frame MultiCamVideo clip, it averages 0.67M 32-bit-equivalent values on random windows and 0.66M on the first-32 protocol. On first-32, Sparc4D reaches 21.97 dB, compared with 20.40 dB for MoVieS. On randomly placed windows, their PSNR scores are comparable. Without fine-tuning on real data, Sparc4D transfers to DyCheck and Neu3D, where stored texture improves LPIPS while slightly reducing PSNR. Frozen Sparc4D features also support a manipulation policy that reaches 81.3% success on ManiSkill3 StackCube from 1,000 demonstrations.

AI.tldr: Sparc4D：一种前馈自编码器，将已知相机的单目视频编码为紧凑稀疏4D场景表示，用稀疏2D高斯面元解码新视角，兼顾存储效率与渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 紧凑的动态场景表示需同时保留随时间观察到的表面以及从新视角渲染所需的外观。现有方法（如MoVieS）在存储效率与新视角质量之间难以兼顾，因此需要一种既紧凑又高保真的4D表示。
AI.method: 提出Sparc4D前馈自编码器：静态特征在整段视频中共享；空间锚定的时间槽（temporal slots）存储时变特征，其数值量约为逐帧存储的中位数5.0倍更少。稀疏解码器生成2D高斯面元，并通过几何重投影用存储的源像素保留精细纹理。状态包含一个完整源帧、每四帧采样的动态区域像素，以及学习到的特征与稀疏占用。
AI.result: 在32帧MultiCamVideo片段上，随机窗口平均0.67M个32位等效数值，first-32协议为0.66M。first-32上PSNR达21.97 dB，MoVieS为20.40 dB；随机窗口下两者PSNR相当。无需在真实数据上微调即可迁移至DyCheck和Neu3D，存储纹理提升LPIPS但略降低PSNR。冻结的Sparc4D特征支持操作策略，在ManiSkill3 StackCube上以1000个演示达到81.3%成功率。
AI.conclusion: Sparc4D以稀疏4D状态实现了高效的动态场景表示，在存储紧凑性、新视角渲染质量及跨数据集迁移和下游操作任务上均表现优异。

title: Flow Matching Reinforcement for 3D Mesh Generation via Dynamic Homing Optimization
summary: Flow matching is central to 3D generation, yet in practice its reinforcement learning (RL) methods are largely adapted from 2D visual generation. Representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives, when applied to negative trajectories, mainly steer predicted velocities away from the corresponding directions without explicitly specifying a target velocity field toward preferred samples. In 3D generation, constrained by pretrained model capabilities, rollout diversity, and reward-distribution complexity, directly applying these RL methods yields limited gains in geometric quality. We introduce a forward-process RL method \textbf{Dynamic Homing Optimization (DHO)}, which reformulates negative-trajectory optimization as positive-sample attraction-guided dynamic homing. Specifically, Minimum-Cost Attractive Matching (MAM) assigns each negative sample a distinct positive target, and Time-Aware Dynamic Correction (TDC) then redirects its trajectory toward the target using a remaining-time-aware corrective velocity. Building on asynchronous online DHO, we develop \textbf{Flow3D-Pro}, an image-to-3D geometry generation framework. Experiments show that DHO outperforms representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives in 3D generation, while Flow3D-Pro produces higher-quality 3D geometry than existing mesh generation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出前向过程强化学习方法DHO，将负轨迹优化重构为正向样本吸引引导的动态归航，并构建图像到3D几何生成框架Flow3D-Pro。
AI.motivation: 流匹配是3D生成的核心，但现有强化学习方法多从2D视觉生成迁移而来；DPO、GRPO、NFT等目标在负轨迹上仅将预测速度推离相应方向，未明确指向偏好样本的目标速度场。受预训练模型能力、rollout多样性与奖励分布复杂性限制，直接应用这些方法在3D生成中几何质量提升有限。
AI.method: 提出前向过程RL方法DHO，将负轨迹优化重构为正向样本吸引引导的动态归航。其中最小代价吸引匹配（MAM）为每个负样本分配不同的正目标；时间感知动态校正（TDC）利用剩余时间感知的校正速度将轨迹重定向至目标。基于异步在线DHO构建图像到3D几何生成框架Flow3D-Pro。
AI.result: 实验表明，DHO在3D生成中优于代表性的DPO、GRPO与NFT类目标，Flow3D-Pro生成的3D几何质量优于现有网格生成方法。
AI.conclusion: 将负轨迹优化转化为正向样本吸引的动态归航可有效提升3D生成中的强化学习效果，DHO与Flow3D-Pro在几何质量上均取得领先表现。

title: ASCRIBE: Atomic and Significance-Based Reasoning for Thai Clinical SOAP Note Generation
summary: Automatic SOAP note generation can ease the documentation burden on physicians, but existing reasoning methods often omit clinically important information and generate unsupported content. Progress in Thai is further hindered by the lack of publicly available datasets. We propose ASCRIBE, a physician-inspired reasoning framework that ascribes a clinical-significance level to each extracted atomic fact in the conversation before summarization, making a general-purpose LLM a more reliable scribe. We also release ThaiClinicBench, the first de-identified Thai clinical summarization benchmark of real encounters, together with a synthetic training corpus derived from real clinical notes. As a prompt, ASCRIBE outperforms chain-of-thought prompting on GPT-5.4 and Gemini 3.1 Pro across the physician-aligned LLM-judge metrics and improves on standard prompting by up to 10.3 points on the completeness LLM-judge metric. As a GRPO reward, it enables a Gemma-4-E4B model trained solely on synthetic data to match Gemini 3.1 Pro in factual precision and surpass it in completeness. Code and data can be found at https://github.com/loolootech/ascribe.

AI.tldr: 提出 ASCRIBE 推理框架为对话中提取的原子事实赋予临床重要性等级以指导 SOAP 病历生成，并发布首个泰语临床摘要基准 ThaiClinicBench 及合成训练语料，在提示与 GRPO 奖励两种用法下均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 自动生成 SOAP 病历可减轻医生文书负担，但现有推理方法常遗漏临床重要信息并生成缺乏依据的内容；泰语方向还因缺乏公开数据集而进展受限。
AI.method: ASCRIBE 为医生启发的推理框架，先对对话中提取的每个原子事实赋予临床重要性等级，再进行摘要，使通用 LLM 成为更可靠的书记员。同时发布 ThaiClinicBench——首个基于真实问诊的去标识化泰语临床摘要基准，以及由真实临床病历衍生的合成训练语料。
AI.result: 作为提示时，ASCRIBE 在 GPT-5.4 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 上于医生对齐的 LLM 评判指标上优于思维链提示，在完整度指标上较标准提示最高提升 10.3 分；作为 GRPO 奖励时，仅用合成数据训练的 Gemma-4-E4B 在事实精确度上追平 Gemini 3.1 Pro，并在完整度上超过它。
AI.conclusion: ASCRIBE 通过显式建模临床重要性提升了病历生成的可靠性与完整度，配合 ThaiClinicBench 与合成语料填补了泰语临床摘要的资源空白，代码与数据已开源。

title: Harness Annealing: Learning to Act with Less External Control
summary: Language agents rely on external harnesses to track state, organize workflows, and verify answers. Beyond providing tools and information, these harnesses supply control decisions about what to investigate, whether to revise, and when to stop. Training on successful harness-supported trajectories can improve task performance while leaving these decisions dependent on runtime intervention. We ask whether harness-supported experience can also teach the model to make these decisions, allowing the division of control to change as the model learns. We call this objective harness internalization: learning to assume specified control responsibilities while retaining task performance after the corresponding support is withdrawn. We introduce HARNESS ANNEALING TRAINING (HAT), which combines explicit control supervision with a curriculum over teacher trajectories collected under progressively weaker harnesses. Experiments with 9B and 35B models on SWE-QA and SWE-QA-Pro evaluate every checkpoint under four deployment harnesses. Selected annealed checkpoints operating with tools alone achieve scores close to those of their respective starting checkpoints deployed with the full harness. The benefits vary with model scale and deployment configuration, and further annealing does not uniformly improve performance. These findings suggest that harness-supported experience can help reduce the runtime control required by a trained agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"工具框架内化"（harness internalization）目标与HAT训练方法，通过显式控制监督与逐步减弱框架的教师轨迹课程，使模型在学习中承接原本由外部框架承担的控制决策，并在撤除支持后保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体依赖外部工具框架来追踪状态、组织工作流并验证答案，这些框架不仅提供工具与信息，还提供"调查什么、是否修订、何时停止"等控制决策。以往在框架支持的成功轨迹上训练虽能提升任务表现，但控制决策仍依赖运行时干预。因此作者追问：框架支持的经验能否也教会模型自行做出这些决策，从而使控制权的划分随学习而变化。
AI.method: 提出HARNESS ANNEALING TRAINING（HAT），将显式控制监督与"教师轨迹课程"相结合，教师轨迹在逐步减弱的框架（progressively weaker harnesses）下采集。在9B与35B模型上，于SWE-QA与SWE-QA-Pro任务进行实验，并在四种部署框架下评估每一个检查点，以考察撤除框架支持后的表现。
AI.result: 部分退火（annealed）检查点仅使用工具、不带完整框架时，得分接近各自起始检查点在完整框架下部署的得分。收益随模型规模与部署配置而变化，且进一步退火并不能一致地提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 框架支持的经验有助于降低已训练智能体对运行时控制的需求，即控制责任可由外部框架逐步转移至模型自身；但内化效果受模型规模与部署配置影响，并非单调递增。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Japanese LLMs to IME-Related and Typographical Errors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across various natural language processing tasks. However, their robustness to typographical errors remains underexplored, particularly in Japanese, where text input involves multiple writing systems and IME-based conversion. In this study, we evaluate the robustness of Japanese LLMs against realistic Japanese-specific typos. We introduce five typo categories: Character Transposition, Character Replacement, Homophone Conversion, Japanese IME Conversion, and Full-Width Conversion. These perturbations are applied to three Japanese benchmark datasets (JMMLU, JCommonsenseQA, and JamC-QA), and eleven Japanese and multilingual LLMs are evaluated. The results show that Character Transposition and Character Replacement typos consistently reduce accuracy across benchmarks, whereas IME Conversion, Full-Width Conversion, and Homophone Conversion have relatively limited impact. These findings reveal that current Japanese LLMs remain vulnerable to realistic Japanese typing errors, particularly those that substantially distort the original input, highlighting the importance of robustness evaluation in practical input environments.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了日语大语言模型对真实日语输入法相关拼写错误的鲁棒性，提出五类错误并测试了11个模型在3个基准上的表现。
AI.motivation: LLM在NLP任务中表现优异，但其对拼写/输入错误的鲁棒性研究不足，尤其是日语因多书写系统和IME转换的特殊性更缺乏探索。
AI.method: 定义五类日语特定拼写错误：字符换位、字符替换、同音转换、日语IME转换、全角转换；在JMMLU、JCommonsenseQA、JamC-QA三个基准上对11个日语及多语言LLM进行扰动评估。
AI.result: 字符换位和字符替换在各基准上持续降低准确率；而IME转换、全角转换和同音转换影响相对有限。
AI.conclusion: 当前日语LLM对真实日语打字错误仍较脆弱，尤其是显著扭曲原始输入的错误，凸显在实际输入环境中进行鲁棒性评估的重要性。

title: When the Judge Acts: Auditing VLM-Guided Image Selection on Culturally Situated Prompts
comment: 25 pages including appendix. Code and project page: https://github.com/seochan99/JudgeActs ; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/seochan99/JudgeActs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly act as judges that pick the best of several generated images, so their choices decide what users see. Such judges are usually validated by score agreement with human ratings, not by the images they return. We audit VLM judges as decision-makers: on 300 culturally situated prompts, we compare the returned image with human ratings the judge never sees and with random choice from the same candidates, and repeat every decision with the candidates reordered. A 4B-parameter judge barely beats random and falls short of a CLIP similarity baseline. It picks the first image shown in 49% of calls (chance: 28%), and reordering changes its choice on 60% of prompts. For this judge, agreement across orders is informative: decisions that survive reordering are much better than random, whereas agreement with a weaker second judge keeps the wrong ones. An 8B judge shows almost no position bias and outperforms CLIP, yet for it the same filter mostly discards good decisions. Agreement helps only when it targets the judge's failure mode, so filters must be re-audited whenever the judge changes. The 4B judge's slight rise in stereotype ratings is no longer detectable after aggregating across orders or with the larger judge.

AI.tldr: 该论文将视觉语言模型（VLM）作为图像评审者（judge）进行决策层面的审计，而非仅比较评分一致性。在300个文化情境提示上，通过对比返回图像与人类评分、随机选择及CLIP基线，并重复打乱候选顺序，发现4B评审者位置偏置严重（49%选第一张，随机为28%；60%提示因重排改变选择），仅略优于随机；8B评审者几乎无位置偏置且优于CLIP。顺序一致性过滤只在针对该评审者特定失效模式时有效，评审者变化时需重新审计；4B评审者偏见评分的轻微上升在跨顺序聚合或使用更大评审者后不可检测。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM作为图像评审者通常仅通过与人评分的分数一致性来验证，而未审计其作为决策者实际返回的图像。作者希望揭示这种验证盲区，考察VLM评审者的决策质量、位置偏置及其过滤机制的有效性。
AI.method: 在300个文化情境提示上，将VLM评审者返回的图像与人类评分（评审者不可见）及同一候选集中的随机选择进行比较；重复每个决策并在打乱候选顺序的条件下进行；同时引入CLIP相似度基线，并比较4B与8B参数规模评审者、以及跨顺序一致性与与较弱第二评审者一致性两类过滤策略。
AI.result: 4B评审者仅略优于随机且不及CLIP基线；49%的调用选择第一张图像（随机基准28%）；重排使60%提示的选择发生改变。跨顺序一致性过滤能保留显著优于随机的决策，而与较弱第二评审者的一致则保留了错误决策。8B评审者几乎无位置偏置且优于CLIP，但同样的过滤策略对其主要丢弃的是好决策。4B评审者的偏见评分轻微上升在跨顺序聚合或使用更大评审者后不再可检测。
AI.conclusion: 一致性过滤仅在针对评审者具体失效模式时才有帮助，因此每当评审者发生变化，过滤机制必须重新审计。评审者的决策质量不能仅由分数一致性保证，需从返回图像层面进行决策审计。

title: Right Answers, Wrong States: Hidden Information Failures in Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent systems are often judged by whether they reach the correct answer. This can miss a distinct failure: collaboration may leave behind a corrupted information state even when the immediate decision is correct. We call this an off-query failure. To study this failure in collaborative decision support, we introduce OffQuery, which separately evaluates evidence verification (T1), shared-state reconstruction (T2), and task resolution (T3) in two representative high-stakes settings: healthcare and disaster response. Across GPT, Gemini, and Qwen models, standard collaboration shows much stronger task performance than state reliability. Averaged over 21 model--setting combinations, task resolution reaches 64.7%, while evidence verification and state reconstruction reach only 14.3% and 43.1%. We trace this gap to selective information use: current queries often bypass corrupted facts, which become consequential when later tasks require them. We further introduce ReGround, which resolves conflicting evidence, verifies shared facts, reconstructs a trusted state, and reasons over that state. Across seven models from three families, ReGround improves all three capabilities in every evaluated setting, with average relative gains of 309.0%, 82.9%, and 17.6% on T1, T2, and T3. Reliable collaboration therefore requires both a correct decision and a reliable shared state for future reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"离查询失败"（off-query failure）概念：协作系统即使当前决策正确，也可能留下被污染的信息状态；为此构建OffQuery评测框架（分T1证据验证、T2共享状态重建、T3任务解决三个维度），并验证了GPT、Gemini、Qwen等21个模型-场景组合中任务表现远优于状态可靠性，进而提出ReGround方法显著改善三项能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统评测通常只以"是否给出正确答案"为标准，但这一标准会掩盖一类独立失败：协作过程可能在当前决策正确的情况下，仍留下被污染的共享信息状态，等到后续任务需要这些信息时才暴露问题。作者希望揭示并量化这类被忽视的失败。
AI.method: 提出OffQuery评测框架，将协作决策支持拆分为三个独立维度分别评估：T1证据验证、T2共享状态重建、T3任务解决，并在医疗与灾难响应两个高风险场景下对多个模型（GPT、Gemini、Qwen及三大家族共七个模型）进行测试。同时提出ReGround方法，通过解决冲突证据、验证共享事实、重建可信状态并基于该状态推理来提升协作可靠性。
AI.result: 在21个模型-场景组合的平均结果中，任务解决（T3）达64.7%，而证据验证（T1）与状态重建（T2）仅为14.3%和43.1%，显示任务表现远强于状态可靠性。该差距归因于选择性信息使用：当前查询常绕过被污染的事实。ReGround在所有评测场景中同时提升三项能力，T1、T2、T3的平均相对增益分别为309.0%、82.9%、17.6%。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的协作不仅要求当前决策正确，还要求为未来推理保留一个可信的共享状态；仅以最终答案评判多智能体系统会系统性忽视"离查询失败"这一风险。

title: Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graphs for Dynamic Reasoning
summary: Conventional reasoning protocols present a fixed, preselected task, so they cannot test whether an agent propagates relevant updates, preserves unaffected work, or reconstructs a historical task binding. We therefore study \emph{dynamic task routing}, in which an event stream revises task bindings and a system must select the document version valid at each query time before solving it. To study this problem, we repurpose six widely used benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedMCQA, MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval into 31{,}119 dynamic episodes comprising 373{,}428 temporally categorized queries. This setting exposes a central trade-off: recomputing after every event wastes work, whereas unguarded reuse returns stale conclusions. We introduce the Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG), a bounded multi-agent policy that separates deterministic temporal resolution from task reasoning. RIAG caches solutions by immutable document identity, starts each fresh task with two unexposed attempts, and conditionally invokes audit and repair, using at most four calls per document version. On this collection, homogeneous RIAG achieves 54.24\% joint routing-and-answer accuracy at 0.62 calls/query, compared with 32.22\% at 18.00 calls/query for the strongest comparison method; heterogeneous RIAG reaches 49.78\% at 0.63 calls/query.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"动态任务路由"：事件流不断修订任务绑定，系统须在每个查询时刻选出有效文档版本再求解。作者将MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MedMCQA、MATH、GPQA、HumanEval六个基准重构为31,119个动态episode、373,428条带时间标签的查询，并提出Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph（RIAG），通过按不可变文档身份缓存、两次无暴露尝试、条件触发审计与修复，每版最多四次调用，在联合路由与答题准确率上大幅优于基线且调用成本极低。
AI.motivation: 传统推理协议给出预先固定的任务，无法检验智能体能否传播相关更新、保留未受影响的既有工作，或重建历史任务绑定。为填补这一评测空白，作者提出动态任务路由问题：事件流修订任务绑定后，系统必须检索每个查询时刻有效的文档版本，再据此作答。
AI.method: 将六个主流基准（MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MedMCQA、MATH、GPQA、HumanEval）改造为31,119个动态episode、共373,428条按时间分类的查询。提出RIAG（Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph），一种有界多智能体策略，把确定性的时间解析与任务推理分离；按不可变文档身份缓存解答，每个新任务先进行两次无暴露尝试，并条件性地调用审计与修复，每个文档版本至多四次调用。
AI.result: 同构RIAG取得54.24%的联合路由与答题准确率，仅需0.62次调用/查询；最强对比方法为32.22%准确率、18.00次调用/查询。异构RIAG达到49.78%准确率、0.63次调用/查询。
AI.conclusion: 该设置揭示核心权衡：每个事件后重算会浪费计算，而无保护地复用会返回过时结论。RIAG以"时间解析与推理解耦 + 身份缓存 + 有界条件审计修复"的方案在准确率与调用成本上同时显著优于基线，说明有界多智能体策略可有效应对动态任务路由。

title: Fine-Grained Emotion Classification from Mobile App Reviews: An Empirical Study with Large Language Models
summary: Context: Fine-grained emotion classification of mobile app reviews enables requirements engineering activities that go beyond polarity-based opinion mining, including emotionally informed issue prioritisation and feature-oriented feedback analysis. However, automatic fine-grained emotion extraction from app reviews remains understudied. Objectives: Building on a previously published annotation framework and human-labelled ground truth adapted from Plutchik's taxonomy, this paper investigates how large language models can be leveraged for automatic multi-label emotion classification under severe class imbalance. Methods: We compare encoder-only fine-tuning under multi-label and binary-ensemble formulations, decoder-only zero- and few-shot prompting across open-source and proprietary models, and a catalogue of imbalance mitigation strategies (loss reweighting, resampling, generative data augmentation), with the synthetic-review generator and prompting strategy selected via an intrinsic augmentation-utility ranking. Results: Fine-tuned encoders trail the best decoder-only few-shot prompting (macro-F1 0.642) by a wide margin at baseline (multi-label: 0.387; binary ensemble: 0.450); pairing the best multi-label encoder with generative data augmentation and positive-weighted loss closes most of this gap (+0.204) at up to three orders of magnitude lower inference latency than the decoders, with the largest gains on the rarest emotions, from undetected to gains of up to +0.501 F1. Conclusion: Large language models make fine-grained, multi-label emotion classification of app reviews feasible for requirements engineering pipelines, with modest macro-F1, and the best formulation and mitigation strategy are backbone- and formulation-dependent. We release the experimental pipeline, synthetic corpora, and fine-tuned checkpoints for replication and reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文研究移动应用评论的细粒度多标签情感分类，在严重类别不平衡下比较编码器微调、解码器提示与多种不平衡缓解策略，发现微调编码器结合生成式数据增强与正类加权损失可大幅缩小与最优提示方法的差距，且推理延迟低数个数量级。
AI.motivation: 移动应用评论的细粒度情感分类可支持情感驱动的需求工程活动（如问题优先级排序、面向功能的反馈分析），超越传统的极性情感挖掘；但面向应用评论的自动细粒度情感抽取仍缺乏研究，且面临严重类别不平衡问题。
AI.method: 基于已发布的人工标注框架与依据Plutchik分类法构建的标注真值，系统比较三类方法：1) 仅编码器模型在多标签与二分类集成两种设定下的微调；2) 仅解码器模型（开源与专有）的零样本与少样本提示；3) 一系列不平衡缓解策略（损失重加权、重采样、生成式数据增强），其中合成评论生成器与提示策略通过内禀增强效用排序进行选择。
AI.result: 基线情形下微调编码器大幅落后于最佳少样本提示方法（macro-F1 0.642；多标签0.387，二分类集成0.450）。将最佳多标签编码器与生成式数据增强及正类加权损失结合后，差距缩小约+0.204，而推理延迟最多低三个数量级；收益主要集中在最稀有的情感类别，从完全无法检出提升至最高+0.501 F1。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型使应用评论的细粒度多标签情感分类在需求工程流程中具备可行性，但macro-F1水平中等；最佳模型形式与缓解策略依赖骨干模型与任务设定。作者公开了实验流程、合成语料与微调检查点以供复现与复用。

title: Science Utopia? Closed-Loop LLM Simulation of Academic Research Ecosystems
summary: Scientific progress emerges from a longitudinal ecosystem in which researchers, institutions, funding agencies, collaboration networks, and the scientific literature co-evolve. As AI becomes increasingly involved throughout the scientific research cycle, understanding these interconnected and evolving processes becomes increasingly important. We introduce SciUtopia, a persistent, closed-loop LLM-agent simulation framework for studying academic research ecosystems. SciUtopia models interconnected scientific processes such as research-direction choice, collaboration, submission, peer review, resubmission, citation, funding, and researcher attrition, while maintaining evolving states across simulated years. Its configurable institutional mechanisms and information channels provide a controlled testbed for matched counterfactual experiments and targeted interventions. Across 61 simulation worlds, SciUtopia simulates over 40,000 researchers from 8,000 institutions, producing around 400,000 publication decisions and 1.2 million LLM-generated peer reviews. Using these longitudinal simulations, we find that rejection-driven resubmission substantially amplifies reviewer burden beyond population growth alone, cautious exploration balances citation impact with career success and long-term topic diversity, and resource inequality can emerge even without detectable cumulative advantage from narrowly winning early funding. Code is available at https://github.com/Ahren09/ScienceUtopia.

AI.tldr: SciUtopia 是一个持久化闭环 LLM-agent 仿真框架，用于研究学术科研生态系统，在 61 个仿真世界中模拟超 4 万名研究者、约 40 万次发表决策与 120 万条 LLM 生成的同行评审，揭示了重新投稿对审稿负担的放大效应、谨慎探索的多目标权衡，以及资源不平等的自发涌现。
AI.motivation: 科学进步源于研究者、机构、资助方、合作网络与科学文献共同演化的纵向生态系统。随着 AI 日益深入科研全流程，理解这些相互关联且动态演化的问题变得愈发重要，但现有研究缺乏能够持续追踪并可控干预该生态系统的仿真平台。
AI.method: 提出 SciUtopia，一个持久化闭环 LLM-agent 仿真框架，建模方向选择、合作、投稿、同行评审、重新投稿、引用、资助与研究者流失等互联科研流程，并跨仿真年份维护演化状态；其可配置的机构机制与信息通道支持匹配的反事实实验与定向干预。基于 61 个仿真世界开展纵向实验。
AI.result: 模拟了来自 8000 个机构的超 4 万名研究者，产生约 40 万次发表决策与 120 万条 LLM 生成的同行评审。发现：拒稿驱动的重新投稿会显著放大审稿人负担，其影响超出单纯人口增长；谨慎探索能在引用影响力、职业成功与长期主题多样性之间取得平衡；即使早期资助以微弱优势胜出且未检测到累积优势，资源不平等仍可能自发涌现。
AI.conclusion: SciUtopia 为科研生态系统的纵向、可控、反事实研究提供了可复用的仿真基础设施，表明审稿负担、探索策略权衡与资源不平等是该生态系统中可由机制而非仅个体行为解释的涌现现象。代码开源于 https://github.com/Ahren09/ScienceUtopia。

title: Know When to Hold 'em: Correct-Token Retention in Uniform-State Diffusion Language Models
summary: Uniform-state diffusion models (USDMs) can revise any token at any denoising step, which lets them correct their own mistakes, a key advantage over masked diffusion. Self-correction, however, requires both revising incorrect tokens and retaining correct ones, and we show that current USDMs lack the latter. Even under greedy-tail decoding, state-of-the-art USDMs (DUO, UDLM, and uniform-noise SEDD) keep revising 173--270 of 512 positions at every step, and these large, uncoordinated edits collapse sample diversity. A random-token corruption experiment traces this deficit to the models themselves: they reconstruct clean and corrupted tokens with nearly identical accuracy, even though clean tokens are easier targets. A decomposition of the validation NELBO shows that training barely rewards retention: incorrect predictions are heavily penalized at corrupted positions but almost free at clean ones. We propose Correct-Token Retention Regularization (CTR-Reg), a simple but effective auxiliary loss that trains the model to retain tokens left unperturbed by the forward process and requires no change to the sampler. CTR-Reg improves clean-token accuracy by 26.5 percentage points on average across six benchmarks, while leaving corrupted-token accuracy virtually unchanged, and its per-step revisions converge to only 3--11 positions. With just five greedy-tail steps, generative perplexity more than halves under CTR-Reg for all three models while diversity is preserved, and these gains hold across sampling budgets. Our results identify correct-token retention as a key missing ingredient for self-correcting diffusion language models, and demonstrate an effective fix.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前均匀状态扩散模型（USDMs）在自纠正时缺乏"保留正确token"能力，并提出CTR-Reg辅助损失加以修复。
AI.motivation: USDMs可在任意去噪步修正任意token，理论上优于掩码扩散，但自纠正需同时"修正错误"和"保留正确"。作者发现现有USDMs缺失后者：即便贪心尾部解码，DUO、UDLM、uniform-noise SEDD每步仍修改512个位置中的173-270个，这种大规模无协调编辑会破坏样本多样性。
AI.method: 通过随机token破坏实验定位问题根源——模型对干净token与被破坏token的重建准确率几乎相同，说明模型本身未学会保留。对验证NELBO的分解表明训练几乎不奖励保留：错误预测在被破坏位置受重罚，但在干净位置几乎无代价。据此提出Correct-Token Retention Regularization（CTR-Reg），一种简单的辅助损失，训练模型保留前向过程未扰动的token，且无需改动采样器。
AI.result: CTR-Reg在六个基准上平均将干净token准确率提升26.5个百分点，而破坏token准确率几乎不变，每步修改位置收敛至仅3-11个。仅用五个贪心尾部步，三个模型的生成困惑度均减半以上，同时保持多样性，且在各采样预算下均成立。
AI.conclusion: 正确token保留是自纠正扩散语言模型缺失的关键要素，CTR-Reg提供了有效修复方案。

title: SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI--AD continuum. Retrospective training records provide sampled Bellman targets for an energy-based teacher, whose action distributions are distilled into a Qwen policy. At deployment, the agent selects acquisition or diagnosis actions under availability and budget constraints without access to unacquired values. After each acquisition, the evidence and ordinal belief are updated before the next decision. On ADNI, SCOPE-AD achieves 77.70\% Macro-F1 at an average acquisition cost of \$50.46, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.34 percentage points. Full-modality evaluation raises Macro-F1 by only 1.89 points while increasing acquisition cost by 116.7 times. These results support selective acquisition for cost-effective diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出SCOPE-AD，一个成本感知的序数信念规划诊断智能体，通过序数建模与能量模型蒸馏策略，在ADNI上以平均50.46美元成本实现77.70% Maco-F1。
AI.motivation: AD诊断需在异构检查成本与患者负担下序贯获取证据，固定模态预测器无法联合决定"下一步做哪项检查"以及"现有证据是否足以诊断"。
AI.method: 采用mask-aware序数模型刻画CN–MCI–AD有序连续体上的不确定性；用回顾性训练记录采样Bellman目标训练能量模型教师，将其动作分布蒸馏进Qwen策略；部署时在可用性与预算约束下选择采集或诊断动作，每次采集后更新证据与序数信念。
AI.result: 在ADNI上达77.70% Macro-F1，平均采集成本50.46美元，较最强基线高9.34个百分点；使用全模态仅提升1.89个百分点Macro-F1，却使成本增加116.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 选择性采集可实现成本有效的AD诊断，避免为微小精度增益付出高昂检查成本。

title: PickMoment: Continuous-Time Single-Image-to-Video via Learning Deblurring and Blur-to-Video
summary: Motion blur arises from the temporal integration of a continuous sharp signal over a finite exposure window, yet existing learning-based methods sidestep this physical model and predict only the sharp signal itself: most single-image deblurring methods recover a single frame at the exposure center, while blur-to-video methods predict a fixed set of frames. We introduce PickMoment, a continuous-time reformulation that directly learns the interval-mean blur over arbitrary sub-intervals of the exposure with a single deterministic model. Drawing an analogy to MeanFlow's average-velocity formulation, we train the model with three supervisions derived from the blur integral: an empirical reconstruction loss from available subframes, an additivity loss that enforces self-consistency across overlapping sub-intervals, and a sharp-frame loss anchored at the zero-interval limit. A single trained model unifies single-image deblurring, blur-to-video generation, and continuous-time pick-a-moment recovery as different queries to the same network, with no separate training for each task. Our PickMoment achieves state-of-the-art performance among generative-based deblurring methods on GoPro and HIDE while competitive against restoration-based methods on RealBlur, and the highest per-frame fidelity on GoPro-7 blur-to-video, all in a single forward pass without iterative sampling.

AI.tldr: PickMoment将单图去模糊重新表述为对曝光区间任意子区间均值模糊的连续时间学习，用单一确定性模型统一了单图去模糊、模糊转视频和连续时间任意时刻恢复三类任务。
AI.motivation: 运动模糊本质是连续清晰信号在有限曝光窗口内的时间积分，但现有学习方法回避该物理模型，只预测清晰信号本身：单图去模糊多只恢复曝光中心处的单帧，模糊转视频则预测固定的若干帧，无法在任意时刻查询。
AI.method: 类比MeanFlow的平均速度表述，直接学习任意子区间上的区间均值模糊；训练使用三种源自模糊积分的监督：基于可得子帧的经验重建损失、约束重叠子区间自一致性的可加性损失，以及锚定零区间极限的清晰帧损失。单一模型把三类任务视为对同一网络的不同查询，无需分别训练。
AI.result: 在GoPro与HIDE上取得生成式去模糊方法中的SOTA，在RealBlur上与复原类方法相比具竞争力；在GoPro-7模糊转视频上取得最高逐帧保真度；全部在单次前向传播中完成，无需迭代采样。
AI.conclusion: 以连续时间区间均值建模运动模糊，可在单一确定性模型、单次前向推理下统一单图去模糊、模糊转视频与任意时刻恢复，验证了将物理成像模型直接嵌入学习框架的有效性。

title: ShelfChange3D: Object-Level 3D Change Detection for Retail Shelf Monitoring
comment: Our code will be available on our project website at https://zerone0011.github.io/ShelfChange3D/
summary: Reliable shelf monitoring is an important capability for retail automation, yet existing out-of-stock detection methods mainly operate in image space and lack metric 3D localization for downstream robotic systems. We formulate shelf monitoring as object-level 3D change detection: given two RGB-D observations captured at different times, the goal is to identify changed products and localize each change with a 3D bounding box. To support this task, we introduce ShelfChange3D, comprising 145K synthetic and 5K real-world paired RGB-D observations with object-level 3D change annotations. We further propose ChangeBox, an end-to-end framework that jointly reasons over paired observations and predicts object-level 3D change boxes. To improve localization accuracy, we introduce a geometry-based refinement stage that exploits depth and gravity prior to estimate relative pose and refine predicted boxes. Experiments show that ChangeBox outperforms existing change detection baselines, with further gains from refinement and effective transfer from synthetic to real-world observations.

AI.tldr: 该论文将货架监测问题建模为物体级3D变化检测，提出ShelfChange3D数据集与ChangeBox端到端框架，实现变化产品的3D框定位，并在合成与真实数据上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有缺货检测方法主要在图像空间进行，缺乏面向下游机器人系统的度量级3D定位能力，难以支撑零售自动化的实际部署。
AI.method: 将货架监测形式化为物体级3D变化检测任务：输入不同时刻的两组RGB-D观测，输出变化产品的3D边界框。构建ShelfChange3D数据集（145K合成+5K真实配对RGB-D观测，含物体级3D变化标注）；提出ChangeBox端到端框架，联合推理配对观测并预测物体级3D变化框；引入基于几何的精化阶段，利用深度与重力先验估计相对位姿并精化预测框。
AI.result: ChangeBox优于现有变化检测基线；几何精化带来进一步提升；合成到真实观测的迁移有效。
AI.conclusion: 物体级3D变化检测为货架监测提供了具备度量定位能力的新范式，数据集与框架为零售自动化中的机器人下游应用奠定基础。

title: Dyna3: VLM-Guided Training-Free 4D Reconstruction via Depth Foundation Models
summary: Recent depth foundation models like Depth Anything 3 (DA3) achieve remarkable multi-view depth estimation but assume static 3D scenes, limiting their applicability to real-world dynamic environments. Existing training-free 4D methods like Easi3R and VGGT4D rely on correspondence-trained backbones whose attention encodes cross-frame matching, a property absent in depth-only models like DA3. We present Dyna3, a training-free framework that extends DA3 for 4D dynamic scene reconstruction without any fine-tuning. Our key insight is that DA3's cross-view features, though trained only for depth consistency, implicitly encode motion-discriminative signals when combined with best-match feature search across frames. Its static surfaces find consistent matches globally, while dynamic objects cannot. We further adopt vision-language models (VLM) to automatically generate scene-specific semantic prompts for SAM 3, enabling precise instance-level segmentation that distinguishes which objects move from what objects exist. For reconstruction, we decouple the scene into a cross-frame aligned static background and per-frame dynamic point clouds. Experiments on four datasets demonstrate that Dyna3 surpasses correspondence-trained methods with +5.5pp J-Mean over state-of-the-art VGGT4D on dynamic object segmentation, while achieving up to 13x faster pose estimation and 3x faster 4D reconstruction with 4 to 8x lower memory. Dyna3 could therefore enable much denser temporal sampling that prior methods cannot support.

AI.tldr: Dyna3：无需训练的框架，将深度基础模型DA3扩展至4D动态场景重建。
AI.motivation: 深度基础模型（如DA3）虽在多视图深度估计上表现优异，但假设场景为静态，难以适用于真实动态环境；而现有免训练4D方法（Easi3R、VGGT4D）依赖经对应关系训练的主干网络（其注意力编码跨帧匹配），这一特性在纯深度模型DA3中并不存在。
AI.method: 核心洞察：DA3的跨视图特征虽仅针对深度一致性训练，但与跨帧最佳匹配特征搜索结合时，隐式编码了运动判别信号——静态表面能在全局找到一致匹配，动态物体则不能。方法采用VLM自动生成场景特定语义提示以驱动SAM 3进行实例级分割，区分"哪些物体在运动"与"存在哪些物体"。重建时将场景解耦为跨帧对齐的静态背景与逐帧动态点云。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，动态物体分割较SOTA VGGT4D提升+5.5pp J-Mean，位姿估计最多快13倍，4D重建快3倍且内存低4–8倍。
AI.conclusion: Dyna3可支持此前方法无法实现的更密集时间采样。

title: ODDR: One-Step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward Guidance
summary: Recent advances in deep learning for shadow removal have significantly enhanced image quality and realism. However, most approaches rely on real-world paired datasets, which are costly to collect and often limited in scene diversity, leading to limited generalization. To address these limitations, we propose One-step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward guidance (ODDR), a new framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity shadow removal without relying on real-world paired supervision. Our method begins with One-step Deshadow Diffusion (ODD), a baseline model trained on synthetic shadow data for efficient one-step shadow-free reconstruction. We further adapt ODD into ODDR using ShadowReward. In contrast to traditional, annotation-heavy approaches, ShadowReward is the first reward model for shadow removal trained entirely without human annotation. It learns to mimic human perceptual judgments by ranking synthetically generated images with controlled degradations, such as texture distortion and boundary artifacts. This reward-guided fine-tuning enables ODDR to close the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Extensive experiments show that ODD achieves strong performance without relying on real-world paired supervision, and ODDR further improves the results, narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods trained on real-world paired data while maintaining higher computational efficiency as a single-step model.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ODDR框架，利用单步扩散模型（ODD）与无需人工标注的奖励模型（ShadowReward），在不依赖真实配对监督的情况下实现高效、高质量去阴影，并缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有去阴影方法大多依赖真实世界配对数据集，采集成本高、场景多样性有限，导致泛化能力受限。因此作者希望摆脱真实配对监督，同时保持高效与高保真度。
AI.method: 方法分为两部分：1）ODD，一个在合成阴影数据上训练的单步去阴影扩散基线模型，实现高效的一步无阴影重建；2）ODDR，在ODD基础上引入ShadowReward进行奖励引导微调。ShadowReward是首个完全无需人工标注的去阴影奖励模型，通过学习对带受控退化（如纹理失真、边界伪影）的合成生成图像进行排序，来模仿人类感知判断。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ODD在不依赖真实配对监督下取得强性能；ODDR进一步提升效果，缩小了与使用真实配对数据的全监督方法的差距，同时作为单步模型保持更高的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过单步扩散结合无标注奖励引导，为去阴影任务提供了一条不依赖真实配对监督的高效路径，并展现出接近全监督方法的潜力。

title: STAGE: Subspace-Targeted Affine Generative Erasure for Text-to-3D Models
summary: Concept erasure suppresses a target concept while preserving behavior on unrelated inputs. Existing closed-form methods were designed for 2D image diffusion and assume a single generative pathway, so one edit must cover geometry and texture at once. Native 3D generators, which synthesize structured 3D representations directly rather than by lifting 2D samples, violate this assumption. We show that shape and object concepts must be erased in the structural stage of the pipeline and material concepts in the appearance stage. We therefore formulate erasure in native text-to-3D as a stage-aware editing problem and introduce STAGE, a training-free, closed-form framework. STAGE confines each edit to the low-dimensional subspace spanned by the differences between erase and anchor embeddings, and relaxes the norm-preserving (orthogonal) constraint of prior editors into a least-squares affine correction that maps target activations onto safe anchors subject to a penalty on the displacement of retained prompts. The correction applies to the structural stage, the appearance stage, or both. We find that the stage an edit must reach is determined by concept type. On TRELLIS, the standard open native 3D generator, across 15 shape, material, and object concepts, STAGE reaches 66.7 on a composite score that balances forgetting the target concept against preserving everything else, aggregating CLIP-based semantic and physical metrics, versus 53.2 for the strongest adapted baseline. Code: https://github.com/gmum/STAGE/ Project Page https://gmum.github.io/STAGE/

AI.tldr: 本文将原生文本到3D生成中的概念擦除建模为阶段感知编辑问题，提出免训练闭式框架STAGE，在结构阶段与外观阶段分别擦除形状/物体概念与材质概念，在TRELLIS上取得66.7综合分，优于最强适配基线的53.2。
AI.motivation: 现有闭式概念擦除方法面向2D图像扩散模型，假设存在单一生成路径，因此一次编辑需同时覆盖几何与纹理。原生3D生成器直接合成结构化3D表示而非提升2D样本，违背该假设，导致既有方法不适用。
AI.method: 作者将原生文本到3D中的擦除形式化为阶段感知编辑问题，提出免训练、闭式的STAGE框架。该方法将每次编辑限制在由擦除嵌入与锚嵌入之差张成的低维子空间中，并把先前编辑器的保范（正交）约束松弛为最小二乘仿射校正，在保留提示位移惩罚下把目标激活映射到安全锚点；校正可施加于结构阶段、外观阶段或两者。
AI.result: 在标准开源原生3D生成器TRELLIS上，针对15个形状、材质与物体概念，STAGE在综合遗忘目标概念与保留其余内容的复合得分（聚合基于CLIP的语义与物理指标）上达到66.7，而最强适配基线为53.2。
AI.conclusion: 编辑所需触及的阶段由概念类型决定：形状与物体概念须在结构阶段擦除，材质概念须在外观阶段擦除。阶段感知的闭式编辑为原生3D生成提供了有效且免训练的概念擦除方案。

title: DAYJOB: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Professional Work
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. An earlier version was accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET) at NeurIPS 2026. Evaluation harness: https://github.com/surge-ai/dayjob
summary: Professional work often starts with a brief request that leaves the professional to work out what is needed, which documents matter, and whether the request's premise holds. We introduce DAYJOB, a benchmark of 130 tasks built by professionals in healthcare (50) and finance (80). The tasks are estimated to take a professional 13.6 hours on average in healthcare and 16.6 in finance. Each task is a containerized Harbor environment with an expert rubric of binary criteria (median 47.5 and 57.5 per task) that an agentic judge applies to the delivered files, and an attempt passes only if it meets every criterion. Across 30 model configurations from 13 developers, the strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, passes 24.7% of healthcare and 23.9% of finance attempts, and the median configuration passes 0.6% and 2.5%. In case studies, agents accept premises that the record contradicts and carry wrong inputs through otherwise consistent analyses. We release all healthcare tasks, 50 of the 80 finance tasks, the evaluation harness, and the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 DAYJOB 基准，包含医疗（50）与金融（80）专业任务，用于评估智能体在真实职业工作流中的表现，最强模型通过率不足 25%，且存在接受错误前提等问题。
AI.motivation: 现实中的专业工作常始于一段简短的请求，需要从业者自行判断真正需求、关键文档以及请求前提是否成立。现有基准难以反映这种开放式、前提可能错误的真实工作场景，因此需要构建由专业人士设计的端到端任务基准来检验智能体能力。
AI.method: 构建 DAYJOB 基准，含 130 个任务（医疗 50、金融 80），由专业人士设计，平均预期耗时医疗 13.6 小时、金融 16.6 小时。每个任务为容器化 Harbor 环境，配套专家提供的二值标准评分表（中位数每任务医疗 47.5 条、金融 57.5 条），由智能体裁判对交付文件逐条判定，须满足全部标准才算通过。共评估来自 13 个开发方的 30 种模型配置。
AI.result: 最强配置 Claude Opus 5.5 在医疗任务通过率 24.7%、金融 23.9%；中位配置仅 0.6% 与 2.5%。案例研究显示，智能体会接受与记录相矛盾的前提，并在其余分析保持一致的情况下沿用错误输入。
AI.conclusion: DAYJOB 揭示了当前智能体在长时程、多文档、前提易错的专业任务上与人类专业人士的巨大差距，尤其暴露出前提检验与输入校验方面的缺陷。作者公开全部医疗任务、80 个金融任务中的 50 个、评测框架与排行榜，以推动后续研究。

title: ARROW: Arbitrary Reconstruction and Tracking of 4D Observations in the Wild
summary: Dynamic scenes may be captured by a moving camera, multiple video streams, or images taken at different times. These observations reveal complementary aspects of scene geometry and motion, yet bringing them together requires establishing correspondence across viewpoints, capture times, and visibility changes. We introduce ARROW, a feed-forward model that unifies 3D reconstruction and 3D point tracking from arbitrary image sets. At its core is a novel order-invariant querying approach, which allows the association of queries with observations across arbitrary inputs. We show that exposing the model to more diverse sets of inputs during training results in improved task performance. Moreover, the resulting model is capable of generalization to a wider range of tasks including multi-view tracking. Trained with this strategy, ARROW establishes a new state of the art in 3D tracking on WorldTrack and TAPVid-3D and outperforms dedicated multi-view trackers on an adapted RGB-only MVTracker benchmark, while remaining competitive across 3D reconstruction tasks. Code and weights are publicly available.

AI.tldr: ARROW 是一个前馈模型，用顺序无关的查询机制统一了任意图像集合上的三维重建与三维点追踪，并在多项基准上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 动态场景常由运动相机、多路视频或不同时刻拍摄的图像捕获，这些观测分别揭示场景几何与运动的互补信息。但将它们整合需要跨视角、跨拍摄时刻以及可见性变化建立对应关系，现有方法难以统一处理。
AI.method: 提出 ARROW 前馈模型，核心是一种顺序无关的查询方法，可在任意输入间将查询与观测进行关联；训练时向模型暴露更多样化的输入集合，以提升任务表现与泛化能力。
AI.result: 在 WorldTrack 和 TAPVid-3D 上刷新三维追踪的最优结果，在适配的仅 RGB 的 MVTracker 基准上超越专用多视角追踪器，同时在三维重建任务上保持竞争力。代码与权重已公开。
AI.conclusion: 顺序无关查询加多样化输入训练的策略，可有效统一三维重建与三维点追踪，并泛化到包括多视角追踪在内的更广泛任务。

title: What Wins a Vote? Formatting, Length, and Lexical Diversity in the French Compar:IA LLM Arena
summary: LLM arenas turn pairwise human preferences into model rankings. Those preferences may reflect how an answer is presented as well as what it says. We take a stylometric approach to 137,293 decisive French-language votes from the July 2026 Compar:IA release; the primary formatting analysis includes 137,113 battles across 116 models, and the joint estimates use the 127,092 battles with all required measurements. For each battle, we reconstruct the response visible when the user voted. We then compare the raw ranking with rankings adjusted for formatting, length, readability, vocabulary variety, and sentence structure. Presentation is associated with winning, but length, bold text, and lists tend to occur together, making their individual contributions hard to separate. Across the measured features, two associations change least across specifications: bold usage (+11.0% win odds per standard deviation in the joint model) and moving-average type-token ratio (MATTR), a measure of vocabulary variety that is less sensitive to answer length (+16.8%). The bold association is substantially smaller in observed multi-turn conversations, whereas the MATTR association changes little; because users choose whether to continue, this difference is descriptive rather than causal. The full adjustment moves 36 of 116 models by at least ten ranks. Yet comparisons with external benchmarks do not show that adjusted rankings better measure capability. We therefore recommend publishing raw and adjusted rankings side by side as a transparent sensitivity analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文用文体计量学方法分析137,293条法语Compar:IA投票，发现加粗、词汇多样性等呈现特征与获胜显著相关，全面调整格式后可大幅改变模型排名，但调整后排名并未更好地反映能力，建议同时发布原始与调整排名。
AI.motivation: LLM竞技场将成对人类偏好转化为模型排名，但偏好可能反映答案的呈现方式而非内容本身，因此需要评估格式、长度、可读性等呈现因素对排名的影响及其是否应被校正。
AI.method: 采用文体计量学（stylometric）方法，分析2026年7月Compar:IA发布的137,293条决定性法语投票；格式分析主样本含116个模型的137,113场对战，联合估计使用具备全部测量值的127,092场对战。重建用户投票时可见的回答，比较原始排名与对格式、长度、可读性、词汇多样性和句法结构调整后的排名。
AI.result: 呈现特征与获胜相关，但长度、加粗与列表常共现，难以分离各自贡献。跨设定最稳健的两个关联是加粗（联合模型中每标准差+11.0%获胜几率）和移动平均类符形符比MATTR（+16.8%）。加粗关联在多轮对话中明显减弱，MATTR关联变化很小；由于用户自行决定是否继续，该差异仅为描述性而非因果。全面调整使116个模型中的36个排名变动至少10位。与外部基准比较未显示调整后排名能更好地衡量能力。
AI.conclusion: 建议将原始排名与调整后排名并列发布，作为一种透明的敏感性分析，而非用单一调整后排名替代原始排名。

title: Evaluating Biomedical Reranking for LLM-Based Question Answering over Longitudinal Clinical Notes
summary: Patient-specific clinical question answering requires locating the right evidence within long, heterogeneous longitudinal clinical records in which relevant facts may be scattered across encounters, repeated in copied-forward notes, or expressed using different clinical terminology. We evaluated whether biomedical reranking can improve evidence selection and downstream answer quality in a locally deployed retrieval-augmented generation pipeline for longitudinal clinical notes. The pipeline combines PubMedBERT dense retrieval, BM25 lexical retrieval, weighted reciprocal-rank fusion, and MedCPT cross-encoder reranking. Across 1,000 open- and closed-ended question-answer pairs from a cohort of 200 bariatric surgery patients, reranking increased exact source-chunk retrieval within the top 10 items, Hit@10 from 46.6% to 60.6% and mean reciprocal rank from 0.2371 to 0.3252. With Qwen3-8B generation, local judge-assessed answer correctness increased from 44.8% to 48.6%. These results show that biomedical reranking can improve the placement of relevant clinical evidence within a limited context window, although gains in retrieval do not translate proportionally into gains in answer correctness.

AI.tldr: 在纵向临床病历的RAG管线中，生物医学重排序（MedCPT交叉编码器）显著提升证据检索命中率，但下游答案正确率提升有限。
AI.motivation: 患者特异性临床问答需要在长且异构的纵向病历中定位证据，而相关事实可能分散于多次就诊、被复制粘贴重复，或以不同临床术语表述，导致证据选择困难。
AI.method: 构建本地部署的检索增强生成管线：PubMedBERT稠密检索 + BM25词法检索 + 加权倒数排名融合 + MedCPT交叉编码器重排序；在200名减重手术患者、1000个开放式与封闭式问答对上进行评估，生成模型为Qwen3-8B，采用本地评判器评估答案正确性。
AI.result: 重排序使前10项内精确源片段检索的Hit@10从46.6%提升至60.6%，平均倒数排名（MRR）从0.2371提升至0.3252；问答正确率从44.8%提升至48.6%。
AI.conclusion: 生物医学重排序能改善有限上下文窗口内相关临床证据的排序位置，但检索性能的提升并未按比例转化为答案正确率的提升。

title: CLASP: Continual Low-rank Adapters for Spatially Placed Concepts from One Hypernetwork
comment: 31 pages. Code: https://github.com/genwro-ai/clasp, project page: https://genwro-ai.github.io/clasp
summary: Continual personalization of text-to-image diffusion models requires sequentially acquiring new concepts while retaining previously learned ones. However, existing methods either suffer from catastrophic forgetting or rely on storing additional concept-specific parameters and spatial components, causing their parameter footprint to grow with the concept stream. This limits their ability to scale to long sequences of personalization tasks. We propose a rehearsal-free approach that uses a single fixed-size hypernetwork to continually personalize a frozen diffusion model. Instead of expanding the model as new concepts are acquired, the hypernetwork dynamically produces the concept-specific adaptations required for personalization while preserving previously learned concepts. Our framework further integrates spatial control into the personalization process, allowing users to specify where a personalized concept should appear without introducing additional per-concept components. This formulation enables continual personalization with a parameter footprint that remains independent of the number of learned concepts, aside from compact concept representations. Experiments demonstrate strong retention of previously learned concepts and reliable spatial grounding, matching or improving upon existing methods while scaling effectively to long streams of personalization tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免回放、无需扩展参数的持续个性化方法，用单个固定尺寸超网络为冻结扩散模型动态生成概念特定适配，并集成空间控制，参数量不随概念数增长。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型的持续个性化需顺序学习新概念并保留旧概念，但现有方法要么遭受灾难性遗忘，要么依赖存储额外的概念特定参数与空间组件，导致参数足迹随概念流增长，难以扩展到长序列个性化任务。
AI.method: 免回放框架：使用单个固定尺寸超网络对冻结的扩散模型进行持续个性化。超网络动态产生个性化所需的概念特定适配，而非随新概念扩展模型；同时将空间控制整合进个性化过程，使用户可指定个性化概念出现的位置，且不引入额外的每概念组件。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法对先前学习的概念具有很强的保留能力，空间定位可靠，在性能上匹配或优于现有方法，并能有效扩展到长序列的个性化任务。
AI.conclusion: 该公式化方法实现了参数足迹与已学概念数量无关的持续个性化（除紧凑的概念表示外），在保持旧概念、空间可控和长序列可扩展性方面具有优势。

title: ARCCS: An Automated Regulatory Compliance Checking System
