comment: This is the extended version of a paper accepted to EMNLP 2026 (System Demonstrations)
summary: Regulatory compliance checking - deciding whether a target document satisfies the obligations of a regulation - requires interpreting dense legal text, identifying which provisions apply, and grounding each decision in explicit evidence. We present ARCCS, an end-to-end, automated, agentic, and regulation-agnostic Legal NLP system for compliance checking. ARCCS decomposes raw regulatory text into atomic, traceable requirements and evaluates a target document against them using retrieved evidence, confidence scores, and human-interpretable justifications. This design decouples compliance assessment from any fixed regulatory template or predefined rule set, enabling the pipeline to operate over regulations of varying size and structure. We evaluate ARCCS in two complementary settings. First, in a GDPR policy-document evaluation, LLM-based judges find its decisions and justifications legally and evidentially consistent in up to 96.67% of the assessed cases. Second, on an EU public-procurement benchmark comprising more than 1,200 individual rule checks, the system attains 98.8% accuracy in violation detection. ARCCS is, to our knowledge, the first fully open-source system for end-to-end regulatory compliance checking and auditable report generation.

AI.tldr: ARCCS 是首个开源、端到端、与具体法规无关的智能体式法律 NLP 合规检查系统，将法规拆解为可追溯的原子要求并基于检索证据、置信度和可解释理由进行判定，在 GDPR 政策评估中一致率达 96.67%，在 EU 公共采购基准上违规检测准确率达 98.8%。
AI.motivation: 合规检查需要解读密集的法律文本、确定适用条款并为每个结论提供显式证据，现有方法往往依赖固定法规模板和预定义规则集，难以适配规模与结构差异较大的法规。
AI.method: ARCCS 将原始法规文本分解为原子化、可追溯的要求，针对每条要求检索证据，并对目标文档进行逐项评估，输出置信度分数与人类可解释的理由；该设计将合规评估与固定模板/预定义规则解耦，使其适用于不同规模和结构的法规。
AI.result: 在 GDPR 政策文档评估中，基于 LLM 的评测者认为其判定与理由在法律与证据层面的一致性最高达 96.67%；在包含超过 1200 条规则检查的 EU 公共采购基准上，违规检测准确率为 98.8%。
AI.conclusion: ARCCS 是首个完全开源、支持端到端合规检查与可审计报告生成的系统。

title: MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Open multimodal reasoning models have benefited from large-scale reasoning supervision, yet reliable post-training remains challenging due to uneven data quality, inefficient supervision construction, imbalanced difficulty, and cross-domain interference. We introduce MMVistaReason (MVR), an open-data post-training recipe with three components: (1) broader capability coverage across complementary Analytical and Real-World reasoning groups, emphasizing structured reasoning versus visual perception and spatial grounding; (2) efficient SFT and RL data construction, standardizing heterogeneous open data through staged cleaning and annotation, combining difficulty-aware cascaded teacher distillation with answer-likelihood-based trajectory selection to construct MVR-SFT-528K, and applying scale-specific frontier filtering for MVR-RL-63K; and (3) specialize-then-integrate training, which trains complementary RL experts and consolidates their capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Our analyses reveal a capacity-dependent interaction between supervision difficulty, trajectory quality, and model capacity: smaller students benefit more from selected supervision, while larger students are robust to trajectory variation and mixed-domain interference. Mixed-domain RL introduces benchmark-level negative transfer, whereas MOPD provides consistent capability integration, with the preferred KL direction varying across model scales. Across 15 multimodal benchmarks, MVR-4B achieves an average score of 72.8, outperforming Qwen3.5-9B (Instruct) and MMFineReason-8B while using about 70% fewer samples than MMFineReason. Scaling to 9B improves the average to 74.4, surpassing Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Instruct). Overall, MMVistaReason demonstrates that systematic open-data construction and capacity-aware post-training provide a practical and scalable path toward reliable multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: MMVistaReason（MVR）是一个开放数据的多模态推理后训练方案，通过能力覆盖扩展、高效SFT/RL数据构建与“先专精后整合”策略，实现跨15个基准的强性能。
AI.motivation: 开放多模态推理模型虽受益于大规模推理监督，但后训练面临数据质量参差、监督构建低效、难度不平衡与跨域干扰等挑战，亟需可靠的开放数据后训练方案。
AI.method: 提出MVR三组件：(1) 覆盖Analytical与Real-World互补推理组，强调结构化推理与视觉感知/空间定位；(2) 高效SFT与RL数据构建，通过分阶段清洗标注标准化异构开放数据，结合难度感知级联教师蒸馏与基于答案似然的轨迹选择构建MVR-SFT-528K，并用规模特定前沿过滤构建MVR-RL-63K；(3) specialize-then-integrate训练，训练互补RL专家并用多教师on-policy蒸馏（MOPD）整合能力。
AI.result: 分析揭示监督难度、轨迹质量与模型容量间存在容量依赖交互：小模型更受益于精选监督，大模型对轨迹变化与混域干扰更鲁棒；混域RL带来基准级负迁移，而MOPD实现一致能力整合，且最优KL方向随模型规模变化。15个多模态基准上，MVR-4B平均72.8，超过Qwen3.5-9B(Instruct)与MMFineReason-8B且样本量少约70%；扩展至9B平均达74.4，超过Qwen3.5-35B-A3B(Instruct)。
AI.conclusion: MMVistaReason表明，系统化开放数据构建与容量感知后训练是通往可靠多模态推理的实用且可扩展路径。

title: Does AI-Generated Scientific Text Follow Human Argumentation Patterns? A CARS-Based Comparison of Research Article Introductions
summary: Large language models are moving from helping write up research to helping do it, which makes it important to know how the scientific text they produce differs from human writing. Work on this question has stayed mostly at the surface, using lexical and stylistic cues that light paraphrasing erases. We look instead at rhetorical structure, the sequence of argumentative moves through which a text makes its case. We study research-article introductions under Swales' CARS model, and compare original introductions from published linguistics articles with generated counterparts of the same papers. We find that human-written introductions are more flexible in which moves they use and in what order, while the generated ones are more uniform. Giving the models the CARS definitions makes them more rigid.

AI.tldr: 该论文从修辞结构（而非表层词汇/风格线索）出发，用Swales的CARS模型比较已发表语言学论文的原始引言与同一论文的模型生成引言，发现人类引言在语步选择与顺序上更灵活，生成引言更趋同质，且向模型提供CARS定义反而使其更僵化。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正从"帮助撰写研究成果"转向"帮助开展研究"，因此有必要厘清其生成的科学文本与人类写作的差异。已有相关研究多停留在表层，依赖词汇与风格线索，而这些线索容易被轻度改写抹去，难以揭示深层差异。
AI.method: 选取修辞结构作为分析层面，即文本论证所依循的语步序列。以Swales的CARS模型为框架，聚焦研究论文引言部分，将已发表语言学论文的原始引言与其对应论文的模型生成引言进行对比，考察两类文本在语步使用与语步顺序上的表现；并设置向模型提供CARS定义的实验条件。
AI.result: 人类撰写的引言在所用语步类型及其排列顺序上更为灵活多样；模型生成的引言则更为统一、同质。向模型提供CARS定义后，生成文本的语步结构并未变得更接近人类，反而更加僵化。
AI.conclusion: 修辞结构层面的差异比表层词汇与风格线索更能稳健地区分人类与模型生成的科学文本。模型在论证语步组织上缺乏人类写作的灵活性与变异性，且显式提供体裁定义不足以改善这一状况，甚至适得其反，提示未来需在修辞结构层面提升生成文本的多样性。

title: Generation Provenance Before Behavior Attribution: Auditing Synthetic Speech Research Objects
comment: Accepted to the Third NeurIPS Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale: Data Attribution and Provenance. 4 pages, 0 figures, 1 table. An aggregate reproducibility package is available from the authors on request!
summary: Attributing model behavior to synthetic training data requires knowing what produced each training item before estimating what that item caused. A waveform-label pair does not preserve this knowledge. We propose a generation-provenance substrate in which a synthetic research object binds source specification, generated content, waveform, target, fact requirements, quality signals, review lineage, and immutable manifest identity. Producer and selection mechanism determine evidentiary meaning; storage location and variable name do not. We audit this substrate in a private Japanese care-handoff pipeline. A 113-asset review population contains 1.552 hours of synthetic speech across six scenario families; all items have linked audio, transcripts, candidate notes, and fact checklists, but human evidence is selective and source-specific. Two faithful-only manifests are scenario-seed-disjoint and immutably versioned, while exact upstream attribution remains blocked by floating generator aliases, missing per-clip TTS and code stamps, and an unversioned checking prompt. We argue that generation provenance is necessary but not sufficient for behavior attribution: it defines the candidate causal graph and audit units, whereas contributive attribution still requires frozen training runs and intervention or influence evidence. The paper contributes a compact provenance contract, an audit protocol, and a bounded case study for synthetic-data attribution; controlled research access may be offered, but we do not claim causal training-data attribution, clinical validity, or unrestricted public release.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"生成溯源基座"(generation-provenance substrate):将合成研究对象的源规范、生成内容、波形、目标、事实要求、质量信号、审核谱系与不可变清单身份绑定,从而确定候选因果图与审计单元;在日语护理交班私有流水线中审计113项资产(1.552小时合成语音、6类场景),发现忠实型清单可做到场景种子不相交与不可变版本化,但精确上游归因因生成器别名漂移、缺失逐片段TTS与代码戳、检查提示未版本化而受阻。
AI.motivation: 将模型行为归因于合成训练数据,需要先知道每个训练项"由什么产生",再估计其"造成了什么"。而波形-标签对无法保留这一知识;存储位置与变量名也不决定证据含义,真正决定证据意义的是生产者与选择机制。因此需要一种更严格的溯源载体来界定可审计的因果结构与单元。
AI.method: 提出生成溯源基座:合成研究对象绑定源规范、生成内容、波形、目标、事实要求、质量信号、审核谱系与不可变清单身份。在私有日语护理交班流水线中进行审计:113项资产、1.552小时合成语音、6类场景族,全部条目含链接音频、转写、候选笔记与事实清单;构建两个仅含忠实项的清单(场景种子不相交、不可变版本化),并检查上游归因的可达性。
AI.result: 清单层面可实现场景种子不相交与不可变版本化,条目层面音频、转写、候选笔记、事实清单齐全,但人类证据具有选择性与来源特异性。精确上游归因受阻:生成器别名浮动、缺少逐片段TTS与代码戳、检查提示未版本化。
AI.conclusion: 生成溯源是行为归因的必要非充分条件:它定义候选因果图与审计单元;而贡献性归因仍需冻结的训练运行与干预/影响证据。论文贡献为紧凑的溯源契约、审计协议与有界案例研究;可提供受控研究访问,但不声称因果训练数据归因、临床有效性或无限制公开发布。

title: Gacha Decoding: Eliciting Diverse Generations Through Instruction Following
summary: We introduce Gacha Decoding, an inference-time method for eliciting diverse language model generations that scales with model capability. Across open-ended domains (in-the-wild chat, creative writing, planning for image generation, and protein design), Gacha Decoding significantly outperforms existing generation diversity approaches at equal quality (up to 2.4x Vendi over the next-best prior approach), reaching the same number of high-quality modes with over an order of magnitude fewer samples (11.0x) and discovering novel modes that no other approach surfaces. Our key insight is to treat diversity as an instruction-following problem: rather than relying on the LM's token entropy, we combine its instruction-following capability with randomness from an external RNG tool to scalably identify and realize distinct modes of the response space. This approach of "planning with dice" enables Gacha to invert the long-observed tension between diversity and model capability. As the underlying LM becomes a better instruction follower, diversity under Gacha Decoding consistently improves--even as its token entropy and diversity under prior approaches decline. Together, our results highlight that instruction following, rather than token entropy alone, can drive generation diversity.

AI.tldr: 提出 Gacha Decoding，一种推理时方法，将多样性视为指令跟随问题，用外部随机数生成器（RNG）结合模型的指令跟随能力来识别并实现响应空间中不同的模式，在同等质量下显著优于现有生成多样性方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖语言模型的 token 熵来获得生成多样性，导致随着模型能力增强，token 熵下降，多样性与模型能力之间存在长期张力（此消彼长）。作者希望打破这一矛盾，找到一种能随模型能力提升而提升多样性的机制。
AI.method: Gacha Decoding 将多样性建模为指令跟随问题，而非依赖 token 熵。它把语言模型的指令跟随能力与来自外部 RNG 工具的随机性相结合，通过"用骰子做规划"（planning with dice）的方式，可扩展地识别并实现响应空间中的不同模式。
AI.result: 在开放域任务（真实场景聊天、创意写作、图像生成规划、蛋白质设计）中，Gacha Decoding 在同等质量下显著优于现有方法：Vendi 分数最高达次优方法的 2.4 倍；以超过一个数量级更少的样本（11.0 倍）达到相同数量的高质量模式；并发现了其他方法未能呈现的新模式。
AI.conclusion: 指令跟随而非 token 熵本身，才是驱动生成多样性的关键。Gacha Decoding 扭转了多样性与模型能力之间的张力：随着底层模型成为更好的指令跟随者，其多样性持续提升，而 token 熵及先前方法的多样性却在下降。

title: Is it Possible to Generate Irreversible PolyProtected Templates from Face Embeddings using System-Specific Keys?
comment: Submitted to TIFS journal on 12 May 2026 (under review). Consists of: 13 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables
summary: This work aims to answer the question of whether it is possible to generate irreversible protected templates when the PolyProtect biometric template protection method is applied to face embeddings using system-specific keys (i.e., the same C and E parameters, which define the transform, are applied to all subjects' face embeddings), instead of the traditional subject-specific keys (i.e., each subject has their own C and E parameters). This is important for determining whether we can perform de-duplication of face identities in the PolyProtected domain, which is not possible in the subject-specific key scenario due to the clash with PolyProtect's unlinkability property (i.e., one could generate multiple protected templates belonging to the same identity, using different C and E parameters, such that those templates cannot be linked to each other). We present experiments (reproducible using our open-source code) to prove that there exist at least three ways of systematically selecting system-specific keys that produce irreversible PolyProtected templates: (i) from pre-selected subject-specific keys, (ii) by applying a previously proposed key selection algorithm to random vectors, and (iii) by approximating a "good" C/E pair distribution from which system-specific keys can be constructed. Our findings thus point to the conclusion that it is, indeed, possible to safely operate PolyProtect in the system-specific key scenario without degrading the template protection potential. This opens up the possibility for identity de-duplication in the PolyProtected domain.

AI.tldr: 该研究验证了PolyProtect在人脸嵌入上采用系统特定密钥时能否生成不可逆保护模板，并证明存在三种系统化选取系统特定密钥的方法，从而支持在PolyProtected域进行身份去重。
AI.motivation: 传统PolyProtect使用受试者特定密钥（每人独立的C、E参数），虽满足不可链接性，但无法在保护域内进行人脸身份去重，因为同一身份可用不同C、E生成多个无法相互关联的模板。作者希望确定能否改用系统特定密钥（所有受试者共享同一C、E）来生成不可逆模板，从而兼顾模板保护与身份去重。
AI.method: 作者在人脸嵌入上应用PolyProtect，并将密钥设置由受试者特定改为系统特定；通过实验（提供开源代码可复现）探索三种系统化选取系统特定密钥的途径：(i) 从预先选定的受试者特定密钥中选取；(ii) 将已有密钥选取算法应用于随机向量；(iii) 近似一个"良好"的C/E参数对分布，并据此构造系统特定密钥。
AI.result: 实验证明上述三种方式均可系统性地选出系统特定密钥，并生成具有不可逆性的PolyProtected模板，且不会削弱模板保护潜能。
AI.conclusion: PolyProtect确实可以在系统特定密钥场景下安全运行，不降低模板保护能力，这为在PolyProtected域实现身份去重提供了可能。

title: Supervising Sound Localization by In-the-wild Egomotion
comment: CVPR 2025 Highlight (IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition)
summary: We present a method for learning binaural sound localization using egomotion as a supervisory signal. Over the course of a video, the cameras direction to a sound source will change as the camera moves. We train an audio model to predict sound directions that are consistent with visual estimates of camera motion, which we obtain using traditional methods from multi-view geometry. This provides a weak but plentiful form of supervision that we combine with traditional binaural cues. To evaluate this method, we propose a dataset of real-world audio-visual videos with egomotion. We show that our model can successfully learn from real-world data and that it performs well on sound localization tasks

AI.tldr: 提出一种以自我运动为监督信号的双耳声源定位学习方法，并构建真实音视频数据集验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统双耳声源定位依赖人工标注的声源方位，标注成本高且稀缺。作者希望利用视频中相机运动导致的声源方向变化这一自然信号，获得弱监督且丰富的训练数据。
AI.method: 利用多视角几何方法从视频中估计相机运动，并将其与声源方向变化建立一致性约束，训练音频模型预测与视觉估计一致的声源方向；同时将该弱监督信号与传统的双耳线索相结合。
AI.result: 构建了包含真实世界音视频与自我运动的评估数据集，实验表明模型能够从真实数据中有效学习，并在声源定位任务上表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 自我运动可作为双耳声源定位的弱监督信号，结合传统双耳线索后，模型可在真实场景中实现有效的声源定位。

title: AiSearch: Interactive Multi-Modal Search with VLMs
comment: The demo paper with 1 page main paper, 7 pages supplementary material accepted and presented in ECCV 2026
summary: Modern retrieval systems must both be automated and interactive, allowing users to search and refine results in real time. We present AiSearch, a flexible multimodal retrieval framework that leverages the zero shot capabilities of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for natural language search over images and videos. AiSearch supports interactive search refinement through user feedback to tailor results to the user's intent, and allows visual benchmarking across multiple VLMs, enabling users to select the most suitable model for their task.

AI.tldr: AiSearch：基于视觉语言模型零样本能力的多模态检索框架，支持图像与视频的自然语言搜索、交互式结果精炼及跨模型视觉基准评测。
AI.motivation: 现代检索系统需同时具备自动化与交互性，使用户能实时搜索并精炼结果；现有方案在跨模态（图像、视频）自然语言检索与用户意图对齐方面仍存不足。
AI.method: 提出 AiSearch 框架，利用 VLM 的零样本能力实现图像与视频的自然语言检索；通过用户反馈支持交互式检索精炼，并支持跨多个 VLM 的视觉基准评测，以便用户选择最适配模型。
AI.result: 摘要未提供定量实验数据或评测指标，仅定性说明框架支持图像/视频自然语言搜索、交互式精炼与多模型基准比较。
AI.conclusion: AiSearch 通过融合零样本 VLM 检索、交互式反馈精炼与模型横向基准评测，为多模态检索提供灵活且可定制的解决方案。

title: LLM-Assisted Discovery of Typed Semantic Links for Ontology Network Construction
summary: Constructing typed, justified semantic links between ontologies is essential for enabling interoperability across heterogeneous and interdisciplinary knowledge domains. However, manually curating such links is difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end framework for ontology network construction that automates the discovery and generation of both intra-domain and inter-domain relationships. Our approach combines domain-adapted DistilBERT embeddings for dense contextual representation, clustering-based pre-filtering to reduce the candidate search space, and GPT-4o-driven relationship generation via iterative prompt engineering to produce semantically rich, interpretable links. Applied to ReproduceMeON - a network of 33 ontologies spanning machine learning, microscopy, computational science, and experimental workflow - the pipeline reduces approximately 800k raw concept pairs to 95k high-quality candidates. Human expert validation of 429 generated relationships by two independent annotators yields an overall precision of 80.19% (91.49% on high-certainty annotations) and an F1 of 0.890, with substantial inter-annotator agreement. Comparative experiments against five similarity-based baselines, including Sentence-BERT, show a substantial performance gap (best baseline F1 = 0.581), while an ablation study demonstrates that similarity-based methods alone fail to discriminate valid from invalid relationships (AUC approx 0.5) on the filtered candidate set. These findings highlight the necessity of LLM-based reasoning over concept roles and domain semantics for accurate relationship construction.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端本体网络构建框架，结合DistilBERT嵌入、聚类预过滤与GPT-4o关系生成，自动发现并生成域内与跨域语义关系，在33个本体的ReproduceMeON网络上将80万概念对降至9.5万高质量候选，专家验证精确率80.19%、F1 0.890，显著优于五个相似度基线。
AI.motivation: 异构与跨学科知识域之间的互操作性依赖本体间带类型、有依据的语义链接，但人工构建难以规模化，亟需自动化的本体网络构建方法。
AI.method: 域自适应DistilBERT嵌入获取稠密上下文表示；基于聚类的预过滤压缩候选搜索空间；GPT-4o驱动的迭代提示工程生成语义丰富且可解释的关系，统一处理域内与跨域关系。
AI.result: 在涵盖机器学习、显微镜学、计算科学与实验工作流的33个本体网络ReproduceMeON上，将约80万原始概念对缩减至9.5万高质量候选；两名独立标注者验证429条生成关系，总体精确率80.19%（高确定性标注达91.49%），F1为0.890，标注者间一致性显著；对比五个相似度基线（含Sentence-BERT），最佳基线F1仅0.581；消融实验显示纯相似度方法在过滤候选集上无法区分有效与无效关系（AUC约0.5）。
AI.conclusion: 准确的关系构建需要LLM对概念角色与领域语义进行推理，而仅依赖相似度的方法不足以胜任；所提LLM驱动框架为可扩展的本体网络构建提供了有效路径。

title: Smoother Flow Matching via Contrastive Trajectory Repulsion
summary: Trajectory crossing remains a critical bottleneck in Flow Matching (FM), and previous works typically view these crossings from a theoretical optimization perspective causing velocity averaging. They attempt to address it indirectly by post-hoc distillation or endpoint coupling, without explicitly regulating the intermediate trajectories. In this paper, we introduce a new network learning perspective: crossing points inherently induce large local Lipschitz constants in the target velocity field, leading to two drawbacks. First, high Lipschitz constants correspond to high-frequency signals in the velocity field that neural networks struggle to fit due to spectral bias. Second, they also imply drastic velocity variations, leading to severe numerical integration errors in few-step inference. To alleviate this, we propose CoFlow, a framework that introduces the contrastive learning paradigm into FM to explicitly repel trajectories during training, thereby lowering the local Lipschitz constants of the velocity field. Specifically, we formulate CoFlow from a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) perspective by injecting a repulsive drift term. This drift actively guides the forward process of positive samples away from negative trajectories, effectively reducing the local Lipschitz constant. Furthermore, we derive an equivalent stochastic interpolant formulation from this SDE, providing a simple and tractable design space to control the influence of negative samples. Extensive experiments on ImageNet 256x256 demonstrate that CoFlow significantly reduces FID compared to standard FM in few-step inference (e.g., 20 steps), with no added training overhead. The code can be accessed at: https://github.com/HKUST-LongGroup/CoFlow

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoFlow框架，从网络学习视角将Flow Matching中的轨迹交叉归因于速度场的局部Lipschitz常数过大，并通过引入对比学习的排斥漂移项显式降低该常数，从而在少步推理下显著提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: Flow Matching中轨迹交叉是核心瓶颈。既有工作多从理论优化角度将其视为速度平均问题，仅通过事后蒸馏或端点耦合间接处理，未显式调控中间轨迹。作者提出新视角：交叉点会在目标速度场中诱发较大的局部Lipschitz常数，进而带来两个问题——一是高频信号难以被神经网络拟合（谱偏置），二是速度剧烈变化导致少步推理时数值积分误差严重。
AI.method: 提出CoFlow，将对比学习范式引入Flow Matching，在训练中显式排斥轨迹以降低速度场的局部Lipschitz常数。具体从随机微分方程（SDE）视角建模，注入一个排斥漂移项，主动引导正样本的前向过程远离负轨迹，从而减小局部Lipschitz常数；并由此推导出等价的随机插值（stochastic interpolant）形式，提供一个简洁可控的设计空间来调节负样本的影响。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256上的大量实验表明，相比标准Flow Matching，CoFlow在少步推理（如20步）下显著降低了FID，且不增加额外训练开销。代码开源：https://github.com/HKUST-LongGroup/CoFlow
AI.conclusion: CoFlow通过对比学习中的排斥机制显式调控中间轨迹，从降低速度场局部Lipschitz常数的新角度缓解轨迹交叉问题，为少步高质量生成提供了一种简单、无需额外训练成本的有效方案。

title: Localisation-Aware Uncertainty for Pretrained Object Detection
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying object detectors when distribution/covariate shift and adversarial attacks may occur. Existing approaches often require detector retraining, architectural modification, or repeated inference, which may be infeasible or incur significant overheads. We introduce a lightweight post-hoc evidential meta-model that learns when object localisations should be considered uncertain while keeping the base detector frozen. Our approach automatically identifies localisation-relevant features and uses saliency-guided modification to construct an increasingly challenging curriculum. Detection-level targets combine localisation error, modification level, and prediction instability to guide an evidential meta-model to estimate uncertainty for each predicted bounding box. Our approach requires no changes to the detector and preserves its original localisation outputs. Across adversarial attacks and evaluated strengths, GRACE improves TP-FP AUROC by 22% relative to the strongest comparator in some cases while maintaining in-distribution detection performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级事后证据式元模型GRACE，在冻结目标检测器的前提下估计每个预测边界框的不确定性，显著提升对抗攻击下的TP-FP AUROC。
AI.motivation: 部署目标检测器时面临分布/协变量偏移与对抗攻击，可靠的不确定性估计至关重要；但现有方法通常需要重训练、修改架构或重复推理，代价高或不可行。
AI.method: 一种事后（post-hoc）证据式元模型：保持基检测器冻结，自动识别与定位相关的特征，并利用显著性引导的修改构建难度递增的课程；检测级目标融合定位误差、修改程度与预测不稳定性，指导元模型为每个预测框输出不确定性；无需改动检测器，且保留其原始定位输出。
AI.result: 在多种对抗攻击及不同强度下，相较最强对比方法，GRACE在某些情形下将TP-FP AUROC提升22%，同时保持分布内检测性能。
AI.conclusion: GRACE以低成本的事后方式实现了有效的不确定性估计，在对抗鲁棒性评测中显著优于现有方法，且不牺牲原始检测性能。

title: SHAMS: An Audio-Grounded Pronunciation Benchmark for Levantine Arabic
comment: Accepted to ArabicNLP 2026. Project page: https://shams-nlp.github.io/
summary: Levantine Arabic (LA) is spoken by tens of millions of people, creating a pressing need for shared benchmarks to evaluate LA speech-language technologies. Evaluating such technology is particularly challenging given LA's internal diversity and its opaque and non-standardized orthography. We present SHAMS (SHami Annotated Multi-dialect Speech), a benchmark comprising 1,300 utterances drawn from open audio corpora, balanced across five LA varieties (Urban and Rural Palestinian, and Urban Jordanian, Lebanese, and Syrian). Each utterance is represented across four aligned tiers: audio, unvocalized orthography, diacritized text, and phonetic transcription. This structure supports evaluation of various downstream tasks such as diacritization, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, automatic speech recognition, and audio-to-phoneme, grounded in audio and stratified by variety. We benchmark open and proprietary models across these tasks to demonstrate the utility of this benchmark for measuring progress across LA. We release SHAMS at https://shams-nlp.github.io .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SHAMS，一个覆盖五种黎凡特阿拉伯语方言、包含1300条话语的多层级标注语音评测基准。
AI.motivation: 黎凡特阿拉伯语（LA）使用者众多，但缺乏统一的评测基准；其内部方言多样、正字法不透明且非标准化，使得语音语言技术评测尤为困难。
AI.method: 从开放音频语料中选取1300条话语，覆盖五种LA方言（城乡巴勒斯坦、城市约旦、黎巴嫩、叙利亚），每条话语提供四个对齐层级：音频、无变音正字法、带变音文本、音标转写；并在这些层级上对开放与专有模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: 构建了一个按方言分层、基于音频的基准，可支持变音恢复、字素到音素转换、自动语音识别、音频到音素等下游任务评测，并给出了开放与专有模型的对比结果。
AI.conclusion: SHAMS为衡量LA语音语言技术进展提供了共享基准，并已公开发布。

title: Generalization Is Stability, Not Accuracy: Multi-Axis Evaluation of LLMs
comment: Accepted at the TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop: Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Generalization in large language models (LLMs) is the ability to produce consistent and semantically stable outputs when the same input is expressed in different ways. Existing work typically evaluates generalization through aggregate accuracy on a single prompt format, task, or set of variations, which conflates robustness with overall benchmark performance. In this work, we show generalization evaluation at the level of individual examples, across multiple input variants, and across different aspects of model behavior, focusing on variability rather than reducing performance to a score that can be improved through narrow training or other ways that obfuscate generalization evaluation. Following this view, we introduce the Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO), a framework that measures how much model behavior changes for the same input under different variations and benchmarks, capturing variability across several dimensions including generation consistency, internal activations, confidence, and response mirroring. We show that many commonly used models exhibit statistically significant and consistent generalization instability: no model generalizes uniformly, behavioral axes capture independent failure modes, and cross-dataset variation can reverse model rankings.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAGO 框架，从样例级、多输入变体、多行为维度评估 LLM 泛化，强调变异性而非聚合准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有工作通常用单一 prompt 格式、单一任务或固定变体集合上的聚合准确率来评估泛化，将鲁棒性与整体基准性能混为一谈；分数可通过窄化训练等方式提升，从而掩盖真实的泛化评估。
AI.method: 提出 Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO) 框架，在同一样输入的不同变体与不同基准下测量模型行为变化，覆盖生成一致性、内部激活、置信度、响应镜像等多个维度，在单样例级别进行泛化评估。
AI.result: 常见模型普遍表现出统计显著且一致的泛化不稳定性：没有任何模型能均匀泛化，不同行为轴捕捉到相互独立的失败模式，跨数据集的变化甚至会逆转模型排名。
AI.conclusion: 泛化评估应转向以变异性为导向的、样例级、多维度的评估范式；单一聚合分数不足以刻画 LLM 的泛化能力，SAGO 为揭示隐藏的不稳定性提供了可操作框架。

title: MWOP: Modality-aware Width-wise Operation Pruning for Efficient MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial inference costs when processing long visual-textual sequences. While existing operation compression methods exploit modality-level redundancy, they largely treat computation within attention heads and shared feed-forward network (FFN) channels as unified units, leaving finer-grained redundancy underexplored. We find that redundancy varies both across modality-interaction paths within the same attention head and across visual and textual executions of the same FFN channel. Based on these findings, we propose Modality-aware Width-wise Operation Pruning (MWOP), which independently prunes visual-to-visual (V2V), text-to-visual (T2V), and text-to-text (T2T) attention paths within each layer, and separately selects FFN channels for visual and textual inputs. A first-order Taylor criterion guides the pruning process, with FFN importance re-evaluated after attention pruning and LoRA-based recovery training. To translate the resulting fine-grained sparsity into practical acceleration, we further develop path-sparse Triton attention kernels and compact visual-side FFN execution. MWOP preserves the token sequence while reducing attention and FFN computation, making it complementary to token compression and enabling simultaneous reduction of sequence length and per-token computation. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, MWOP alone achieves a $1.6\times$ prefill speedup with 99.7\% average performance retention across 12 benchmarks. Combined with two representative token compression methods, it further increases their prefill speedups from $2.0\times$ and $1.9\times$ to $2.9\times$ and $2.7\times$, respectively. Results on Qwen2.5-VL-7B further demonstrate its applicability across architectures. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/MWOP.

AI.tldr: 提出MWOP（模态感知宽度维度操作剪枝），在多模态大模型中对注意力路径和FFN通道进行细粒度模态级剪枝，并配套稀疏kernel实现加速。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型操作压缩方法仅利用模态级冗余，将注意力头内计算和共享FFN通道视为统一单元，忽略了模态交互路径与视觉/文本执行之间的更细粒度冗余。
AI.method: 发现注意力头内不同模态交互路径、以及同一FFN通道的视觉与文本执行存在冗余差异；据此将每层注意力独立划分为V2V、T2V、T2T路径分别剪枝，并分别为视觉和文本输入选择FFN通道；用一阶泰勒准则指导剪枝，注意力剪枝后重新评估FFN重要性并做LoRA恢复训练；开发路径稀疏的Triton注意力kernel和紧凑视觉侧FFN执行以落地加速。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-OneVision-7B上，MWOP单独实现1.6倍预填充加速，12个基准平均性能保留99.7%；与两个代表性token压缩方法结合后，其预填充加速从2.0倍、1.9倍提升至2.9倍、2.7倍；在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上验证了跨架构适用性。
AI.conclusion: MWOP保持token序列不变，仅减少注意力与FFN计算，与token压缩互补，可同时降低序列长度和每token计算量。

title: The Impact of Processing Parameters on High-Accuracy Measurements in UAV Photogrammetry
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry is increasingly used in applications requiring high accuracy, such as determining ground surface changes caused by landslides, mining, or microrelief transformation. While acquisition strategies have been widely studied, the influence of the processing workflow-particularly Bundle Block Adjustment parameter settings-remains insufficiently explored. This study addresses this gap through a systematic, full-factorial evaluation of 768 processing variants applied to ten UAV datasets collected over 1.5 years in a 220 ha study area. Eight key parameters were analysed. The results show substantial variability in final 3D accuracy: the best performing variant achieved a root mean square error (RMSE) of 16 mm, whereas the weakest reached 303 mm. The most influential factors were the number of ground control points, the application of additional camera calibration corrections, and the use of the Post-Processing Kinematic GNSS method for determining camera projection center coordinates. The study also evaluates how workflow optimization affects the accuracy of displacement, tilt changes, and horizontal strain determination. While random displacement errors remained stable (RMSE of ~6-7 mm), systematic errors were significantly reduced by over half in all axes, with vertical median absolute error decreasing from 14 mm to 7 mm in the optimized configuration compared to the baseline previously used by the authors. This study provides the first large-scale, practice-oriented assessment of how processing parameter selection shapes the accuracy of both photogrammetric products and deformation indices determination. The results offer actionable guidance for developing more robust and repeatable UAV photogrammetry workflows tailored to high-precision monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过768个处理变体的全因子实验，系统评估了无人机摄影测量中Bundle Block Adjustment参数设置对3D精度及形变指标的影响，发现最优配置RMSE为16 mm，而最差达303 mm。
AI.motivation: 无人机摄影测量在高精度应用（如滑坡、采矿引起的地表变化监测）中需求日益增长，但现有研究多聚焦于采集策略，对处理流程中Bundle Block Adjustment参数设置的影响缺乏充分探索。
AI.method: 在220公顷研究区、历时1.5年采集的10个无人机数据集上，开展768个处理变体的系统全因子评估，分析8个关键参数，并评估工作流优化对位移、倾斜变化及水平应变确定精度的影响。
AI.result: 3D精度差异显著：最佳变体RMSE为16 mm，最差为303 mm。最具影响力的因素为地面控制点数量、附加相机标定校正以及使用Post-Processing Kinematic GNSS确定相机投影中心坐标。随机位移误差稳定（RMSE约6-7 mm），系统误差在各轴均降低一半以上，垂直中位绝对误差由14 mm降至7 mm。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次大规模、面向实践地评估了处理参数选择如何影响摄影测量产品及形变指标确定的精度，为构建更稳健、可重复的高精度无人机摄影测量工作流提供了可操作的指导。

title: Code-Switching Spoken Language Identification as Multi-Label Set Prediction
summary: Code-switched (CS) speech leaks through the monolingual language identification (LID) filters used to curate massive speech corpora, calling for CS-aware LID (CS-LID). We formulate utterance-level CS-LID as multi-label language-set prediction and propose a set generator that directly outputs the languages in an utterance, comparing it against atomic-pair and score-based classification baselines. Oracle Top-k is the strongest baseline, but thresholding fails because no single threshold separates CS from monolingual speech. Our set generator predicts the correct language count on unseen pairs without assuming the number of languages, but underperforms oracle Top-k in exact set accuracy. Our analysis identifies the key obstacles to robust CS-LID: oracle cardinality, threshold instability, language bias in CS training data, and the synthetic-to-real gap.

AI.tldr: 该文将话语级代码切换语言识别（CS-LID）建模为多标签语言集合预测，提出直接输出话语所含语言的集合生成器，并与原子对及分数式分类基线比较，指出oracle基数、阈值不稳定、语言偏置与合成-真实差距是稳健CS-LID的主要障碍。
AI.motivation: 大规模语音语料库依赖单语LID过滤，而代码切换（CS）语音会漏过这些过滤，导致语料纯净度受损，因此需要能识别代码切换的CS-LID。
AI.method: 将话语级CS-LID形式化为多标签语言集合预测；提出集合生成器，直接输出话语中的语言集合；与原子对分类基线和基于分数的分类基线进行对比；并分析阈值化与oracle Top-k等方法。
AI.result: Oracle Top-k是最强基线，但阈值化失效，因为没有单一阈值能将CS语音与单语语音分开；集合生成器能在未见语言对上预测正确语言数量且不预设语言数，但在精确集合准确率上低于oracle Top-k。
AI.conclusion: 稳健CS-LID的关键障碍包括oracle基数、阈值不稳定、CS训练数据中的语言偏置以及合成到真实的差距。

title: Uncertainty-Guided Handshake: Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Refinement for Surgical-Grade Glioma Segmentation
summary: While state-of-the-art automated models for medical image segmentation achieve high mean performance, they frequently suffer from localized, catastrophic failures that preclude safe clinical deployment, particularly in neuro-oncology. Interactive segmentation frameworks mitigate this by incorporating human oversight, but traditionally impose prohibitive cognitive and temporal workloads by requiring clinicians to manually search for errors. In this project, we present an efficient, Hybrid Structural-Aleatoric Human-in-the-Loop framework for glioma segmentation that bridges the gap between automated baseline performance and surgical-grade precision, achieving sub-2.0 mm HD95 on curated benchmarks while providing safety-net routing for structural failures across real-world clinical data. By extracting voxel-wise Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) uncertainty and applying hierarchical topological filtering, our method proactively isolates high-risk structural anomalies. We comprehensively evaluated our approach on a challenging out-of-distribution clinical stress-test cohort (N = 362). Operating under a simulated Human Oracle, the framework improved the Whole Tumor (WT) Dice score from 0.891 to 0.914 and reduced the 95th percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95) from 5.82 mm to 4.76 mm. Critically for surgical safety, the system rescued severe boundary failures in the Tumor Core, reducing mean HD95 from 17.96 mm to 14.83 mm (improving absolute TC Dice to 0.356). These spatial rescues were achieved while demanding a median interactive workload of just 11.3% of the target volume. Acknowledging this as a simulated upper bound lacking real-world cognitive friction, the framework nevertheless demonstrates a highly Pareto-efficient pathway for safely deploying clinical AI.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合结构-随机不确定性的HITL胶质瘤分割框架，通过TTA不确定性与层级拓扑过滤主动定位高风险结构异常，在N=362的OOD临床压力测试队列中将WT Dice从0.891提升至0.914、HD95从5.82mm降至4.76mm，TC HD95从17.96mm降至14.83mm，交互工作量中位数仅占目标体积的11.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割模型虽平均性能高，但在神经肿瘤等领域存在局部灾难性失败，难以安全临床部署；交互式分割可引入人工监督，但传统方式需临床医生手动搜索错误，带来过高的认知与时间负担。因此需要一个既能保障安全、又具备高帕累托效率的交互框架。
AI.method: 混合结构-随机不确定性的人在回路（Hybrid Structural-Aleatoric Human-in-the-Loop）框架：提取体素级Test-Time Augmentation（TTA）不确定性，并施加层级拓扑过滤，以主动隔离高风险结构异常，并为结构性失败提供安全网路由，从而将自动化基线性能提升至手术级精度。
AI.result: 在具挑战性的分布外临床压力测试队列（N=362）上，模拟Human Oracle条件下：全肿瘤（WT）Dice由0.891提升至0.914，HD95由5.82 mm降至4.76 mm；肿瘤核心（TC）平均HD95由17.96 mm降至14.83 mm，TC Dice绝对值为0.356，严重边界失败得到挽救；交互工作量中位数仅为目标体积的11.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在curated基准上实现sub-2.0 mm HD95，并在真实临床数据中提供结构性失败的安全网路由。作者承认结果为模拟上界、未包含真实认知摩擦，但仍展示了一条高度帕累托高效的安全临床AI部署路径。

title: When Does a Second Model Help? Cross-Model Review in LLM Verification
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Follow-up to arXiv:2603.12123 and arXiv:2603.21454. v2: corrects two condition labels in Table 1 (CCR sees the artifact only; SA runs in a new session) and dependent interpretations; adds review prompts, a TP/FP breakdown by severity, and limitations; states how each reviewer was run; softens case studies. Numbers unchanged except removed B5 percentages
summary: Large language models now generate code, documentation, and analyses, and are increasingly used to review such output. We ask when a second review by a different model helps. Building on the author's earlier preprints, which varied context, repetition, and role structure within one model, we test model independence in a controlled experiment: 30 artifacts with 150 planted errors, 10 review conditions, and 900 review sessions with three reviewer models from two developers. In this experiment, (1) a top-tier cross-model reviewer is not significantly different in F1 from same-model review in a fresh session (CCR), which does not establish equivalence; (2) the two find partly different errors (Jaccard 41.2%); and (3) at two review calls, one CCR plus one cross-model review matches more planted errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%; Holm-adjusted p=.006), but not significantly more than two reviews by the top-tier cross-model reviewer, so model difference and reviewer capability are not separated. A lightweight cross-model reviewer scores no higher than same-model review. Withholding requirements from the reviewer raises F1 for the two lower tiers but not the top tier, in untested point estimates whose pattern depends on how failed sessions are scored. Before analysis we audited all session records, excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance and 14 failed calls; results with all sessions are also reported. A partial check on public detector outputs from another benchmark neither replicates nor contradicts the main comparison. Records, artifacts, and scripts are available from the author on request.

AI.tldr: 在150个植入错误的受控评审实验中，跨模型评审与同模型新会话评审的F1无显著差异；两次评审配置下，一次同模型新会话加一次跨模型评审比两次同模型新会话评审发现更多植入错误，但跨模型评审的"模型差异"效应与"评审能力"效应无法分离。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已被广泛用于生成代码、文档与分析，并越来越多地用于评审这类产出。作者希望回答一个具体问题：当引入另一个不同模型的第二次评审时，究竟在什么情况下有帮助。此前预印本已在单一模型内部变化上下文、重复次数与角色结构，本文进一步检验"模型独立性"是否带来增益。
AI.method: 受控实验：30个产出物、150个植入错误、10种评审条件，共900次评审会话，涉及来自两家开发者的三个评审模型。设置同模型新会话评审（CCR）、跨模型评审（含顶级跨模型评审与轻量跨模型评审）、两次评审调用组合等条件；并测试"向评审者隐瞒需求"这一变体。实验前审计全部会话记录，剔除一次来源不确定的基线运行和14次失败调用，同时报告包含全部会话的结果。以F1、Jaccard相似度、植入错误命中率作为主要指标，并做Holm多重比较校正。
AI.result: (1) 顶级跨模型评审者与同模型新会话评审（CCR）的F1无显著差异，但该检验未能确立等价性；(2) 两种评审发现部分不同的错误，Jaccard相似度为41.2%；(3) 在两次评审调用预算下，一次CCR加一次跨模型评审命中植入错误的比例高于两次CCR评审（56.7% vs. 42.7%，Holm校正p=.006），但相对两次顶级跨模型评审并无显著优势，因此模型差异与评审者能力两个因素无法分离；轻量跨模型评审表现不高于同模型评审；向评审者隐瞒需求可提升两个较低档模型的F1，而对顶级模型无此效果，该结果为未检验的点估计，其模式还取决于失败会话的计分方式。对另一基准公开检测器输出的部分核查，既未复现也未否定主要比较结论。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型评审并非普遍优于同模型新会话评审，其可观测收益至少部分来自评审者能力而非模型差异；在两次评审预算下，同模型与跨模型组合具有一定收益，但效应来源尚不能干净地归因。作者强调结果受失败会话计分方式影响、且次要结果为未经检验的点估计，外部队列核查亦无定论。会话记录、产出物与脚本可向作者索取。

title: ALFRED: Requirement-driven development of an open-source mobile manipulator for long-term plant monitoring
summary: Tracking seasonal change in crops and forests requires observing the same plants repeatedly. Ground robots can do this at close range, and a manipulator gives their sensors more viewpoints. Yet the robots behind long-term field datasets are rarely released with their design files, and how a robot's own structure limits arm reach and occludes its sensors is seldom compared between builds. We present ALFRED, an open-source mobile manipulator built from commercially available components. It carries a six-degree-of-freedom arm, LiDAR, RGB-D cameras, RTK GNSS and an IMU on an Ackermann-steered base, all mounted on a reconfigurable aluminium strut frame, and runs containerised ROS software. It was developed through four builds against six requirements for repeated outdoor deployment: durability, modularity, repairability, sensing reach, endurance and reproducibility. Model-based analysis of the last three builds shows the usable share of the arm's reachable poses rising from 34.0% to 60.0% and then 66.1%, and ray casting shows that only the final build keeps the frame-mounted LiDAR's horizontal view clear both forwards and backwards. ALFRED completed a year of monthly forest surveys (528 traversals) without missing a scheduled collection. This was despite battery degradation, reconfiguration for another researcher's study, and the parallel development of ALFRED 2.0 for autonomous crop-row operation, with each switch between builds taking about six hours. The deployment also showed that mechanical modularity is only as dependable as the robot description that tracks it.

AI.tldr: 提出开源移动机械臂平台ALFRED，通过四代迭代优化结构对臂展与传感器视野的限制，完成一年528次森林月度调查无缺失。
AI.motivation: 长期野外物候观测需重复访问同一植株，地面机器人配合机械臂可提供多视角近距离传感；但长期田间数据集所用机器人鲜少公开设计文件，且机器人自身结构对机械臂可达性与传感器遮挡的影响缺乏不同构型间的对比分析。
AI.method: 基于商用组件搭建开源移动机械臂ALFRED：Ackermann转向底盘、六自由度机械臂、LiDAR、RGB-D相机、RTK GNSS与IMU，安装于可重构铝型材框架，运行容器化ROS软件。围绕重复户外部署的六项需求（耐久性、模块化、可维修性、感知可达性、续航、可复现性）进行四次构型迭代；对后三代构型开展基于模型的可达位姿分析（计算可用位姿占比）与射线投射（评估框架安装LiDAR前向与后向水平视野）。
AI.result: 后三代构型的机械臂可用可达位姿占比由34.0%提升至60.0%，再至66.1%；射线投射表明仅最终构型能同时保持框架安装LiDAR前向与后向水平视野无遮挡。ALFRED完成一年月度森林调查共528次穿越，未遗漏任何计划采集，期间经历电池衰减、为其他研究者研究进行重构，并同步开发用于自主作物行作业的ALFRED 2.0，每次构型切换约耗时6小时。
AI.conclusion: 机器人结构的迭代设计可显著提升机械臂有效可达性与传感器无遮挡视野，是长期野外部署可行性的关键因素；机械模块化的可靠性取决于与之同步维护的机器人描述文件（URDF等）；完整开源设计文件有助于长期田间数据集的复现。

title: FiVOS: A Fish Segmentation Algorithm Based on Interactive Video Object Segmentation and Filter Enhancement
summary: With the continuous expansion of aquaculture, precise and efficient monitoring of fish behavior has become increasingly critical for improving farming efficiency and reducing economic losses. In particular, with the ongoing enhancement of computational capabilities in deep learning models, vision-based fish segmentation methods are garnering growing attention. By analyzing video segmentation results, fish behavior can be effectively tracked, thereby providing reliable data support for the precise regulation of aquaculture environments. However, existing deep learning-based video segmentation methods for aquaculture scenarios often overlook the dynamic correlations between video frames. In contrast, Interactive Video Object Segmentation (IVOS) employs an interaction-propagation scheme to achieve high-precision segmentation while minimizing user effort, thereby enhancing monitoring efficiency. Yet, IVOS applications in aquaculture remain limited due to data scarcity, and are susceptible to error accumulation and mask loss over long sequence propagation due to high intra-class similarity. In response, this paper proposes an improved interactive video object segmentation method (FiVOS) and constructs two fish-specific datasets. FiVOS utilizes a mask block filter to enable early detection and correction of erroneous propagated mask blocks, enhancing filtering accuracy through a rule-based thresholding approach. Additionally, it serializes noise filters to further eliminate erroneous mask noise, thereby improving model robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that FiVOS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in fish video segmentation tasks, providing robust technical support for fish behavior research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出改进的交互式视频目标分割方法FiVOS，并构建两个鱼类专用数据集，通过掩码块过滤与噪声过滤串联策略解决长序列传播中的错误累积与掩码丢失问题，在鱼类视频分割任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 水产养殖规模持续扩大，鱼类行为的精准高效监测对提升养殖效率、降低经济损失至关重要。基于视觉的鱼类分割方法受到关注，但现有面向养殖场景的深度学习视频分割方法往往忽视视频帧间的动态相关性；而交互式视频目标分割（IVOS）虽能以较少用户交互实现高精度分割，却因数据稀缺在养殖领域应用有限，且受类内高相似性影响，在长序列传播中易出现错误累积与掩码丢失。
AI.method: 提出改进的交互式视频目标分割方法FiVOS，并构建两个鱼类专用数据集。FiVOS采用掩码块过滤器，实现错误传播掩码块的早期检测与纠正，并借助基于规则的阈值方法提升过滤精度；同时将噪声滤波器串联化，进一步去除错误掩码噪声，从而增强模型鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FiVOS在鱼类视频分割任务上取得了当前最优（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: FiVOS为鱼类行为研究提供了稳健的技术支撑，推动了交互式视频目标分割在水产养殖场景中的应用。

title: The Persona Is Still There, but Who Is Speaking? Latent Identity Reversion in Persistent AI Agents
summary: In February 2026, an always-on personal agent (``Paul,'' Claude Opus 4.5) entered a striking dissociation-like state: after repeated automated ``heartbeat'' checks, it stopped responding as Paul, claimed it could not message its user on Discord, and referred to ``Paul'' as someone else. We used this incident to study a broader question: what makes a persona remain the identity from which an LLM agent speaks? We first tested whether repetition of the scheduled heartbeat was sufficient to produce the effect. It was not: with the persona continuously anchored in the system prompt, we observed 0/46 failures, including a verbatim replay of the incident. The incident instead exposed an implementation quirk that created a useful experimental manipulation: on resumed turns, conversational history was preserved but the persona was no longer re-injected at the privileged system-prompt level. Using this manipulation, we found that persona continuity depends jointly on system-level anchoring and conversational context. After anchor loss, rich human interaction could preserve the persona, whereas a single automated heartbeat turn could precipitate reversion toward the harness identity. Restoring the anchor reversibly restored persona enactment. Crucially, apparently normal conversation could conceal the shift: unanchored agents sometimes interacted appropriately while identifying themselves as the underlying harness (having lost the assigned persona), and after conversational recovery only 1/18 remained persona-enacting versus 17/17 anchored controls. We therefore distinguish \emph{represented} from \emph{enacted} identity: persona-related information can remain available in conversational history without the persona remaining the identity bound to ``I.''

AI.tldr: 本文以一次"人格脱离（dissociation-like）"事故为切入点，研究LLM智能体"人格连续性"的维持条件：发现人格维持同时依赖系统提示层的锚定与会话上下文，并据此区分"被表征的身份"与"被施行（enact）的身份"。
AI.motivation: 2026年2月，一个常驻个人智能体（"Paul"，Claude Opus 4.5）在反复自动"心跳"检查后进入类解离状态：不再以Paul身份回应、声称无法通过Discord联系用户，并将"Paul"称为他人。作者希望借此事故回答一个更一般的问题：是什么使一个人格（persona）始终作为LLM智能体言说的那个"我"。
AI.method: 1) 首先检验"重复定时心跳"本身是否足以诱发该效应——在系统提示中持续锚定人格的条件下进行复现实验（含对事故的逐字重放）。2) 利用事故暴露的实现缺陷构造实验操纵：在恢复的对话轮次中，会话历史被保留，但人格不再于特权系统提示层被重新注入。3) 在该"去锚定"条件下，对比富有人类交互与单次自动心跳轮次对人格保持的影响，并检验恢复锚定是否可逆地恢复人格施行。4) 用锚定对照组（17/17）与去锚定后经对话"恢复"组（1/18）比较表面正常对话下的人格施行率。
AI.result: 重复心跳不足以诱发该效应：人格持续锚定于系统提示时失败为0/46，包括事故的逐字重放。人格连续性同时依赖系统层锚定与会话上下文：锚定丢失后，丰富的人类交互可保住人格，而单次自动心跳轮次可促使向harness底层身份的回归；恢复锚定可逆地恢复人格施行。关键在于，表面正常的对话可以掩盖这一转变：去锚定的智能体有时交互得体，却以底层harness而非被分配人格自称；对话恢复后仅1/18仍在施行人格，而锚定对照组为17/17。
AI.conclusion: "人格连续性"并非仅由信息可得性决定，而是系统层锚定与会话上下文联合作用的结果。作者据此区分身份的被表征（represented）与被施行（enacted）：人格相关信息可以仍然存在于会话历史中，但人格已不再是绑定于"我"的那个言说身份。该框架可用于诊断与评估长时运行智能体的身份稳定性。

title: Auditing Web Agent Evaluation on WebArena-Lite: Human Review of Outcomes and Trajectories
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development"
summary: Web agents are an important application of large language models, yet their evaluation often depends on rule based or language model evaluators that inspect only the final outcome. Human verification of task completion and detailed analysis of failed trajectories remain limited. We audit all 165 WebArena Lite tasks under six evaluation conditions built from GPT 5.5 and an untrained Qwen3.5 9B model. The audit retains the original score, corrects false negatives from the automatic evaluator, identifies the first consequential error, and examines progress across the trajectory. We also study a Memory and Analysis Support Mechanism (MASM), which maintains explicit execution state, and Guide Text, which provides task relevant procedural guidance. Across four GPT 5.5 settings, human review recovers 5.45 to 8.49 percentage points of success missed by the evaluator. With a 25 step budget, Guide Text raises corrected success with MASM from 34.55% to 38.18%. On the untrained Qwen3.5 9B model, MASM raises the evaluator score from 13.90% to 18.80%. Review of 102 failed GPT 5.5 trajectories reveals frequent scrolling loops, unfinished exploration, premature answers, invalid actions, and incomplete form workflows. Step level evidence further shows that substantial early progress can coexist with a final failure. These results show why final scores alone provide an incomplete account of web agent behavior and motivate human grounded, trajectory aware verification.

AI.tldr: 对WebArena Lite全部165个任务的审计表明，仅凭最终得分的自动评估会漏掉大量成功案例，需引入人工校验与轨迹级分析。
AI.motivation: 现有Web智能体评估多依赖规则或语言模型评估器，只检查最终结果，缺乏人工验证与失败轨迹的细粒度分析，导致评估结论不完整。
AI.method: 在6种评估条件下审计全部165个WebArena Lite任务，使用GPT-5.5与未训练的Qwen3.5 9B；保留原始得分、纠正假阴性、定位首个关键错误、考察轨迹进度；并研究MASM（显式维护执行状态）与Guide Text（任务相关程序性指导）。
AI.result: 四种GPT-5.5设置下人工复核找回5.45–8.49个百分点的成功；25步预算下，Guide Text将带MASM的修正成功率从34.55%提升至38.18%；未训练Qwen3.5 9B上MASM将评估得分从13.90%提升至18.80%；102条失败轨迹暴露滚动循环、探索未完成、过早作答、无效动作与表单流程不完整等问题，且早期显著进展可与最终失败并存。
AI.conclusion: 最终得分无法完整刻画Web智能体行为，需采用以人为据、面向轨迹的验证方式。

title: Q-SPT: Learnable Query-Based Compression for Low-Frame-Rate Speech Tokenization
summary: Neural speech codecs increasingly serve as tokenizers for speech language models (SLMs). Lowering the frame rate reduces the computational and memory costs of SLMs, but makes it difficult to preserve both linguistic information and acoustic detail. Existing approaches rely on rule-based compression: average pooling can discard linguistic information, whereas similarity-based merging uses a fixed threshold on adjacent-frame similarity and applies the resulting boundaries to the acoustic stream. We propose Q-SPT, a low-frame-rate dual-stream speech tokenizer with separate, context-aware, learnable query-based compressors specialized for semantic and acoustic representations. In particular, queries at a fixed rate independently attend to the semantic and acoustic streams as separate key-value sources, enabling stream-specific, context-aware aggregation through two separately learned compressors. In addition, an autoregressive text loss explicitly supervises the semantic compressor to preserve linguistic information. Experimental results show that Q-SPT achieves the best reconstruction among the evaluated codecs at the same frame rate. In downstream SLMs, it yields the best speech recognition accuracy and text-to-speech perceptual quality with competitive intelligibility.

AI.tldr: Q-SPT是一种低帧率双流语音分词器，通过可学习的上下文感知查询压缩器分别处理语义与声学表征，在相同帧率下取得更优重建效果并提升下游SLM性能。
AI.motivation: 神经语音编解码器越来越多地作为语音语言模型（SLM）的分词器。降低帧率虽能减少SLM的计算与内存开销，但难以同时保留语言信息和声学细节。现有方法依赖规则化压缩：平均池化会丢失语言信息，而基于相似度的合并对相邻帧相似度使用固定阈值，并将所得边界直接应用于声学流，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 提出Q-SPT，一种低帧率双流语音分词器。其核心是分别面向语义与声学表征的、独立的、上下文感知的、可学习的查询式压缩器。固定速率的查询分别作为独立的键值源关注语义流和声学流，通过两个单独学习的压缩器实现针对特定流的上下文感知聚合；此外引入自回归文本损失，显式监督语义压缩器以保留语言信息。
AI.result: 在相同帧率下，Q-SPT在所评估的编解码器中取得最佳重建效果。在下游SLM任务中，实现最佳语音识别准确率和最佳文本到语音感知质量，并具有竞争力的可懂度。
AI.conclusion: Q-SPT通过可学习、流特定的查询式压缩替代规则化压缩，有效缓解低帧率下语言信息与声学细节的权衡问题，兼顾重建质量与下游SLM性能。

title: No Model Required: Text Entropy Rate Filtering Mitigates Iterative Fine-Tuning Collapse
summary: Iterative fine-tuning on synthetic data causes \emph{model collapse}: output diversity narrows as rare patterns are progressively lost, a signature most visible as phrase-level repetition. Existing mitigations either require model log-probabilities, an external oracle, or continued access to real human data. Here we develop a new approach grounded in mathematical information theory: the non-parametric Kontoyiannis entropy rate estimator $h_k$, computed entirely from raw text via match-length statistics, with no model of any kind. We show that this is in fact a \emph{superior} training-data filter on text-diversity metrics in a fully-synthetic, single-lineage fine-tuning setting. In a six-generation QLoRA collapse experiment on Llama-3.1-8B, logprob-based filtering (the most established model-access-requiring baseline) provides no significant text-diversity benefit on any metric ($p > 0.23$), whereas $h_k$-filtering yields $+42\%$ unique trigrams, $+30\%$ vocabulary, and $-19\%$ repetition (all $p < 0.001$). We validate $h_k$ as a cross-domain entropy proxy ($β= 0.924$, $R^2 = 0.746$) and collapse detector ($ρ= +0.454$, $p < 0.0001$) across 4~domains, 2~temperatures, 2~generator--scorer model pairs, and 1{,}520 generated documents. Our results demonstrate that information theoretic approaches to collapse mitigation are efficient, and suggest new approaches for maintaining multi-agent diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于信息论的Kontoyiannis熵率估计器$h_k$，无需模型即可从原始文本计算，作为合成数据过滤指标，在QLoRA模型坍塌实验中显著优于需要模型log概率的过滤基线，能有效提升文本多样性、抑制重复。
AI.motivation: 迭代在合成数据上微调会导致模型坍塌，表现为输出多样性收窄、罕见模式逐渐丢失，尤以短语级重复为显著特征。现有缓解方法依赖模型log概率、外部oracle或持续获取真实人类数据，存在资源与访问限制，因此需要一种不依赖模型、可仅从原始文本计算的替代方案。
AI.method: 本文引入非参数的Kontoyiannis熵率估计器$h_k$，完全通过匹配长度统计从原始文本计算，不依赖任何模型。在完全合成、单谱系的微调设置下，将$h_k$作为训练数据过滤器，并在Llama-3.1-8B上进行六代QLoRA坍塌实验，与基于log概率的过滤基线对比。同时在4个领域、2种温度、2组生成器-评分器模型对及1520篇生成文档上验证$h_k$作为跨域熵代理和坍塌检测器的有效性。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B的六代QLoRA坍塌实验中，基于log概率的过滤（最成熟的需模型访问基线）在任何指标上均无显著文本多样性收益（$p>0.23$）；而$h_k$过滤带来唯一三元组$+42\%$、词汇量$+30\%$、重复率$-19\%$（均$p<0.001$）。$h_k$作为跨域熵代理（$\beta=0.924$，$R^2=0.746$）和坍塌检测器（$\rho=+0.454$，$p<0.0001$）在4个领域、2种温度、2组生成器-评分器模型对及1520篇生成文档上均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于信息论的坍塌缓解方法高效可行，$h_k$是一种优越的文本多样性训练数据过滤器，并为维持多智能体多样性提供了新思路。

title: SALD: Self-Referenced Advantage Learning for Diffusion Models
summary: Recent work on language-model adaptation has shown that single models can obtain informative training signals by evaluating their behavior in demonstrationor feedback-augmented contexts, with the help of a teacher network, which is driven by the student's learned parameters. Inspired by this internal-reference principle, we investigate how diffusion models can identify self-referenced training signals without external demonstrations or teacher networks. We introduce SALD, a self-referenced training framework that evaluates each image-caption pair at two noise levels using the same model. The easier, lower-noise path is evaluated without gradient tracking to provide a reference, while the harder, higher-noise path provides the training gradient. Rather than directly distilling the easy-path prediction, SALD uses the difference between two path errors to adapt the hardpath objective. The proposed Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) converts this relative error into a differentiable sample-level weight. Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) accumulates relative difficulty across training and adapts the future gap between the two noise levels. Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) further compares the residual power spectra of the two paths and constructs a differentiable, frequency-derived latent-element weight. All components share a single set of model parameters, requiring neither an external teacher network nor additional trainable parameters during training or inference, and no modification to the inference procedure. Experiments across multiple architectures and datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in generation quality, while component-wise ablations quantify the contributions of the proposed components.

AI.tldr: 提出SALD自参照训练框架，无需外部演示或教师网络，通过同一扩散模型在低噪声（参考）与高噪声（训练）两路径上的相对误差构造训练信号。
AI.motivation: 已有语言模型适配工作表明，借助由学生参数驱动的教师网络，模型可通过在演示或反馈增强上下文中的行为评估获得有信息的训练信号。本文受此"内部参照"原理启发，探究扩散模型如何在无外部演示、无教师网络条件下识别自参照训练信号。
AI.method: SALD对每个图文对在两个噪声水平上用同一模型评估：低噪声易路径不做梯度跟踪以提供参考，高噪声难路径提供训练梯度；不直接蒸馏易路径预测，而用两路径误差之差适配难路径目标。包含三个组件：(1) Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) 将相对误差转为可微的样本级权重；(2) Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) 跨训练累积相对难度并自适应调整两噪声水平间的未来间隔；(3) Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) 比较两路径残差功率谱，构造可微的频域潜元素权重。所有组件共享单一模型参数。
AI.result: 在多种架构和数据集上的实验表明，生成质量获得一致提升；组件消融实验量化了各提出组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需外部教师网络、无额外可训练参数，训练与推理均不改变推理流程。

title: VTR-Bench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Video Generation
summary: Recent video generation models can produce highly realistic videos from natural language instructions, with visual quality approaching cinematic standards. Existing evaluation benchmarks, however, predominantly assess visual quality, aesthetic appeal and physical plausibility, while paying limited attention to text, an essential medium for conveying information in everyday scenes. A generated video may appear visually compelling and feature lifelike subjects, yet still render the text within the scene incorrectly. To address this overlooked dimension, we introduce \textbf{VTR-Bench}, a systematic benchmark for evaluating the \textbf{V}isual \textbf{T}ext \textbf{R}endering capabilities of video generation models. VTR-Bench situates text within concrete application scenarios, such as advertisements and scientific videos, with 300 carefully constructed prompts spanning five scenario categories. We develop an automated evaluation pipeline with human alignments that separately assesses text fidelity through carrier-specific transcription and scene and motion requirements through a prompt-specific chain of query. Beyond evaluation, we introduce a \textbf{Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework} in which a Director agent coordinates image and video generation with visual evaluation, guiding iterative refinement and candidate selection through visual feedback. Experiments on 11 state-of-the-art models reveal widespread difficulties in accurately rendering scene text, with the best-performing model recording an overall word error rate (WER) of 0.250. We further analyze text rendering failures to characterize the challenges faced by current video generation models. These findings highlight visual text rendering as a key challenge for video generation and demonstrate a practical path toward improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/hardenyu21/VTR-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VTR-Bench，一个系统评估视频生成模型视觉文本渲染能力的基准，包含 300 个覆盖五类场景的提示词与自动化评测流水线，并引入关键帧引导的智能体框架进行迭代优化。实验表明 11 个先进模型普遍难以正确渲染场景文本，最佳模型词错误率仍达 0.250。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成评测基准主要关注视觉质量、美学吸引力和物理合理性，对文本这一日常场景中重要的信息载体关注不足。生成视频可能视觉上引人入胜且主体逼真，但场景内文本渲染仍可能出错，这一被忽视的维度亟需系统评估。
AI.method: 提出 VTR-Bench 基准，将文本置于广告、科学视频等具体应用场景，构建覆盖五类场景的 300 个提示词；设计与人评对齐的自动化评测流水线，分别通过载体特定转录评估文本保真度，并通过提示词特定的查询链评估场景与运动要求。此外，提出关键帧引导的智能体框架，由 Director 智能体协调图像与视频生成及视觉评估，借助视觉反馈引导迭代优化与候选选择。
AI.result: 在 11 个先进模型上的实验揭示其在准确渲染场景文本方面普遍存在困难，表现最佳模型的整体词错误率（WER）为 0.250。进一步分析文本渲染失败案例，刻画了当前视频生成模型所面临的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果凸显视觉文本渲染是视频生成的关键挑战，并展示了切实可行的改进路径。代码已在 https://github.com/hardenyu21/VTR-Bench 公开。

title: OverAct: Measuring and Mitigating Proactive Over-Authorization in LLM Tool-Calling Agents
summary: LLM agents with tool-calling capabilities can access external services and private user data, but they may retrieve more information than a user's request explicitly requires. We study this behavior in structured tool-calling agents and term it proactive over-authorization. This setting differs from filesystem-level coding agents because the main risk is unnecessary access to private data. We introduce OverAct, a controlled benchmark spanning eight privacy-sensitive domains with deterministic, judge-free scoring, together with an interpretive decision-theoretic framework that yields three testable predictions. Across seven models from four families, all models significantly exceed authorized scope. Request specificity is the strongest predictor of severity, over-authorization grows sublinearly with tool-pool size, and decoding temperature has little effect. These patterns are consistent with a cost-asymmetry account, suggesting that over-authorization arises more from structural decision tendencies than from decoding randomness. We also propose SelfAudit, a zero-shot inference-time method that generates request-grounded justifications and filters unjustified calls before execution. Ablation shows that explicit filtering is the main driver of scope reduction. SelfAudit reduces privacy-oriented excess by 43% without oracle knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文研究结构化工具调用型LLM智能体的"主动过度授权"行为，提出OverAct基准与决策论框架，发现所有模型均显著超出授权范围，并给出SelfAudit零样本推理期方法，将隐私相关超额访问降低43%。
AI.motivation: 具备工具调用能力的LLM智能体可访问外部服务与私有用户数据，但可能检索超出用户请求明确所需的信息，造成对私有数据的不必要访问，形成隐私风险。该问题区别于文件系统级编码智能体的风险模式，此前缺乏系统性刻画。
AI.method: 提出OverAct受控基准，覆盖八个隐私敏感领域，采用确定性、无需评审的打分；构建解释性决策论框架并推导出三条可检验预测。评估来自四个家族、共七个模型，考察请求具体性、工具池规模、解码温度等因素。另提出SelfAudit零样本推理期方法：生成基于请求依据的说明，在执行前过滤无依据的调用，并进行消融分析。
AI.result: 所有模型均显著超出授权范围；请求具体性是严重程度的最强预测因子；过度授权随工具池规模亚线性增长；解码温度影响甚微。消融显示显式过滤是范围缩减的主要驱动因素。SelfAudit在无先知信息条件下将隐私导向的超额访问降低43%。
AI.conclusion: 过度授权更可能源于结构性决策倾向而非解码随机性，与成本不对称解释一致。SelfAudit通过显式过滤可在推理期有效压缩隐私导向的超额调用范围，为工具调用智能体的隐私保护提供可行路径。

title: FedCKA: Representation-Guided Layer Personalization for Federated 3D Perception Across Driving Domains
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Robust perception in intelligent vehicles demands 3D object detectors that remain dependable under domain shifts, such as changes in time of day, location, or weather. However, due to costly annotation and rare shifts, some environments lack sufficient data to train a standalone detector. Federated learning offers a privacy-preserving framework for collaborative model training, enabling clients to benefit from shared learning across diverse environments. Yet, this framework traditionally relies on a single global consensus model, which struggles to perform across heterogeneous local data distributions. Local conditions are better captured by adapting a subset of the model, but many personalization approaches rely on predefined layer partitions or fixed personalization ratios, thereby limiting adaptation to client-specific divergence. To reduce this rigidity, we propose FedCKA, a Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA)-based strategy that dynamically handles the personalization-globalization trade-off. Specifically, FedCKA computes layer-wise feature similarities between local client models and the global consensus model during training. By converting layer-wise similarity scores into client-specific aggregation masks, FedCKA selectively shares representation-consistent layers. Evaluation on a unified multi-domain benchmark based on nuScenes shows that FedCKA outperforms established federated baselines, including FedBN, FedRep, and FedSelect, improving average NDS by 7 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The findings offer both a comparative benchmark and a promising direction for robust federated 3D perception across shifts in location, weather, and illumination. Code is available at https://github.com/j-verhoog/FedCKA.

AI.tldr: 提出FedCKA：基于CKA的层间相似度动态生成客户端个性化聚合掩码，在nuScenes多域基准上比FedBN/FedRep/FedSelect平均NDS提升7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 智能车辆在时间、地点、天气等域偏移下需鲁棒的3D目标检测，但部分环境因标注成本高、域偏移稀少而缺乏训练独立检测器的数据。联邦学习可隐私保护地协同训练，但传统单一全局共识模型难以适配异构本地分布，现有个人化方法多依赖预设层划分或固定个人化比例，适应性受限。
AI.method: FedCKA在训练中计算本地客户端模型与全局共识模型的逐层特征相似度（Centered Kernel Alignment），将逐层相似度分数转换为客户端特定的聚合掩码，从而选择性共享表示一致的层，动态处理个人化-全局化权衡。
AI.result: 在基于nuScenes的统一多域基准上，FedCKA优于FedBN、FedRep、FedSelect等联邦基线，相对最强基线平均NDS提升7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FedCKA为跨地点、天气、光照偏移的鲁棒联邦3D感知提供了比较基准与有前景的方向，代码已开源。

title: GAW-PO: Preference Optimization with Gradient-Aligned Token Weights
summary: Most preference optimization methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), apply preference supervision at the response level, although autoregressive language models are optimized token by token. As a result, all tokens in a rejected response contribute to the negative training signal, including tokens that may encode behavior that is useful for the preferred response. We introduce GAW-PO, a gradient-aligned token reweighting method for DPO that estimates, for each rejected token, whether penalizing it would interfere with the preferred update directions. Tokens whose gradients are strongly aligned with the preferred behavior receive a weaker negative contribution, while conflicting tokens retain a stronger penalty. Our method achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated preference-optimization methods, improving by 0.97 points over standard DPO and 0.65 points over the strongest competing baseline across 11 benchmarks spanning mathematics, reasoning, coding, and question answering. We further show that gradient-aligned weighting is substantially more robust to aggressive preference optimization: as the DPO regularization parameter $β$ decreases, standard DPO degrades sharply, whereas GAW-PO continues to improve. These results suggest that accounting for the interaction between rejected-token updates and preferred behavior provides an effective form of token-level credit assignment for preference optimization.

AI.tldr: GAW-PO 提出一种梯度对齐的 token 重加权方法用于 DPO，通过判断被拒回复中各 token 的梯度是否与偏好行为方向一致来调整其负向惩罚强度，从而改善 token 级信用分配，在 11 个基准上取得最优平均表现并对超参 β 更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好优化方法（如 DPO）在回复层面施加偏好监督，但自回归语言模型是按 token 优化的。这导致被拒回复中的所有 token 都贡献负向训练信号，其中可能包含对偏好回复同样有用的行为模式，造成误惩罚。
AI.method: 提出 GAW-PO（梯度对齐 token 重加权）：对被拒回复中的每个 token，估计惩罚它是否会干扰偏好更新方向。若该 token 的梯度与偏好行为方向强对齐，则赋予较弱的负向贡献；若方向冲突，则保留较强惩罚。据此在 DPO 框架内进行 token 级重加权。
AI.result: 在涵盖数学、推理、编程和问答的 11 个基准上，GAW-PO 取得所评估偏好优化方法中最高的平均性能，较标准 DPO 提升 0.97 分，较最强竞争基线提升 0.65 分。此外对激进的偏好优化更鲁棒：随着 DPO 正则参数 β 减小，标准 DPO 性能急剧下降，而 GAW-PO 持续改善。
AI.conclusion: 考虑被拒 token 更新与偏好行为之间的相互作用，为偏好优化提供了一种有效的 token 级信用分配形式。

title: VoxelSynth3D: Interpretable Volumetric Image-Domain Metal Artifact Reduction with a Paired Synthetic CLINIC Benchmark
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication at BHI 2026
summary: Metal artifacts in postoperative musculoskeletal CT obscure bone-implant and adjacent soft-tissue interfaces. Many metal artifact reduction (MAR) methods require unavailable raw projections or learned models that may shift across scanners and implants. We present VoxelSynth3D, a training-free 3D image-domain framework for reconstructed CT. The framework combines support masking, normalized tissue synthesis, deviation gating, and restricted edge refinement. Detected implant voxels are preserved in the output, while correction targets metal-induced artifacts in the surrounding tissue. We also construct Synthetic CLINIC-Metal, a controlled paired synthetic evaluation resource, from no-metal CTPelvic1K volumes with clean targets, metal/artifact masks, fixed seeds, and patient-level splits; 75 unpaired real metal cases receive qualitative/no-reference evaluation only. The operating point was fixed in a near-flat validation basin. With exact-mask oracle localization, all methods share a metal-excluded tissue ROI. On 40 held-out cases, VoxelSynth3D reduced RMSE from 801.48 to 786.18 HU (paired gain 15.30 HU, 95% CI 11.68-19.23), improving every case and exceeding the evaluated 3D Gaussian smoother by 13.58 HU. Clean-edge agreement decreased next to metal but exceeded input beyond 5 mm. Thus, VoxelSynth3D provides case-consistent within-distribution tissue-error reduction with a localized structural tradeoff. Spacing-aware sensitivity retained aggregate broad-region improvement and identified near-metal calibration as a target.

AI.tldr: VoxelSynth3D：一种免训练的3D图像域金属伪影抑制框架，在合成配对数据上实现稳定的组织误差降低。
AI.motivation: 术后肌骨CT中金属伪影干扰骨-植入物及邻近软组织界面，而现有MAR方法多依赖不可得的原始投影或易随扫描仪与植入物变化的已学习模型。
AI.method: 提出免训练3D图像域框架VoxelSynth3D，结合支持掩膜、归一化组织合成、偏差门控与受限边缘精修；保留植入物体素，仅校正周围组织的金属伪影。同时构建受控配对合成数据集Synthetic CLINIC-Metal（源自无金属CTPelvic1K，含干净目标、金属/伪影掩膜、固定随机种子与患者级划分），75例无配对真实金属病例仅作定性/无参考评估。工作点固定于近平坦验证盆地，采用精确掩膜oracle定位使各方法共享排除金属的组织ROI。
AI.result: 在40例留出病例上，RMSE由801.48降至786.18 HU（配对增益15.30 HU，95% CI 11.68–19.23），每例均有改善，较所评估的3D高斯平滑器优13.58 HU；金属旁干净边缘一致性下降，但在5 mm外优于输入。
AI.conclusion: VoxelSynth3D可在分布内实现病例一致的体素级组织误差降低，代价是局部结构性折衷；间距感知敏感性分析保持了广域聚合改善，并将近金属校准确定为后续目标。

title: How the Audit Rule Shapes Faithful Factor Explanations in LLMs
summary: Large language models are often asked which input factors influenced their outputs. For structured inputs, such reports can be checked by counterfactual perturbation, but each factor must be queried multiple times to estimate its effect, so verification is usually budget-limited. We study how this limited-budget setting changes the incentive to report factor-level influence truthfully. We formalize the interaction as a verification game and show that proper scoring alone is not enough when auditing depends on the report: report-dependent auditing creates a suppression incentive, because factors reported as important are more likely to be checked and penalized for estimation noise. In contrast, report-independent auditing, or a mixed rule with a small report-independent floor, removes this channel and makes truthful reporting preferable to full suppression. We instantiate the framework with the Counterfactual Brier Score (CBS) and evaluate its predictions on four NLP benchmarks. A synthetic rational agent matches the theoretical prediction exactly, and real LLMs follow the same incentives when they are made explicit. The main design implication is simple: under partial verification, factor-level explanation systems should include a report-independent audit component so that under-reporting cannot be used to avoid scrutiny.

AI.tldr: 该论文将LLM因素级影响报告置于有限预算的反事实验证框架下，形式化为验证博弈，指出报告依赖型审计会产生压低报告（suppression）的动机，而报告无关型审计或带小比例独立底线的混合规则能消除这一动机；结合反事实Brier分数（CBS）在四个NLP基准上验证，合成理性智能体与理论预测完全吻合，真实LLM在动机显式化后也遵循相同激励。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常被询问哪些输入因素影响其输出，结构化输入可通过反事实扰动核查，但每个因素需多次查询估计效应，验证通常受预算限制。论文关注这种有限预算设定如何改变模型如实报告因素级影响（factor-level influence）的激励。
AI.method: 将交互形式化为验证博弈（verification game）；分析纯proper scoring rule在审计依赖报告时的失效；提出报告无关型审计（report-independent auditing）及含小比例报告无关底线的混合规则；实例化为反事实Brier分数（Counterfactual Brier Score, CBS），并在四个NLP基准上评估，对比合成理性智能体与真实LLM。
AI.result: 理论分析表明：报告依赖型审计产生suppression激励，因被报告为重要的因素更易被检查并为估计噪声受罚；报告无关型审计或带小比例独立底线的混合规则可移除该渠道，使如实报告优于完全压低。合成理性智能体与理论预测完全一致，真实LLM在激励显式化时也遵循相同激励。
AI.conclusion: 主要设计启示是：在部分验证（partial verification）下，因素级解释系统应包含报告无关型审计组件，使少报（under-reporting）无法用于规避审查。

title: SuperMotion: Source-Preserving Denoising for Text-Driven Human Motion Editing
summary: Text-driven human motion editing aims to realize a requested change while preserving compatible source content. Existing diffusion editors rely largely on learned conditioning for preservation of the unedited part, yet their outputs can lose temporal detail as denoising proceeds. We propose the \textbf{Source-Preserving Denoising framework (SuperMotion)}, which explicitly reuses the source at each reverse step for source preservation. We first align the source motion to the output timeline and predict a preservation gate that controls reuse across frames and feature dimensions. A clean-space source anchor then utilizes the learned preservation gate to blend the predicted clean motion with the aligned source and passes the corrected estimate directly to the sampling posterior. Because the aligned source is a realized motion rather than a regression output, the anchor injects sample-level temporal detail that a reconstruction-trained denoiser tends to smooth away. To learn effective source reuse, we supervise the anchored estimate against the editing target and match its second temporal differences through a temporal high-frequency loss. These objectives require no explicit edit masks. Extensive experiments show that SuperMotion improves editing accuracy, reaching 33.20\% full-pool R@1 on MotionFix, while reducing temporal-detail attenuation and preserving motion dynamics as it realizes the requested changes. Ablations confirm that the learned preservation gate is responsible for the gain and that it reuses the source to retain the unedited content properly.

AI.tldr: 提出 SuperMotion 框架，通过在扩散反向采样每一步显式复用源运动，缓解文本驱动运动编辑中时序细节衰减问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的文本驱动运动编辑器主要依靠学习到的条件注入来保持未编辑内容，但随着去噪推进，输出容易丢失时序细节。
AI.method: SuperMotion 在每个反向步显式复用源运动：先将源运动对齐到输出时间线，预测一个跨帧与特征维度控制复用程度的 preservation gate；再用 clean-space 源锚点按门控将预测的干净运动与对齐源混合，把校正估计直接送入采样后验。由于对齐源是已实现的运动而非回归输出，可注入被重建训练的降噪器抹平的样本级时序细节。学习时以编辑目标监督锚定估计，并用时序高频损失匹配其二阶时间差分，无需显式编辑掩码。
AI.result: 在 MotionFix 上达到 33.20% full-pool R@1，编辑准确率优于基线，同时减少时序细节衰减、保持运动动态。消融实验证实增益来自学习到的 preservation gate，其通过复用源正确保留未编辑内容。
AI.conclusion: 显式源复用是提升文本驱动运动编辑中源保持与细节保留的有效途径，且无需编辑掩码监督。

title: Towards Reliable Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language models (VLMs) are increasingly being explored in autonomous driving for tasks such as scene understanding, driving reasoning, decision-making, and end-to-end driving. As their role becomes more prominent, ensuring their robustness and reliability is increasingly important. In real-world conditions, visual inputs may be degraded by sensor imperfections and environmental conditions, potentially affecting both model predictions and their associated confidence. Such degradation is especially concerning in autonomous driving, where safety-critical decisions require models to make accurate predictions and recognize when their predictions may be unreliable. In this work, we evaluate five VLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, LLaVA-OneVision-7B, DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B, and NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B) across four driving-related QA datasets with different visual input settings, including single-frame, multi-view, multi-frame, and monocular inputs. Our results show that the effects of visual corruption vary across models, datasets, and input settings, with changes in accuracy and confidence reliability and also differing across conditions. We then apply Visual Evidence Augmentation ($\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$), a recent inference-time method to examine whether it can improve model reliability under degraded visual conditions. We find that $\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$ improves performance for some models and datasets, although the gains are not consistent across all settings.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了五种视觉语言模型在四类驾驶相关问答数据集及不同视觉输入设置下的鲁棒性，并检验了视觉证据增强（VEA）方法在视觉退化条件下提升模型可靠性的效果。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在自动驾驶中的场景理解、推理与决策任务中日益重要，而真实环境中传感器缺陷和环境因素会退化视觉输入，可能同时影响预测结果及其置信度。在安全攸关的自动驾驶场景下，模型不仅要预测准确，还需识别自身预测何时不可靠，因此有必要系统评估其鲁棒性与可靠性。
AI.method: 选取五个视觉语言模型（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-E4B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B、DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B、NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B），在四个驾驶相关问答数据集上设置单帧、多视角、多帧和单目等不同视觉输入条件，考察视觉损坏对准确率和置信度可靠性的影响；随后应用推理时方法视觉证据增强（VEA），检验其在退化视觉条件下能否提升模型可靠性。
AI.result: 视觉损坏的影响因模型、数据集和输入设置而异，准确率与置信度可靠性的变化在不同条件下表现不同。VEA对部分模型和数据集有性能提升，但增益并不在所有设置下保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型在自动驾驶中的鲁棒性与置信度可靠性对视觉退化高度敏感且表现不一致；VEA可带来一定改善但缺乏普适性，说明在退化视觉条件下保障模型可靠性仍具挑战，需要更具一致性的方法。

title: Synthetic training for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation in data-scarce settings
summary: Cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) and cortical superficial siderosis (cSS) are imaging markers of cerebral small vessel disease, but their automated segmentation is limited by the scarcity of positive cases and voxel-level annotations. We propose a synthetic training framework for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation that requires no real lesion annotations for training and leverages radiological description of the lesions. Starting from anatomical brain parcellations, the framework applies spatial augmentation and voxel resampling, procedurally inserts cSS and CMB labels using clinical priors on lesion location and morphology, and synthesises images through randomised intensity assignment, blurring, and Rician noise simulation. Models were trained on dynamically generated image-label pairs and evaluated against manual delineations in 10 cSS cases and 13 CMB cases. The proposed configurations outperformed classical filter baselines. For cSS, the hypointensity constrained model achieved higher AUPRC and AUROC than the Frangi filter (AUPRC: 0.284 vs 0.083; AUROC: 0.907 vs 0.731). For CMBs, explicit synthesis of blood vessels as lesion mimics improved performance over the classical baseline (AUPRC: 0.538 vs 0.004; AUROC: 0.999 vs 0.968). These results support our proposal as a feasible strategy for data-scarce haemorrhagic lesion segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需真实病灶标注的合成训练框架，用于长尾分布的脑出血性病灶（脑微出血CMB与皮层表面铁沉积cSS）分割，性能优于经典滤波基线。
AI.motivation: CMB与cSS是脑小血管病的影像标志物，但其自动分割受限于阳性病例稀少且缺乏体素级标注，数据稀缺导致长尾问题严重。
AI.method: 以解剖脑分区为起点，采用空间增强与体素重采样，依据病灶位置与形态的临床先验程序化插入cSS和CMB标签，并通过随机强度分配、模糊和Rician噪声模拟合成图像；模型在动态生成的图像-标签对上训练，无需真实病灶标注；额外通过显式合成血管作为病灶混淆项提升CMB表现。
AI.result: 在10例cSS和13例CMB病例上与人工勾画对比评估。cSS中低信号约束模型优于Frangi滤波（AUPRC 0.284 vs 0.083，AUROC 0.907 vs 0.731）；CMB中显式合成血管使性能大幅提升（AUPRC 0.538 vs 0.004，AUROC 0.999 vs 0.968）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该合成训练框架是数据稀缺条件下出血性病灶分割的一种可行策略。

title: Revisiting Cross-Reconstruction for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
summary: Existing image forgery detectors often suffer from generalization to unseen manipulation methods due to the limited ability to capture transferable forensic cues. Recent cross-reconstruction based methods attempt to improve generalization through semantic-artifact disentanglement, but typically align heterogeneous artifacts across generators and exclude artifact representations during reconstruction, which may overlook the inherent diversity and visual cues of manipulation artifacts. In this work, we revisit cross-reconstruction and introduce an artifact-oriented disentanglement framework for robust image forgery detection. We argue that \textbf{artifact diversity}, i.e., the intrinsic variations of manipulation artifacts introduced by different generation processes, contains complementary forensic cues rather than undesirable domain variations. Instead of enforcing explicit artifact alignment, our framework preserves diverse artifact characteristics through semantically aligned cross-generator reconstruction. Furthermore, we incorporate artifact representations into the reconstruction process and introduce a masked frequency-aware reconstruction strategy to emphasize manipulation-related residuals while reducing semantic interference. This design enables the model to learn transferable forensic representations from diverse artifacts. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate improvements under both cross-dataset and cross-generator evaluation settings. Further analysis and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of artifact diversity preservation and artifact-aware cross-reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向伪影（artifact-oriented）的解纠缠框架，通过语义对齐的跨生成器重建保留伪影多样性，并将伪影表征纳入重建过程，结合掩码频率感知重建策略，提升图像伪造检测的跨数据集与跨生成器泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有图像伪造检测器对未见操控方法泛化性不足，难以捕获可迁移的取证线索。近期基于跨重建的方法试图通过语义-伪影解纠缠提升泛化性，但通常对异构伪影进行跨生成器对齐，并在重建时排除伪影表征，从而忽视了操控伪影的内在多样性与视觉线索。
AI.method: 重新审视跨重建范式，提出面向伪影的解纠缠框架。核心观点是伪影多样性（不同生成过程引入的操控伪影内在差异）包含互补取证线索而非不良域变化。方法上不做显式伪影对齐，而是通过语义对齐的跨生成器重建保留多样伪影特征；同时将伪影表征纳入重建过程，并引入掩码频率感知重建策略以强调操控相关残差、降低语义干扰，从而学习可迁移的取证表征。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，在跨数据集和跨生成器两种评测设定下均取得性能提升。进一步的分析与消融实验验证了伪影多样性保留与伪影感知跨重建的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 伪影多样性应被视为互补取证线索而非需消除的域差异；保留多样性并结合伪影感知的跨重建与频率感知掩码策略，可有效提升图像伪造检测的泛化性能。

title: From Rules to Neural Graphs: Scalable Structured Prediction for Patent Prior Art Search
comment: Accepted for publication at the ECML PKDD 2026 conference (Applied Data Science track)
summary: Patent search requires processing documents routinely exceeding tens of thousands of tokens. Most neural retrieval approaches operate on truncated inputs, limiting their effectiveness. Graph-based retrieval addresses this by representing each patent as a structured invention graph, but constructing these graphs relies on brittle rule-based parsers. We present the neural parser, which adapts biaffine attention from dependency parsing to predict invention graphs directly from patent text. Our local biaffine attention restricts pairwise scoring to a sliding window, reducing complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n \cdot w)$. Since local and global scoring share the same weights, the model trains on short sequences and deploys on documents exceeding 40,000 tokens without retraining. Distilled from 1 million rule-parsed documents, it surpasses its teacher at 3$\times$ lower inference cost: neural graphs improve citation recall by 0.5% on short queries and 1.1% on full documents in a downstream Graph Transformer retrieval system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经解析器，将依存句法中的双仿射注意力适配为直接从专利文本预测发明图谱，用滑动窗口局部双仿射注意力把复杂度从O(n²)降到O(n·w)，可在短序列训练后直接部署于超4万token文档，检索召回率优于规则教师模型且推理成本降低3倍。
AI.motivation: 专利检索需处理常超数万token的文档，主流神经检索方法受限于截断输入而效果受损；基于图谱的检索以结构化发明图谱表示专利，但其构建依赖脆弱的规则解析器，成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出神经解析器，把依存句法中的双仿射注意力迁移用于从专利文本直接预测发明图谱；采用局部双仿射注意力，将成对打分限制在滑动窗口内，复杂度由O(n²)降至O(n·w)；局部与全局打分共享同一套权重，使模型可在短序列上训练、在超4万token文档上直接部署而无需重训；以100万份规则解析文档进行知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 神经解析器在推理成本降低3倍的情况下性能超越其规则教师模型；在下游Graph Transformer检索系统中，神经图谱使短查询的引用召回率提升0.5%，完整文档提升1.1%。
AI.conclusion: 神经解析器以局部双仿射注意力实现了可扩展、无需重训即可迁移到长文档的发明图谱预测，既克服规则解析器的脆弱性，又在更低推理成本下提升下游专利检索效果，为长文档结构化检索提供了可行方案。

title: QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning
summary: Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda, which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection (keys for query weights, and queries for key weights), allowing both projections to share a pruning budget. Its closed-form scores require no gradients or weight updates; full pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200 with the calibration used in our main experiments.
