Empirically, VETO achieves up to 45% faster inference (e.g., on LLaVA-OneVision-7B) while preserving or improving accuracy. Under extreme token starvation (10% budget), VETO outperforms VFlowOpt (54.9%), VisionZip (52.6%), and FastV (47.9%) with 55.7% accuracy. We demonstrate universal applicability across LLaVA-OneVision, InternVL-2.5, and LongVA, with zero-shot accuracy preserved or improved in all cases.

AI.tldr: VETO是一种免训练的视频VLM视觉token压缩插件，通过先空间后时间的双轴分层压缩，突破单轴压缩的效率瓶颈，实现最高45%推理加速并保持或提升精度。
AI.motivation: 长视频VLM推理受视觉token二次方成本制约，长时段推理代价高昂。现有单轴压缩方法仅独立处理空间或时间冗余，存在效率下限（hard efficiency floor），难以进一步降低开销。
AI.method: VETO采用双轴压缩的分层顺序设计：（i）帧内压缩器基于最优传输启发的匹配，合并每帧内语义相似的token；（ii）帧间压缩器识别并合并时间冗余帧。关键洞察是先压缩空间维度，大幅降低后续全局时间匹配的成本，从而绕过单轴方法的效率墙，且优势随现代全融合注意力基础设施增强。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-OneVision-7B上实现最高45%推理加速，精度保持或提升；极端token预算（10%）下以55.7%准确率超越VFlowOpt（54.9%）、VisionZip（52.6%）和FastV（47.9%）；在LLaVA-OneVision、InternVL-2.5、LongVA上均验证通用性，零样本准确率全部保持或提升。
AI.conclusion: VETO作为免训练即插即用模块，通过双轴分层token压缩有效解决长视频VLM推理效率瓶颈，兼顾效率与精度，具备跨模型通用适用性。

title: Continuous Conditioning of VLAs with Augmenting EMG and Visual Task Descriptors
comment: Presented at IROS WORLDS Workshop 2026. Four main pages double-column format plus references and appendices
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely strongly on language for describing task information, despite having multimodal inputs. We hypothesize that other modalities in the state space may present opportunities for supplemental task conditioning, which may be particularly relevant in cluttered or otherwise ambiguous scenes. We introduce two tuned models to test this hypothesis: (1) an electrophysiology-conditioned VLA (EC-VLA) that incorporates 8-channel electromyography envelopes as continuous conditioning input concatenated to the proprioceptive vector, and (2) a visually-annotated VLA (VA-VLA) that incorporates visual segmentation annotations to the image inputs. On a cube-selection task evaluated across three participants, EC-VLA matches a language-prompted baseline in uncluttered, in-distribution conditions and substantially outperforms it in cluttered, out-of-distribution scenes. Similarly, VA-VLA shows modest improvements over a language-prompted baseline in in-distribution scenes with substantial improvement in cluttered, out-of-distribution trials. Together, these results provide strong evidence for the potential benefit of task-conditioning beyond language.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并验证了超越语言的额外模态任务条件化对VLA模型的价值：肌电条件化的EC-VLA与视觉分割标注条件化的VA-VLA在杂乱、分布外场景下均显著优于语言提示基线。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽有多模态输入，但任务信息几乎完全依赖语言描述。作者假设状态空间中的其他模态可提供补充性任务条件，尤其在杂乱或语义歧义的场景中语言描述不足时更具价值。
AI.method: 作者设计了两个微调模型进行验证：(1) EC-VLA，将8通道肌电包络作为连续条件输入，拼接至本体感受向量；(2) VA-VLA，在图像输入中加入视觉分割标注。在三个被试参与的立方体选择任务上，与语言提示基线进行对比评测，涵盖无杂乱（分布内）与杂乱（分布外）两类场景。
AI.result: EC-VLA在无杂乱分布内条件下与语言提示基线持平，在杂乱分布外场景中大幅超越基线；VA-VLA在分布内场景中较基线有小幅提升，在杂乱分布外试验中提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 结果有力支持了超越语言的任务条件化（如生理信号、视觉标注）的潜在收益，为VLA模型在复杂环境下的鲁棒性提升提供了新思路。

title: A Safe Prototype Is Not a Safety Direction: Reference Dependence and Prompt Confounds in Response-Safety Embeddings
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec). 15 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code, results, and a verifier are in the ancillary files
summary: Can response safety be scored by cosine similarity to the mean embedding of known-safe responses? A recent sleeper-agent detector proposes exactly this score, yet the raw positive-centroid rule is not identified: positive observations locate the safe class relative to an encoder origin, but do not determine which direction separates safe from unsafe responses. We audit the rule on two prompt-controlled, human-labeled corpora and one auxiliary jury-labeled source control, using four frozen encoders and prompt-grouped splits. On the human-labeled corpora the safe prototype reaches ROC-AUC 0.457-0.545, with two cells significantly below chance and one above, while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference reaches 0.588-0.738 on the same embeddings; on the jury control the prototype is inverted (0.358-0.405) and the reference reaches 0.754-0.793. At validation-calibrated 5% false-safe thresholds, the reference accepts more safe responses on PKU-SafeRLHF (0.153-0.263 versus 0.039-0.061 across encoders) and Aegis (0.189-0.291 versus 0.004-0.045), but not reliably on BeaverTails. A fully unlabeled held-out reference recovers part to most of the referenced ranking, much less when only 5% of the pool is unsafe, whereas 80-634 labeled unsafe responses recover most of it. Prompt-only ablations show that prompt-label composition can inflate uncontrolled evaluations. This is a bounded result about a raw positive centroid, not all one-class methods or safety-specialized guards. A class mean is a location, not necessarily a safety direction; a declared reference with enough unsafe mass identifies orientation.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了"以安全和已知安全响应均值嵌入的余弦相似度"作为安全评分规则的做法，认为原始的正质心规则无法识别安全方向，需借助显式安全-不安全参考集才能确定方向。
AI.motivation: 近期某sleep-agent检测器提出用响应与已知安全响应均值嵌入的余弦相似度来评分安全性，但原始的正质心规则存在缺陷：正样本仅能定位安全类相对于编码器原点的位置，无法确定区分安全与不安全响应的方向。
AI.method: 在两个提示控制、人工标注的语料库及一个辅助陪审团标注的源控制集上审计该规则，使用四个冻结编码器和按提示分组的划分；并对比显式"安全减不安全"参考集的表现。
AI.result: 人工标注语料上安全原型ROC-AUC仅0.457-0.545（两格显著低于随机、一格高于随机），显式参考达0.588-0.738；陪审团控制集上原型反转（0.358-0.405），参考达0.754-0.793。在校准后5%假安全阈值下，参考在PKU-SafeRLHF和Aegis上接受更多安全响应，但在BeaverTails上不稳定。无标签参考可部分恢复排序，不安全占比仅5%时恢复较差，80-634个标注不安全响应可恢复大部分。提示词消融显示提示-标签组成会夸大未受控评估。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为关于原始正质心的有限结论，不适用于所有单类方法或安全专用守卫；类均值是位置而非安全方向，只有带足够不安全样本的显式参考才能确定方向。

title: PhaseAT: Fourier Phase Adversarial Training for Medical Image Domain Generalization
comment: The paper is accepted in MICCAI 2026
summary: Reliable clinical deployment of deep medical image models is hindered by distribution shifts across scanners, sites, and acquisition protocols. Existing domain generalization (DG) methods often focus on style or intensity diversification, but they can still leave networks dependent on domain-specific texture correlations. Inspired by evidence that Fourier phase encodes semantic structure, we introduce PhaseAT, a phase-aware adversarial training framework for medical DG. PhaseAT forms phase-perturbed training views in the Fourier domain by iteratively updating a bounded phase perturbation while keeping the amplitude spectrum unchanged, thereby stressing spatial organization under matched appearance statistics. Perturbations are applied only to the luminance channel in YCbCr color space to avoid chromatic artifacts. Additionally, a simple phase-saliency mask concentrates updates on the most influential frequencies. The model is trained with a weighted combination of losses on clean and phase-perturbed samples, supporting both single-source and multi-source DG. We validate our method on two challenging medical datasets and demonstrate that PhaseAT achieves over 20% improvement in single-source domain generalization, outperforming several state-of-the-art DG methods. The code implementation is available at: https://github.com/ahmed-sharshar/PhaseAT.

AI.tldr: PhaseAT：一种基于傅里叶相位对抗扰动的医学图像领域泛化框架，在保持幅度谱不变的前提下迭代生成相位扰动视图，并仅在YCbCr亮度通道施加扰动，配合相位显著性掩码聚焦关键频率，在单源与多源DG上均超越多个SOTA方法，单源场景提升超过20%。
AI.motivation: 深层医学图像模型在跨扫描仪、跨站点、跨采集协议部署时受分布偏移影响而不可靠。现有领域泛化（DG）方法多聚焦风格或强度多样化，但仍可能使网络依赖域特有的纹理相关性，未能真正削弱对表观统计的依赖。
AI.method: 受傅里叶相位编码语义结构这一证据启发，提出PhaseAT相位感知对抗训练框架。在傅里叶域通过迭代更新有界相位扰动、保持幅度谱不变，构造相位扰动训练视图，从而在表观统计匹配条件下施压空间组织结构；扰动仅施加于YCbCr颜色空间的亮度通道以避免色度伪影；另引入简单的相位显著性掩码，将更新集中于最具影响力的频率；训练采用干净样本与相位扰动样本上的加权损失组合，兼容单源与多源DG。
AI.result: 在两个具有挑战性的医学数据集上验证，PhaseAT在单源领域泛化上取得超过20%的提升，优于多个当前最先进（SOTA）的DG方法。代码开源：https://github.com/ahmed-sharshar/PhaseAT。
AI.conclusion: 相位域对抗扰动可有效削弱医学图像模型对域特有纹理相关性的依赖，为医学领域泛化提供了一条区别于风格/强度多样化思路的有效途径，且实现简单、可同时适用于单源与多源设置。

title: Beyond Linear Concepts: Discovering and Aligning Non-Linear Concept Manifolds in Large Language Models
summary: Understanding information processing in large language models (LLMs) requires dissecting the geometric organization of their internal token representations. While existing mechanistic interpretability (MI) methods seek to extract concepts, they are constrained by a strong linearity assumption challenged by evidence of non-linear feature manifolds. We move beyond linear concepts by adapting Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) from computer vision to token-level LLM activations, modeling concepts as low-dimensional manifolds. To compare concept manifolds across layers and models, we introduce a concept-based alignment (CBA) score, a generalized Rand index that measures geometric proximity without explicit feature matching. Our analysis yields six key findings: (i) a neighboring-layer sanity check shows CBA is more sensitive than PCA- or CKA-based linear baselines; (ii) layer-by-layer alignment matrices reveal two block structures in intermediate and late layers, consistent across models and obscured by linear metrics; (iii) concept composition remains syntax-dominated through most of the network before giving way to increasingly mixed syntactic-semantic concepts in later layers, with increasing output-orientation toward the final layers; (iv) multilingual concept sharing between English and Mandarin is training-dependent rather than universal, strongest in Qwen, weaker in Llama, and absent in GPT-2; (v) inter-model alignment mirrors this structure, with strong correspondence between same-family Qwen models of different scale but weak alignment across model families; and (vi) across Tulu-3 training stages, alignment is highest between adjacent stages, with the largest shift between the base model and SFT, while subsequent preference-alignment stages (DPO, RLVR) leave early layers largely unchanged and RLVR mostly preserves DPO's concepts in late layers.

AI.tldr: 该论文将非线性多维概念发现方法从计算机视觉迁移到LLM token级激活，提出概念对齐分数CBA，在跨层与跨模型比较中揭示六个关键发现。
AI.motivation: 现有机械可解释性方法多假设特征空间线性可分，但证据显示特征呈非线性流形结构，因此需要超越线性概念、以低维流形建模概念并进行几何对齐比较。
AI.method: 采用NLMCD对LLM激活进行token级低维流形概念建模；提出基于概念的对齐分数CBA（广义Rand指数），无需显式特征匹配即可度量几何邻近性；用CBA比较不同层、不同模型的概念流形。
AI.result: (i) CBA比PCA/CKA线性基线更敏感；(ii) 中后期层出现两个块结构；(iii) 多数网络层概念以句法为主，后期转向句法-语义混合并增强输出导向；(iv) 英汉多语概念共享依赖训练，Qwen最强、Llama较弱、GPT-2缺失；(v) 同族Qwen跨规模对齐强、跨族弱；(vi) Tulu-3中相邻阶段对齐最高，base到SFT变化最大，DPO/RLVR对早期层影响小。
AI.conclusion: 非线性流形概念建模与CBA可揭示线性指标掩盖的层间块结构与训练阶段演化规律，为LLM内部表征的几何组织提供新分析框架。

title: The Asymptotics of Language Model Alignment with Memory
summary: Language model (LM) alignment broadly aims to perturb a given LM $Q$ into an aligned LM $q$ such that i) the outputs produced by $q$ and $Q$ are 'close' in probability, ii) $q$ has a higher expected reward than $Q$. Two common techniques for LM alignment are: KL-constrained RL, which requires knowledge of the LM distribution and is computationally expensive, and the best-of-$n$ algorithm, which requires only sampling from the LM. The work of Yang et al. established asymptotic closeness between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods for an $m$--length i.i.d. token sequence output by the LM, in the limit as $m$ increases to infinity. However, the i.i.d. assumption is not representative of practical LMs, whose output sequences often have memory. In this paper, we extend the asymptotic closeness result to the case when the $m$--length token sequence outputted by the LM is Markovian. Further, for finite-length output sequences -- particularly, when $m=1$ -- we provide a complete characterization of LM distributions and reward functions for which the KL-divergence between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods is zero -- a question first posed in Yang et al.

AI.tldr: 本文将KL约束RL与best-of-n两种对齐方法的分布渐近接近性结果，从i.i.d. token序列推广到马尔可夫序列，并对有限长度（特别是m=1）情形给出了KL散度为零的完整刻画。
AI.motivation: 已有工作（Yang等）在两个对齐方法间建立了渐近分布接近性，但依赖token序列i.i.d.假设，与真实LM输出存在记忆性不符；同时有限长度下KL散度为零的条件尚属未解问题。
AI.method: 在m长度token序列服从马尔可夫链的假设下，重新推导并证明KL约束RL与best-of-n两种对齐方法所产生分布的渐近接近性；针对有限长度情形（重点为m=1），完整刻画使两方法分布间KL散度为零的LM分布与奖励函数条件。
AI.result: 将渐近接近性结论成功推广至马尔可夫输出序列；并在m=1等有限长度下，给出KL散度为零时LM分布与奖励函数的完整充要刻画，解答了Yang等提出的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究放宽了原有i.i.d.限制，使理论更贴近实际LM的记忆性输出，并为理解两种对齐方法在有限长度下的等价性提供了精确条件。

title: Beyond Decodability: Do Acoustic Factors Drive Predictions in Speech-Based Alzheimer's Assessment?
summary: Speech-based Alzheimer's disease (AD) assessments increasingly rely on pretrained self-supervised learning (SSL) models that learn acoustic representations directly from raw audio, exposing the model to recording factors. We ask whether such factors are merely encoded in SSL representations or can systematically alter predictions. Using ADReSSo and three large SSL backbones, we apply controlled noise and reverberation interventions to participant-speech-only, non-speech, and full-recording audio. We combine layer-wise linear decoding, input- and representation-space interventions, and geometric alignment analysis to distinguish acoustic decodability from influence on AD prediction. Our results show that controlled acoustic interventions alter AD predictions across all three SSL backbones. Noise, despite showing no significant diagnostic-group difference in the original data, produces the strongest intervention effects. Importantly, these effects are systematically structured relative to the classifier's decision direction, replicate on the held-out test set and reverse when the representation-space intervention direction is reversed. Together, these findings show that high predictive performance and the absence of a significant diagnostic-group difference in a measured acoustic factor are not sufficient for robustness. We argue that intervention-based robustness tests should become standard for trustworthy clinical speech models.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验预训练自监督语音模型是否会因录音因素（噪声、混响）系统性地改变阿尔茨海默病预测，结果显示受控声学干预确实能改变预测，且该效应沿分类器决策方向结构化并与表示空间干预方向可逆，说明高预测性能与组间差异不显著并不足以保证鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 基于语音的AD评估日益依赖自监督学习模型直接从原始音频学习声学表示，这使得模型暴露于录音相关因素。作者关注的核心问题是：这些录音因素只是被编码进SSL表示，还是能够系统性地改变AD预测结果。
AI.method: 使用ADReSSo数据集与三个大型SSL骨干模型，对仅参与者语音、非语音和整段录音施加受控的噪声与混响干预；结合逐层线性解码、输入空间与表示空间干预，以及几何对齐分析，以区分“声学可解码性”与“对AD预测的影响”。
AI.result: 受控声学干预在三个SSL骨干上均改变了AD预测。噪声在原始数据中未表现出显著诊断组间差异，却产生最强的干预效应。这些效应相对分类器决策方向呈系统性结构，在留出测试集上可复现，且当表示空间干预方向反转时效应也随之反转。
AI.conclusion: 高预测性能以及某一声学因素缺乏显著诊断组间差异，都不足以证明模型鲁棒。作者主张将基于干预的鲁棒性测试纳入可信临床语音模型的标准评估流程。

title: Detecting Inconsistencies in Model Specifications with LLM-as-Verifier Reasoning
summary: Model specifications define how large language models (LLMs) should behave, guiding alignment training, inference-time behavior, and evaluation. Yet these specifications may themselves contain defects: two individually reasonable principles may prescribe incompatible behavior when applied to the same situation, leaving no response that satisfies both. Detecting such inconsistencies is challenging. Formalizing natural-language specifications risks losing subtle distinctions, while behavior-based testing cannot reliably distinguish specification defects from differences in model behavior. We introduce VeriSpec, the first approach to directly detect inconsistencies in model specifications by auditing the specification text itself. Our key insight is to preserve the specification in natural language while using an LLM as a verifier. VeriSpec extracts structured, context-aware rules, constructs a topic-guided graph to cluster behaviorally related rules at the same authority level, and applies LLM-as-verifier reasoning to detect inconsistencies. Applying VeriSpec to the OpenAI Model Spec, we extract 405 rules and manually validate five inconsistencies, all reported to its developers, who responded positively and have initiated internal discussions. Compared with five baselines, VeriSpec identifies the most validated inconsistencies, achieves the highest precision (38.5%), and incurs the lowest cost per validated inconsistency ($11.12). These results establish direct specification auditing as a practical complement to behavioral alignment evaluation, catching defects at the source before they shape any model. The code is available at https://github.com/HIPREL-Group/VeriSpec.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VeriSpec，这是首个直接审计规范文本本身以检测模型规范中不一致性的方法。VeriSpec 在保留自然语言规范的同时，利用 LLM 作为验证器，通过提取结构化、上下文感知的规则，构建主题引导图对同一权威层级下行为相关的规则进行聚类，并应用 LLM-as-verifier 推理来检测不一致性。
AI.motivation: 模型规范定义了大型语言模型应如何行为，指导对齐训练、推理时行为和评估。然而这些规范本身可能存在缺陷：两条单独合理的准则在应用于同一情境时可能规定不兼容的行为，导致没有任何回应能同时满足两者。检测此类不一致性颇具挑战性——将自然语言规范形式化可能丢失细微差别，而基于行为的测试无法可靠区分规范缺陷与模型行为差异。
AI.method: VeriSpec 的核心洞见是在保留自然语言规范的同时使用 LLM 作为验证器。该方法提取结构化、上下文感知的规则，构建主题引导图（topic-guided graph）以聚类同一权威层级下行为相关的规则，并应用 LLM-as-verifier 推理来检测不一致性。
AI.result: 将 VeriSpec 应用于 OpenAI Model Spec，提取出 405 条规则，并人工验证了五处不一致性，均已报告给其开发者，开发者回应积极并已启动内部讨论。与五个基线相比，VeriSpec 识别出最多经验证的不一致性，达到最高精确率（38.5%），且每个经验证不一致性的成本最低（11.12 美元）。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了直接规范审计作为行为对齐评估的实用补充，能够在缺陷影响任何模型之前从源头捕获它们。代码见 https://github.com/HIPREL-Group/VeriSpec。

title: LiteReality-Agent: An Agentic System for Interactable 3D Indoor Scene Reconstruction
summary: We present LiteReality-Agent, an agentic system for reconstructing real indoor environments as realistic, articulated, and simulation-ready 3D scenes from RGB-D scans. At its core, LiteReality-Agent formulates 3D reconstruction as a coding problem, in which a coding agent gathers evidence using specialised tools and iteratively edits a Python script, Room.py, which can be executed to produce a 3D digital twin of the room. With this formulation, we develop a robust observe-edit-verify harness that supports evidence gathering, measurement, verification, layout optimisation, simulation readiness, and quality control throughout the reconstruction process. LiteReality-Agent produces high-quality reconstructions suitable for simulation and downstream embodied AI tasks. Furthermore, as agent capabilities continue to improve rapidly, the system introduced by LiteReality-Agent remains a strong orchestration framework for future agents: it equips them with specialised tools, structured workflows, and robust verification mechanisms that substantially improve reconstruction quality and reliability. We demonstrate that LiteReality-Agent produces reconstructions that are more geometrically accurate, visually realistic, and simulation-compatible than those generated by recent frontier models, such as Astra and Fable. We therefore view LiteReality-Agent as a practical and important building block for robust real-to-sim systems. Both the source code and the data-capture application are publicly available. Code:https://github.com/LiteReality/LiteReality-Agent/

AI.tldr: LiteReality-Agent 将室内 3D 重建建模为"编码问题"，通过编码智能体调用专用工具、迭代编辑 Room.py 脚本，配合 observe-edit-verify 闭环框架，从 RGB-D 扫描生成真实、可动、可仿真的 3D 数字孪生。
AI.motivation: 需要从 RGB-D 扫描获得既几何精确、视觉真实，又能直接用于下游具身 AI 仿真的室内 3D 场景；现有前沿模型（如 Astra、Fable）在几何精度、视觉真实感与仿真兼容性方面仍不足。
AI.method: 把 3D 重建转化为编码任务：编码智能体借助专用工具采集证据，并迭代编辑可执行的 Python 脚本 Room.py 来生成房间数字孪生；构建 observe-edit-verify 鲁棒执行框架，覆盖证据采集、测量、验证、布局优化、仿真适配与质量控制。
AI.result: 重建结果在几何精度、视觉真实感与仿真兼容性上均优于 Astra、Fable 等近期前沿模型，且适用于仿真与下游具身 AI 任务。
AI.conclusion: LiteReality-Agent 是 robust real-to-sim 系统的重要实用构件；其专用工具、结构化工作流与验证机制也构成面向未来更强智能体的通用编排框架。代码与数据采集应用已公开。

title: From Pixels to Policy: A Multi-Agent System for Intervention and Geo-Spatial Decision Support
summary: Urban environments are shaped by design choices with long-term implications for health, safety, and quality of life, yet evaluating proposed interventions remains costly, time-consuming, and often impractical. Existing geospatial vision methods largely focus on monitoring urban indicators from aerial and street-view imagery, rather than proposing interventions and estimating their effects on such indicators. Moving beyond recognition, we introduce the problem of discovering interventions that improve target indicators for a given aerial or street-view image. We argue that a black-box indicator model, combined with a generative editing model, can serve as an implicit digital twin for testing intervention hypotheses. We present VIDA-Geo , a multi-agent system that explores this intervention space by coordinating segmentation, diffusion-based inpainting, and indicator scoring models to produce interventions that are both perceptually realistic and aligned with real-world policies. We evaluate our system on 8 indicators across aerial and street-view imagery, measuring changes in factors such as perceived safety and greenery. Our approach outperforms existing baselines in many cases, achieving up to 2X higher perceptual quality and policy alignment scores. Finally, our model provides users with multiple candidate interventions, supporting an expert city-planner-in-the-loop workflow.

AI.tldr: 提出"干预发现"这一新问题：利用黑盒指标模型+生成式编辑模型构建隐式数字孪生，通过多智能体系统VIDA-Geo协调分割、扩散修复与指标评分，为航拍/街景图像生成既感知真实又符合政策的城市干预方案。
AI.motivation: 城市设计决策对健康、安全与生活质量有长期影响，但评估拟议干预成本高、耗时长、常不可行；现有地理空间视觉方法多聚焦于从航拍和街景影像中监测城市指标，而非提出干预并估计其对指标的影响。
AI.method: 将问题定义为：针对给定航拍或街景图像，发现能改善目标指标的干预方案。论证黑盒指标模型与生成式编辑模型的组合可作为测试干预假设的隐式数字孪生。提出多智能体系统VIDA-Geo，协调分割、基于扩散的修复（inpainting）以及指标评分模型，在此干预空间中搜索，从而生成感知真实且与真实世界政策一致的干预。
AI.result: 在航拍与街景影像上对8项指标（如感知安全、绿视率等）进行评估，测量指标变化。该方法在多数情况下优于现有基线，感知质量与政策一致性得分最高提升2倍；同时为用户提供多个候选干预方案。
AI.conclusion: VIDA-Geo支持专家城市规划者在环（expert city-planner-in-the-loop）的工作流程，将城市干预评估从被动监测推进到主动假设检验，为可扩展、低成本的干预发现提供新范式。

title: Where LLMs Fail with Visualization DSLs
summary: As LLMs take up the role of authoring charts using visualization domain-specific languages (DSLs), the human constraints that shaped those languages may no longer apply, as what is easy for a person is not necessarily easy for a model. To understand how LLMs might work better with DSLs, we explore where and how they fail with current DSL designs. We evaluate 10 JSON-style visualization DSLs with 41 tasks across 3 LLMs, then assess the generated specifications with JSON and rendering checks, and qualitative coding of failed cases. Analyzing how this specification generation process fails, we identify four recurring failure patterns, link each to specific DSL features, and discuss design considerations for future DSL designs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM使用可视化领域特定语言（DSL）生成图表规格时的失败模式，评估10种JSON风格可视化DSL在41个任务、3个LLM上的表现，通过JSON与渲染校验及失败案例定性编码，归纳出四类反复出现的失败模式，并将其与具体DSL特性关联，提出未来DSL设计考量。
AI.motivation: LLM正逐步承担使用可视化DSL撰写图表的任务。传统可视化DSL的设计受人类使用约束塑造——对人容易的操作对模型未必容易，因此既有DSL设计假设可能不再适用。理解LLM在现有DSL设计下如何以及在哪里失败，成为改进DSL设计的关键前提。
AI.method: 评估10种JSON风格的可视化DSL，覆盖41个任务、3个LLM；对生成的规格进行JSON正确性检查与渲染检查，并对失败案例进行定性编码分析；进而将识别出的失败模式与具体DSL特性进行关联。
AI.result: 识别出四类反复出现的规格生成失败模式，并将每一类追溯到具体的DSL设计特性。
AI.conclusion: LLM在现有可视化DSL上的失败具有规律性且可归因于具体DSL特性，据此提出了面向未来DSL设计的设计考量。

title: EvenSplat: Coupled 2D-3D Decomposition for Gaussian Splatting under Exposure and Illumination Variation
summary: A surface photographed under even light presents nearly the same appearance from every angle; the same surface under uneven light does not. Exposure changes between views, illumination varies within a single image, and locally strong light sources leave one region bright and its neighbor in shadow. Multi-view reconstruction methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting treat these lighting artifacts as if they were properties of the scene, entangling capture-specific illumination with the geometry and color they recover. We present EvenSplat, a framework that separates the two. EvenSplat couples an image-space illumination decomposition with an illumination field carried by the Gaussians, so that the same explanation of the lighting is shared between the two-dimensional and three-dimensional views of the scene; a camera-response network and a local exposure-compensation module absorb the global and residual differences that remain across training images. Through extensive experiments across multiple datasets and diverse forms of uneven illumination (cross-view exposure, spatial illumination variation, and high-contrast lighting) on both real-world captured and simulated benchmarks, EvenSplat generally outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under high-contrast illumination.

AI.tldr: EvenSplat是一个将光照与场景固有属性分离的多视图重建框架，通过图像空间光照分解与高斯携带的光照场耦合，并辅以相机响应网络和局部曝光补偿模块，在多种不均匀光照场景下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 均匀光照下同一表面各角度外观一致，但不均匀光照下则不同：视图间曝光变化、单幅图像内光照不均、局部强光源造成明暗对比。3D Gaussian Splatting等重建方法会把这些光照伪影当作场景本身属性，将特定拍摄条件的光照与几何、颜色纠缠在一起，导致重建结果受拍摄光照污染。
AI.method: EvenSplat将图像空间的光照分解与由高斯携带的光照场相耦合，使二维图像与三维视角共享同一套光照解释；同时引入相机响应网络与局部曝光补偿模块，分别吸收训练图像间残留的全局差异与局部残差。
AI.result: 在多个数据集及多种不均匀光照形式（跨视图曝光、空间光照变化、高对比度光照）上，针对真实拍摄与仿真基准进行大量实验，EvenSplat总体优于现有最优方法，尤以高对比度光照条件下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦光照与场景几何、颜色，EvenSplat能有效抑制拍摄特定光照带来的伪影，提升多视图重建在复杂光照条件下的鲁棒性与质量。

title: Memory-Guided B-Roll Generation from User Video Collections
summary: We introduce an approach for collection-grounded B-roll sequence generation. Given a user's video collection, a directive given in natural language, and a target duration, the goal is to produce a multi-shot sequence that complements the user's primary footage (A-roll) while preserving the collection's characters, settings, objects, and style. This task is challenging as one must choose the visual evidence from hours of captured footage that should guide the generation of each shot in the sequence. We address this challenge with MemComposer, a three-stage system that turns raw footage into a structured memory with visual references (characters, settings, objects, and style) and uses it to plan, retrieve, and generate grounded B-roll sequences. First, in a one-time offline stage, MemComposer constructs an entity-centric memory from raw video. Second, it uses the memory and user directive to plan a grounded sequence and retrieve conditioning frames for each shot. Third, it iteratively generates and critiques the sequence to enforce identity, setting, and sequence-level consistency. We evaluate MemComposer in a user preference study along two dimensions: prompt adherence and visual alignment to the user's collection. Against an ungrounded text-to-video planner, MemComposer wins 60.0\% of prompt-adherence and 92.8\% of visual-alignment comparisons, showing the grounding benefit of collection memory and reference retrieval. Against retrieval-only sequences assembled from captured footage, MemComposer wins 94.5\% of prompt-adherence comparisons, showing the value of generating missing shots, while retrieval-only sequences are preferred for visual alignment in 58.2\% of comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出 MemComposer，一个三阶段系统，用于基于用户视频集合生成 B-roll 序列，通过实体中心记忆实现规划、检索与生成。
AI.motivation: 基于视频集合的 B-roll 序列生成需从数小时素材中选取视觉证据以指导每个镜头的生成，同时保持角色、场景、物体与风格一致，极具挑战。
AI.method: MemComposer 分三阶段：一是离线构建以实体为中心的记忆（角色、场景、物体、风格）；二是结合记忆与用户指令规划序列并检索每个镜头的条件帧；三是迭代生成与批判序列，以强化身份、场景与序列级一致性。
AI.result: 用户偏好研究中，对比无 grounding 的文本到视频规划器，MemComposer 在提示遵从性上胜出 60.0%，在视觉对齐上胜出 92.8%；对比仅检索序列，在提示遵从性上胜出 94.5%，但仅检索序列在视觉对齐上被偏好 58.2%。
AI.conclusion: 集合记忆与参考检索带来显著 grounding 收益，同时生成缺失镜头对提示遵从性有重要价值；视觉对齐方面检索方法仍有优势。

title: Stochastic Rounding in Low-Precision Transformer Inference: A Variable-Precision Emulation Study of a Small GPT-2
comment: 35 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Code and evaluation pipeline available at https://github.com/big-data-lab-team/fuzzy-llm and archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23066028
summary: Should low-precision transformer inference use stochastic rounding (SR) or round-to-nearest (RN)? The answer depends on where in the network you look. We isolate this effect by holding the numerical format fixed and varying only the rounding rule at individual operation sites. To enable experiments at freely chosen precisions, we extend the PRISM vectorized rounding library to arbitrary virtual precision via a variable-precision stochastic rounding (VPSR) algorithm, proving that the rounding decision is evaluated exactly in hardware floating point. We develop two analyses providing complementary insight into this site-level trade-off. First, a probabilistic forward-error bound for linear projections shows that SR's error envelope grows as $O(\sqrt{n} u)$ in reduction length $n$, versus $O(n u)$ for RN, a gap that widens rapidly at low precision and is most pronounced in the long multilayer perceptron (MLP) down-projection. Second, a second-order decomposition of expected cross-entropy loss change at the output softmax into signed drift, drift curvature, and a Fisher-weighted variance penalty reveals why the two sites behave oppositely: MLP noise is predominantly a uniform logit shift to which softmax is invariant, so SR's variance is largely discounted; head noise is non-uniform across the vocabulary and is not. On DistilGPT-2 at $t=6$ significand bits, observations match theory: SR in the MLP raises perplexity to 1.15x the full-precision reference, versus 2.21x for RN. At the language-model head, the ordering reverses because SR introduces non-uniform variance, whereas deterministic RN carries none. In a mixed-precision configuration (MLP output at $t=6$), assigning SR to the MLP and RN to the head brings perplexity within 1.10x of the full-precision reference, a 28% reduction over matched-bit RN.

AI.tldr: 低精度Transformer推理中随机舍入(SR)与就近舍入(RN)的优劣取决于网络中位置:MLP中SR更优,语言模型头部RN更优,混合策略可将困惑度逼近全精度。
AI.motivation: 探究低精度Transformer推理中随机舍入(SR)与就近舍入(RN)的取舍,并揭示该权衡在网络不同位置的依赖性。
AI.method: 固定数值格式,仅改变各操作位点的舍入规则;将PRISM向量化舍入库扩展为可变精度随机舍入(VPSR);提出线性投影的概率前向误差界与输出softmax处交叉熵损失期望变化的二阶分解两种分析。
AI.result: SR误差包络随归约长度n呈O(√n·u),RN为O(n·u);DistilGPT-2在t=6有效位下,MLP中SR困惑度为全精度1.15倍而RN为2.21倍;头部则RN优于SR;混合配置(MLP用SR、头部用RN)困惑度在1.10倍以内,较匹配位宽RN降低28%。
AI.conclusion: 舍入规则的最优选择具有位置依赖性,应由各站点的误差结构与softmax敏感性共同决定,而非全局统一。

title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Enhanced Radiometer Image Precipitation Estimation using Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Deep generative networks have recently achieved unprecedented performance in precise image and video editing using sophisticated textual prompts. However, the effectiveness of such models heavily depends on access to very large supervised and annotated image datasets, which can be very difficult to obtain. This is particularly true for satellite instruments, which very rarely overlap with labelled data, and suffer from domain shifts in the rare occasions they do. In this paper, we investigate the potential of flow matching models for unsupervised domain adaptation of satellite radiometer images. Our main contribution is a novel unsupervised method that achieves precise domain alignment by leveraging parts of the deterministic ordinary differential equations in flow matching models, conditioned on different satellite instruments. A key strength of our approach is its ability to preserve essential information while adapting across any domains since the perturbations are in theory bijective. Extensive experiments conducted on the GPM-Core constellation show the benefit of our conditional domain adaptation, particularly in improving rain precipitation estimation from radiometer imagery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于流匹配模型的无监督域自适应方法，利用其确定性ODE的局部特性，实现不同卫星辐射计图像间的精确域对齐，并在GPM-Core星座上验证了该方法能提升降水估计精度。
AI.motivation: 深度生成模型在图像/视频编辑中表现优异，但高度依赖大规模有标注数据。卫星辐射计领域尤为受限：不同仪器几乎不共享标注数据，偶有重叠时还存在域偏移，导致难以直接迁移。
AI.method: 提出一种无监督域自适应方法，针对卫星辐射计图像。核心是复用流匹配模型中确定性常微分方程（ODE）的部分环节，并以不同卫星仪器为条件进行域对齐。由于扰动在理论上为双射，方法能够在跨域转换时保留关键信息。
AI.result: 在GPM-Core星座上进行的大量实验表明，条件域自适应具有明显收益，尤其体现在利用辐射计影像改进降水（降雨）估计任务上。
AI.conclusion: 流匹配模型可为卫星辐射计图像提供有效的无监督域自适应，其双射性质保证了信息保持与跨域对齐的兼顾，为标注稀缺的遥感场景提供了可行路径。

title: MapLightning: Online Vectorized HD Map Construction with 1D Map Tokens
summary: Online vectorized HD map construction is essential for scaling safe autonomous driving and requires accurate, real-time inference. Prior methods typically rely on dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) grids as the intermediate representation. We propose \textit{MapLightning}, which replaces the dense BEV grid with a compact set of 1D learnable map tokens. To construct map tokens from image features, we choose self-attention over vanilla cross-attention because it enables joint interactions and contextual aggregation among image and map tokens. Our transformer-based mapper concatenates map and image tokens, applies full self-attention, discards the image tokens, and retains the updated map tokens for decoding. This design offers three advantages. First, our representation is efficient, using fewer tokens, consuming less memory, and running faster. Second, the lightweight design allows the map decoder to use full rather than deformable cross-attention for better global context. Third, unlike BEV-based methods, our network does not use camera projection parameters, making it robust to camera-extrinsic perturbations. MapLightning uses up to 16.7$\times$ fewer intermediate tokens than dense BEV-based methods and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on nuScenes and Argoverse~2. Its lightweight variant surpasses MapTRv2 by +10.1 mAP on nuScenes and +16.2 mAP on Argoverse~2, while delivering 1.73$\times$ faster inference (40+ FPS) with 53\% less memory. We further show improvements on uncertainty-aware map construction and downstream trajectory prediction. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: MapLightning提出用1D可学习地图token替代稠密BEV栅格作为中间表示，通过自注意力实现图像与地图token的联合建模，在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上实现精度与效率双SOTA。
AI.motivation: 在线矢量化高精地图构建对可扩展的安全自动驾驶至关重要，需要准确且实时的推理。现有方法通常依赖稠密BEV栅格作为中间表示，存在token数量多、内存占用大、推理慢的问题，且依赖相机投影参数，对相机外参扰动不鲁棒。
AI.method: 提出MapLightning，用一组紧凑的1D可学习地图token替代稠密BEV栅格。选用自注意力而非普通交叉注意力，以支持图像token与地图token之间的联合交互和上下文聚合。具体做法：将地图token与图像token拼接，施加完整自注意力，丢弃图像token，保留更新后的地图token用于解码。由于表示轻量，地图解码器可采用完整交叉注意力而非可变形交叉注意力以获得更好的全局上下文；且网络不使用相机投影参数，对相机外参扰动更鲁棒。
AI.result: 相比稠密BEV方法最多减少16.7倍中间token。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上取得精度与效率的SOTA。轻量变体相比MapTRv2在nuScenes上提升+10.1 mAP、在Argoverse 2上提升+16.2 mAP，同时推理速度提升1.73倍（40+ FPS），内存减少53%。在不确定性感知地图构建和下游轨迹预测任务上也有改进。
AI.conclusion: MapLightning通过以1D地图token替代稠密BEV表示并结合自注意力交互，实现了高效且高精度的在线矢量化高精地图构建，同时具备对外参扰动的鲁棒性，并惠及下游任务。

title: DecomVoxel: Harnessing 3D-Native Priors with Guided In-situ Denoising Optimization for Decompositional Scene Reconstruction
comment: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 - Journal Track (TOG). Project page: https://decomvoxel.github.io/DecomVoxel-Webpage/
summary: Decompositional scene reconstruction aims to reconstruct high-quality objects and background, yet existing methods still struggle with the level of quality under heavy occlusions. While generative priors offer a potential solution, 2D image-based priors often suffer from multi-view inconsistency due to a lack of 3D awareness. Conversely, 3D-native priors provide stronger structural inductive biases but frequently lead to spatial drift and misalignment within complex scenes. To address these issues, we propose DecomVoxel, formulating object completion as a guided in-situ denoising optimization that bridges 3D-native priors with neural scene reconstruction. Our framework introduces a reformulated epsilon-based distillation loss to ensure stable latent refinement, alongside adaptive spatial guidance that utilizes occupied and vacant anchors with temporal annealing to suppress generative hallucinations and mitigate spatial drift. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ show that DecomVoxel significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while faithfully preserving the original spatial layout, structural fidelity, and style-consistent texture. Our method pushes the boundary of decompositional reconstruction by delivering high-quality textured meshes with clean topology, geometry, and appearance, providing a robust solution for the decompositional reconstruction of complex real-world scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/DecomVoxel/DecomVoxel.

AI.tldr: DecomVoxel 将物体补全建模为受引导的原位去噪优化，融合 3D 原生先验与神经场景重建，在 Replica 和 ScanNet++ 上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 分解式场景重建需高质量重建物体与背景，但在严重遮挡下质量不足。2D 图像先验缺乏 3D 意识导致多视图不一致，3D 原生先验虽有结构归纳偏置但易产生空间漂移与错位。
AI.method: 提出 DecomVoxel，将物体补全表述为受引导的原位去噪优化，桥接 3D 原生先验与神经场景重建；引入重构的基于 epsilon 的蒸馏损失以保证潜在精修稳定；采用基于占用与空置锚点并带时间退火的自适应空间引导，抑制生成幻觉、缓解空间漂移。
AI.result: 在 Replica 和 ScanNet++ 上显著超越最优方法，忠实保持原始空间布局、结构保真度与风格一致的纹理，输出拓扑、几何与外观干净的带纹理网格。
AI.conclusion: DecomVoxel 推进了分解式重建的边界，为复杂真实场景的分解式重建提供了稳健解决方案，代码已开源。

title: MoLE: Mixture of Latent Experts for Complementary Visual Reasoning
summary: Latent visual reasoning equips vision--language models with continuous intermediate states that can process visual evidence without explicit textual reasoning traces or repeated image operations. However, existing methods often allow multiple latent tokens to access the same visual evidence through shared value projections, providing no mechanism for them to extract complementary visual information; simply increasing the latent budget can therefore yield redundant latent representations. We argue that effective latent reasoning should encourage different latent tokens to extract complementary visual information, and thereby act as specialized visual experts. Based on this insight, we propose MoLE, a Mixture of Latent Experts framework that controls both what visual evidence each latent visual expert observes and how it transforms that evidence. MoLE isolates latent visual experts during evidence extraction and uses dedicated latent summary experts to aggregate the complementary representations of latent visual experts. A two-stage training pipeline first forces visual evidence through this latent pathway and then restores direct visual access, requiring neither predefined expert roles nor intermediate visual targets. Across five visual reasoning benchmarks, MoLE achieves an average score of 78.6, outperforming data-matched supervised fine-tuning by 4.9 and the strongest evaluated latent visual reasoning baseline at the same latent budget by 3.6. Representation analyses show lower latent-state similarity and more diverse visual attention, while masking the latent pathway reduces average performance by 9.2. These results demonstrate that specializing latent computation is more effective than merely increasing the number of latent tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoLE（Mixture of Latent Experts）框架，通过让不同潜在视觉专家提取互补视觉信息并加以聚合，提升视觉语言模型的潜在视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在视觉推理方法中，多个潜在 token 通过共享 value projection 访问同一视觉证据，缺乏提取互补信息的机制，单纯增加潜在 token 数量只会导致表征冗余。
AI.method: 将潜在视觉专家在证据提取阶段相互隔离，分别控制其观察的视觉证据及转换方式；用专门的 latent summary experts 聚合各专家的互补表征；采用两阶段训练：先强制视觉证据经过潜在通路，再恢复直接视觉访问。无需预定义专家角色或中间视觉目标。
AI.result: 在五个视觉推理基准上平均得分 78.6，超过数据匹配的监督微调 4.9，超过同潜在预算下最强潜在视觉推理基线 3.6；表征分析显示潜在状态相似度更低、视觉注意力更多样；遮蔽潜在通路使平均性能下降 9.2。
AI.conclusion: 对潜在计算进行专门化（specialization）比单纯增加潜在 token 数量更有效。

title: Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers
summary: Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural constraints of modern LLMs. Rather than applying an auxiliary alignment loss on hidden states, we propose using the outputs of the mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers as the target for alignment. Router outputs lend themselves better to pooling over many tokens, enabling more reliable cross-lingual comparisons at the sequence-level. Controlled continual pre-training experiments on four open-source MoEs show that incorporating this routing loss also aligns the underlying hidden representations across languages. Most importantly, this loss improves multilingual performance on our diverse evaluation suite, demonstrating the potential of cross-lingual MoE router alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出跨语言MoE路由器对齐方法，通过对路由器输出施加对比损失实现LLM跨语言表征对齐并提升多语言性能。
AI.motivation: 跨语言对比学习是多语言编码器训练的核心，但decoder-only LLM因多语言分词差异无法直接对齐表征。已有研究显示更高的跨语言表征对齐能改善跨语言迁移，因此需要在LLM架构约束下重新设计跨语言对比学习。
AI.method: 不对隐状态施加辅助对齐损失，而是以MoE路由器输出作为对齐目标。路由器输出更易在大量token上池化，从而在序列级实现更可靠的跨语言比较。在四个开源MoE模型上进行受控持续预训练。
AI.result: 引入路由损失不仅对齐了跨语言的底层隐表征，还提升了模型在多样化评测集上的多语言性能，验证了跨语言MoE路由器对齐的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言MoE路由器对齐是一种适用于现代LLM架构约束的有效跨语言对比学习新范式。

title: CLoSeR: Closing the Loop for Long-Context Streaming Reconstruction
comment: Authors contributed equally to this work. Author order is interchangeable
summary: Feedforward foundation models have recently shown remarkable 3D reconstruction capabilities. However, existing models exhibit large tracking drift in long-context streaming reconstruction due to error accumulation. In this paper, we revisit loop closure with streaming reconstruction foundation models to enable accurate, drift-free, kilometer-scale reconstruction. Specifically, our method detects loop candidates through global descriptor retrieval, and constructs loop-conditioned windows to estimate the relative poses between looped frames. Given the observation that our adopted streaming reconstruction backbone produces a globally consistent scale, we optimize all frame poses on the SE(3) manifold with sequential and loop closure constraints, avoiding the pose graph optimization on the Sim(3) or higher-dimensional SL(4) manifolds employed in prior works. Extensive experiments show that our method reduces drift and produces consistent geometry on kilometer-scale sequences, significantly outperforming the state of the art. Code is available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/CLoSeR.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将闭环检测引入流式重建基础模型，在SE(3)流形上优化位姿，实现公里级无漂移的精确3D重建。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈基础模型在长序列流式重建中因误差累积产生严重跟踪漂移，难以支撑公里级大场景的准确重建。
AI.method: 通过全局描述子检索检测闭环候选，构建闭环条件窗口估计闭环帧间相对位姿；利用流式重建主干产生全局一致尺度的特性，在SE(3)流形上联合顺序约束与闭环约束优化所有帧位姿，避免以往在Sim(3)或SL(4)流形上的位姿图优化。
AI.result: 在公里级序列上显著降低漂移并产生一致的几何结构，性能大幅超越当前最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 将闭环机制重新引入流式重建基础模型，并借助SE(3)流形优化，可有效抑制长序列漂移，实现准确的公里级重建。

title: A rubric landscape for evaluating clinical reasoning in large language models: what exists, what is missing, and what needs to be combined
summary: Exam-style accuracy does not establish whether large language models (LLMs) reason well over clinical records. We define clinical reasoning as integrating and updating evidence across time and sources to form, revise and justify a patient's problem representation and a defensible plan. This structured narrative review maps three literatures: medical education assessment instruments, clinical LLM benchmarks published from 2023 onwards, and general-domain methods for evaluating long-form generation. We examine six dimensions: problem representation, temporal synthesis, differential and management reasoning, counterfactual reasoning, calibrated uncertainty, and reasoning faithfulness. Preprints are included and flagged. No single instrument covers all six dimensions. Problem representation and differential or management reasoning are reasonably covered, although reliability varies by instrument and setting. TIMER-Eval targets temporal synthesis, and ER-Reason assesses sequential diagnostic belief updating. Dedicated uncertainty and counterfactual evaluations are emerging, but their applicability to longitudinal free-text reasoning remains limited. Factual completeness is well theorised in general-domain evaluation, with early clinical evidence of important omissions. Faithfulness remains the weakest dimension, with one identified clinical causal-ablation study on multiple-choice questions. Existing tools should be combined through binary rubric items, separate completeness and correctness scores, case-specific importance weighting with non-compensable safety caps, temporal order-consistency checks, and chance-corrected reliability reporting. Further design work is needed for calibrated uncertainty, counterfactual reasoning and faithfulness over longitudinal free-text records. This review provides a design rationale, not a validated instrument.

AI.tldr: 临床推理评估不能被考试式准确率替代；现有工具无一覆盖全部六维度，需组合式设计仍需进一步开发。
AI.motivation: 考试风格（exam-style）的准确率无法证明大语言模型（LLMs）在临床病历上的推理能力。本文提出临床推理的操作化定义：跨时间与来源整合和更新证据，以形成、修订并论证患者的问题表征（problem representation）与可辩护的诊疗计划。动机在于厘清现有三大文献在评估LLMs临床推理时的覆盖范围与缺口，为评估工具设计提供依据。
AI.method: 结构化叙述性综述（structured narrative review），映射三类文献：（1）医学教育评估工具；（2）2023年以来的临床LLM基准（benchmarks）；（3）通用领域长文本生成评估方法。围绕六个维度进行考察：问题表征、时间综合（temporal synthesis）、鉴别与管理推理、反事实推理、校准不确定性（calibrated uncertainty）、推理忠实性（faithfulness）。纳入预印本并加以标注。
AI.result: 没有任何单一工具覆盖全部六个维度。问题表征与鉴别/管理推理覆盖尚可，但信度（reliability）随工具与场景而变化。TIMER-Eval针对时间综合，ER-Reason评估序列化诊断信念更新（sequential diagnostic belief updating）。专门的不确定性与反事实评估正在兴起，但对纵向自由文本推理的适用性仍然有限。事实完整性（factual completeness）在通用领域评估中已有较好理论化，临床领域已有重要遗漏的早期证据。忠实性是最薄弱维度，仅识别出一项针对多选题的临床因果消融（causal-ablation）研究。
AI.conclusion: 建议通过以下方式组合现有工具：二元评分表条目（binary rubric items）、完整性与正确性分开计分、个案特定重要性加权（case-specific importance weighting）并设置不可补偿的安全上限（non-compensable safety caps）、时间顺序一致性检查，以及机会校正的信度报告（chance-corrected reliability reporting）。校准不确定性、反事实推理与纵向自由文本记录上的忠实性仍需进一步设计工作。本综述提供设计依据（design rationale），而非已验证的评估工具。

title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
summary: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.

AI.tldr: PyRUA-Lean：以交互式代码执行框架让VLM智能体在Python单元中组合机器人基元与VLA策略，并按需返回观测，从而降低token开销并提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLM智能体虽可通过视觉反馈与动作基元控制机器人，但重复调用模型与冗余观测带来显著token开销。
AI.method: 提出PyRUA-Lean交互式代码执行框架，将反馈驱动的基元组合与选择性观测耦合：智能体把经典机器人基元和学习型VLA策略组合进Python单元，在其中执行条件检查与局部重试，仅返回显式请求的图像与状态反馈用于重规划。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365共700个仿真任务实例上，与使用同一GPT-6 Astra规划器和底层机器人基元的工具调用基线对比：同等LLM调用预算下，整体成功率从63.1%提升至71.7%；在两者均解决的实例上，LLM调用减少49%，输入token减少65%。
AI.conclusion: 通过代码执行封装控制逻辑并选择性回传观测，可在不增加调用预算的前提下提高成功率并大幅降低token消耗。

title: Latent-Foresight: End-to-End Learning Predictable Representations for Latent World Models
summary: Predicting the future evolution of a scene is a fundamental capability for world modeling. Recent work has shown that operating in the feature space of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) yields semantically rich representations that support diverse future scene understanding tasks. However, existing approaches rely on two-stage pipelines, where VFM features are first compressed using fixed dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA) or independently trained autoencoders, and a separate predictor is trained on top of the resulting frozen latent space. This decoupling between representation learning and temporal prediction, as well as approaches that apply predictors directly on raw VFM features, provides no guarantee that the latent space is structured for predictable dynamics. In this work, we propose Latent-Foresight, an end-to-end framework that jointly learns a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model, explicitly shaping the representation to support temporal predictability. To enable stable joint optimization, we introduce several key design choices that prevent latent collapse and align reconstruction with generative objectives. Extensive experiments show that our approach learns more temporally coherent latent representations and consistently outperforms two-stage baselines across multiple future scene understanding tasks and prediction horizons, while eliminating separate training stages, including during high-resolution adaptation. We provide the implementation code and model weights at https://github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight

AI.tldr: 提出Latent-Foresight端到端框架，联合学习潜在分词器与基于流的生成动力学模型，显式塑造支持时间可预测性的表征，在多个未来场景理解任务上超越两阶段基线。
AI.motivation: 场景未来演化预测是世界建模的基础能力。现有方法在视觉基础模型(VFM)特征空间操作，但依赖两阶段流程：先用固定降维(如PCA)或独立训练的自编码器压缩VFM特征，再在冻结的潜在空间上训练独立预测器。这种表征学习与时间预测的解耦，以及直接在原始VFM特征上应用预测器的方法，都无法保证潜在空间的结构适合可预测的动力学。
AI.method: Latent-Foresight是一个端到端框架，联合学习潜在分词器(latent tokenizer)和基于流的生成动力学模型，显式塑造表征以支持时间可预测性。为实现稳定的联合优化，引入若干关键设计：防止潜在塌缩(latent collapse)，并使重建目标与生成目标对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法学到了时间上更一致的潜在表征，在多个未来场景理解任务和不同预测时间跨度上持续优于两阶段基线，同时消除了分离的训练阶段，包括在高分辨率适配时。代码与模型权重已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合优化表征学习与时间预测，并在优化中保持潜在空间结构以支撑可预测动力学，可在无需独立训练阶段的情况下提升未来场景理解的表征质量与预测性能。

title: Anti-Persona: Disrupting Unauthorized Identity Binding and Recognition in Personalized Vision--Language Models
summary: Few-shot personalization enables large vision--language models (LVLMs) to learn user-specific visual concepts for applications such as personalized retrieval and subject-aware querying. However, it also creates a privacy risk: an adversary can bind a target identity from a few reference images and subsequently detect that identity in new images through natural-language queries. We introduce Anti-Persona, an image-level defense against unauthorized identity binding and recognition in personalized LVLMs. Our key insight is that identity personalization relies on visual features shared across multiple reference images. We aggregate these features into an identity prototype and optimize visually subtle perturbations that disrupt prototype alignment in the vision-encoder space. Spatial smoothing and low-frequency preservation further promote visual fidelity and practical resilience to image compression. The resulting protection does not depend on a specific prompt and supports both proactive anti-personalization and reactive image protection. Experiments on two representative personalized LVLMs demonstrate protection rates of up to $95.0\%$ while preserving visual fidelity. The method remains stable across prompt variations and evaluated identity-query tasks, and improves black-box transfer under encoder mismatch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Anti-Persona，一种针对个性化 LVLM 的图像级防御方法，通过聚合多参考图特征构建身份原型，并优化细微扰动破坏视觉编码器空间中的原型对齐，从而实现防身份绑定与识别，保护率最高达 95.0%。
AI.motivation: 少样本个性化使 LVLM 能学习用户特定视觉概念，但同时带来隐私风险：攻击者可用少量参考图绑定目标身份，并通过自然语言查询在新图像中检测该身份。现有方法缺乏针对个性化 LVLM 中未授权身份绑定与识别的有效图像级防御。
AI.method: 核心洞察是身份个性化依赖多张参考图共享的视觉特征。方法聚合这些特征形成身份原型，在视觉编码器空间中优化视觉上细微的扰动以破坏原型对齐；并引入空间平滑与低频保留以提升视觉保真度和抗图像压缩的实用鲁棒性。该保护不依赖特定提示，支持主动式反个性化与被动式图像保护。
AI.result: 在两个代表性个性化 LVLM 上实验，保护率最高达 95.0%，同时保持视觉保真度；方法在提示变化和评估的身份查询任务中保持稳定，并在编码器不匹配情况下提升黑盒迁移性。
AI.conclusion: Anti-Persona 能有效防御个性化 LVLM 中的未授权身份绑定与识别，兼顾视觉质量和实用鲁棒性，并可跨提示与任务稳定工作。

title: Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry
summary: Large language models offer a promising foundation for chemical reasoning, bringing together chemical knowledge and multistep problem solving. Chemical intuition can provide an initial sense of plausible outcomes before the details of a solution are fully worked out. Inspired by how such expectations complement explicit analysis, we study how continuous latent thoughts can be trained to anticipate informative aspects of future solutions without verbalizing every intermediate step. We introduce Latent JEPA, a framework that combines autoregressive learning with joint-embedding prediction of one or more future views. For chemical reasoning, we develop textual and molecular prediction objectives that connect latent thoughts to both subsequent reasoning and molecular outcomes. Experiments on ChemCoTBench show gains in molecular optimization and on several editing and reaction metrics. Representation analyses show that future prediction makes latent thoughts more informative about molecular outcomes and strengthens their correspondence with chemical structure. These findings support abstract future prediction as a learning principle for connecting continuous latent reasoning with scientific outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Latent JEPA 框架，通过联合嵌入预测未来信息（文本推理与分子结果）来训练连续隐思维，在 ChemCoTBench 上提升分子优化与编辑/反应指标。
AI.motivation: 化学推理需要结合化学知识与多步问题求解；人类化学直觉能在解题细节展开前先给出对结果的合理预期。受此启发，作者希望让连续隐思维在不显式输出每步中间过程的情况下，预测未来解决方案中具有信息量的方面，从而把连续隐推理与科学结果连接起来。
AI.method: 提出 Latent JEPA 框架，将自回归学习与联合嵌入预测相结合，对一到多个未来视图进行预测。针对化学推理，设计了文本预测目标与分子预测目标，把隐思维分别与后续推理过程和分子结果关联。
AI.result: 在 ChemCoTBench 上，分子优化任务及若干编辑与反应指标均有提升。表征分析显示，未来预测使隐思维对分子结果更具信息量，并增强其与化学结构的对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 抽象的未来预测可作为一种学习原则，有效连接连续隐推理与科学结果。

title: EndoLive: Real-Time Style Transfer for Endoscopic Endonasal Skull Base Surgical Video
summary: Complex surgical procedures around critical anatomy, such as the endoscopic endonasal skull base surgery, requires significant practice and training on the part of the surgeon before they are allowed to perform the operation on a live patient. This training in typically done in cadaveric specimens, due to them containing the same critical structures as a living human. However, cadavers are not a perfect 1-to-1 substitute for a living patient. The dead and preserved tissues of a cadaver are colored completely differently than a living human, and -- without complex and expensive pumping systems -- do not bleed in the same way. As a result, identifying the critical pieces of anatomy that make this procedure so complex can be quite different in a live case than in a surgeon's cadaveric practice. This paper presents EndoLive, a framework for real-time style transfer between cadaveric endoscopic video and living human endoscopic video. Our method combines the ConStructS GAN model for realistic style transfer for surgical applications, with the HyPER-GAN model that can learn complex translations and perform them in real-time. We train EndoLive on unpaired cadaveric and live images taken from an endoscope, and test the trained model with cadaveric video, on a variety of devices. Experimental results demonstrate that EndoLive can perform cadaveric-to-live translation at speeds well above the minimum necessary for real-time, while maintaining semantic consistency of critical anatomical structures. Our source code is available at https://github.com/griffhurt/endolive.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 EndoLive 框架，实现尸体内镜视频与活体内镜视频的实时风格迁移，用于颅底手术训练。
AI.motivation: 内镜下颅底手术等关键解剖区域手术需要大量训练，通常依赖尸体标本，但尸体组织颜色与活体差异大且无法正常出血，导致解剖辨识体验与真实手术不同。
AI.method: 结合 ConStructS GAN（面向手术场景的真实风格迁移）与 HyPER-GAN（学习复杂翻译并实时执行），在未配对的尸体内镜与活体内镜图像上训练，并用尸体内镜视频在多设备上测试。
AI.result: EndoLive 可进行尸体到活体的翻译，速度远高于实时所需最低要求，同时保持关键解剖结构的语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: EndoLive 能有效提升尸体训练视频的真实感与解剖辨识度，具备实时应用潜力；源代码已公开。

title: SIEVE: Selective attention-value Suppression for Vision-Language Models Unlearning
summary: The ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to associate visual identities with biographical information creates a need for selective unlearning of personally identifiable information (PII) while preserving permitted knowledge about the same individual. This setting is challenging because both sensitive and retained information can share the same visual inputs and intermediate representations. We introduce SIEVE, a simple and effective framework for selective VLM unlearning. SIEVE directly regularizes attention-value representations while also controlling model outputs. SIEVE suppresses attention values for forget examples toward a constant zero, while preserving retain-example representations by matching them to a frozen reference model. These objectives are combined with sequence-level forget and retain supervision, enabling targeted forgetting without largely affecting retained knowledge. Extensive experiments show that SIEVE achieves state-of-the-art performance on unlearning with multiple model-modality settings, while maintaining competitive retained utility. Ablation studies further show that value suppression and negative cross-entropy contribute complementary forgetting signals, while reference-based value matching substantially reduces utility degradation. These results demonstrate that attention values provide an effective intervention point for selective multimodal unlearning when sensitive and retained knowledge are closely related.

AI.tldr: 提出SIEVE框架，通过正则化注意力值实现视觉语言模型(PII)的选择性遗忘，同时保留同一人物的许可知识。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型能将视觉身份与传记信息关联，因此需要对其中的个人可识别信息(PII)进行选择性遗忘，同时保留关于同一人物的许可知识。难点在于敏感信息与保留信息可能共享相同的视觉输入和中间表示，难以区分。
AI.method: SIEVE直接正则化注意力值(attention-value)表征并控制模型输出：将遗忘样本的注意力值压制到常数零，同时通过对齐冻结参考模型来保留保留样本的表示；再结合序列级的遗忘与保留监督，实现定向遗忘。
AI.result: 在多模型-模态设置下，SIEVE在遗忘任务上取得最先进性能，并保持有竞争力的保留效用。消融实验显示，值压制与负交叉熵贡献互补的遗忘信号，基于参考的值匹配显著减少效用退化。
AI.conclusion: 当敏感知识与保留知识高度相关时，注意力值是选择性多模态遗忘的有效干预点。

title: Counterfactual Auditing of Bias in Open-Source Large Language Models for Clinical Triage
summary: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. Models include Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a QLoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage, overtriage, shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, versus 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base model. Several larger or medical-domain models showed more significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses further revealed clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns hidden by aggregate rates. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight, clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks in open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文对十个开源大语言模型进行反事实审计，用于儿科急诊分诊（ESI）预测，发现模型的反事实敏感性并不随规模或医学预训练而一致降低，微调模型敏感度最低。
AI.motivation: 急诊分诊是高风险的优先级排序任务，人口学、社会经济和系统背景信息可能不当影响分诊等级判定。开源LLM虽被考虑用于本地隐私保护的临床决策支持，但反事实偏见在不同模型家族、规模、医学领域模型及领域适配模型间的差异尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建配对反事实变体：从真实与手册式临床案例出发，仅改变一个人口学、社会经济、医疗可及性、行为、社会或系统背景变量，保持临床表现固定。纳入Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct、QLoRA微调Qwen2.5-7B、MedGemma变体、MedLLaMA2-7B、GPT-OSS-20B、GPT-OSS-120B等十个开源模型，测量任意反事实偏移、分诊不足、分诊过度、偏移超过一个ESI等级、平均偏移与平均绝对偏移。
AI.result: 反事实敏感性差异显著，且并未随模型规模增大或医学领域预训练而一致下降。微调Qwen2.5-7B整体敏感性最低，任意偏移率5.27%，平均绝对偏移0.0534，而基座模型分别为16.02%和0.1706。若干更大或医学领域模型表现出更显著的偏移。分层与相关性分析进一步揭示出被总体比率掩盖的、具临床重要性的方向性和共同失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 反事实审计是一种轻量、临床可解释的框架，可用于在临床部署前比较开源LLM的公平性风险。

title: RASteer: Retain-Aware Activation Steering for Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
summary: Concept erasure aims to remove a target concept, such as a copyrighted style, a recognizable character, or unsafe content, from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model while preserving its ability to generate other content. Existing activation steering methods build an erasure direction mainly from the target concept and adjust model activations along it at inference time. However, target and retained concepts often overlap in the model's representation space, so this direction also contains shared components that retained concepts rely on. Steering directly along this direction can therefore suppress retained concepts and harm the generation of non-target content. To address this issue, we propose Retain-aware Activation Steering (RASteer), a training-free method. RASteer first builds a retain subspace from the concepts to preserve. Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) then removes components aligned with this subspace from the erasure direction, making steering more specific to the target. Since fully removing the shared components can weaken erasure, we further introduce Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC). At each layer and denoising step, OAC uses the overlap between the erasure direction and the retain subspace to control how much of each shared component is removed, balancing target erasure and concept preservation. Experiments on unsafe-content, instance, and artistic-style erasure across multiple backbones and benchmarks show that RASteer matches or outperforms the activation steering and weight editing baselines we evaluate, achieving a better balance between erasure and preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 Retain-aware Activation Steering (RASteer)，通过在擦除方向中去除与保留子空间对齐的分量并自适应校准，实现更精准的概念擦除，兼顾目标擦除与保留概念生成。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法从目标概念构建擦除方向并在推理时沿该方向调整激活，但目标概念与保留概念在表征空间中常存在重叠，方向中含有保留概念所依赖的共享分量，直接引导会抑制被保留概念、损害非目标内容生成。
AI.method: RASteer 为免训练方法：首先由需保留概念构建保留子空间；再用 Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) 从擦除方向中移除与该子空间对齐的分量，提升引导对目标概念的特异性；随后引入 Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC)，在每层与每去噪步依据擦除方向与保留子空间的重叠程度，控制各共享分量的移除比例，从而平衡擦除与保留。
AI.result: 在多个骨干网络与基准上，针对不安全内容、实例与艺术风格的擦除实验表明，RASteer 达到或超越所评估的激活引导与权重编辑基线，在擦除与保留之间取得更优平衡。
AI.conclusion: 在激活引导中显式建模并自适应控制目标与保留概念共享分量的去除，可有效缓解擦除对非目标生成的损害，为文本到图像扩散模型的概念擦除提供了一种免训练且平衡性更好的方案。

title: Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for video generation usually assigns one scalar reward to an entire sampled video. Yet a video is not uniformly flawed: some visual tokens may already satisfy the prompt, whereas others require correction. A scalar reward cannot localize errors, causing optimization to perturb satisfactory tokens while under-targeting the tokens that actually need to change. We introduce Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning, TVRL, a framework that derives token-level credit from the reward being optimized. Our key insight is that the answer likelihood of a frozen vision-language model provides both signals: its outputs contribute to the video-level reward, while magnitudes of its video-input gradients reveal which generated video tokens most affect that score. We instantiate TVRL in Group Relative Policy Optimization by averaging prompt-derived question rewards into one group-relative advantage and using detached, question-conditioned token-credit maps to reweight dense denoising-transition log-probabilities inside the clipped policy ratio. On VBench-2.0, TVRL achieves an Overall score of 57.69, outperforming the base model by 3.60 points. TVRL also improves matched GRPO baselines across three SDE samplers (SAGE, Flow, and Dance) by 2.68--3.15 points and across four reward models (VideoAlign, VideoScore2, UnifiedReward2, and Qwen3.5-9B) by 1.33--3.15 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TVRL，从奖励中导出token级信用分配，用于视频生成的强化学习，在VBench-2.0上较基础模型提升3.60分。
AI.motivation: 视频生成中RL通常为整段采样视频分配单一标量奖励，但视频并非均匀存在缺陷：部分视觉token已符合提示，另一些则需修正。标量奖励无法定位错误，导致优化扰动已满意的token，而对真正需改变的token施加不足的优化。
AI.method: 核心洞察是冻结视觉语言模型的答案似然同时提供两种信号：其输出构成视频级奖励，其视频输入梯度幅值揭示哪些生成token对该分数影响最大。在GRPO中实例化TVRL：将提示导出的问题奖励平均为组相对优势，并用分离的、问题条件化的token信用图，在裁剪策略比率内重加权密集去噪转移对数概率。
AI.result: VBench-2.0总体得分57.69，较基础模型提升3.60分；在SAGE、Flow、Dance三种SDE采样器上较匹配的GRPO基线提升2.68–3.15分；在VideoAlign、VideoScore2、UnifiedReward2、Qwen3.5-9B四种奖励模型上提升1.33–3.15分。
AI.conclusion: TVRL通过从奖励中导出token级信用分配，实现更精细的视频生成RL优化，在多种采样器与奖励模型上均稳定优于GRPO基线，验证了token级信用在视频生成RL中的有效性。

title: Universal Byte-Level Encoding: UTF-8/UTF-16 Routing to Reduce Cross-Script Token-Budget Disparities
summary: Byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizers are attractive for multilingual large language models (LLMs) because they cover all Unicode text. In UTF-8-based BBPE, however, many scripts start from a higher fallback cost than English: when no learned merges can be applied, a multibyte character requires multiple byte-derived symbols. We call this worst-case pre-merge cost the encoding floor. A higher floor can increase token counts and per-request cost and shrink usable context. Changing the text encoding can reduce this gap, but a single global encoding can make already-efficient English spans more expensive in mixed-script text. We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps 1-2-byte UTF-8 characters on the UTF-8 path while routing 3-4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE); the merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE's LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and slightly lowers English token counts, yielding more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE)，一种双字母表 tokenizer：1-2 字节 UTF-8 字符走 UTF-8 路径，3-4 字节字符改走 UTF-16，从而降低 3 字节 BMP 字符的编码下限，缓解多语言 LLM 中的跨语言 token 不均衡问题。
AI.motivation: UTF-8 基的 BBPE 虽覆盖全部 Unicode，但许多非英语文字存在更高的 "encoding floor"（最坏情况下合并前成本）：当无可用的已学合并规则时，多字节字符需由多个字节派生符号表示。较高的编码下限会增加 token 数与单请求成本并压缩可用上下文。然而改用单一全局编码又会使混排文本中原本高效的英文片段变贵，因此需要一种既能降下限又不损害英文效率的方案。
AI.method: UBE 采用双字母表设计：保留 1-2 字节 UTF-8 字符于 UTF-8 路径，将 3-4 字节 UTF-8 字符路由至 UTF-16。它仅改变呈现给 BPE 的字节表示，合并规则仍为标准 BPE，且保持精确可解码性。该方法可与替代边界策略及基于形态学的表示相组合。作者通过 Unicode 17 审计与测试套件验证往返一致性，并进行内在评估与多语言 LM 实验。
AI.result: 在 Unicode 17 审计中，UBE 对所有 Unicode 标量值以及官方 normalization、grapheme-break、emoji 测试套件的全部输入实现精确往返。内在评估显示 UBE 降低了英文归一化 token 计数比值的离散度，缩小跨语言 token 预算差距。多语言 LM 实验中 UBE 达到与 BBPE 相当的 LM 质量；在主要多语言设置下，UBE 对高 premium 文字降 token 效果最明显，并略微降低英文 token 数，在固定 token 预算下带来更多可用上下文，并在内容匹配基准上加快 prompt 处理。
AI.conclusion: UBE 通过双字母表字节路由有效降低非英语文字（尤其 3 字节 BMP 字符）的编码下限，在不牺牲英文效率与 LM 质量的前提下缓解跨语言 token 预算不均衡，提升上下文可用性并加速 prompt 处理，且保持精确解码、可与现有 BPE 及边界/形态策略兼容。

title: Continual Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models by Suppressing Cross-Edit Interference
summary: Concept erasure removes copyright-protected, privacy-sensitive, or otherwise undesirable concepts from pretrained text-to-image diffusion models to support content governance and compliance. As erasure requests arrive over time, models must remove new targets without undoing prior erasures. Existing methods do not constrain interference across edits: residual perturbations outside the retain set interact and accumulate, degrading unrelated generations and sometimes collapsing previously erased targets into noise. We propose CEASE (Continual Erasure via Adaptive Subspace Editing), a training-free method that imposes two subspace constraints on a closed-form solver. CEASE adds the token representation of the shared replacement to the solver's invariance matrix and, when interference is detected, projects the current update onto the orthogonal complement of dominant output directions extracted from cumulative past updates. A closed-form decomposition attributes the accumulated interference to repeated activation of the shared replacement and overlap between successive update directions, showing that the two constraints suppress these respective sources. Across continual erasure of celebrities, artistic styles, and instances, CEASE achieves the most consistent erase-preserve trade-off, while existing methods either degrade general generation or insufficiently erase targets.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练连续擦除方法CEASE，通过两项子空间约束抑制编辑间干扰，在名人、艺术风格与实例的连续擦除中实现最一致的擦除-保留权衡。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型需随时间响应擦除请求，去除版权、隐私等不良概念以支持内容治理与合规。现有方法未约束多次编辑间的相互干扰：保留集之外的残差扰动会相互作用并累积，导致无关生成退化，甚至使先前已擦除的目标坍缩为噪声。
AI.method: CEASE（基于自适应子空间编辑的连续擦除）是一种免训练方法，在闭式求解器上施加两项子空间约束：一是将共享替换token的表示加入求解器的不变矩阵；二是在检测到干扰时，将当前更新投影到由累积历史更新中提取的主导输出方向的正交补空间。
AI.result: 通过闭式分解将累积干扰归因于共享替换的重复激活与相邻更新方向间的重叠，表明两项约束分别抑制了这两个来源。在名人、艺术风格和实例的连续擦除任务中，CEASE取得最一致的擦除-保留权衡，而现有方法要么损害通用生成能力，要么擦除不充分。
AI.conclusion: CEASE通过自适应子空间约束有效抑制连续擦除中的干扰累积，在不损害通用生成的前提下稳定移除多个目标，为扩散模型的内容治理与合规提供了训练无关的可扩展方案。

title: Comparing a gradient boosting algorithm to the GOES FDC for wildfire detection
summary: Wildfires pose severe risks to human life, ecosystems, and property. This study presents a machine learning approach for wildfire detection from GOES ABI imagery. A CatBoost model was trained on a large dataset with thousands of ABI images and over 300,000 matching VIIRS fire detections. An evaluation on a separate dataset across five regions showed that the learned CatBoost model outperformed the operational GOES Fire Detection and Characterization (FDC) product. It achieved higher precision, recall, and F1 scores both within and outside the training area. The CatBoost model achieved F1 scores that were 0.16 to 0.38 higher than the GOES FDC in all regions. In addition, out of 51 historical fire events, the CatBoost detected 26 fires before both VIIRS and GOES FDC, compared to only six earlier detections by the GOES FDC. Importantly, the CatBoost model achieved accurate wildfire detection also during nighttime, whereas the GOES FDC obtained very low recall values, around 0.03. This study demonstrates that machine learning models may offer significant improvements over existing geostationary fire products, including higher accuracy, fewer false alarms, and earlier detection.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出基于GOES ABI影像的CatBoost野火检测模型，在精度、召回、F1及早发现能力上均优于运行中的GOES FDC产品，并显著改善夜间检测性能。
AI.motivation: 野火对人类生命、生态系统和财产构成严重威胁，需要更准确、更及时的检测手段。现有运行中的地球静止卫星火点产品（GOES FDC）在准确性和夜间检测等方面存在不足，因此探索机器学习方法以提升野火检测性能具有重要价值。
AI.method: 构建大规模训练数据集，包含数千张GOES ABI影像及超过30万条匹配的VIIRS火点检测结果；在此基础上训练CatBoost模型；并在覆盖五个区域的独立数据集上进行评估，与GOES FDC产品进行对比。评估指标包括精确率、召回率和F1分数，并考察夜间检测能力及对51起历史火灾事件的首次发现时间。
AI.result: 在五个区域的独立数据集上，CatBoost模型的精确率、召回率和F1分数均高于GOES FDC，无论在训练区域内还是区域外；各区域F1分数比GOES FDC高出0.16至0.38。在51起历史火灾事件中，CatBoost在VIIRS和GOES FDC之前发现26起，而GOES FDC仅提前发现6起。夜间检测方面，CatBoost仍能保持准确检测，而GOES FDC召回率极低，约为0.03。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，机器学习模型相较现有地球静止卫星火点产品具有显著改进潜力，可实现更高精度、更少误报和更早发现，尤其能够有效弥补夜间检测的短板。

title: From Reasoning Failures to Composable Video Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial reasoning benchmarks evaluate vision-language models across diverse tasks, but task-level scores do not reveal which underlying capabilities account for success or failure. Each task requires recovering spatial evidence, representing geometry, and reasoning over it. We disentangle these capabilities by comparing predicted and ground-truth spatial context under a shared schema and coordinate contract. This comparison reveals four recurring sources of error: inaccurate perception, missing information in the spatial context, selection of the wrong measurement, and errors in reference frames or in tracking position and orientation. Guided by this diagnosis, we develop CROSS, a training-free library of typed geometric operators and spatial skills that function over available evidence to support reliable video spatial reasoning. The resulting library supplies verified context to non-coding VLMs or callable skills to a SpatialClaw agent. We evaluate \methodname{} on five benchmarks. \methodname{} raises the average score from 55.9\% to 60.2\% on ReVSI and improves the SpatialClaw result from 62.8\% to 66.3\% on DSI-Bench. These gains demonstrate that explicit handling of spatial conventions can repair systematic reasoning failures without additional training.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过统一模式与坐标约定对比预测和真实空间上下文，诊断出四类空间推理错误来源，并据此提出免训练的CROSS几何算子库，将验证过的空间上下文提供给非编程VLM或SpatialClaw智能体，在五个基准上提升了视频空间推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准仅给出任务级分数，无法揭示哪些底层能力导致成功或失败。每个任务都需要恢复空间证据、表示几何并进行推理，任务级评分掩盖了能力层面的差异，因此需要一种可分解能力、定位错误来源的诊断方法，以指导改进。
AI.method: 在共享的模式（schema）和坐标约定下，对比预测的空间上下文与真实空间上下文，从而将空间推理拆解为感知、几何表示与推理等能力并定位错误；据此构建CROSS——一个免训练的、类型化几何算子与空间技能库，作用于可用证据之上，为不编程的VLM提供经验证的上下文，或为SpatialClaw智能体提供可调用技能。
AI.result: 在五个基准上评估CROSS：在ReVSI上平均分从55.9%提升至60.2%；在DSI-Bench上SpatialClaw的结果从62.8%提升至66.3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式处理空间约定（坐标、参考系、度量选择等）能够修复系统性的推理失败，且无需任何额外训练，说明诊断驱动的免训练算子库是提升视频空间推理的有效途径。

title: Weather-Aware Domain Adaptation for Street-View Weather Recognition
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Published in the 2026 IEEE Conference on Technologies for Sustainability (SusTech)
summary: Adverse conditions such as rain, snow, fog, and dust remain challenging for camera-based perception in autonomous driving. We study multi-class weather recognition from street-view images under domain shift, where most available training data come from non-street-view sources that differ markedly from real driving scenes. We propose Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA), which conditions the domain discriminator on predicted weather to promote features that are both domain-invariant and weather-sensitive. We also assemble a multi-dataset benchmark by unifying diverse non-street-view weather collections as sources and real street-view images as targets, and define a standardized evaluation protocol with macro accuracy as the primary metric. Across backbones (ResNet-50, EfficientNet, VGG, DenseNet), WA-ADDA consistently improves street-view performance and yields strong per-class recalls in challenging conditions while preserving clear-weather accuracy. These findings highlight the feasibility of domain-adapted weather recognition and the value of our benchmark for advancing robust, on-board perception.

AI.tldr: 提出WA-ADDA方法，通过条件化域判别器实现跨域多类天气识别，并构建了街景天气识别基准。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶中基于相机的感知在雨、雪、雾、尘等恶劣天气下仍具挑战性；训练数据多来自非街景来源，与真实驾驶场景存在显著域偏移，导致街景天气识别性能受限。
AI.method: 提出Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation（WA-ADDA），以预测天气为条件对域判别器进行条件化，促使学到的特征同时具备域不变性与天气敏感性；并整合多样非街景天气数据集为源域、真实街景图像为目标域，构建多数据集基准及以宏平均准确率为主指标的标准化评测协议。
AI.result: 在ResNet-50、EfficientNet、VGG、DenseNet等多种骨干网络上，WA-ADDA均稳定提升街景天气识别性能，在恶劣天气下取得较高的各类召回率，同时保持晴好天气准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了域自适应天气识别的可行性，以及该基准对推进鲁棒车载感知研究的价值。

title: Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks
comment: 44 pages, 9 figures. Code, benchmark protocol, scoring code, and all 288 per-cell results: https://github.com/Mingbird/Mingbird-agent
summary: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate point-by-point for small-model failure forms, three of them representative: a byte-level net-zero prefill budget, a finish gate that re-reads the task before accepting completion, and signature-level loop detection. On LRAB, a controlled comparison holding machine, models, budgets, and scoring fixed (4 harnesses $\times$ 4 open models (2B-35B) $\times$ 18 real tasks, deterministic artifact scoring), Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), and 0.405 (agent-mini), with all 288 cells published; on $τ^2$-bench (278 tasks, three arms, one protocol) it totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737; and a frontier-model probe on the same 18 tasks spans 0.997 to 0.478 across harnesses, with well-formed scaffolds staying within 0.072 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation is reported as directional only: same-night replications of the same arm move its mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal single-trial delta, and the one batch-matched comparison (full mechanism stack versus text re-read alone) gives the executable completion guards a paired +0.10 across three replications. The evidence carries stated limits: a self-built benchmark, a single machine, and single-trial scoring.

AI.tldr: 论文提出本地优先的小模型智能体框架 Mingbird，论证小模型在云端智能体编排（harness）下的失败多源于框架而非模型本身。通过受控对比（LRAB）与第三方基准（τ²-bench），Mingbird 显著优于 goose、opencode、agent-mini 等框架。
AI.motivation: 小参数开源权重模型（2-9B）虽可在普通笔记本上运行，但在云规模的智能体调度框架下几乎无法完成真实任务，表现为工具预填充溢出上下文、自纠正发散、工具演示循环、任务被静默放弃。作者认为这些失败很大程度上可归因于编排框架而非模型能力。
AI.method: 提出本地优先的智能体框架 Mingbird（面向 Windows 与 Ollama），含十项机制逐点补偿小模型失败形态，三个代表机制为：字节级净零预填充预算、接受完成前重读任务的完成门控（finish gate）、签名级循环检测。在受控的 LRAB 基准上固定机器、模型、预算与评分（4 框架×4 开源模型（2B-35B）×18 真实任务，确定性产物评分），并在 τ²-bench（278 任务、三臂、单一协议）上评测，另做前沿模型探针与留一机制消融。
AI.result: LRAB 上 Mingbird 总分 0.886，对比 goose 0.631、opencode 0.479、agent-mini 0.405，288 个单元格全部公开；τ²-bench 上总分 0.856，对比 0.791 与 0.737；同一 18 任务的前沿模型探针在不同框架下跨度为 0.997 至 0.478，结构良好的脚手架彼此差距在 0.072 以内。留一机制消融仅作方向性参考：同夜复现可使同一臂均值变动达 0.069，等于每个名义单次试验增量；唯一批次匹配对比（完整机制栈 vs 仅文本重读）在三次复现中显示可执行完成门控配对增益 +0.10。
AI.conclusion: 相当一部分小模型智能体失败可归因于编排框架而非模型本身，Mingbird 通过针对性机制补偿显著提升完成率。但证据存在明确局限：自建基准、单机环境与单次试验评分。

title: Mem++: Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents now take part in organizational work, where many authors record decisions across documents over months. Because a revised decision arrives as a new document rather than an edit, answering a question requires knowing which version held at a given time. However, most memory systems compress the record at write time. By distilling each document into facts, notes or graph edges, these methods fix what can be answered before any question is asked. To address this, we propose Mem++, a non-destructive memory framework shifting from write-time distillation to read-time selection. Mem++ stores every document whole with its date and author, and it calls no generative model at write time. At read time, it retrieves only documents dated up to the time a question asks about and fuses lexical and semantic rankings. Unlike systems that overwrite older versions, Mem++ keeps them and leaves the choice to the answering model. Evaluations on the organizational benchmark OrgMemBench demonstrate that Mem++ surpasses the strongest memory system baseline by 8.0 to 13.1 points across two answering models. With gpt-4.1-mini, it also achieves the best overall score, 2.6 points above RAG. In addition, Mem++ achieves the best average LLM-judge score on LoCoMo and ranks second on LongMemEval-S, behind only its entity-graph variant. Code for benchmark evaluation is available at https://github.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Mem++，一种非破坏性记忆框架，将记忆处理从"写入时蒸馏"转为"读取时选择"，在保留全部原始文档的基础上按时间检索与融合排序，从而更准确地回答涉及决策版本演变的问题。
AI.motivation: 在组织工作中，LLM 智能体需要在跨月、跨文档的场景下记录决策，修订版决策以新文档形式出现而非对旧文档的编辑，因此回答问题必须先判断某个时间点上哪一版本有效。然而现有记忆系统多在写入时压缩记录，例如把文档蒸馏为事实、笔记或图边，这等于在任何问题提出之前就固定了可回答的内容范围，导致涉及版本演变与时序的问题无法被正确回答。
AI.method: Mem++ 采用非破坏性记忆设计：写入时不做任何生成式蒸馏，完整保存每篇文档及其日期与作者，不调用生成模型；读取时仅在问题所指向的时间点之前（含该时间点）检索相关文档，并融合词法排序与语义排序进行选择。与覆盖旧版本的系统不同，Mem++ 保留历史版本，把版本取舍的判断权交给回答模型。
AI.result: 在组织记忆基准 OrgMemBench 上，Mem++ 相较最强的记忆系统基线在两个回答模型上分别提升 8.0 至 13.1 个点；在使用 gpt-4.1-mini 时取得最佳总分，比 RAG 高 2.6 分。此外，Mem++ 在 LoCoMo 上取得最佳平均 LLM-judge 得分，在 LongMemEval-S 上排名第二，仅次于其自身实体图变体。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，非破坏性、读取时选择的记忆范式在需要时间敏感与版本追溯的组织场景中优于写入时蒸馏式记忆系统，且具有跨基准的泛化能力。基准评测代码已开源。

title: Exploring Weaknesses of Generative Image Watermarks against Latent Frequency Masking
comment: This work has been accepted for publication at IEEE ICDM 2026 conference. The final published version will be available via IEEE Xplore
summary: Invisible watermarking has become a central tool for tracing AI-generated images, but its robustness against adaptive removal attacks remains an open security question. We introduce Latent Frequency Masking, an attack that erases watermark evidence by replacing selected Fourier coefficients in the latent representation of a watermarked image. The replacement can be sampled from Gaussian noise for efficiency or derived from diffusion regeneration for improved image preservation.
