AI.result: 相较最强基线，PSNR提升8.7%，覆盖率提升5.96个绝对点，Betti误差降低9.2%；令牌数比次紧凑基线少70.0%，比稀疏或分层令牌器少98%以上；训练内存降低40.4%，推理时间减少58.5%。定性结果显示薄结构、重复部件和长程连通性保持更好。
AI.conclusion: SILSA通过切片潜变量与拓扑监督，在显著降低生成成本的同时提升结构保真度与拓扑一致性。

title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research
summary: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.

AI.tldr: 论文构建 ScholarCatalyst 数据集，通过可扩展的作者标注流程，让 207 篇近期计算机科学论文的 184 位第一作者标注哪些早期文献推动或可能推动了其研究，并提出"给定初始研究问题、仅从项目开始时可得文献中检索关键先行工作"的检索任务，发现智能体搜索与嵌入检索表现相当，即便强模型智能体也仅达 0.51 R@20，凸显模型缺乏专家式文献搜索直觉。
AI.motivation: 科学家在"感知一个全新问题需要哪些被埋没的早期思想"方面远胜当前 AI 系统。作者希望研究这一难以量化的科研直觉能力，但由于缺少"作者亲历、可判定哪些前期工作真正推动了项目"的标注数据，该技能难以被评估与训练，因此需要构建带作者判断的检索任务与数据集。
AI.method: 1) 设计可扩展的自动化标注流水线，实现作者标注的大规模收集；2) 邀请 207 篇近期计算机科学论文的 184 位第一作者，对候选文献逐条标注其是否推动（或可能推动）已完成项目，并附详细理由；3) 构建 ScholarCatalyst 数据集，并定义一项检索任务：给定初始研究问题，只能从项目开始时可获取的文献中检索这些论文，采用 Recall@20 评估。
AI.result: 智能体式搜索（agentic search）表现并不优于嵌入检索（0.42 对 0.48 Recall@20），尽管前者把同一检索器当作工具调用；即便基于 Claude Fable 5.1 构建、可能在训练中见过这些已完成论文的智能体，也仅达到 0.51 R@20。
AI.conclusion: 现有方法在模拟科学家"文献直觉"上仍有明显差距，说明需要新的训练范式来赋予模型面向广域文献库的专家级检索直觉。ScholarCatalyst 被视为迈向"科学智能体可接收半成型想法并指向其所需先行研究"的一步。

title: Embedding Prediction Helps Image Generation
summary: In diffusion transformers, a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. We ask whether predicted embeddings can serve as this condition instead. Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA) trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding in a sequence. In generation, the clean image follows the noisy image, so its embeddings are the next embeddings after the condition and the noisy image. We train a NEPA model to predict them all at once with Multi-Embedding Prediction, and in Embedding Conditioned Generation, a DiT generator is conditioned on these predictions, recomputed at every denoising step, so the conditioning signal adapts to the current noisy state. Experiments on class-conditional ImageNet $256\times256$ study the condition of the generator, the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction, and the scaling of both models. The NEPA model adds a second network to every sampling step; with it, and combined with REPA, our final model, NEPA-DiT-XL, reaches an FID of 1.32 using about a third of the training compute of REPA.

AI.tldr: 提出NEPA，用可预测的连续嵌入作为扩散Transformer的条件，在每个去噪步重新计算，实现自适应条件；NEPA-DiT-XL在ImageNet 256×256上FID达1.32，训练计算量约为REPA的三分之一。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散Transformer中，类标签或文本提示仅被嵌入一次，并在每个去噪步重复使用同一条件，条件信号是静态的、无法随当前噪声状态自适应调整。作者追问：能否改用"预测出的嵌入"来充当这一条件。
AI.method: 提出NEPA（Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression），训练Transformer预测序列中的下一个连续嵌入。生成时干净图像位于噪声图像之后，故其嵌入是条件与噪声图像之后的下一个嵌入。采用Multi-Embedding Prediction一次性预测全部嵌入；在Embedding Conditioned Generation中，DiT生成器以这些预测为条件，并在每个去噪步重新计算，使条件随当前噪声状态自适应变化。在ImageNet 256×256类条件生成上研究了生成器条件方式、Multi-Embedding Prediction设计及两模型缩放。
AI.result: 在类条件ImageNet 256×256上，NEPA在每个采样步增加第二个网络；结合该方法与REPA，最终模型NEPA-DiT-XL取得FID 1.32，训练计算量约为REPA的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 预测嵌入可作为扩散Transformer的自适应条件替代静态标签/文本条件；逐去噪步重算的条件信号显著提升生成质量与训练效率，且方法具备良好的缩放性。

title: PROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?
summary: Programmable world models separate executable dynamics from visual generation, offering a promising foundation for next-generation game engines. However, their visual adherence to explicit rules and interactions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing benchmarks assess visual quality, controllability, and instruction or physical adherence, but rarely test fidelity to fine-grained, program-specified world events. We introduce PROWBench, comprising 170 programmatically constructed episodes and 600 proxy videos covering diverse scenes and interactions. PROWBench logs entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera's field of view, as replayable world records, from which it renders synchronized views and proxy representations. This enables generated videos to be checked against the observable consequences of program execution. An extensible framework constructs scenes, controls behaviors, and can render each camera view in different representations, such as coarse 3D, and bounding boxes. The benchmark covers first- and third-person perspectives, with synchronized multi-view observations available for a subset of episodes. Grounded in these records, PROWBench evaluates entity control, long-horizon memory, and, with two VLM-based metrics, Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate, adherence to the prescribed timeline and the visual realization of timestamped engine-recorded events.

AI.tldr: 提出PROWBench基准，用程序化构造的可回放世界记录评测可编程世界模型对细粒度世界事件的视觉忠实度。
AI.motivation: 可编程世界模型将可执行动力学与视觉生成分离，但现有基准多评估视觉质量、可控性、指令或物理遵循度，很少检验对程序指定的细粒度世界事件的忠实度，视觉遵循性与交互一致性缺乏充分评测。
AI.method: 构建PROWBench，含170个程序化episode与600个代理视频，覆盖多样场景与交互；记录实体状态与带时间戳事件（含视野外事件）作为可回放世界记录，据此渲染同步视角与代理表示。提供可扩展框架以构造场景、控制行为并渲染不同表示（如粗3D、边界框），覆盖第一/第三人称视角，部分episode提供同步多视角观测。基于记录评估实体控制、长时程记忆，并用两个VLM指标（Logic-Render Alignment与Interaction Success Rate）评估时间线遵循度与带时间戳引擎事件的视觉实现。
AI.result: PROWBench能对生成视频与程序执行的可观测后果进行对照检验，覆盖实体控制、长时程记忆、逻辑-渲染对齐及交互成功率等维度。
AI.conclusion: PROWBench填补了细粒度程序指定世界事件视觉忠实度评测的空白，为可编程世界模型与下一代游戏引擎提供可回放、多视角、可扩展的评测基础。

title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://risys-lab.github.io/KaliBench/ | Github: https://github.com/RISys-Lab/KaliBench
summary: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KaliBench，一个面向Kali Linux的自然语言到CLI命令生成的细粒度基准与数据集，包含8,504个查询-命令对，覆盖1,642个工具，并支持可验证奖励训练。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在网络安全评估中侧重知识测评或端到端智能体任务，未能直接衡量模型为真实安全工具生成可执行命令的能力。而安全运维依赖严格的命令行接口，细微语法错误、参数绑定错误或参数顺序错误都会导致执行失败，因此亟需针对性基准。
AI.method: 构建KaliBench，通过基于文档的流水线、确定性规范化与别名感知评估生成数据；采用多阶段验证流水线结合LLM验证、沙箱终端执行与人工在环优化，保证语义正确性与可执行性；并基于细粒度确定性信号设计免运行时可验证奖励用于训练。
AI.result: 在三种评估模式和24种通用及安全专用开源权重模型配置下，无限制设置中无开源模型超过42%的精确命令准确率；使用KaliBench监督微调与可验证奖励强化学习后，8B模型性能显著提升，达到与685B MoE模型相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: KaliBench填补了自然语言到安全工具CLI翻译评估的空白，揭示了开源模型在无工具提示下准确使用CLI安全工具的困难，并证明其可有效用于训练与提升中小模型性能。

title: One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars
summary: 3D Gaussian avatars support fast rendering, however, their real-time animation is often challenged by the costly neural inference. We address this bottleneck and show that the animation of pretrained avatar models can be closely approximated by a linear combination of identity-independent blendshapes. Building on this finding, we introduce GALA (Gaussian Animation via Linear Approximation), a distillation method that replaces per-frame heavy neural decoding with a shallow coefficient predictor and a linear blend. To improve fidelity and reduce memory requirements, we propose to construct the basis using block-local PCA under a rendering-aware metric and a memory budget. Our method learns a shallow MLP network to predict blendshape coefficients and applies to various animation architectures without retraining original models. We validate GALA by accelerating the inference of three distinct avatar models for 3D animation of facial expressions and full-bodies with clothing dynamics. Across these models, our distillation generalizes to held-out identities and reduces CPU animation cost by up to three orders of magnitude while preserving most of the rendering quality. Excellent results of our method confirm the shared linear structure of learned avatar representations and enable highly efficient and accurate animation at frame rates reaching up to 60fps on mobile devices. Project page: https://ramazan793.github.io/gala/

AI.tldr: 提出GALA，用线性近似蒸馏预训练3D高斯虚拟人动画模型，以浅层系数预测器+线性混合替代逐帧神经解码，大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯虚拟人虽渲染快，但实时动画受制于高昂的神经推理开销，需要一种高效且保持质量的动画加速方案。
AI.method: 发现预训练虚拟人模型的动画可近似为与身份无关的blendshapes线性组合；据此提出GALA蒸馏方法：用浅层MLP预测blendshape系数并进行线性混合，替代每帧重型神经解码。基向量在渲染感知度量与内存预算下通过块局部PCA构建，可适配多种动画架构且无需重训原模型。
AI.result: 在三种不同虚拟人模型（面部表情与带服装动态的全身）上验证：可泛化到未见身份，CPU动画成本降低最多三个数量级，同时保留大部分渲染质量，移动端帧率可达60fps。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实学习到的虚拟人表示具有共享线性结构，可实现高效且准确的动画，支持移动端实时应用。

title: Sphere Encoder 2
comment: + one more ablation point for Fig.5. Code is available at https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2
summary: Sphere Encoder is an autoencoder that generates images by decoding random points from a high-dimensional latent sphere. We identify two limitations of the original formulation that reduce its generation quality. First, random points concentrate near the equator relative to the pole on an encoded latent, but the training rotation never reaches this region, leaving a gap that limits one-step generation. Second, training for generation with pixel-wise reconstruction loss encourages the decoder to average over plausible images, producing blurry images that lack high-frequency details. We present Sphere Encoder 2 to address both limitations, substantially improving image generation quality while maintaining the speed and simplicity of a autoencoder. Models are released at https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Sphere Encoder 2，针对 Sphere Encoder 自编码器图像生成中随机点集中于隐球赤道附近而训练旋转未覆盖该区域，以及像素级重建损失导致生成模糊两个问题，在保持自编码器速度与简洁性的同时显著提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 原始 Sphere Encoder 通过从高维隐球上采样随机点并解码来生成图像，但其生成质量受两方面限制：一是随机点集中在相对极点而言的赤道附近，而训练旋转从未到达该区域，形成间隙，限制了一步生成；二是以像素级重建损失进行生成训练会促使解码器对多个可行图像取平均，导致图像模糊、缺乏高频细节。
AI.method: 文章提出 Sphere Encoder 2，以同时解决上述两个限制。摘要未给出具体技术细节，仅说明其针对赤道区域覆盖间隙与像素级重建损失导致的模糊问题进行了改进设计。
AI.result: Sphere Encoder 2 在保持自编码器速度与简洁性的同时，显著提升了图像生成质量。模型已在 https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2 发布。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别并修正随机采样分布覆盖不足与像素重建损失造成的模糊问题，Sphere Encoder 2 在维持自编码器高效简洁特性的前提下大幅改善了生成质量，并公开了模型。

title: Moore, Escher, Penrose: A Conformal Golden Braid
summary: I don't think I have ever done anything as peculiar in my life. Among other things, it shows a young man looking with interest at a print on the wall of an exhibition that features himself. How can this be? Perhaps I am not far removed from Einstein's curved universe.'' So wrote M.C. Escher about his 1956 lithograph Print Gallery. Nearly half a century later, a mathematical analysis related its geometry to an untwisted source image through a conformal power map $z \mapsto z^α$, $α\in \mathbb{C}$. Building on this construction, we use a frozen text-to-image diffusion model to generate new self-referential scenes. Prompting alone does not enforce the recursion, while a post-hoc transformation can leave structures poorly connected. Applying the transformation during sampling is also insufficient: the denoiser may "repair" the intended distortion or drift out of the prescribed geometry. We construct a generalized inverse $T^\dagger$ of the non-invertible image transformation $T$, adapted to its recursive constraint. In the idealized formulation, the Penrose identity $TT^\dagger T = T$ makes $TT^\dagger$ an idempotent projection onto geometrically admissible images. Yet denoising only the transformed image remains an out-of-distribution task, even with projection. We therefore braid denoising steps with $T$ and $T^\dagger$: source-space steps develop the untwisted scene, while transformed-space steps refine its appearance and connections in the final geometry. We generate Print Gallery-like compositions and explore further transformations. Rather than distorting a finished image, we let the scene and its distortion develop together.

AI.tldr: 该论文将埃舍尔《Print Gallery》的共形幂映射几何与冻结的文本到图像扩散模型结合，通过构造非可逆变换T的广义逆T†并在去噪采样中交替编织T与T†，生成自指递归场景。
AI.motivation: 《Print Gallery》的几何可用共形映射z↦z^α关联其扭曲与无扭曲源图像；作者希望利用冻结的扩散模型生成类似的自指递归场景。但仅靠提示词无法强制递归，事后变换会导致结构连接不良，采样中施加变换又会被去噪器"修复"或偏离规定几何，因此需要新方法。
AI.method: 基于非可逆图像变换T构造适应其递归约束的广义逆T†，理想情形下Penrose恒等式TT†T=T使TT†成为几何可容许图像上的幂等投影。但仅对变换后图像去噪仍是分布外任务，故将去噪步与T、T†交替编织：源空间步发展无扭曲场景，变换空间步精修其在最终几何中的外观与连接。生成Print Gallery式构图并探索更多变换。
AI.result: 成功生成Print Gallery式自指构图并探索了更多变换，使场景与其扭曲共同生成，而非先完成图像再施加扭曲。
AI.conclusion: 通过广义逆与去噪步骤的编织，可在采样过程中同时发展场景及其几何扭曲，实现扩散模型驱动的自指递归图像生成，无需依赖提示词或事后变换。

title: DeskForge: Dense Supervision from Desktop Environments for Computer-Use Agents
comment: 37 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/deskforge/
summary: Computer-use agents need to reliably ground action targets in complex desktop scenes, where multiple applications, overlapping windows, and visually similar controls compete for attention. Existing training data rarely pair such scenes with dense annotations or vary them in a controlled way. We introduce DeskForge, a controllable desktop environment that composes and explores real applications to generate large-scale supervision for computer-use agents. It varies application states, content, window layout, appearance, and resolution, and fuses screenshots, accessibility trees, and window geometry into dense element annotations while recording the outcome of each executed action. Using this environment, we construct DeskForge-1M, a corpus of 1.2M annotated desktop observations containing 159.7M element instances. We fine-tune four vision-language models on 200K grounding examples drawn from DeskForge-1M. All four improve across held-out desktop conditions and on all five external GUI grounding benchmarks; for Qwen3.5-4B, accuracy increases by 11.51 percentage points on ScreenSpot-Pro and 10.11 points on OSWorld-G. The gains also translate to long-horizon task completion: under a fixed planner, the fine-tuned action models solve more WebArena-Infinity and OpenApps tasks, with Qwen3.5-4B increasing from 31 to 50 of 119 tasks and from 3 to 15 of 100 tasks, respectively. These results show that controllable composition of real desktop environments provides a scalable source of supervision for improving both GUI grounding and long-horizon computer use. The framework code, the dataset, and the fine-tuned model are available from the project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/deskforge/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出可控桌面环境DeskForge，通过组合真实应用生成大规模监督数据（DeskForge-1M，120万观测、1.597亿元素实例），微调四个视觉语言模型后，在五个外部GUI grounding基准和长程任务上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体需在复杂桌面场景（多应用、重叠窗口、视觉相似控件）中可靠地定位动作目标，但现有训练数据很少将此类场景与密集标注配对，也缺乏可控的变化方式，导致监督数据稀缺。
AI.method: 构建可控桌面环境DeskForge，组合并探索真实应用，系统变化应用状态、内容、窗口布局、外观与分辨率；将截图、无障碍树和窗口几何信息融合为密集元素标注，并记录每个执行动作的结果。基于此构建DeskForge-1M语料库（120万条标注观测、1.597亿元素实例），并从中抽取20万grounding样本微调四个视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 四个模型在留出的桌面条件下和全部五个外部GUI grounding基准上均有提升；Qwen3.5-4B在ScreenSpot-Pro上准确率提升11.51个百分点，在OSWorld-G上提升10.11个百分点。在固定规划器下，微调后的动作模型在WebArena-Infinity上从119个任务完成31个提升至50个，在OpenApps上从100个任务完成3个提升至15个。
AI.conclusion: 可控地组合真实桌面环境可为提升GUI grounding和长程计算机使用提供可扩展的监督来源；框架代码、数据集与微调模型已在项目页面公开。

title: SCION: Scene Composition with Instanced Neural Primitives
summary: Real-world scenes are compositional: bricks, blades of grass, pebbles, and tree leaves recur across human-built and natural environments. Existing neural scene representations model these elements independently. Most 3D Gaussian Splatting and follow-up abstraction and compression methods treat each element as unique, fitting millions of independent Gaussians per scene. Prior methods like Splat and Replace fit template objects, but they require mostly manual selection of repeated elements. As a result, these representations store redundant parameters and provide weak manipulation handles for downstream tasks. We introduce SCION, a hierarchical compositional scene representation that replaces independent Gaussians with a compact vocabulary of reusable primitives and lightweight world-space instances that place transformed copies throughout the scene. We fit this representation to multi-view captures via a joint optimization over discrete and continuous scene parameters, combining two-level densification over splats and instances with an adversarial loss that preserves detail across shared primitives. The recovered structure yields a compact, controllable representation while maintaining high quality even at 1.2 MB. SCION achieves rate-distortion favorable to existing Gaussian compression methods, and it enables instance-level scene editing and animation without retraining. Our results show that neural scene representations need not memorize scenes as independent primitives; they can discover reusable parts. Project webpage: https://light.princeton.edu/SCION

AI.tldr: SCION提出层次化组合式场景表示，用可复用基元词汇表及世界空间实例替代独立3D高斯，通过离散-连续联合优化拟合多视角采集，实现高压缩率与实例级编辑。
AI.motivation: 真实场景具有组合性，砖块、草叶、卵石、树叶等在自然与人造环境中反复出现。然而现有神经场景表示（如3D Gaussian Splatting及其抽象压缩方法）多将每个元素视为独立个体，为每个场景拟合数百万个独立高斯，导致参数冗余、存储冗余，且缺乏下游任务所需的操作接口。已有模板替换方法（如Splat and Replace）虽拟合模板物体，但需大量人工选择重复元素。
AI.method: SCION构建层次化组合场景表示：以紧凑的可复用基元词汇表（vocabulary of reusable primitives）替代独立高斯，并用轻量级世界空间实例将变换后的副本放置于场景中。通过对离散与连续场景参数的联合优化，将该表示拟合到多视角采集数据，结合splat与instance两级致密化（two-level densification）以及对抗损失以在共享基元间保持细节。
AI.result: 恢复出的结构在1.2 MB下仍保持高质量，得到紧凑且可控的表示。SCION在率失真性能上优于现有高斯压缩方法，并支持无需重训练的实例级场景编辑与动画。
AI.conclusion: 神经场景表示无需将场景记忆为独立基元，而能够发现可复用的部件，从而实现紧凑、可控且高质量的表示。

title: World-Calibrated Proposal-to-Action Flow for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies generate action chunks by transporting samples from a task-agnostic isotropic Gaussian source. As this source is conditioned on neither recent execution nor predicted future evolution, (i) it discards the local continuity established by recently executed motion. (ii) Even when predictive world representations are introduced, they often only condition the transport dynamics rather than determine where generation starts, how far it may deviate, or along which action directions it may expand. Building on this observation, we introduce ProAct, a world-calibrated proposal-to-action framework that makes the generative source itself predictable. (i) To preserve motion continuity, a lightweight Proposal Expert converts recent actions into a scene-aware hypothesis via one motion-anchored endpoint flow-matching step, initializing generation near the demonstrated action manifold. (ii) To jointly capture intended scene evolution and proposal-future compatibility, a prospective World Expert treats the hypothesis as a soft motion prior while predicting the task-consistent latent future. (iii) From this compatibility, the model calibrates a proposal-centered anisotropic source, where a bounded per-step extent controls the allowed deviation and a trace-normalized low-rank geometry under a condition-number budget allocates refinement over coupled translation, rotation, and gripper directions. Compared with $π_{0.5}$, ProAct improves performance across simulation and real-world tasks while reducing denoising steps by 50%, inference latency by up to 25.8%, and increasing throughput by up to 34.8%.

AI.tldr: ProAct：一种世界校准的 proposal-to-action 框架，让基于流的 VLA 策略的生成源本身变得可预测，从而保持运动连续性并提升效率。
AI.motivation: 基于流的 VLA 策略从任务无关的各向同性高斯源生成动作块，该源既不条件于近期执行，也不条件于预测的未来演化。因此：(i) 它丢弃了近期已执行运动所建立的局部连续性；(ii) 即使引入预测性世界表征，通常也只条件于传输动力学，而非决定生成起点、允许的偏差范围及动作扩展方向。
AI.method: ProAct 包含三个组件：(i) 轻量 Proposal Expert 通过一次运动锚定的端点流匹配步骤，将近期动作转换为场景感知假设，使生成初始化靠近示范动作流形；(ii) 前瞻性 World Expert 将该假设作为软运动先验，预测任务一致的潜未来，从而联合捕捉预期场景演化与 proposal-future 兼容性；(iii) 基于该兼容性校准 proposal 为中心的各向异性源，用有界的每步 extent 控制允许偏差，并在条件数预算下用迹归一化低秩几何将精化分配到耦合的平移、旋转和夹爪方向。
AI.result: 与 π_{0.5} 相比，ProAct 在仿真和真实世界任务上均提升性能，同时将去噪步数减少 50%、推理延迟最多降低 25.8%、吞吐量最多提升 34.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过让生成源本身可预测，ProAct 在保持运动连续性和场景一致性的同时显著提升效率，验证了世界校准的 proposal-to-action 范式的有效性。

title: Least Squares for Time Series Forecasting
summary: A time-series forecast is scored on a future value of the series. A representation loss that regresses the next latent, as in LeNEPA, is a different least-squares problem on the same bottleneck. We write both programs down. The forecast program minimizes the error of a decoded latent on the coordinate that will be reported. For a scalar target and a linear decoder, every latent rank of at least one matches ordinary least squares, and an isotropy constraint is only a rescaling: after the decoder is refit, the forecast does not move. The other program fits the whole next vector at a fixed rank, then freezes the encoder and attaches a head. On a four-dimensional series whose last three coordinates are the same autoregression, that rank-1 fit puts mass $0.9998$ on the repeated coordinate and forecasts the remaining signal at the marginal variance $2.794$. The forecast program puts mass $1$ on the signal and matches the innovation variance $0.992$. Rank $2$ gives the vector fit a second direction, and the two programs agree. Iterating the fitted one-step coefficient $0.803$ raises the open-loop error from $0.992$ at one step to $2.700$ at eight steps.

AI.tldr: 对比两种共享同一瓶颈的时序预测程序：LeNEPA式的下一隐变量回归（表示损失）与直接在预测坐标上最小化解码误差的预测程序。文中证明在线性解码器与标量目标下两者等价（各向同性约束仅重标定），并构造反例说明表示损失在固定低秩下会误分配容量、导致预测方差错误，直到秩2才与预测程序一致。
AI.motivation: 作者质疑以"回归下一隐变量"作为表示损失的做法：预测精度只取决于被报告的坐标，而表示损失却在同一瓶颈上求解一个不同的最小二乘问题，两者的目标函数并不一致。因此需要明确写出两个程序并辨析其异同，判定表示损失何时无偏、何时会损害预测。
AI.method: 将两种方法形式化为两个优化问题：预测程序P在将被报告坐标上最小化解码隐变量的误差；表示程序R在固定秩下拟合完整下一向量，随后冻结编码器并接一个预测头。理论分析针对标量目标与线性解码器进行，刻画秩与各向同性约束的作用；并用一个四维序列（后三坐标共享同一自回归）作为构造性实验，比较rank-1与rank-2下两者的质量分配、信号方差与预测误差，并迭代拟合的一步系数做开环外推。
AI.result: 理论上：在标量目标+线性解码器时，任何秩≥1的latent都与普通最小二乘匹配，各向同性约束仅是重标定——解码器重拟合后预测不变。实验上：在该四维序列上，rank-1的向量拟合把0.9998的质量放在重复坐标上，其余信号仅按边际方差2.794预测；而预测程序把质量1放在信号上并匹配新息方差0.992。秩2时向量拟合获得第二个方向，两程序一致。此外，迭代拟合出的一步系数0.803使开环误差从一步0.992升至八步2.700。
AI.conclusion: 表示损失并非预测目标的等价替代：在固定低秩下，它可能把容量错配到与预测无关的方向，产生看似合理却方差错误的预测；只有当秩足够（此例为秩2）时两者才趋同。单步拟合系数在开环多步递推下误差迅速累积，提示应区分"拟合下一隐变量"与"最小化被报告坐标误差"这两个目标。

title: SCOPE-4D: Endoscopic 4D Geometry Foundation Models
summary: Geometric understanding supports endoscopic navigation and robotic assistance, but learning reliable endoscopic geometry faces two challenges: scarce geometric annotations and ambiguity between camera motion and tissue deformation. We present SCOPE-4D, an endoscopic 4D geometry foundation model that jointly predicts camera parameters, dense geometry, and 3D tissue trajectories from monocular RGB video in a single forward pass. Our curation and annotation pipeline constructs SCOPE-5K, a collection of approximately 5,000 clips spanning real and synthetic gastrointestinal endoscopy and laparoscopy. The collection provides rich geometric supervision and includes newly collected phantom and real-colonoscopy evaluation sets. Geometric supervised fine-tuning on SCOPE-5K learns endoscopic priors that improve camera and depth estimation. Common--Residual Motion (CRM) further constrains local deformation relative to common tissue movement. Together with geometric supervision, CRM and trajectory supervision further improve camera and depth estimation over geometric fine-tuning alone while enabling dense 3D tissue tracking. Evaluations on public and newly collected benchmarks demonstrate strong in-domain and out-of-domain geometry, superior 3D tracking, and more stable long-sequence colon reconstruction. A blinded user study further supports the perceived reconstruction quality on real clinical video. Together, these results demonstrate the value of large-scale endoscopic supervision and motion constraints for joint geometry estimation and tissue tracking.

AI.tldr: SCOPE-4D 是一个内窥镜 4D 几何基础模型，单次前向即可从单目 RGB 视频联合预测相机参数、稠密几何与 3D 组织轨迹，并借助 SCOPE-5K 数据集与 Common–Residual Motion (CRM) 约束提升估计与跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜导航与机器人辅助需要可靠的几何理解，但学习内窥镜几何面临两大挑战：几何标注稀缺，以及相机运动与组织形变之间的歧义。现有方法难以在单目视频中同时获得稳健的相机、深度与组织运动估计。
AI.method: 提出 SCOPE-4D 基础模型，单次前向从单目 RGB 视频联合预测相机参数、稠密几何和 3D 组织轨迹。构建数据策展与标注流程，形成 SCOPE-5K 数据集，约 5,000 段片段，覆盖真实与合成的胃肠内窥镜及腹腔镜，并提供丰富几何监督及新采集的体模与真实结肠镜评测集。采用几何监督微调学习内窥镜先验；引入 Common–Residual Motion (CRM) 约束局部形变相对于共有组织运动的变化；结合几何监督、CRM 与轨迹监督进行训练。
AI.result: 在公开及新采集基准上，方法展现出较强的域内与域外几何性能、更优的 3D 跟踪效果，以及更稳定的长序列结肠重建。盲法用户研究进一步支持其在真实临床视频上的感知重建质量。CRM 与轨迹监督在几何微调基础上进一步提升了相机与深度估计，同时实现稠密 3D 组织跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，大规模内窥镜监督数据与运动约束对联合几何估计与组织跟踪具有重要价值，SCOPE-4D 为内窥镜 4D 几何理解提供了可行且有效的基础模型方案。

title: Does Every User Need a Private LoRA? Decoupling Personalization from Per-User Adaptation
comment: 10 pages main content, 36 pages total including appendix, 7 figures
summary: Personalized large language models often require a complete adaptation state for each user. However, this paradigm scales poorly as the user population grows. We revisit this design through the lens of personalization capacity allocation: how much adaptation capacity can be shared across users, how the shared capacity should be composed, and how much must remain user-specific. We answer them through three complementary empirical analyses. We find that independent user adapters contain substantial cross-user reusable structure, that the utility of reusable directions reflects both user relevance and variation across queries, and that user histories provide transferable signals for compact individual correction. Motivated by these findings, we propose LINEUP. It learns a bank of reusable low-rank personalization factors, composes them through user-conditioned recall and query-dependent calibration, and restricts target-user adaptation to a tiny user code over a shared correction space. This design decouples expressive personalization capacity from per-user trainable state. Each target user optimizes only eight scalars, while all shared components remain fixed. By comparison, the evaluated private-LoRA configuration uses 4.19 million per-user parameters. Our theoretical analysis gives a finite-step, finite-history risk bound and sufficient conditions for user-code refinement to improve on history initialization. Across six tasks spanning personalized classification, prediction, and generation, LINEUP leads on all 12 metrics, each averaged over three independent runs (e.g., reducing LaMP-3 RMSE by 11.4% relative to the strongest baseline). It maintains advantages under limited history. These results show that rich personalization can be supported primarily by reusable, conditionally composed shared capacity, while independent user adaptation remains confined to a tiny correction state.

AI.tldr: LINEUP提出以"个性化容量分配"视角重构个性化LLM：共享低秩个性化因子经用户条件召回与查询依赖校准组合，目标用户仅优化8个标量（对比私有LoRA的419万/用户参数），在6任务12指标上全面领先（LaMP-3 RMSE降低11.4%）。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化LLM通常为每个用户维护完整适配状态，随用户规模增长扩展性差，需重新审视用户间可共享与必须用户特有的适配容量如何分配。
AI.method: 通过三项实证分析发现：独立用户适配器含大量跨用户可复用结构；可复用方向效用同时反映用户相关性与查询间变化；用户历史提供可迁移信号用于紧凑个体修正。据此提出LINEUP：学习可复用低秩个性化因子库，经用户条件召回与查询依赖校准进行组合，并将目标用户适配限制在共享修正空间上的极小子用户码（8个标量），共享组件全部冻结。并给出有限步、有限历史的风险界与用户码精化优于历史初始化的充分条件。
AI.result: 在覆盖个性化分类、预测、生成的6个任务上，LINEUP在全部12项指标（各3次独立运行平均）均领先，例如相对最强基线将LaMP-3 RMSE降低11.4%，且在历史有限时仍保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 丰富的个性化主要可由可复用、条件组合的共享容量支持，独立用户适配只需限定在极小修正状态中，从而实现个性化表达能力与每用户可训练状态的解耦与良好扩展性。

title: Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) usually optimizes answer correctness, yet useful language-model behavior also requires high-quality reasoning and concise responses. Existing multi-reward post-training methods typically scalarize rewards or combine specialists without explicitly protecting a reward priority order. This is problematic when trade-offs are asymmetric: conciseness, for example, should not improve at the cost of correctness. We introduce Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation (LMOPD), a multi-teacher method for integrating reward-specialized policies under explicit priorities. For each student rollout, LMOPD selects the specialist for the first objective whose gate detects a deficiency, then locally projects its centered log-policy correction to remove components that oppose higher-priority specialists. We evaluate 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts transformer models in two- and four-expert settings on three math benchmarks, measuring retained specialist gains. With two experts, LMOPD's point estimates fully retain the accuracy and reasoning-quality gains while acquiring $46.9\%$ of the conciseness gain. With four experts, it retains $\approx90\%$ of both the accuracy gain and reasoning-correctness gain, compared to only $\approx57\%$ by the next best evaluated baseline. Matched four-expertablations show that lexicographic routing outperforms random routing and that projection further strengthens both top-priority capabilities. Across both scales, LMOPD preserves the highest-priority capabilities more effectively than the existing baselines we evaluate, demonstrating the value of explicit priorities for specialist integration.

AI.tldr: 提出词典序多目标在线策略蒸馏（LMOPD），在多教师、显式优先级下整合奖励专精策略，优先保护高优先级能力，实验显示其能力保留优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: RLVR 通常只优化答案正确性，但有用行为还需高质量推理与简洁回答；现有多奖励后训练多以标量化或专家组合方式处理，未显式保护奖励优先级，在权衡不对称时（如简洁不应以牺牲正确性为代价）会产生问题。
AI.method: LMOPD：对每个学生 rollout，按优先级顺序选择首个被门控判定为存在不足的目标所对应的专家，再将其中心化对数策略修正做局部投影，去除与更高优先级专家相冲突的分量。
AI.result: 在 30B-A3B MoE 模型上，两专家与四专家设置、三个数学基准测试：两专家时点估计完全保留准确率与推理质量增益，并获得 46.9% 的简洁性增益；四专家时保留约 90% 的准确率增益与推理正确性增益，而次优基线仅约 57%；匹配四专家消融显示词典序路由优于随机路由，投影进一步增强最高优先级能力。
AI.conclusion: 在两个规模上，LMOPD 比所评估的现有基线更有效地保留最高优先级能力，表明显式优先级对专家整合具有价值。

title: SEDIMA: Cross-Run Hierarchical Insight Memory for Evolutionary Search Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-driven evolutionary search is a powerful paradigm for automated program and algorithm discovery, yet existing systems are largely memoryless: each run explores from scratch, so agents repeatedly rediscover the same improvements and re-encounter the same dead ends. We introduce SEDIMA, a persistent hierarchical insight memory for evolutionary search agents. SEDIMA distills raw traces into natural-language insights, clusters them by semantic similarity using attention-weighted centroids, and retrieves relevant guidance to condition future mutations, accumulating transferable knowledge across runs and problems rather than within a single trajectory. As a drop-in module that leaves the search operators unmodified, SEDIMA improves average final performance by 5.5% on AlgoTune and 6.6% on ALE-Bench LITE under a fixed budget of 100 evaluated candidates. Under OpenEvolve, SEDIMA requires 32.3% fewer iterations on average to reach baseline-best performance across the five evaluated backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出 SEDIMA——一种为进化搜索智能体设计的持久化层级洞察记忆模块，将原始轨迹蒸馏为自然语言洞察并按语义聚类检索，实现跨任务知识积累，显著提升算法发现性能并减少迭代次数。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的进化搜索系统大多"无记忆"：每次运行都从零开始探索，导致智能体反复重新发现相同的改进、反复陷入相同的死胡同，无法在多次运行与多个问题之间积累可迁移知识。
AI.method: SEDIMA 作为即插即用模块，不修改搜索算子。其核心流程为：将原始搜索轨迹蒸馏为自然语言洞察；使用注意力加权质心按语义相似度对洞察进行聚类；检索相关指导信息以条件化未来的变异操作，从而在跨运行、跨问题的层面累积可迁移知识，而非局限于单条轨迹内。
AI.result: 在固定 100 个评估候选的预算下，SEDIMA 使平均最终性能在 AlgoTune 上提升 5.5%，在 ALE-Bench LITE 上提升 6.6%。在 OpenEvolve 框架下，跨五个评估骨干模型，SEDIMA 平均减少 32.3% 的迭代次数即可达到基线最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 持久化层级洞察记忆能有效缓解进化搜索的"无记忆"缺陷，通过跨运行知识复用同时提升性能与搜索效率，且可作为通用即插即用模块兼容现有搜索框架。

title: Confidence-Controlled XAI Auditing for Pedestrian Detection under Domain Shift
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Vehicular Electronics and Safety (ICVES 2026). 6 pages, 4 figures
summary: Explainability is increasingly required for perception models in intelligent vehicles, yet whether explanations remain faithful under driving domain shift is still poorly understood. This work audits post-hoc explanations of a fixed YOLOv8s pedestrian detector across PIE and JAAD using ROI-based D-Deletion, frozen confidence terciles, rank-based tests, bootstrap intervals, and Holm correction. The audit shows that deletion-based faithfulness is strongly coupled to detection strength at explanation time, with Spearman correlations between 0.70 and 0.82 for D-RISE, making naive confidence-stratified comparisons unreliable. After controlling for detection strength within fixed f0 bins, D-RISE faithfulness remains domain-dependent in the central f0 range, with PIE showing higher D-Deletion than JAAD and Holm-adjusted significance. A non-perturbative EigenCAM baseline is less faithful than D-RISE but also exhibits score coupling, suggesting that the effect is not specific to D-RISE and is related to the deletion-based evaluation setup. These results motivate confidence-controlled XAI audits for safety-critical perception under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 本文对固定YOLOv8s行人检测器在PIE与JAAD数据集上的事后解释方法进行忠实性审计，发现基于删除的忠实度与解释时的检测强度强耦合，控制检测强度后D-RISE忠实性仍具域依赖性。
AI.motivation: 智能车辆感知模型日益需要可解释性，但解释在驾驶域偏移下是否仍然忠实尚不清楚，尤其在安全关键场景中缺乏可靠的审计证据。
AI.method: 采用基于ROI的D-Deletion、冻结置信度三分位、基于秩的检验、bootstrap置信区间与Holm校正，审计固定YOLOv8s行人检测器在PIE和JAAD上的事后解释（D-RISE及非扰动基线EigenCAM）。
AI.result: 删除式忠实度与解释时检测强度强耦合，D-RISE的Spearman相关系数为0.70–0.82，使朴素置信度分层比较不可靠；在固定f0分箱内控制检测强度后，D-RISE忠实性在中心f0区间仍呈域依赖，PIE的D-Deletion高于JAAD且Holm校正后显著；EigenCAM忠实性低于D-RISE但也表现出分数耦合。
AI.conclusion: 分数耦合效应并非D-RISE特有，而与基于删除的评估设置相关；研究结果呼吁在域偏移下对安全关键感知开展置信度控制的XAI审计。

title: EviDent-CBCT: Evidence-Bottlenecked Report Generation from Dental CBCT under Non-Exhaustive Report Supervision
summary: Dento-maxillofacial cone-beam CT (CBCT) reports may contain dozens of tooth-specific, anatomical, and spatial findings from a single 3D scan. Learning to generate such reports from limited clinical data is challenging because routine reports may not exhaustively document image findings, and a non-mention may reflect either absence or non-reporting. We present EviDent-CBCT, an evidence-bottlenecked framework designed for this incomplete supervision. An anatomy-aware network maps each CBCT scan to a discrete record of tooth-level, global, and tooth-IAC evidence. A dental-logic consistency projection reconciles incompatible evidence before a deterministic renderer and an image-blind local language model generate the report using only this record. For tooth-level evidence, reliability-aware training uses eligible non-mentions as reduced-weight negatives, while unreported global and tooth-IAC labels remain unknown. A metal-sensitive input channel preserves intensity cues from dental materials. Across three validation runs, EviDent-CBCT achieves $0.666\pm0.006$ merged evidence set-F1 and $0.402\pm0.003$ RadFact-Lite-Dental logical-F1, versus $0.371\pm0.018$ for the strongest controlled direct baseline. In the ODIN 2026 challenge, it ranked second in automated evaluation and third in blinded clinical Arena comparison on the hidden test set. These results support the discrete evidence record as an effective and auditable interface for CBCT report generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 EviDent-CBCT 框架，通过"证据瓶颈"设计将 CBCT 报告生成解耦为离散证据记录提取与确定性渲染，在部分监督下实现可审计的牙颌面报告生成。
AI.motivation: 单次 CBCT 扫描可产生数十条牙位、解剖与空间发现，但从有限临床数据学习报告生成极具挑战：常规报告未必穷尽记录影像发现，且"未提及"既可能表示不存在，也可能表示未报告（即标签缺失而非阴性）。这种不完整监督使得直接端到端生成难以可靠学习。
AI.method: 1) 解剖感知网络将 CBCT 扫描映射为离散证据记录，包含牙位级、全局及牙-IAC（下牙槽神经管）三类证据；2) 牙科逻辑一致性投影在渲染前调和互相矛盾的证据；3) 由确定性渲染器与图像盲（image-blind）局部语言模型，仅依据该证据记录生成报告；4) 针对牙位级证据采用可靠性感知训练，将符合条件的"未提及"作为降权负样本，而未报告的全局与牙-IAC 标签保持为未知；5) 引入金属敏感输入通道以保留牙科材料的高强度线索。
AI.result: 三次验证运行中，合并证据集 set-F1 达 $0.666\pm0.006$，RadFact-Lite-Dental 逻辑 F1 为 $0.402\pm0.003$；最强受控直接基线为 $0.371\pm0.018$。在 ODIN 2026 挑战赛中，自动化评估排名第二，隐藏测试集上的盲法临床 Arena 比较排名第三。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，离散证据记录可作为 CBCT 报告生成的有效且可审计的中间接口，在部分监督条件下显著优于直接生成基线。

title: FactorSplat: Appearance-Controllable Gaussian Proxies for Medical Volume Rendering
summary: Transfer functions (TFs) control color and visibility in medical volume rendering, but image-trained Gaussian proxies typically bake one transfer function into their appearance. We present FactorSplat, a per-scene N-dimensional Gaussian splatting (N-DGS) proxy that accepts region-specific intensity-to-RGBA curves at inference. A local lookup applies the authored color and opacity change, while a shared functional encoder and low-rank per-Gaussian factors learn the residual appearance response. Geometry and directional appearance remain shared across presets, with visibility control and TF-aware pruning preserving the ability to hide and reveal structures. On seven CT and MR scans, FactorSplat improves mean PSNR and changed-region error over region-aware VEG across validation, interpolation, unseen composition, and out-of-distribution (OOD) edits. Across these four splits, seven-scan mean PSNR gains over VEG range from 1.10 to 1.52 dB. One checkpoint per scan supports unseen edits without retraining. At $1600^2$, the cached fast renderer averages 524 FPS with 1.17 ms TF switches. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/FactorSplat/.

AI.tldr: FactorSplat 是一种逐场景的 N 维高斯泼溅代理，支持在推理时接收区域特定的强度到 RGBA 曲线，实现无需重训的可编辑传递函数体渲染。
AI.motivation: 医学体渲染中，传递函数（TF）控制颜色与可见性，但基于图像训练的高斯代理通常将单一 TF 烘焙进其外观，导致无法在推理时灵活编辑 TF。作者希望构建一种可接受任意 TF 输入、逐扫描仅需一个检查点、且保持几何与方向外观共享的代理模型。
AI.method: 提出 FactorSplat，即逐场景 N 维高斯泼溅（N-DGS）代理：推理时输入区域特定的强度到 RGBA 曲线；通过局部查找（local lookup）施加自定义的颜色与不透明度变化，并用共享的功能编码器与低秩逐高斯因子学习残余外观响应；几何与方向外观在各预设间共享，并引入可见性控制与 TF 感知剪枝以保留隐藏/显现结构的能力。
AI.result: 在七个 CT 与 MR 扫描上，FactorSplat 在验证、插值、未见组合及分布外（OOD）编辑四种划分下，平均 PSNR 与变化区域误差均优于区域感知的 VEG；相对 VEG 的七扫描平均 PSNR 增益为 1.10 至 1.52 dB；每扫描仅需一个检查点即可支持未见编辑而无需重训；在 1600² 分辨率下，缓存快速渲染器平均达 524 FPS，TF 切换耗时 1.17 ms。
AI.conclusion: FactorSplat 通过将传递函数响应与共享几何/方向外观解耦，实现了高效、可泛化的医学体渲染 TF 编辑，兼顾质量、泛化性与实时性能。

title: Social bot detection in the age of ChatGPT: Challenges and opportunities
summary: We present a comprehensive overview of the challenges and opportunities in social bot detection in the context of the rise of sophisticated AI-based chatbots. By examining the state of the art in social bot detection techniques and the more salient real-world application to date, we identify gaps and emerging trends in the field, with a focus on addressing the unique challenges posed by AI-generated conversations and behaviors. We suggest potentially promising opportunities and research directions in social bot detection, including (i) the use of generative agents for synthetic data generation, testing and evaluation; (ii) the need for multimodal and cross-platform detection based on network and behavioral signatures of coordination and influence; (iii) the opportunity to extend bot detection to non-English and low-resource language settings; and, (iv) the room for development of collaborative, federated learning detection models that can help facilitate cooperation between different organizations and platforms while preserving user privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了AI聊天机器人兴起背景下社交机器人检测的挑战与机遇，指出现有技术的不足，并提出四个有前景的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 随着复杂AI聊天机器人的兴起，AI生成对话与行为给社交机器人检测带来新挑战，需梳理领域现状、识别差距与新兴趋势。
AI.method: 这是一篇综述性工作：通过考察社交机器人检测技术的最新进展及实际应用现状，分析领域空白与趋势，并提出潜在研究方向。
AI.result: 识别出四个有前景的方向：(i) 利用生成式智能体进行合成数据生成与测试评估；(ii) 基于协调与影响的网络和行为特征开展多模态、跨平台检测；(iii) 将检测扩展到非英语及低资源语言场景；(iv) 发展协作式联邦学习检测模型，在保护隐私前提下促进机构与平台合作。
AI.conclusion: 应对AI生成内容带来的检测难题，需从合成数据、多模态跨平台、多语言覆盖和联邦协作等多维度推进社交机器人检测研究。

title: Octrees as an Explicit 3D Language
summary: Existing 3D large language models (LLMs) compromise on two fronts: they compress shapes into latent codebook indices or coordinate text, which removes spatial structure from what the model observes, and they acquire the 3D modality by fine-tuning the backbone, which overwrites its general language ability. We present OctLLM, which addresses both limitations. Geometry enters as an explicit 3D sequence of octree occupancy tokens. However, full octree sequences grow rapidly with depth; OctLLM therefore randomly empties penultimate-level nodes and omits descendants while preserving shape, yielding a shorter coordinate- and depth-anchored Sparse Octree (S-Octree) for position-aware mask-modeling generation and 3D understanding. On the other front, existing methods introduce a new modality with full fine-tuning or LoRA, but full fine-tuning is costly, LoRA limits 3D capacity, and both modify the language pathway. OctLLM instead adds 3D capacity in parameters separate from the pretrained ones: mesh tokens are routed through independent trainable branches in a subset of blocks while text and image tokens retain the frozen vision-language pathway, and the two streams interact through shared self-attention. It trains far fewer parameters than full fine-tuning, yet sets a new state of the art among unified multimodal LLMs, lowering image-to-3D FID by $17.4\%$ and raising render-grounded captioning by $28.7$ points over ShapeLLM-Omni, while matching the backbone on general language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: OctLLM 用显式八叉树占据序列表示几何，并通过独立可训练分支注入 3D 能力，在冻结的视觉-语言通路上保持通用语言能力，取得统一多模态 LLM 的新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D LLM 存在两大缺陷：(1) 将形状压缩为隐空间码本索引或坐标文本，使模型观测中丢失了空间结构；(2) 通过微调主干获取 3D 模态，覆盖了其通用语言能力。作者希望同时解决这两点。
AI.method: 几何以显式 3D 序列形式进入模型：八叉树占据 token。因完整八叉树序列随深度快速增长，OctLLM 随机清空倒数第二层节点并省略其后代，同时保持形状，得到更短、坐标与深度锚定的稀疏八叉树（S-Octree），用于位置感知的掩码建模生成与 3D 理解。在参数层面，不采用全量微调或 LoRA，而是在与预训练参数分离的参数中新增 3D 容量：mesh token 经由部分 block 中的独立可训练分支，文本与图像 token 保留冻结的视觉-语言通路，两路通过共享自注意力交互。
AI.result: 训练参数远少于全量微调，却在统一多模态 LLM 中取得新 SOTA：相比 ShapeLLM-Omni，图像到 3D 的 FID 降低 17.4%，渲染grounded 描述提升 28.7 分，同时在通用语言基准上与主干持平。
AI.conclusion: OctLLM 通过显式稀疏八叉树序列保留空间结构，并以参数隔离的独立 3D 分支实现模态扩展，在显著降低训练成本的同时兼顾 3D 生成/理解性能与通用语言能力，为统一多模态 3D LLM 提供了有效范式。

title: Hesitation Has a Geometry: Entropy-Trained Hyperbolic Probes for Sparse Activation Steering
summary: When a large language model solves a mathematical problem, its reasoning is largely hierarchical, and the solution often branches at a few tokens where the next-token entropy is high. Such tree-like structure embeds in hyperbolic space with far lower distortion than in Euclidean space. Activation steering, however, usually edits the hidden states of a pretrained model by adding one fixed Euclidean vector at every token, even though most tokens of a solution are already determined by the context. We propose Hyperbolic Entropy Steering (HEST), which embeds the hidden states in the Poincaré ball with a lightweight probe whose only label is the model's own next-token entropy. Where this entropy exceeds a threshold, HEST moves the embedded state along the geodesic of steepest descent of a readout of the probe and maps the change back to the hidden state. For the Busemann readout of a learned ideal point, we prove that a step of fixed length lowers it by the same amount at every state. On three instruction-tuned models from the Qwen2.5-Math and Llama-3.1 families, HEST with the Busemann readout improves greedy accuracy on MATH-500 and GSM8K in five of six settings, by up to 1.8 points, whereas a contrastive steering vector added at every token lowers accuracy. With a Euclidean probe trained in the same way, this gain disappears on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct. The gains are largest on problems where the model hesitates often, and accuracy on the remaining problems is almost unchanged.

AI.tldr: 提出Hyperbolic Entropy Steering (HEST)，在庞加莱球中嵌入隐藏状态，仅在熵高的分支token处沿测地线进行激活引导，利用Busemann读出实现固定步长下一致的熵下降，在多个指令微调模型上提升数学推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 大模型解数学题时推理呈层次树状结构，分支主要发生在少数高熵token处；该树状结构在双曲空间中嵌入的失真远低于欧氏空间。然而现有激活引导（activation steering）通常在每个token处添加固定的欧氏向量，忽视了大多数token已由上下文确定这一事实，效率低且可能损害性能。
AI.method: HEST用轻量探针将隐藏状态嵌入庞加莱球，探针的唯一标签是模型自身的下一token熵。当熵超过阈值时，沿探针读出值最速下降的测地线移动嵌入状态，再将变化映射回隐藏状态。对学习到的理想点的Busemann读出，证明固定长度的步长在每个状态下降低该读出的量相同。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math和Llama-3.1系列的三个指令微调模型上，采用Busemann读出的HEST在六个设置中的五个提升了MATH-500和GSM8K的贪婪准确率，最高提升1.8个百分点；而每token添加对比引导向量则降低准确率。用同样方式训练的欧氏探针在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct上增益消失。增益在模型频繁犹豫的问题上最大，其余问题准确率几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 将隐藏状态嵌入双曲空间并仅在关键高熵token处进行测地线引导，是一种有效且有针对性的激活引导方式；Busemann读出的理论性质保证了引导的稳定性，且引导效果与问题难度相关，验证了双曲几何在推理干预中的价值。

title: Trained Agentic Context Management
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/brycesandlund/infinite-context. Under review
summary: We study long context language models. Instead of training long context natively, or designing a long context harness, we train a model over the simplest possible harness: a tool to call itself with any specified prompt and a tool to read tokens in a range from the input context. We finetune Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on a diverse synthetic dataset using this harness. With only 8,000 tokens of context, our small model is as strong as GPT-5.4 with 1M tokens of context on the OOLONG-synth benchmark when document length exceeds 40K tokens.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种极简长上下文方案：不改动原生上下文长度，也不设计复杂长上下文支架，而是训练模型使用两个工具（自调用任意提示、读取输入上下文中指定范围的token）。在合成的多样化数据集上微调Qwen3.6-35B-A3B后，仅用8K上下文的小模型在OOLONG-synth基准上（文档长度超过40K token时）可媲美使用1M上下文的GPT-5.4。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文能力获取方式主要有两类：原生训练长上下文，或设计长上下文处理支架（harness）。前者训练成本高，后者工程复杂。作者希望用最简单的支架让模型获得长上下文能力，从而以小上下文窗口和较小模型达到大上下文大模型的效果。
AI.method: 不原生训练长上下文，也不设计复杂支架，而是训练模型使用最简单支架：一个可用任意指定prompt调用自身的工具，以及一个可读取输入上下文中指定范围token的工具。基于该支架，在多样化的合成数据集上对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B进行微调，模型仅使用8,000 token上下文。
AI.result: 在OOLONG-synth基准上，当文档长度超过40K token时，仅用8K上下文的小模型性能与使用1M上下文的GPT-5.4相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练模型掌握极简的“自调用+范围读取”工具使用能力，可用很小的上下文窗口和较小模型实现与大上下文大模型相当的长文档处理性能，为长上下文建模提供了一条低成本、低复杂度的替代路径。

title: An AI-Based Multi-Stage Approach for Androgenetic Alopecia Assessment from Low-Magnification Scalp Images
summary: Androgenetic alopecia (AGA) is characterized by patterned follicular miniaturization, increased single-hair follicular units, and altered hair-shaft diameter. We present an automated quantitative scalp-analysis and clinical decision-support framework combining FU localization, ordinal visible-shaft counting, calibrated shaft-width estimation, regional aggregation, and an interpretable rule layer. The clinical cohort comprised 243 patients (127 AGA, 116 non-AGA), while the computer-vision experiments used 160 expert-annotated patients, 2,400 trichoscopic images, and approximately 158,000 FU annotations. Under patientdisjoint evaluation, YOLOv8m achieved test mAP@0.5=0.920 and recall=0.860; EfficientNet-B5 with a support-map channel achieved 87.0% expert-box count accuracy (macro F1=0.85). A separate 500-image set was processed end-to-end with detector-generated boxes, yielding MAE of 6.56 for follicle detection and 16.59 for follicle classification relative to human-expert annotations. The system is intended to assist, rather than replace, dermatologist interpretation.

AI.tldr: 提出结合FU定位、序数可见发干计数、校准发干宽度估计、区域聚合与可解释规则层的自动化头皮分析与临床决策支持框架，用于AGA评估。
AI.motivation: 雄激素性脱发（AGA）以模式化毛囊微小化、单发毛囊单位增多及发干直径改变为特征，临床上需要客观、可量化的头皮评估手段，以辅助皮肤科医生的诊断与随访判断。
AI.method: 临床队列含243例患者（127例AGA、116例非AGA）；计算机视觉实验使用160例专家标注患者、2,400张毛发镜图像及约158,000个FU标注。方法 pipeline 包括：FU定位（YOLOv8m）、序数可见发干计数（EfficientNet-B5并引入support-map通道）、校准的发干宽度估计、区域级聚合以及可解释规则层。
AI.result: 患者不重叠（patient-disjoint）评估下，YOLOv8m测试mAP@0.5=0.920、recall=0.860；EfficientNet-B5配合support-map通道达到87.0%的专家框计数准确率（macro F1=0.85）。另用500张图像以检测器生成框进行端到端处理，相对人类专家标注，毛囊检测MAE为6.56，毛囊分类MAE为16.59。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可实现自动化的量化头皮分析与临床决策支持，定位为辅助而非替代皮肤科医生判读。

title: Finding the Move Is Not Winning the Game: XiangqiBench for Closed-Loop Evaluation of LLM Agents
summary: Static evaluations credit a language model for naming the right move, but an agent must carry a plan through to a verified outcome while an opponent responds. We introduce XiangqiBench, an executable benchmark that measures this difference in Chinese chess: starting from 119 tactical endgames with forced mates supported by engine or checks-only search, an LLM agent must deliver checkmate against an engine defender. An interactive REPL interface separates real moves, state queries, and forward simulation, and we record 8,568 multi-turn trajectories from 12 frontier LLMs under two observation protocols. Three signals that look like competence each overstate closed-loop success. (i) The Conversion Gap: models play the stored reference first move in 26.1\% of Sighted trials, yet only 13.9\% of these trials end in a win. (ii) The Consistency Gap: the leading model reaches 38.7\% pass@3 but only 5.9\% pass^3, winning all three trials on 7 of the 46 positions it ever wins. (iii) The Simulation Gap: 32.3\% of accepted simulation calls stop on an illegal move, and in 49.3\% of comparable cases the real defender replies differently from the line the agent simulated; self-authored rollouts check legality but cannot anticipate the opponent. Finding the move is not winning the game: agent evaluations should score closed-loop outcomes and report reliability alongside coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出 XiangqiBench——一个可执行的中国象棋基准，通过119个强制杀残局与引擎防守者交互，用8,568条多轮轨迹评测12个前沿LLM，揭示"找到着法"≠"赢下棋局"。
AI.motivation: 静态评测只考察模型能否"说出"正确着法，但真实智能体必须在对手应对下把计划执行到可验证的结果。作者想量化这一"能力落差"，即静态命名准确率与闭环获胜率之间的系统性偏差。
AI.method: 构建可执行基准 XiangqiBench：以119个由引擎或纯将军搜索支持、存在强制杀的战术残局为起点，要求LLM智能体对引擎防守者完成将死。设计交互式REPL接口，分离真实走子、状态查询与前向模拟；在两种观测协议（Sighted/Blind）下采集12个前沿LLM的8,568条多轮轨迹，并从转换率、一致性、模拟有效性三个维度评估。
AI.result: 三个看似"能力强"的信号均高估闭环成功率：(i) 转换落差——模型在26.1%的Sighted试验中走出存储的参考首着，但其中仅13.9%最终获胜；(ii) 一致性落差——领先模型pass@3达38.7%，而pass^3仅5.9%，在它赢过的46个局面中仅7个三试全胜；(iii) 模拟落差——32.3%被接受的模拟调用终止于非法着法，49.3%可比情形中真实防守者的应对与智能体模拟线路不同，自生成rollout只校验合法性却无法预判对手。
AI.conclusion: "找到着法不等于赢下棋局"。智能体评测应评分闭环最终结果，并在覆盖率之外同时报告可靠性（如pass^k），以避免静态指标对能力的虚高估计。

title: Evaluating and Improving the Robustness of Large Language Models to Input Sequence Variations
comment: PhD thesis, 2026. 118 pages. v2: corrected a name spelling in the acknowledgements
summary: Large language models (LLMs) in production systems face prompt injections, trojans (backdoors), and manipulation of automatic quality metrics. This thesis develops models, methods, and algorithms for evaluating and improving LLM robustness to adversarial input sequence variations. We propose R_stab(f), a generative robustness metric based on the Jensen-Shannon divergence between per-step output distributions under small input perturbations. For localized attacks we prove V(h) <= 1 - R_class(h), where R_class(h) is the probability that a decision operator h keeps its decision under small perturbations. For non-localized attacks we propose a calibrated empirical model. For LLM-as-a-Judge systems we develop ASA, an adaptive evolutionary black-box attack that reaches an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 73.8%, with transfer between open models up to 62.6%. On Trojan Detection Challenge 2023 data (Pythia-1.4B), surrogate triggers reach REASR ~0.99 while recall of the true triggers is ~0.17 against a baseline of ~0.14. On SaTML CTF 2024 we systematize four classes of bypasses of multi-layer defenses, which reduce the ASR from 90% to 15-25%. Committees of 5-7 heterogeneous models reduce the ASR for Gemma-3-4B by 47-55 percentage points, to 19.3% with 7 models. For agentic systems based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), we propose AttestMCP, which attests tool calls with HMAC-protected packets at under 0.1 ms per call, and the Commit Boundary isolation pattern. On the MCPBench benchmark of 847 scenarios they reduce the average ASR from 53.7% to 12.4%. The methods are implemented in the JudgeGuard and TrojanArmor software suites and the MCPSec module.

AI.tldr: 本论文围绕大语言模型（LLM）在提示注入、后门（木马）与自动评测指标操纵等对抗场景下的鲁棒性，提出度量方法 R_stab、攻击方法 ASA、防御方法 AttestMCP 与 Commit Boundary，并在多个基准上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 生产系统中的 LLM 面临提示注入、木马（后门）以及自动质量指标被操纵等威胁，因此需要系统性地评估并提升 LLM 对对抗性输入序列变化的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 提出生成式鲁棒性度量 R_stab(f)，基于小扰动下逐步输出分布之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度；2) 针对局部化攻击证明 V(h) ≤ 1 − R_class(h)，针对非局部化攻击提出校准的经验模型；3) 面向 LLM-as-a-Judge 提出自适应进化黑盒攻击 ASA；4) 面向多层级防御系统化四类绕过方法；5) 提出异构模型委员会防御；6) 面向基于 MCP 的智能体系统提出 AttestMCP（HMAC 保护的工具调用凭证，单次调用开销低于 0.1 ms）与 Commit Boundary 隔离模式。
AI.result: ASA 的 ASR 最高达 73.8%，开放模型间迁移性最高 62.6%；在 Trojan Detection Challenge 2023（Pythia-1.4B）上代理触发器 REASR 约 0.99，而真实触发器召回率约 0.17（基线约 0.14）；在 SaTML CTF 2024 上系统化四类绕过将 ASR 从 90% 降至 15–25%；5–7 个异构模型委员会使 Gemma-3-4B 的 ASR 下降 47–55 个百分点，7 模型时降至 19.3%；在 MCPBench 的 847 个场景上平均 ASR 从 53.7% 降至 12.4%。
AI.conclusion: 上述模型、方法与算法可有效评估并提升 LLM 对对抗性输入变化的鲁棒性，相关实现集成于 JudgeGuard、TrojanArmor 软件套件及 MCPSec 模块。

title: Are you Synthesizing or Recalling? Evaluating LLMs on Algorithmic Code Retrieval
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in code generation, where success depends on both recalling relevant algorithmic knowledge and reasoning about how to apply it. However, existing LLM pipelines are opaque, with no explicit separation between these two components. We argue that for well-known algorithms whose canonical implementations are widely accessible in pretraining corpora, code generation is better measured as \textit{parametric code retrieval}: reproducing a named algorithm from internalised knowledge rather than synthesizing a novel one. We introduce AlgoREval, a benchmark of 599 problems spanning classical 77 algorithms across 14 domains, 7 programming languages, and 4 graph-input representations to evaluate this capability in isolation, and assess 15 models (7B--34B parameters) in a zero-shot setting. We find substantial variation in retrieval accuracy across languages and input representations, even for widely documented algorithms and show that prompt augmentation with retrieved code snippets or structured algorithmic hints improve accuracy on complex algorithms, while SFT achieves broader language gains and GRPO achieves larger per-language gains on specific languages. Together, our results establish parametric code retrieval as a distinct, measurable capability and caution against deploying AI-generated algorithmic code without systematic validation.\footnote{Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Nickil21/AlgoREval

AI.tldr: 论文提出"参数化代码检索"概念并构建AlgoREval基准（599题，77种经典算法，14领域，7语言，4种图输入表示），零样本评测15个模型（7B-34B），揭示算法代码生成中检索能力的显著差异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码生成流水线不透明，未将"回忆相关算法知识"与"推理如何应用"两个环节明确分离。作者主张：对于规范实现广泛存在于预训练语料中的知名算法，代码生成应被视为"参数化代码检索"——从内化知识中复现命名算法，而非合成新算法。需要单独度量这一能力。
AI.method: 构建AlgoREval基准，包含599个问题，覆盖14个领域的77种经典算法、7种编程语言、4种图输入表示，用于隔离评估参数化代码检索能力。在零样本设置下评测15个模型（参数量7B-34B），并对比prompt增强（检索到的代码片段/结构化算法提示）、SFT和GRPO等策略。
AI.result: 检索准确率在语言和输入表示之间差异显著，即便对文档充分的算法也是如此；prompt增强（检索代码片段或结构化算法提示）可提升复杂算法上的准确率；SFT带来更广泛的语言提升，GRPO在特定语言上取得更大的单语言增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了参数化代码检索是一项独立且可度量的能力，并警示不应在缺乏系统验证的情况下部署AI生成的算法代码。

title: Counterexample Generation via Per-Theorem Symbolic Verifiers: When Imitation Hurts and Reinforcement Repairs
summary: Large language models often solve a theorem forward yet fail to disprove a closely related false one: a falsification gap that supervised fine-tuning does not close and can actively worsen. We frame counterexample generation as constrained witness emission against a deterministic per-theorem Python verifier, and release SymCE, a corpus of 4,707 false undergraduate-algebra and real-analysis conjectures, each paired with executable verifiers. The verifier also serves as the reward function, making SymCE a training environment. Training Qwen3-4B with SFT followed by GRPO under this oracle reveals an imitation trap: counterexample-only SFT collapses true-theorem recognition from 0.27 to 0.00, while RLVR with a sparse outcome-only reward repairs this and exceeds the base, to 0.66. The collapse replicates across four seeds and on Gemma-3-4B. Sparse and dense rewards yield statistically indistinguishable in-domain success yet diverge by 33 points on a held-out calibration probe, a dissociation we trace to the partial-credit term. Our 4B model outperforms every evaluated 7B open-weights math specialist, remains competitive with six frontier commercial APIs, and transfers under unchanged prompting to GSM8K, MATH-500 and MMLU-college-math. A human audit of 177 verifier decisions finds 97.7% accuracy. Code, data, verifier modules and annotations: https://github.com/ce-rlvr/SymCE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将"反例生成"建模为对确定性定理验证器的约束见证输出，发布包含4,707条错误猜想及可执行验证器的SymCE语料库，并以此为训练环境揭示SFT的"模仿陷阱"，用GRPO/RLVR修复并超越基座。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常能正向证明定理，却无法反驳一个密切相关的错误命题，形成"证伪鸿沟"；监督微调（SFT）不仅无法弥合该鸿沟，反而会使其恶化。作者希望为该问题提供可训练、可验证的环境与评测基准。
AI.method: 将反例生成形式化为针对每条定理的确定性Python验证器的约束见证输出；构建SymCE语料库（4,707条本科代数与实分析错误猜想，每条配可执行验证器），验证器同时充当奖励函数。对Qwen3-4B先做SFT再做GRPO训练，对比稀疏结果奖励与稠密奖励，并进行多随机种子与Gemma-3-4B的复现实验及人工审计。
AI.result: 仅用反例的SFT导致真定理识别率从0.27崩溃至0.00（模仿陷阱），稀疏结果奖励的RLVR修复该问题并提升至0.66，超过基座；崩溃在四个随机种子及Gemma-3-4B上可复现。稀疏与稠密奖励在域内成功率统计无差异，但在留出校准探针上相差33个百分点，该分离可归因于部分得分项。4B模型优于所有受评的7B开源数学专用模型，与六个前沿商用API具竞争力，并在GSM8K、MATH-500、MMLU-college-math上零样本迁移。177条验证器判定的人工审计准确率为97.7%。
AI.conclusion: 以验证器为奖励的RLVR能有效修复SFT造成的证伪能力崩塌，且奖励设计（稀疏vs稠密）在校准行为上存在重要分离；SymCE提供了可复用的证伪训练与评测环境，证明小模型在该任务上可超越更大专用模型。

title: A Simulation-Grounded Agentic VLM Framework for Wildfire Monitoring and Reporting
summary: Effective wildfire monitoring requires relating visual evidence to physical fire dynamics, yet real videos with synchronized physical annotations are scarce and high-fidelity 3D simulation is costly. We present a simulation-grounded vision-language model (VLM) framework that automatically converts 2D wildfire simulations into labeled video episodes. A fixed Blender mapping produces low-detail 3D proxies aligned with simulator terrain, fuel layout, fire activity, and wind cues; controllable video generation supplies richer appearance. The proxies are intermediate representations rather than finely rendered final scenes. Generated videos and simulator labels form reusable multimodal memory for a training-free multi-agent VLM system that retrieves reference episodes, reconciles visual and memory-based predictions, and produces structured wildfire reports. On held-out generated episodes, video memory achieves 51.5% exact four-tag accuracy, compared with 22.6% for direct VLM querying and 16-17% for text-only memory; the complete system achieves 77.3% accuracy on six simulator-derived report fields. Component ablations, cross-generator tests, and three real-UAV evaluations assess retrieval, reporting, generator changes, and observable monitoring tasks. The framework connects automatic simulation-to-proxy conversion with memory-based VLM reasoning under scarce real-world physical annotations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个以仿真为支撑的视觉语言模型框架，将2D野火仿真自动转换为带标签的视频片段，作为可复用多模态记忆，供免训练多智能体VLM系统检索与推理，从而生成结构化野火报告。
AI.motivation: 野火监测需要将视觉证据与物理火行为关联，但同步物理标注的真实视频稀缺，高保真3D仿真成本高昂，因此需要一种低成本、可自动生成带标注数据的方法。
AI.method: 使用固定Blender映射将2D野火仿真转为与地形、燃料布局、火活动和风场线索对齐的低细节3D代理；可控视频生成提供更丰富外观；代理作为中间表示而非精细渲染。生成视频与仿真标签构成可复用多模态记忆，驱动免训练多智能体VLM系统进行参考片段检索、视觉与记忆预测调和，并输出结构化报告。
AI.result: 在留出生成片段上，视频记忆四标签精确准确率达51.5%，直接VLM查询为22.6%，纯文本记忆为16–17%；完整系统在六个仿真报告字段上达77.3%。组件消融、跨生成器测试和三项真实无人机评估验证了检索、报告、生成器变化与可观测监测任务。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在真实物理标注稀缺条件下，将自动仿真到代理的转换与基于记忆的VLM推理相连接，优于直接查询与纯文本记忆，并能泛化到不同生成器与真实无人机场景。

title: FinDialogLens: Event Extraction over Multi-Party Dialogue for Missed-Trade Identification in Financial Chatrooms
summary: Multi-party financial chatrooms are vital for sales-and-trading professionals, but their complexity makes manual recovery of missed trades infeasible: each Request for Quote (RFQ) is an event whose final price and trade outcome appear many messages after the RFQ-trigger message (the inquiry message), interleaved with concurrent RFQs from other participants. We cast this as event extraction (EE) over multi-party dialogue and present FinDialogLens, a hybrid LLM pipeline in which compact fine-tuned classifiers act as inference-time scaffolds: they detect RFQ-triggers and price/trade outcome metadata, an RFQ-Level Module segments per-event RFQ windows, and a Trade Engine fills argument roles. With GPT-4o, FinDialogLens reaches 92.1% and 94.3% accuracy on final price and trade outcome, respectively, outperforming full-chatroom CoT prompting methods; fine-tuned open-source LLMs with as few as 3B parameters achieve comparable performance with modest in-domain data. To make the LLM-based solution practical at scale, a difficulty-aware router balances cost and accuracy by allocating RFQs between a low-cost rule-based engine and the higher-performing LLM-powered Trade Engine, cutting LLM calls by 85% on final price while recovering half of the accuracy gap to FinDialogLens (GPT-4o), saving over $300/day at our 70,000-RFQ/day scale.

AI.tldr: 提出FinDialogLens，将多方可信金融聊天室中的漏单恢复建模为对话事件抽取任务，采用混合LLM流水线并在推理时引入微调分类器作为脚手架，配合难度感知路由器实现低成本部署。
AI.motivation: 多方法金融聊天室对销售与交易人员至关重要，但每个Request for Quote（RFQ）的最终价格与成交结果往往在触发消息之后多条消息才出现，并与其他参与者的并发RFQ交织，导致人工恢复漏单不可行。因此需要一个自动化方案从非结构化多方法对话中抽取RFQ事件及其结果。
AI.method: 将任务建模为多方法对话上的事件抽取（EE），提出FinDialogLens混合LLM流水线：用紧凑微调分类器作为推理期脚手架，检测RFQ触发消息与价格/成交结果元数据；RFQ-Level Module按事件切分RFQ窗口；Trade Engine填充论元角色。此外，引入难度感知路由器，在低成本规则引擎与LLM驱动的Trade Engine之间分配RFQ以平衡成本与精度。
AI.result: 使用GPT-4o时，FinDialogLens在最终价格和成交结果上分别达到92.1%和94.3%的准确率，优于全聊天室CoT提示方法；仅3B参数的微调开源LLM在适量域内数据下即可达到可比性能。难度感知路由器将最终价格任务的LLM调用减少85%，挽回与FinDialogLens（GPT-4o）精度差距的一半，在70,000 RFQ/天规模下每日节省超过300美元。
AI.conclusion: FinDialogLens证明基于事件抽取的混合LLM流水线能有效解决多方金融对话中的漏单恢复问题，微调小模型与难度感知路由使其在大规模场景下具备实用性和成本效益。

title: CUEing User Simulators: Calibrated User Embeddings for Multi-Turn Benchmarking
summary: Recent benchmarks rely on user simulators to evaluate AI agents in multi-turn interaction. While existing simulation techniques demonstrate surface fidelity to human style and behavior, ecologically valid interactive benchmarking also requires alignment in when and how agents fail across simulated and real user populations. We find that existing simulators lack outcome calibration: agreement with observed success rates and failure patterns when real users interact with the same agent. We introduce Calibrated User Embeddings (CUE), a framework that both encodes observed sessions and samples continuous representations, then decodes them into persona commands to steer LLMs to act as user simulators without training. Through this, we evaluate user-conditioned replay of past sessions and aggregate metric agreement when sampling novel personas for the same tasks. On $τ^2$-Bench, CUEd simulators commit fewer simulator-attributed errors and more faithfully reproduce real-user agent failure modes, aggregate success rates, and outcomes for specific task-user pairs than other persona-based simulation methods. These gains coexist with competitive user fidelity as measured using metrics established in prior work. After being fit to mostly customer support interactions, the same CUEd simulators generalize to document creation, math tutoring, and casual conversation, and remain effective across different simulator LLMs without CUE retraining.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出校准用户嵌入（CUE）框架，通过编码真实用户会话并采样连续表示、解码为persona指令来引导LLM充当用户模拟器，无需训练，从而在多轮交互基准测试中实现结果校准。
AI.motivation: 现有多轮交互基准依赖用户模拟器来评估AI代理，但现有模拟技术仅在人机风格与行为上达到表面逼真度，缺乏"结果校准"（outcome calibration），即在模拟用户群体与真实用户群体中，代理失败的时间点与方式应保持一致。论文发现现有模拟器在成功率一致性与失败模式上无法与真实用户交互结果对齐，因此需要生态有效的交互式基准测试方法。
AI.method: CUE框架先编码已观测的真实会话，采样连续表示，再将其解码为persona命令（persona commands），用于引导LLM在无需训练的情况下扮演用户模拟器。基于此方法，论文评估了两类任务：一是用户条件下的历史会话回放，二是为相同任务采样新persona时的聚合指标一致性。
AI.result: 在τ²-Bench上，CUEd模拟器相比其他基于persona的模拟方法，产生更少的模拟器归因错误，更忠实地复现真实用户下代理的失败模式、聚合成功率以及特定任务-用户对的结果；同时保持与先前工作所测指标相当的竞争性用户保真度。在主要拟合客服交互后，同一CUEd模拟器可泛化到文档创作、数学辅导和随意对话，且在不同模拟器LLM间无需重新训练CUE仍保持有效。
AI.conclusion: CUE通过在无需训练的情况下实现结果校准的用户模拟，弥合了模拟与真实用户群体在代理失败模式与成功率上的差距，并在多领域、多LLM上展现出良好的泛化性与保真度平衡。

title: Capability Scaling-Down Laws for LLM Compression
summary: LLM compression reduces inference costs and memory requirements, but selecting a method and configuration remains largely empirical because comparable resource reductions can produce different capability losses. We systematically investigate capability scaling-down laws for LLM compression across pruning, quantization, and distillation. Our framework measures capability loss in mathematics, code generation, and question answering, and relates these measurements to model size, training stage, compression settings, data availability, and training exposure. We develop simple predictive relations and evaluate their accuracy, measurement efficiency, and generalization to unseen configurations and model states. Sharing the density response across pruning levels halves the configuration measurements needed to fit a pruning predictor: on new Pythia states, on pre-registered OLMo-2 test states and under Wanda pruning, the compact relation matches a regression fitted with all measurements on math and code to within 0.020 nats per token, with coefficients refitted for each setting. Controlled distillation experiments show that the cost of heavy data reuse recurs across question-answering distributions, while the net benefit depends on the evaluation distribution. We further evaluate the decision value of these predictions by comparing numerical selection with configuration medians and fixed method priorities. Independent evaluations across two model families show that selection captures most of the available cross-method benefit for question answering within the tested candidate sets, where a fixed method priority attains the same regret, with smaller opportunities for mathematics and code. These results clarify the predictive scope of capability scaling-down laws and their use in compression method selection. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/LabRAI/scaling_down_law.

AI.tldr: 系统研究LLM压缩（剪枝、量化、蒸馏）的"能力缩减定律"，提出预测能力损失与压缩配置间关系的简约模型，能减少测量成本并支持压缩方法选择。
AI.motivation: LLM压缩可降低推理成本与内存需求，但选方法/配置仍主要靠经验，因为同等资源压缩可能导致不同能力损失，缺乏可预测的规律。
AI.method: 构建框架，在数学、代码生成、问答任务上测量能力损失，并将其与模型规模、训练阶段、压缩设置、数据可用性、训练曝光等关联；提出简单预测关系；用受控蒸馏实验分析数据重用的代价与收益；通过数值选择与配置中位数、固定方法优先级的对比评估预测的决策价值。
AI.result: 跨剪枝层级共享密度响应可将拟合剪枝预测器所需配置测量数减半；在新Pythia状态、预注册OLMo-2测试状态及Wanda剪枝下，紧凑关系与全测量回归在数学和代码上误差在0.020 nats/token以内（系数按设置重拟合）。蒸馏中重度数据重用的代价在多个问答分布上反复出现，净收益取决于评测分布。跨两个模型族的独立评测显示，数值选择在问答上捕获了大部分跨方法收益，与固定方法优先级达到相同遗憾，数学和代码机会较小。
AI.conclusion: 阐明了能力缩减定律的预测适用范围及其在压缩方法选择中的应用价值，代码已公开。

title: Windfoil: Closed-Form Coverage for Real-Time and Differentiable Vector Graphics
summary: We present Windfoil, a GPU-friendly algorithm that treats rasterisation and differentiable vector graphics as two sides of the same problem by evaluating the box-filtered winding number of quadratic Bézier contours in closed form. We implement this in WebGPU, allowing it to run across a range of environments, including a web browser on a consumer laptop, and apply the system to real-time 2D rendering, high-resolution rasterisation for print media, and a differentiable renderer. We compare our renderer against Skia, a production-grade engine, and Slug, a popular GPU rasterisation algorithm for games and real-time applications, measuring fidelity to a reference box-filtered coverage. Our renderer matches the reference more closely than either, at performance comparable to Slug. We also compare our optimiser against DiffVG and Bézier Splatting, where it reaches equivalent or better reconstruction quality at a fraction of the per-step cost, scaling to tens of thousands of shapes at interactive rates.

AI.tldr: Windfoil：在WebGPU上以闭式求解二次贝塞尔轮廓的盒式滤波环绕数，统一光栅化与可微矢量图形，实现高保真、高效率渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有GPU光栅化（如Slug）与可微微分渲染（如DiffVG、Bézier Splatting）通常被视作两个独立问题，各自在保真度或计算开销上存在不足；作者希望以统一视角同时提升实时渲染、高分辨率打印光栅化与可微渲染的质量与效率。
AI.method: 提出Windfoil算法，将光栅化与可微矢量图形视为同一问题，通过对二次贝塞尔轮廓的盒式滤波环绕数进行闭式求解来统一处理；在WebGPU上实现，覆盖浏览器到消费级笔记本等多种环境；应用于实时2D渲染、打印用高分辨率光栅化及可微渲染器。
AI.result: 与生产级引擎Skia及流行GPU光栅化算法Slug相比，Windfoil相对参考盒式滤波覆盖度的保真度更高，性能与Slug相当；其优化器相较DiffVG与Bézier Splatting达到相当或更好的重建质量，且单步成本大幅降低，可在交互速率下扩展到数万个形状。
AI.conclusion: Windfoil通过闭式盒式滤波环绕数统一光栅化与可微渲染，在高保真度与高效率上同时优于现有方案，适合实时、打印与可微矢量图形等多场景。

title: APDMem: Agent-Controlled Progressive Disclosure for Query-Adaptive Long-Term Memory
summary: Personalized LLM assistants must recover sparse evidence from long conversation histories across queries of varying complexity. We introduce APDMem (Agent-controlled Progressive Disclosure Memory), a hierarchical long-term memory architecture that applies progressive disclosure to memory retrieval. Rather than relying on a flat memory store or fixed retrieval granularity, APDMem represents conversation history as four progressively detailed layers: thematic summaries, personalized key facts, turn-level evidence notes, and raw messages. At inference time, a controller applies progressive disclosure to the memory hierarchy: it first reads high-level summaries and drills into finer evidence only when needed. This creates an adaptive cost-fidelity trade-off: simple queries can terminate early, while complex temporal, multi-hop, or exact-evidence queries trigger deeper inspection. A note synthesizer converts retrieved evidence into a query-focused structure that consolidates facts, orders events, and flags contradictions before final answer generation. Experiments on LongMemEval show that APDMem achieves strong performance for long-context memory reasoning while accessing only 8% of the total conversations.

AI.tldr: APDMem：一种分层、渐进式披露的长期对话记忆架构，通过控制器按需深入检索，仅访问8%对话即在LongMemEval上取得强性能。
AI.motivation: 个性化LLM助手需在长对话历史中跨不同复杂度查询恢复稀疏证据；平坦记忆存储或固定检索粒度难以兼顾成本与保真度。
AI.method: 将对话历史表示为四层渐进细节（主题摘要、个性化关键事实、轮次级证据笔记、原始消息）；推理时由控制器先读高层摘要，仅在需要时下钻更细证据；笔记合成器将检索证据转化为查询聚焦结构（合并事实、排序事件、标记矛盾）。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval上实现长上下文记忆推理的强性能，且仅访问总对话的8%。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式披露的分层记忆架构可在自适应成本-保真度权衡下有效完成长对话记忆推理。

title: From Retrieval to Typed Decisions: Calibrated System One Models from Biomedical Sentence Encoders
summary: Typed decision models answer schema-constrained questions about a text in one forward pass and return probabilities meant to be thresholded. We ask whether biomedical sentence encoders trained for retrieval are good starting points for such models. We present SBERT2S1, which converts Sentence-Transformers encoders into bi-encoder, cross-head (C) and prior-fused residual (PFR) decision models, together with BIODECIDE, a biomedical typed-decision suite, and MEDLINE-S1, 243k training decisions derived from NLM indexing. Across six parent-retriever pairs, retrieval training improves zero-shot matching of content-bearing options. After fine-tuning, its effect depends on the head: across five pairs and three training-set sizes, retrieval training significantly helps PFR, which keeps the retrieval prior, in 10 of 15 comparisons, but helps C in one and hurts it in five. A matched grid of two heads and five training objectives shows that C outperforms PFR under every objective, and that the released RLCD recipe of open System One models trails cross-entropy by 2.5-3.0 points. The deficit stems mainly from its reward normalisation, which inflates the noisy score-function term 3.6-15-fold; an unbiased leave-one-out estimator recovers most of the gap. After temperature scaling, no objective is clearly better calibrated than cross-entropy. We release the code, the MEDLINE-S1 labels and a model.

AI.tldr: 论文研究检索训练的句子编码器是否适合作为类型化决策模型的起点，提出SBERT2S1转换方法、BIODECIDE评测套件和MEDLINE-S1数据集，发现检索训练对保留检索先验的PFR头有显著益处（15组中10组），但对无先验的C头无益甚至有害；同时揭示RLCD配方落后交叉熵2.5–3.0分，主因是奖励归一化放大噪声项3.6–15倍，用无偏留一估计器可弥补大部分差距。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型需在一次前向传播中回答模式约束问题并输出可阈值化的概率，而生物医学领域已有大量检索训练的句子编码器。作者想验证：这类检索编码器是否可作为此类决策模型的有效初始化，以及不同决策头结构对检索先验的利用差异。
AI.method: 提出SBERT2S1，将Sentence-Transformers编码器转换为双编码器、交叉头（C）与先验融合残差头（PFR）三类决策模型；构建生物医学类型化决策评测套件BIODECIDE与基于NLM索引的243k训练决策集MEDLINE-S1；在六组父检索器上进行零样本与微调实验，并对比两种头结构与五种训练目标，分析RLCD奖励归一化问题并提出无偏留一估计器。
AI.result: 检索训练在零样本下提升了对含内容选项的匹配；微调后效果依赖头结构：五组父检索器、三种训练规模下，检索训练对PFR在15组比较中有10组显著有益，对C仅1组有益、5组有害。匹配网格实验中C在所有目标下均优于PFR；开源System One的RLCD配方比交叉熵低2.5–3.0分，主要因其奖励归一化将噪声score-function项放大3.6–15倍，改用无偏留一估计器可恢复大部分差距；温度缩放后各目标校准无明显优于交叉熵者。
AI.conclusion: 检索训练的编码器更适合作为保留检索先验的决策头（如PFR）的起点，而非无先验头；RLCD配方的性能缺陷主要来自奖励归一化，可通过无偏估计器修正。作者开源了代码、MEDLINE-S1标签与一个模型。

title: Right Order, Wrong Scale: Auditing LLM Judges for Occupational AI Measurement
summary: LLM judges are increasingly used to assess whether AI outputs meet workplace requirements, but agreement on response rankings does not establish agreement on acceptance rates or occupational aggregates. We introduce O*NET-BENCH, an audit suite derived from an existing survey of 45,796 worker ratings, and evaluate 33 pre-existing judge configurations across six model families on 4,501 test ratings. Twenty-five configurations achieve tie-aware pair accuracy of at least 0.60, although a train-fitted response-only TF-IDF baseline nearly matches the strongest judge. Despite this ordering agreement, judges estimate that 3.0%-97.9% of responses are acceptable, compared with 61.1% for occupation-matched workers. In one fine-tuned lineage, changing from pointwise scoring to a bundled few-shot/listwise protocol improves response ordering while reducing agreement with worker means at the task and occupation levels; this reversal replicates on a task- and worker-disjoint validation split under prespecified criteria. Cross-validated calibration largely removes mean bias, but calibrated scores explain at most 8.5% of individual worker-rating variance. Prediction-assisted estimation yields at most small precision gains at the studied label budgets. These results show that ranking agreement alone is insufficient for occupational measurement. Judges should be validated against the acceptance rates and aggregates their scores will be used to estimate.

AI.tldr: 论文提出O*NET-BENCH审计套件，发现LLM评判者虽在响应排序上与工人一致，但在接受率与职业聚合指标上严重偏离，排序一致性不足以支撑职业测量。
AI.motivation: LLM评判者被广泛用于评估AI输出是否满足职场要求，但既有验证通常只关注排序一致性，误以为排序一致即可代表接受率与职业层面聚合指标一致；论文旨在检验这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 构建O*NET-BENCH审计套件，基于45,796条工人评分的既有调查，在4,501条测试评分上评估6个模型家族共33种预置评判配置；引入仅基于回答的TF-IDF基线；比较逐点打分与捆绑式few-shot/listwise协议；采用交叉验证校准并在任务与工人不相交的验证划分上复现；开展预测辅助估计实验。
AI.result: 25种配置达到至少0.60的tie-aware成对准确率，但训练拟合的response-only TF-IDF基线几乎追平最强评判者；尽管排序一致，评判者估计的可接受率为3.0%–97.9%，而职业匹配工人为61.1%；某微调谱系中从逐点改为捆绑式few-shot/listwise提升了排序，却降低了与工人在任务和职业层面均值的一致性，该反转在预设定标准下复现；交叉验证校准基本消除均值偏差，但校准分数最多解释个体工人评分方差的8.5%；预测辅助估计在给定标签预算下仅带来微小精度提升。
AI.conclusion: 排序一致性本身不足以用于职业测量，LLM评判者必须针对其分数所要估计的接受率与聚合指标进行验证，而不能仅凭排序一致性判定其有效性。

title: DeepStratNet: A Context-Aware Coordinate Regression Framework for Seismic Horizon Tracking under Sparse Labels
summary: Automatic horizon tracking is a foundational task in 3D seismic interpretation. Most existing deep learning approaches formulate it as dense semantic segmentation, typically using U-Net-based architectures. The model produces a probability map over all pixels that must be post-processed to extract precise horizon coordinates, while horizon picks in time/depth must be converted into dense masks for training. Unpicked seismic traces are consequently treated as background, which can hinder convergence, and both pre- and post-processing can introduce errors into the final interpretation. Moreover, 2D segmentation models do not inherently capture inter-slice context, while 3D models are often computationally prohibitive. We instead formulate horizon tracking as a bounded coordinate regression problem, where the model directly predicts the time/depth coordinate of the target horizon at each lateral position. We propose a lightweight regression head compatible with any pretrained vision backbone, coupled with an LSTM module to model inter-slice context and produce a continuous horizon surface across the volume. A combination of L1 and L2 losses supervises predictions at valid horizon picks, while a geology-informed regularization enforces lateral continuity between successive traces. Under controlled experimental conditions, we evaluate four pretrained vision backbones under both segmentation and regression configurations on a seismic volume from New Zealand. The proposed approach consistently outperforms its segmentation counterparts quantitatively, using metrics including RMSE and PCC, and qualitatively, while also demonstrating greater robustness to increasing sparsity of training picks. Finally, we show that prediction variation across successive traces captures local variations in geological complexity, providing an automated quality control measure for downstream seismic interpretation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将三维地震层位追踪重新定义为有界坐标回归问题，用轻量回归头加LSTM直接预测层位坐标，优于分割方法且更抗训练稀疏性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法多将层位追踪建模为稠密语义分割（通常基于U-Net），需前后处理才能得到精确层位坐标，且需将时间/深度拾取转换为稠密掩码用于训练；未拾取道被当作背景会阻碍收敛，前后处理易引入误差；2D分割缺乏层间上下文，3D模型计算代价高。
AI.method: 将层位追踪表述为有界坐标回归问题，模型在每个横向位置直接预测目标层位的时间/深度坐标；提出与任意预训练视觉骨干兼容的轻量回归头，并耦合LSTM建模层间上下文以生成贯整体的连续层位面；监督采用L1与L2损失组合，仅在有效层位拾取处计算，并加入地质信息启发的正则化项以约束相邻道之间的横向连续性。
AI.result: 在受控实验条件下，基于新西兰某地震体，对四种预训练视觉骨干在分割与回归两种配置下进行评估；所提方法在RMSE和PCC等定量指标及定性结果上均持续优于分割对照，并对训练拾取稀疏性增加表现出更强鲁棒性；相邻道间的预测变化可反映局部地质复杂度差异，提供下游地震解释的自动质控手段。
AI.conclusion: 以有界坐标回归替代稠密分割可避免前后处理误差并提升精度；结合LSTM层间上下文与地质连续性正则化，能生成连续层位面，且在训练拾取稀疏时更鲁棒；预测的道间变化可作为自动质控指标服务于地震解释。

title: MeshQuery: Agentic Seam Planning for UV Parametrization
summary: We present MeshQuery, a training-free agentic approach to automatic UV unwrapping of production-grade quad meshes. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) plans artist-aligned seams using a set of edge-selection tools, conditioned on domain-specific UV-unwrapping knowledge expressed in natural language and refined with a feedback loop. We design a queryable mesh representation together with a domain-specific language (DSL) that enables the agent to retrieve mesh information on demand, express a seam plan as a compact program of edge-selection operators over topological, geometric, and semantic mesh attributes, and iteratively refine it from UV quality feedback. On Adobe Substance 3D and Toys4K meshes, MeshQuery produces 2.9x/4.29x fewer charts and 1.63x/1.7x shorter seams than the strongest baseline, and professional artists prefer its results in 80.9% of comparisons. Ultimately, decoupling high-level intent planning from low-level edge selection and compact mesh representation lets MeshQuery run on different backend VLMs and scale to meshes an order of magnitude larger than autoregressive seam prediction

AI.tldr: MeshQuery 是一种免训练的智能体方法，利用 VLM 规划与艺术家人工对齐的接缝，通过可查询网格表示与 DSL，以反馈循环迭代优化，实现生产级四边形网格的自动 UV 展开。
AI.motivation: 生产级四边形网格的自动 UV 展开需要与艺术家习惯一致的接缝规划，而现有方法（如自回归接缝预测）在可扩展性、后端模型通用性和高质量结果上存在局限，因此需要解耦高层意图规划与低层边选择。
AI.method: 提出 MeshQuery：使用 VLM 作为规划器，结合边选择工具；设计可查询的网格表示及领域特定语言（DSL），使智能体能够按需检索网格信息，将接缝计划表达为基于拓扑、几何和语义属性的紧凑边选择算子程序，并依据 UV 质量反馈进行迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在 Adobe Substance 3D 与 Toys4K 网格上，相比最强基线，MeshQuery 产生的图表数减少 2.9x/4.29x，接缝长度缩短 1.63x/1.7x；专业艺术家在 80.9% 的对比中更偏好其结果。
AI.conclusion: 将高层意图规划与低层边选择及紧凑网格表示解耦，使 MeshQuery 能运行于不同后端 VLM，并可扩展到比自回归接缝预测大一个数量级的网格。

title: World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning
