summary: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual dynamics and actions from an initial observation and instruction. However, existing WAMs struggle with long-horizon prediction, as generating dense video rollouts is highly inefficient. Some recent WAMs address this by predicting a single future frame without generating the full video, but this approach neglects how to progress toward the goal. We present ProWAM, a progressive world action model that jointly predicts actions and an ordered sequence of sparse visual sub-goals, providing explicit visual guidance to anchor action generation throughout task execution. This design scales naturally, as sub-goal prediction can be learned from large-scale action-free videos, allowing the video backbone to offload complex visual planning from the action policy. For efficient action generation, ProWAM executes a single video-backbone forward pass to cache sparse sub-goal features, eliminating iterative full-video generation and requiring only lightweight action denoising during replanning. Across extensive evaluations, ProWAM achieves superior out-of-distribution robustness. On simulation benchmarks, it sets new state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus (85.8%) and randomized RoboTwin (75.7%), outperforming the strongest baseline with relative gains of up to +35.9%. On RoboCasa365, ProWAM achieves a 48.1% success rate and 18.2% on the challenging Composite-Unseen split, ranking 4th overall. Crucially, in zero-shot real-world experiments, ProWAM achieves 70.0% success, outperforming the strongest baseline by +15.0 (from 55.0% to 70.0%, a +27.3% relative gain) in novel scenes. These results demonstrate the value of progress-indexed visual foresight for closed-loop control. Our program is in https://sii-ferenas.github.io/ProWAM-page.

AI.tldr: ProWAM 是一种渐进式世界动作模型，通过联合预测动作序列与有序稀疏视觉子目标，实现高效且鲁棒的长时程机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）在长时程预测上效率低下：生成稠密视频展开代价高昂；而仅预测单一未来帧的做法又缺乏向目标推进的显式引导。因此需要一种兼顾效率与目标导向的视觉前瞻机制。
AI.method: 提出 ProWAM，联合预测动作与有序稀疏视觉子目标序列，为动作生成提供显式视觉锚点。子目标预测可从大规模无动作视频中学习，使视频骨干网络分摊复杂视觉规划；动作生成仅需对视频骨干网络做一次前向传播以缓存稀疏子目标特征，避免迭代式全视频生成，重规划时只需轻量动作去噪。
AI.result: 在仿真基准上，LIBERO-Plus 达 85.8%，随机化 RoboTwin 达 75.7%，均为新的最优结果，相对最强基线提升最高 +35.9%；RoboCasa365 成功率达 48.1%，Composite-Unseen 分割 18.2%，总排名第 4。零样本真实世界实验中，新场景下成功率达 70.0%，较最强基线（55.0%）提升 +15.0 个百分点（相对增益 +27.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了「渐进索引式视觉前瞻」对闭环控制的价值；ProWAM 在分布外鲁棒性、仿真与真实场景中均表现出色，且设计具备良好可扩展性。

title: From Fragments to Global Maps: Learning Vectorized Map Aggregation with Large Language Models
summary: Large-scale vectorized HD maps provide structured road information that is essential for perception, localization, and planning in autonomous driving. Constructing such maps requires aggregating noisy, fragmented, and overlapping local predictions collected along a vehicle trajectory into a coherent global map. Existing aggregation methods typically rely on hand-crafted rules for fragment association and refinement. However, a fixed set of thresholds cannot effectively handle variations in road structures and prediction errors, often requiring detector-specific tuning or manual adjustment. To address this limitation, we propose MapMergeLLM, a data-driven framework that formulates vectorized map aggregation as conditional sequence generation with a large language model. Given serialized local vectorized maps, our model directly predicts the aggregated global map polylines. To reduce dependence on any particular upstream detector, we train the model on synthetic local maps generated from clean vector maps using corruptions that simulate representative prediction errors. We further introduce a coordinate tokenizer with geometry-aware pretraining to precisely represent map coordinates. In addition, we propose a line-level association loss that explicitly supervises correspondences between local observations of the same map element. Experiments on Argoverse2 and nuScenes using multiple recent upstream detectors demonstrate that MapMergeLLM substantially outperforms heuristic and optimization-based aggregation baselines without detector-specific retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MapMergeLLM，将矢量化高精地图的全局聚合建模为条件序列生成任务，用大语言模型直接预测聚合后的全局地图折线，无需针对特定上游检测器调参即可超越启发式和优化类基线。
AI.motivation: 大规模矢量化高精地图需要将沿车辆轨迹采集的、含噪声、碎片化且重叠的局部预测聚合为连贯的全局地图。现有聚合方法多依赖手工规则进行片段关联与精化，固定阈值难以应对道路结构与预测误差的变化，常需针对特定检测器调参或人工调整，泛化性差。
AI.method: 提出MapMergeLLM数据驱动框架，将矢量化地图聚合表述为条件序列生成：输入序列化的局部矢量化地图，直接输出聚合后的全局地图折线。为降低对特定上游检测器的依赖，利用干净矢量地图经模拟典型预测误差的损坏生成的合成局部地图进行训练；引入几何感知预训练的坐标分词器以精确表示地图坐标；并提出线级关联损失，显式监督同一地图元素不同局部观测之间的对应关系。
AI.result: 在Argoverse2和nuScenes数据集上，使用多个近期上游检测器进行实验，MapMergeLLM在无需检测器特定重训练的情况下，显著优于启发式与基于优化的聚合基线。
AI.conclusion: 将地图聚合转化为基于大语言模型的条件序列生成是可行且有效的，合成损坏数据训练与坐标分词、线级关联损失的设计使模型具备跨检测器的泛化能力，为矢量化高精地图聚合提供了无需手工规则与反复调参的新范式。

title: Spatial Memory Intelligence: Endowing World Models with Understanding-Driven Long-Term Memory
summary: Long-video generation and world models have shown strong potential for interactive entertainment and embodied simulation by predicting future observations conditioned on user actions and historical memory. However, as memory sequences grow longer and their structures become increasingly complex, managing long-range spatial context becomes increasingly challenging, calling for a more intelligent and systematic memory-management strategy. Building on the advancing spatial reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and the broader vision of unified models, we propose Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI), the first framework to systematically employ an understanding model for spatial-memory management in long-video world models. SMI introduces four coordinated atomic operations: spatial clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval, and reliability-aware filtering. Extensive experiments across multiple baselines, benchmarks, and world-model backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of SMI, achieving comprehensive improvements in memory sparsity, generation stability, and spatial consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出SMI框架，首次系统性地用理解模型（MLLM）对长视频世界模型进行空间记忆管理，通过四种原子操作提升记忆稀疏性、生成稳定性与空间一致性。
AI.motivation: 长视频生成与世界模型在交互娱乐和具身仿真中潜力巨大，但随着记忆序列增长、结构复杂化，长程空间上下文的管理日益困难，亟需更智能、系统化的记忆管理策略。同时，多模态大语言模型的空�间推理能力与统一模型趋势为此提供了契机。
AI.method: 提出Spatial Memory Intelligence（SMI）框架，系统性地采用理解模型进行空间记忆管理，包含四个协同的原子操作：空间聚类（spatial clustering）、簇内稀疏化（within-cluster sparsification）、动作感知检索（action-aware retrieval）和可靠性感知过滤（reliability-aware filtering）。
AI.result: 在多个基线、基准和世界模型骨干上的大量实验表明，SMI具有有效性与可泛化性，在记忆稀疏性、生成稳定性和空间一致性方面均取得全面提升。
AI.conclusion: SMI是首个系统性地将理解模型用于长视频世界模型空间记忆管理的框架，验证了将空间推理能力引入记忆管理的可行性与优越性，为长视频世界模型的记忆管理提供了新范式。

title: A generative-informed neuro-symbolic framework for syntactic ambiguity resolution: Evidence from Arabic DPs
summary: Syntactic ambiguity poses a persistent challenge for Arabic NLP, particularly in morphologically rich nominal constructions where multiple structu6ral interpretations may be compatible with the same surface sequence. This study proposes a generatively informed neuro-symbolic framework for resolving structural ambiguity in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) DPs. The framework integrates generative syntactic notions with AraBERT by representing ambiguity as a candidate-based decision task in which linguistically motivated alternatives are explicitly constructed and evaluated through candidate-conditioned input representations. Findings indicate that the model achieved 96.88% accuracy, 95.92% macro-F1, 96.83% weighted F1, and 93.94% binary F1 on the unseen evaluation set. Class-level analysis revealed asymmetric performance, with recall of 99.71% for High/VP Attachment (N1) and 89.26% for Low/NP/Embedded Attachment (N2), indicating greater difficulty in recovering the embedded interpretation. The study concludes that formal syntactic representations can be operationalized within Transformer-based NLP as an explicit interface between linguistic structure and contextual neural modeling, providing a controlled and interpretable approach to Arabic syntactic ambiguity resolution and beyond.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个生成语法启发的神经符号框架，通过候选条件下的输入表示将MSA DP结构歧义建模为候选选择任务，结合生成句法理论与AraBERT，实现96.88%准确率与95.92%宏F1，但对嵌入解读（N2）的召回率（89.26%）明显低于高位附接解读（N1，99.71%）。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语NLP长期受句法歧义困扰，尤其是在形态丰富、表层序列可对应多种结构解读的名词性结构中；现有Transformer模型缺乏对语言结构的显式建模，作者希望将形式句法表征操作化为语言结构与上下文神经建模之间的可解释接口。
AI.method: 面向现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）DP的生成语法启发式神经符号框架：将歧义求解形式化为基于候选的判定任务，先依据生成句法构造有语言学动机的候选结构，再通过候选条件化输入表示（candidate-conditioned input representations）将其送入AraBERT进行评价与选择。
AI.result: 在未见测试集上取得96.88%准确率、95.92%宏F1、96.83%加权F1与93.94%二分类F1；类别层面表现不对称：High/VP Attachment（N1）召回率99.71%，Low/NP/Embedded Attachment（N2）召回率89.26%，表明嵌入解读的恢复更为困难。
AI.conclusion: 形式句法表征可在Transformer范式NLP中被操作化，作为语言结构与语境神经建模之间的显式接口，为阿拉伯语句法歧义消解及相关任务提供可控且可解释的途径；但附接类型间的不对称性能提示模型对嵌入式/低位附接解读的建模仍有提升空间。

title: Image-Based Breast Implant Detection for Mammography Dataset Curation and Near-Real-Time Deployment: Comparing Foundation Models and Task-Specific Convolutional Models
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the Journal of Imaging Informatics in Medicine
summary: Purpose: To evaluate the performance-feasibility tradeoffs of foundation models (FMs) and task-specific convolutional neural networks (CNNs) trained from scratch for breast implant classification in 2D mammography, with emphasis on suitability for near real-time clinical deployment. Methods: We evaluated four models: two FMs (RAD-DINO and MammoCLIP) and two CNNs trained from scratch for implant prediction (ResNet18 and our lightweight ResNetLite). Using the Emory Breast Imaging Dataset, 5,000 unilateral screening mammograms were used for training/validation and 1,000 manually reviewed unilateral images were held out for testing. For the FMs, global image embeddings from the pretrained encoder were classified using a support vector machine (SVM). The CNNs were trained end-to-end on 2D mammograms, with ResNetLite optimized via grid search over depth and width to balance accuracy and efficiency. Performance was evaluated using AUROC, sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, embedding visualization, and inference-latency. Results: All models demonstrated strong performance on held-out test data (n = 1,000). MammoCLIP achieved the highest AUROC (0.999) with the quickest training time of 493 seconds. RAD-DINO achieved the highest sensitivity (0.980; accuracy 0.989) but had the slowest inference and training times. ResNet18 and MammoCLIP achieved comparable accuracy (0.985). ResNetLite showed no statistically significant difference from ResNet18 (AUROC 0.993; accuracy 0.976) despite using only 1.4% of ResNet18's parameters, and had the fastest inference time. Conclusion: FMs and task-specific CNN models reliably detect breast implants on 2D mammography. Model selection is best guided by deployment context: MammoCLIP for GPU-equipped hospital settings requiring scalable integration, and lightweight CNNs such as ResNetLite for resource-constrained or edge deployments.

AI.tldr: 评估基础模型与轻量CNN在2D乳腺X线摄影乳房植入物分类中的性能-可行性权衡，为不同部署场景提供模型选型依据。
AI.motivation: 临床近实时部署需在准确率与推理效率间取得平衡，但基础模型（需GPU、推理慢）与从零训练的任务专用CNN（参数少但可能精度受限）之间的权衡尚不明确。
AI.method: 基于Emory乳腺影像数据集，5000张单侧筛查图像用于训练/验证，1000张人工复核图像用于测试。评测4个模型：两个基础模型（RAD-DINO、MammoCLIP，用预训练编码器全局图像嵌入+SVM分类）与两个从零训练CNN（ResNet18及轻量ResNetLite，后者经深度/宽度网格搜索优化）。指标包括AUROC、灵敏度、特异度、准确率、嵌入可视化与推理延迟。
AI.result: MammoCLIP AUROC最高（0.999）且训练最快（493秒）；RAD-DINO灵敏度最高（0.980，准确率0.989）但推理与训练最慢；ResNet18与MammoCLIP准确率相当（0.985）；ResNetLite仅用ResNet18 1.4%参数即达AUROC 0.993、准确率0.976，与ResNet18无统计学显著差异，且推理最快。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型与任务专用CNN均能可靠检测2D乳腺X线摄影中的乳房植入物；模型选型应依据部署情境：GPU医院环境追求可扩展集成选MammoCLIP，资源受限或边缘部署选ResNetLite等轻量CNN。

title: Evaluating Multi-Dimensional Generalization of Large Language Models in Temporal Extraction Tasks
summary: Time and event expression extraction are fundamental temporal reasoning tasks, but the problem remains difficult due to annotation ambiguity, domain sensitivity, and unstable model behavior. Existing evaluations focus on in-domain performance, offering limited insight into reliability under distribution shifts. We evaluate multiple model configurations across families, architectures, and reasoning strategies over four dimensions of generalization, examining transfer from base performance, cross-dimensional correlations, and the effects of scale, architecture, and prompting. This provides a systematic study of how prompted LLMs generalize in time and event expression extraction tasks. We find that strong base-task performance generally predicts better generalization. However, this relationship weakens under substantial distribution shifts. Inductive prompting performs most consistently across domain shift, adversarial perturbations, compositionality, and length increase, while gains from scale, architecture, and deductive and abductive prompting strategies are uneven and dimension-specific. We conclude that LLM generalization in temporal extraction tasks cannot be predicted from any single dimension alone and cannot be reliably inferred from in-domain or single-dimension evaluations, highlighting the need for reasoning strategies that generalize across dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了多种LLM配置在时间和事件表达抽取任务上的泛化能力，覆盖四个泛化维度，发现归纳式提示最稳健，泛化无法由单一维度或域内表现可靠推断。
AI.motivation: 时间和事件表达抽取是时间推理的基础任务，但受标注歧义、领域敏感和模型行为不稳定影响而困难。现有评估仅关注域内性能，对分布偏移下的可靠性了解有限，因此需系统研究LLM的泛化性。
AI.method: 跨模型家族、架构与推理策略评估多种模型配置，围绕四个泛化维度，考察基础性能迁移、跨维度相关性，以及规模、架构和提示策略的影响。
AI.result: 强基础任务性能通常预示更好泛化，但在大幅分布偏移下该关系减弱。归纳式提示在领域偏移、对抗扰动、组合性和长度增加上表现最一致；规模、架构及演绎、溯因提示带来的增益不均衡且依赖具体维度。
AI.conclusion: LLM在时间抽取任务中的泛化无法由单一维度预测，也无法从域内或单维度评估可靠推断，需发展跨维度泛化的推理策略。

title: Oracle headroom without signal: null-calibrated evaluation of candidate selection for thermal heart rate estimation
summary: Camera-based physiological monitoring can produce multiple estimates from several facial regions, extraction methods, and processing settings. Signal quality indices aim to select reliable estimates without a physiological reference, and their potential is often assessed with an oracle that selects the estimate closest to the reference in each window. This retrospective selection can reward chance agreement. We model the effect with order statistics. For K independent candidates unrelated to the reference, the expected oracle error decreases approximately as 1/K. We analyze thermal heart rate estimation on 96 iBVP recordings with 168 candidates per 10 s window. The oracle achieves a mean absolute error of 0.91 bpm, compared with 10.74 bpm for the best fixed configuration, 18.03 bpm for the best quality index, and 8.61 bpm for a constant predictor. With K = 24, a forehead signal from another recording matches the correct one, with 4.62 against 4.61 bpm. Oracle evaluations should report candidate count, valid coverage, and matched null controls.

AI.tldr: 本文指出基于Oracle的候选信号选择评估会因偶然一致性产生虚高，采用顺序统计建模并分析热成像心率估计，证明Oracle误差随候选数K约按1/K下降，需报告候选数、有效覆盖率及匹配零对照。
AI.motivation: 摄像头生理监测可从多个面部区域、提取方法与处理设置产生大量估计，信号质量指标旨在无生理参考下选出可靠估计；其潜力常用Oracle（每窗选最接近参考的估计）评估，但这种回顾式选择会奖励偶然一致，导致评估结果虚高，需要量化该效应。
AI.method: 用顺序统计（order statistics）对Oracle选择效应建模：假设K个与参考无关的独立候选，推导其期望Oracle误差随K的变化；随后在96段iBVP记录上分析热成像心率估计，每10 s窗口含168个候选，并对比最佳固定配置、最佳质量指标与常数预测器；另做K=24的匹配零对照实验，用另一段记录的额头信号替代正确信号。
AI.result: 与参考无关的K个独立候选，其期望Oracle误差约按1/K下降。实验中心率估计Oracle平均绝对误差为0.91 bpm，而最佳固定配置为10.74 bpm、最佳质量指标为18.03 bpm、常数预测器为8.61 bpm；K=24时，来自另一段记录的额头信号与正确信号的误差相当（4.62 vs 4.61 bpm）。
AI.conclusion: Oracle评估会因偶然一致而系统性高估信号质量指标潜力。建议Oracle评估中必须报告候选数量、有效覆盖率，并设置匹配的零对照，以区分真实选择能力与随机机遇带来的虚高表现。

title: DAGS: Disentangled Appearance-and-Geometry Steering of a Frozen Image DiT for Temporally Stabilized Generative Rendering
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
summary: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate high-fidelity images from text and image conditions, but their outputs carry large variance and their faithfulness to a desired target depends heavily on how the condition is supplied. We present DAGS, a lightweight, attention-free, disentangled appearance and geometry conditioning scheme that steers a frozen image DiT to produce high-fidelity, highly faithful, and independently controllable renders. Two small convolutional encoders compute conditioning features once per frame and inject them as a learned, per-layer, element-wise residual into the image tokens, avoiding the quadratic cost of stacking conditions through attention. Because control and temporal handling live outside the frozen backbone, we retain its vast pretrained prior and eliminate backbone-overfitting risk. We further add a small recurrent lighting stabilizer and a training-free temporal guidance term that, coupled with our conditioning, elevate a per-frame image model into a streaming renderer. DAGS produces controllable, high-quality renders at a fraction of the compute of path tracing; it is not real-time, trading compute for controllability and quality. On a matched 1-spp + G-buffer input, per-frame DAGS reconstructs +8.6 dB / +10.1 dB PSNR over the real-time denoiser Intel OIDN and the diffusion renderer RGB<->X while being 2.5-8x more temporally stable perceptually (temporal-LPIPS flicker).

AI.tldr: DAGS 是一种轻量、无注意力机制的解耦外观与几何条件方案，通过小型卷积编码器将条件特征以逐层逐元素残差注入冻结的 DiT 图像 token，实现高保真、可控的图像渲染，并以少量递归光照稳定器和免训练时序引导将逐帧模型升级为流式渲染器。
AI.motivation: DiT 虽能生成高保真图像，但输出方差大，且对目标条件的忠实度高度依赖条件注入方式。作者希望在不破坏预训练先验、避免骨干过拟合的前提下，实现高保真、忠实且外观与几何可独立控制的渲染。
AI.method: 提出 DAGS：两个小型卷积编码器每帧计算一次条件特征，作为学习到的逐层逐元素残差注入图像 token，避免注意力叠加条件的二次开销；控制与时序处理置于冻结骨干之外；额外加入小型递归光照稳定器与免训练时序引导项，将逐帧图像模型变为流式渲染器。
AI.result: 计算量远低于路径追踪（非实时，以算力换可控性与质量）。在匹配的 1-spp + G-buffer 输入下，逐帧 DAGS 相比实时去噪器 Intel OIDN 与扩散渲染器 RGB↔X 分别提升 +8.6 dB / +10.1 dB PSNR，感知时序稳定性（temporal-LPIPS 闪烁）高出 2.5–8 倍。
AI.conclusion: DAGS 以无注意力的解耦条件注入方式，利用冻结 DiT 先验实现高保真、可独立控制外观与几何的渲染，并在质量与感知时序稳定性上显著优于现有实时去噪与扩散渲染方法。

title: SLVR: Structured Latent Visual Reasoning via Human-like Reasoning Flows
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often answer visual reasoning questions by relying on linguistic priors rather than task-relevant visual evidence. Textual chain-of-thought reasoning can partially mitigate this issue by encouraging models to decompose visual questions into intermediate evidence-seeking steps, but generating these steps autoregressively increases inference cost. Latent reasoning avoids explicit rationale generation, but existing approaches provide limited control over what intermediate states encode, making it difficult to impose separate supervision for planning, grounding, and evidence selection. We propose Structured Latent Visual Reasoning (SLVR), a training framework that bridges explicit chain-of-thought and latent reasoning by organizing multimodal reasoning into typed latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and reasoning integration. SLVR first trains the model to rely on the image by masking answer-revealing text and contrasting the correct answer with visually plausible distractors. It then organizes reasoning into latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and integration, supervising each stage with the corresponding signal: plans, boxes, visual evidence, and final rationales. This gives latent reasoning an explicit functional structure while avoiding generated textual chains at inference time. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, SLVR improves consistently across multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with absolute gains of +9.4 on MMVP and +14.2 on BLINK Relation, as well as improvements on V*, MathVista, and ChartQA. These results suggest that structured latent supervision can improve fine-grained visual reasoning without the decoding overhead of textual CoT. Project page is available \href{https://bogao-code.github.io/SLVR/}{here}.

AI.tldr: SLVR 将多模态推理分解为规划、定位、证据选择与整合四类潜在阶段，用对应信号分别监督，在不生成显式文本思维链的情况下提升细粒度视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: MLLM 常依赖语言先验而非视觉证据作答。文本思维链可缓解此问题，但自回归生成中间步骤增加推理开销；现有潜在推理方法对中间状态编码缺乏可控性，难以对规划、定位、证据选择分别施加监督。
AI.method: 提出 Structured Latent Visual Reasoning（SLVR）训练框架：先通过掩蔽揭示答案的文本，并将正确答案与视觉上合理的干扰项进行对比，迫使模型依赖图像；再将推理组织为规划、定位、证据选择、推理整合等类型化潜在阶段，分别以计划、框、视觉证据和最终理由进行监督，从而在推理时无需生成文本链式思维。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，在多模态推理基准上一致提升：MMVP 绝对提升 +9.4，BLINK Relation 提升 +14.2，V*、MathVista、ChartQA 亦有改善。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的潜在监督可在不引入文本 CoT 解码开销的前提下，提升细粒度视觉推理性能，验证了为潜在推理赋予显式功能结构的有效性。

title: Physical AI Smart Spaces: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-Camera 3D Perception in Smart Spaces
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track (poster)
summary: Physical AI Smart Spaces is, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark to simultaneously provide large-scale, multi-class, and multi-camera 3D perception data for indoor smart spaces. It contains over 280 hours of synchronized 1080p footage captured by nearly 1,800 cameras in warehouses, hospitals, retail venues, and similar settings, together with automatic annotations for multi-camera identities, 2D bounding boxes, 3D bounding boxes, camera calibration, and depth where available. The benchmark spans Isaac Sim synthetic generation, Cosmos Transfer appearance augmentation, and real-world Sim2Real evaluation. For the real-world target, we include two warehouse deployments with time-synchronized streams, automatic VGGT-based calibration, and a 3D labeling interface that projects world-frame 3D boxes into each view for cross-camera verification. We describe the dataset scope, annotation and calibration schema, generation workflow, benchmark protocols, and official evaluation system, which standardizes submission format, and leaderboard reporting. A central contribution is a 3D instantiation of Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA), extending the usual 2D box-based tracking evaluation to 3D locations and 3D boxes. We further report empirical baselines from the AI City Challenge leaderboards, showing how methods evolve from person-only 3D location tracking to multi-class 3D box tracking under realistic smart-space constraints. The release is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces.

AI.tldr: Physical AI Smart Spaces是首个面向室内智能空间、同时提供大规模、多类别、多相机3D感知数据的基准，包含超1800个相机、280余小时同步1080p视频及多种自动标注，并提出3D版HOTA评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有基准难以同时满足大规模、多类别、多相机3D感知需求，尤其缺少面向室内智能空间的真实世界同步多相机3D感知与跨相机验证数据，因此需要一个统一的基准来支撑该领域研究。
AI.method: 数据涵盖仓库、医院、零售等场景，通过Isaac Sim合成生成、Cosmos Transfer外观增强及真实世界Sim2Real评估构建；自动标注多相机身份、2D/3D边界框、相机标定与深度；真实场景包含两个仓库部署，采用时间同步视频流、基于VGGT的自动标定，以及将世界坐标3D框投影到各视图的3D标注界面进行跨相机验证；评估提出3D版HOTA。
AI.result: 报告了来自AI City Challenge排行榜的经验基线，展示方法从仅人体3D位置跟踪演进到真实智能空间约束下的多类别3D框跟踪；同时规范了提交格式、排行榜报告等评估体系。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为室内智能空间的多相机3D感知提供了统一数据、标注、标定、生成流程、评测协议与官方评估系统，并通过3D HOTA推动跟踪评估由2D框扩展到3D位置与3D框；数据已公开于Hugging Face。

title: How Causality Bridges the Semantic Gap
summary: Numerical measurements capture how a system behaves, but often leave the meanings of its variables unspecified. Some variables are measured but never labeled, and others are never measured at all. Existing methods assign semantics to such variables by consulting general human knowledge, but this inherits its biases where that knowledge exists and offers nothing where it does not. We bridge this gap between measurements and their meanings with causal structure instead, reading a variable's semantics from how it acts on other variables. We formalize this as structure-constrained semantic alignment, in which the embedding of each unnamed variable is solved under the dependence relations implied by the causal graph, with the embeddings of a few known names as anchors. Accordingly, we build CausalBridge, a framework that discovers the causal graph from the measurements, latent variables included, solves for the embeddings under those relations, and expresses them as names through a language model. The causal structure reflects the mechanism that generated the measurements and is recovered from the measurements alone, which may make it the one source of information free of bias from human knowledge. We evaluate CausalBridge on five questionnaires and three robotics scenarios, with 20 to 90% of the variable names masked. It recovers the semantics of observed and latent variables more accurately than existing methods that rely on association, and its lead widens as less of the system is documented. The graph it discovers names variables as accurately as the documented one, and a new system is named in minutes and at a fraction of the cost of sampling methods. Once the semantic gap is bridged faithfully, machines can understand the world and take actions causally.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CausalBridge 框架，利用因果结构而非通用人类知识，为未命名变量（含潜变量）赋予语义，通过结构约束的语义对齐求解变量嵌入并以语言模型转述为名称。
AI.motivation: 数值测量能捕捉系统行为，但变量的含义常未被标注：部分变量被测量却未命名，部分变量从未被测量。现有方法依赖通用人类知识来赋义，既继承了该知识的偏见，在知识缺失处又无能为力。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为结构约束的语义对齐：在因果图隐含的依赖关系下求解每个未命名变量的嵌入，并以少量已知名称的嵌入作为锚点。据此构建 CausalBridge：从测量数据中（含潜变量）发现因果图，在依赖关系约束下求解嵌入，再通过语言模型将其表达为名称；因果结构仅从测量数据中恢复。
AI.result: 在五个问卷数据集与三个机器人场景上评估，掩蔽 20%–90% 的变量名。相比依赖关联的现有方法，CausalBridge 对观测变量与潜变量的语义恢复更准确，且系统文档越少时领先优势越大；其发现的因果图在命名变量上准确度与人工文档图相当；新系统可在数分钟内以远低于采样方法的成本完成命名。
AI.conclusion: 以因果结构为信息源可忠实弥合测量与语义之间的鸿沟，使机器能够理解世界并进行因果推理与行动。

title: GRAFT: Growing Agglomerative Foundation Models via Continual Teacher Distillation
summary: Vision foundation models such as DINOv2, SigLIP2, and MASt3R develop complementary capabilities from different pretraining objectives, yet their knowledge remains distributed across separate, specialized models. Multi-teacher knowledge distillation offers a path toward consolidating these capabilities into a single agglomerative backbone, but existing approaches assume a fixed set of teachers, and incorporating a new teacher requires repeating expensive joint distillation over the entire teacher set. We introduce GRAFT, a continual multi-teacher distillation framework that enables a unified backbone to progressively acquire capabilities from an open-ended sequence of foundation models. When a new teacher arrives, GRAFT treats the previously distilled model as a teacher for preserving learned capabilities, while the current student jointly learns from both the previous model and the incoming teacher. Furthermore, to reconcile the incompatible representation geometries of heterogeneous teachers, we introduce Teacher Specific Readout Tokens, which grant each teacher an independent read-out of the shared encoder, together with Geometry Agnostic Relational Loss that aligns a vision-language teacher by matching image-text similarity structures rather than raw feature values. We provide GRAFT model, which is a single, continually extensible backbone that unifies five domains, including image understanding, 2D dense prediction, 3D human pose estimation, 3D vision, and vision-language, delivering strong performance across all of them while acquiring each new capability at the cost of a single distillation rather than a full re-distillation.

AI.tldr: GRAFT 是一个持续多教师蒸馏框架，使统一骨干网络能够按顺序从开放式的新基础模型中不断获取能力，无需对全部教师集合重新联合蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型（如 DINOv2、SigLIP2、MASt3R）因预训练目标不同而具备互补能力，但知识分散在各自独立的模型中；现有联合多教师蒸馏假设教师集合固定，加入新教师需对整个教师集合重做昂贵蒸馏。
AI.method: 提出 GRAFT 持续多教师蒸馏框架：新教师到来时，将此前蒸馏得到的模型作为教师以保留已有能力，学生同时向旧模型与新教师学习；针对异构教师表示几何不兼容问题，引入 Teacher Specific Readout Tokens，为每个教师提供共享编码器的独立读出，并提出 Geometry Agnostic Relational Loss，通过匹配图文相似度结构而非原始特征值来对齐视觉-语言教师。
AI.result: GRAFT 模型是单一且可持续扩展的骨干网络，统一了图像理解、2D 稠密预测、3D 人体姿态估计、3D 视觉与视觉-语言五个领域，并在所有领域均取得较强性能；每获取一项新能力的代价仅为一次蒸馏，而非完整重新蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT 实现了开放式序列下的持续多教师知识整合，为构建可增量扩展的统一视觉基础骨干提供了高效可行方案，避免了固定教师集合假设带来的重复联合蒸馏开销。
